0290:             detected.append({

0292:                 'relay_gpio': cc['relay_gpio'],
0293:                 'port':       port,
0294:                 'symlink':    symlink,
0295:             })

0384:         cfg.setdefault("mode", mode)
0385:         cfg.setdefault("forward_interval_s", 300)
0386:         cfg.setdefault("max_events_per_batch", 200 if mode == "lab" else 50)
0387:         cfg.setdefault("journal_units", ["timelapse-edge.service"])
0388:         cfg.setdefault("min_severity", "info" if mode == "lab" else "warning")
0389:         return cfg
0390: 
0391:     @staticmethod
0392:     def _severity_rank(level: str) -> int:
0393:         return {"debug": 0, "info": 1, "warning": 2, "error": 3, "critical": 4}.get(level.lower(), 1)
0394: 
0395:     @staticmethod
0396:     def _journal_priority_to_severity(priority: str | int | None) -> str:
0397:         try:
0398:             p = int(priority)
0399:         except Exception:
0400:             return "info"
0401:         if p <= 2:
0402:             return "critical"
0403:         if p == 3:
0404:             return "error"
0405:         if p == 4:
0406:             return "warning"
0407:         return "info"
0408: 
0409:     @staticmethod
0410:     def _parse_python_log_message(message: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
0411:         match = re.match(
0412:             r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s+([A-Z]+)\s+([^\s]+)\s+(.*)$",
0413:             message or "",
0414:         )
0415:         if not match:
0416:             return None, message
0417:         return match.group(2), match.group(3)
0418: 
0419:     def _forward_siem_logs(self, force: bool = False) -> None:
0420:         """Forward selected systemd journal lines to Headend SIEM according to policy."""
0421:         cfg = self._siem_cfg()
0422:         if not cfg.get("enabled", True):
0423:             return
0424:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0425:         interval_s = int(cfg.get("forward_interval_s", 300))
0426:         if not force and (now - self._last_siem_forward).total_seconds() < interval_s:
0427:             return
0428:         self._last_siem_forward = now
0429: 
0430:         min_sev = str(cfg.get("min_severity", "warning")).lower()
0431:         max_events = max(1, int(cfg.get("max_events_per_batch", 100)))
0432:         units = cfg.get("journal_units") or ["timelapse-edge.service"]
0433: 
0434:         cmd = ["journalctl", "--no-pager", "-o", "json", "--show-cursor"]
0435:         cursor = None
0436:         try:
0437:             if self._siem_cursor_path.exists():
0438:                 cursor = self._siem_cursor_path.read_text().strip()
0439:         except Exception:
0440:             cursor = None
0441:         if cursor:
0442:             cmd += ["--after-cursor", cursor]
0443:         else:
0444:             since_s = int(cfg.get("initial_since_minutes", 10))
0445:             cmd += ["--since", f"{since_s} minutes ago"]
0446:         for unit in units:
0447:             cmd += ["-u", str(unit)]
0448:         cmd += ["-n", str(max_events)]
0449: 
0450:         try:
0451:             result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
0452:         except Exception as exc:
0453:             log.debug("SIEM journal read failed: %s", exc)
0454:             return
0455:         if result.returncode != 0:
0456:             log.debug("SIEM journal read rc=%s stderr=%s", result.returncode, result.stderr[:200])
0457:             return
0458: 
0459:         events: list[dict] = []
0460:         latest_cursor = cursor
0461:         for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
0462:             if line.startswith("-- cursor:"):
0463:                 latest_cursor = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
0464:                 continue
0465:             try:
0466:                 row = json.loads(line)
0467:             except Exception:
0468:                 continue
0469:             latest_cursor = row.get("__CURSOR") or latest_cursor
0470:             message = row.get("MESSAGE", "")
0471:             if not message or "/siem/events/" in message or "SIEM journal" in message:
0472:                 continue
0473:             severity = self._journal_priority_to_severity(row.get("PRIORITY"))
0474:             logger_name, clean_message = self._parse_python_log_message(message)
0475:             if logger_name:
0476:                 level_match = re.match(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\s+([A-Z]+)", message)
0477:                 if level_match:
0478:                     severity = level_match.group(1).lower()
0479:                     if severity == "warn":
0480:                         severity = "warning"
0481:             if self._severity_rank(severity) < self._severity_rank(min_sev):
0482:                 continue
0483:             ts_raw = row.get("__REALTIME_TIMESTAMP")
0484:             occurred = now
0485:             try:
0486:                 occurred = datetime.fromtimestamp(int(ts_raw) / 1_000_000, tz=timezone.utc)
0487:             except Exception:
0488:                 pass
0489:             events.append({
0490:                 "event_type": "log",
0491:                 "severity": severity,
0492:                 "category": "edge_journal",
0493:                 "source": "edge_journal",
0494:                 "logger": logger_name,
0495:                 "process": row.get("SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER") or row.get("_COMM"),
0496:                 "raw_message": clean_message or message,
0497:                 "occurred_at": occurred.isoformat(),
0498:             })
0499: 
0500:         if not events:
0501:             if latest_cursor and latest_cursor != cursor:
0502:                 try:
0503:                     self._siem_cursor_path.write_text(latest_cursor)
0504:                 except Exception:
0505:                     pass
0506:             return
0507:         ok, data = self._api.send_siem_events(events)
0508:         if ok:
0509:             try:
0510:                 if latest_cursor:
0511:                     self._siem_cursor_path.write_text(latest_cursor)
0512:             except Exception:
0513:                 pass
0514:             log.info(
0515:                 "SIEM journal forward complete: events=%d inserted=%s duplicates=%s min_severity=%s mode=%s",
0516:                 len(events),
0517:                 (data or {}).get("inserted"),
0518:                 (data or {}).get("duplicates"),
0519:                 min_sev,
0520:                 cfg.get("mode"),
0521:             )
0522: 
0523:     def _check_camera_profile_known(self, context: str) -> None:
0524:         if not hasattr(self._driver, "get_profile_summary"):
0525:             return
0526:         try:
0527:             profile = self._driver.get_profile_summary()
0528:         except Exception:
0529:             return
0530:         if profile.get("profile_key") == "default":
0531:             model = profile.get("detected_model", "Unknown")
0532:             if model and model != "Unknown":
0533:                 self._emit_siem_event(
0534:                     "camera_profile_missing",
0535:                     "CRITICAL",
0536:                     f"Camera '{model}' detected without a specific TimeLapse Pro camera profile",
0537:                     details={"model": model, "context": context, "profile": profile},
0538:                     min_interval_s=86400,
0539:                 )
0540: 
0541:     def _capture_single_camera(self, cam, dest_dir, results, idx):
0542:         from camera.registry import get_driver as _get_driver
0543:         device_id = cam['device_id']
0544:         log.info("Thread %s port %s", device_id, cam['port'])
0545:         cam_cfg = dict(self._cfg)
0546:         cam_cfg['camera'] = dict(self._cfg.get('camera', {}))
0547:         cam_cfg['camera']['gphoto2_port'] = cam['port']
0548:         cam_cfg['device'] = dict(self._cfg.get('device', {}))
0549:         cam_cfg['device']['device_id'] = device_id
0550:         try:
0551:             driver = _get_driver(cam_cfg)
0552:             driver.connect()
0553:             commands = self._build_camera_commands()
0554:             if commands:
0555:                 driver.apply_initial_commands(commands)
0556:             result = driver.capture_image(dest_dir)
0557:             driver.disconnect()
0558:             quality = self._quality.check(result.filepath, result.sha256)
0559:             capture_id = self._db.insert_capture(
0560:                 device_id=device_id, filepath=result.filepath,
0561:                 sha256=result.sha256, captured_at=result.timestamp,
0562:                 camera_model=result.camera_model, driver_name=result.driver_name,
0563:                 filesize=result.filesize, exposure_time=result.exposure_time,
0564:                 aperture=result.aperture, iso=result.iso, focus_mode=result.focus_mode,
0565:                 quality_flag=quality.flag.value, quality_passed=quality.passed,
0566:                 blur_score=quality.blur_score, brightness=quality.brightness_mean,
0567:             )
0568:             upload = self._upload_capture_transports(capture_id, result.filepath, device_id)
0569:             results[idx] = {'success': True, 'device_id': device_id, 'upload': upload}
0570:         except Exception as exc:
0571:             log.error("Thread %s fejl: %s", device_id, exc)
0572:             results[idx] = {'success': False, 'device_id': device_id, 'error': str(exc)}
0573: 
0574:     def _do_multi_capture_cycle(self, cameras) -> bool:
0575:         log.info("Multi-burst: %d kameraer", len(cameras))
0576:         relay_gpios = [c['relay_gpio'] for c in cameras]
0577:         for gpio in relay_gpios:
0578:             try: open(f'/sys/class/gpio/gpio{gpio}/value', 'w').write('0')
0579:             except Exception as exc: log.warning("GPIO %d ON: %s", gpio, exc)
0580:         warmup_s = int(self._cfg.get('camera', {}).get('relay_on_seconds_before', 10))
0581:         log.info("Warmup %ds…", warmup_s)
0582:         time.sleep(warmup_s)
0583:         dest_dir = self._buffer.path
0584:         results  = [None] * len(cameras)
0585:         threads  = [threading.Thread(target=self._capture_single_camera,
0586:             args=(cam, dest_dir, results, idx), daemon=True)
0587:             for idx, cam in enumerate(cameras)]
0588:         log.info("Start %d threads simultant…", len(threads))
0589:         for t in threads: t.start()
0590:         for t in threads: t.join(timeout=120)
0591:         settle_s = int(self._cfg.get('camera', {}).get('relay_off_seconds_after', 5))
0592:         time.sleep(settle_s)
0593:         for gpio in relay_gpios:
0594:             try: open(f'/sys/class/gpio/gpio{gpio}/value', 'w').write('1')
0595:             except Exception as exc: log.warning("GPIO %d OFF: %s", gpio, exc)
0596:         ok  = sum(1 for r in results if r and r.get('success'))
0597:         err = sum(1 for r in results if r and not r.get('success'))
0598:         log.info("Burst: %d OK, %d fejl", ok, err)
0599:         self._send_heartbeat()
0600:         self._sync_captures()
0601:         return ok > 0
0602: 
0603:     def _load_camera_features(self) -> None:
0604:         """Detect camera capabilities for this session."""
0605:         try:
0606:             self._camera_power_on("feature detection")
0607:             self._driver.connect()
0608:             self._check_camera_profile_known("feature_detection")
0609:             self._has_autofocus = self._driver.supports_autofocus()
0610:             self._has_refocus   = self._driver.supports_remote_focus()
0611:             self._driver.disconnect()
0612:             self._camera_power_off("feature detection")
0613:             log.info(
0614:                 "Camera features: autofocus=%s remote_focus=%s",
0615:                 self._has_autofocus, self._has_refocus
0616:             )
0617:         except Exception as exc:
0618:             log.warning("Could not detect camera features: %s", exc)
0619:             self._emit_siem_event(
0620:                 "camera_detection_failed",
0621:                 "ERROR",
0622:                 f"Could not detect camera features: {exc}",
0623:                 details={"context": "feature_detection", "power_mode": self._camera_power_mode()},
0624:             )
0625:             self._has_autofocus = False
0626:             self._has_refocus   = False
0627: 
0628:     # ── Main tick ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0629: 
0630:     def _tick(self, mode: str) -> None:
0631:         """
0632:         One iteration of the main loop:
0633:           - Check if it's time to capture
0634:           - If yes: do capture cycle
0635:           - Check if heartbeat is due
0636:           - Sleep or suspend until next event
0637:         """
0638:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0639: 
0640:         # Periodic config re-pull (every 6 hours)
0641:         config_interval = timedelta(minutes=int(
0642:             self._cfg.get("diagnostics", {}).get("config_poll_interval_minutes", 5)
0643:         ))
0644:         if now - self._last_config_pull > config_interval:
0645:             self._pull_config()
0646:             # Tjek om headend har bedt om en opdatering
0647:             self._check_update()
0648: 
0649:         # Check capture schedule
0650:         capture_due = self._should_capture(now, mode)
0651:         if capture_due:
0652:             node_cameras = self._cfg.get('node_cameras', [])
0653:             multi_mode   = self._cfg.get('multi_camera_mode', 'single')
0654:             if node_cameras and multi_mode in ('auto_bootstrap', 'manual'):
0655:                 cameras = self._discover_cameras()
0656:                 if len(cameras) > 1:
0657:                     self._do_multi_capture_cycle(cameras)
0658:                 else:
0659:                     log.info("Kun %d kamera fundet — single mode", len(cameras))
0660:                     self._do_capture_cycle()
0661:             else:
0662:                 self._do_capture_cycle()
0663: 
0664:         # Upload pending large files only inside the Headend-assigned slot.
0665:         # This runs after capture checks so upload backlog cannot delay capture.
0666:         self._retry_pending_uploads_if_slot()
0667: 
0668:         # Heartbeat (every 60 minutes)
0669:         heartbeat_interval = timedelta(minutes=int(
0670:             self._cfg.get("diagnostics", {}).get("heartbeat_interval_minutes", 60)
0671:         ))
0672:         if now - self._last_heartbeat > heartbeat_interval:
0673:             self._send_heartbeat()
0674:             self._sync_captures()
0675: 
0676:         self._forward_siem_logs()
0677: 
0678:         # Calculate sleep until next event
0679:         sleep_s = self._seconds_until_next_event(now, mode)
0680: 
0681:         if sleep_s > 60:
0682:             log.info("Sleeping %ds until next capture…", sleep_s)
0683:         self._stop_event.wait(min(sleep_s, 60))   # wake at least every 60s to check signals
0684: 
0685:     # ── Capture cycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0686: 
0687:     def _do_capture_cycle(self) -> bool:
0688:         """
0689:         Full capture cycle:
0690:           Power on → Connect → Configure → Capture → Quality check
0691:           → Store → Upload → Power off
0692: 
0693:         Returns True on success, False on failure.
0694:         """
0695:         log.info("─── Starting capture cycle ───")
0696:         success = False
0697: 
0698:         try:
0699:             # 1. Power camera on and connect
0700:             self._camera_power_on("capture cycle")
0701:             try:
0702:                 self._driver.connect()
0703:                 self._check_camera_profile_known("capture_cycle")
0704:             except Exception as exc:
0705:                 log.error("Camera connect failed: %s", exc)
0706:                 self._emit_siem_event(
0707:                     "camera_detection_failed",
0708:                     "ERROR",
0709:                     f"Camera connect failed: {exc}",
0710:                     details={"context": "capture_cycle", "power_mode": self._camera_power_mode()},
0711:                 )
0712:                 self._db.log_event(
0713:                     self._device_id, "ERROR", "camera",
0714:                     f"Camera connect failed: {exc}"
0715:                 )
0716:                 return False
0717: 
0718:             # 2. Apply configuration commands
0719:             #    Byg commands fra camera config_overrides (hierarkisk model)
0720:             #    Override erstatter initial_commands for de parametre der er sat
0721:             commands = self._build_camera_commands()
0722:             if commands:
0723:                 log.info("Applying %d camera commands", len(commands))
0724:                 failed = self._driver.apply_initial_commands(commands)
0725:                 if failed:
0726:                     log.warning("Some camera commands failed: %s", failed)
0727:                 else:
0728:                     log.info("Camera commands applied OK")
0729: 
0730:             # 3. Health check before capture
0731:             if not self._driver.health_check():
0732:                 log.error("Camera health check failed — aborting capture")
0733:                 self._db.log_event(
0734:                     self._device_id, "ERROR", "camera",
0735:                     "Health check failed before capture"
0736:                 )
0737:                 return False
0738: 
0739:             # 4. Capture image — wait for precise moment if fixed mode
0740:             schedule = self._cfg.get("schedule", {})
0741:             if schedule.get("capture_mode") == "fixed":
0742:                 from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
0743:                 import time as _time
0744:                 tz_name   = schedule.get("timezone", "UTC")
0745:                 tz        = ZoneInfo(tz_name)
0746:                 now_local = datetime.now(tz)
0747:                 for t_str in schedule.get("capture_times", []):
0748:                     try:
0749:                         h, m   = map(int, t_str.split(":"))
0750:                         target = now_local.replace(hour=h, minute=m, second=0, microsecond=0)
0751:                         diff   = (target - now_local).total_seconds()
0752:                         if -5 < diff < 30:
0753:                             if diff > 0:
0754:                                 log.info("Precise wait %.2fs before trigger at %s", diff, t_str)
0755:                                 _time.sleep(diff)
0756:                             break
0757:                     except Exception:
0758:                         pass
0759:             dest_dir = self._buffer.path
0760:             try:
0761:                 result = self._driver.capture_image(dest_dir)
0762:             except Exception as exc:
0763:                 log.error("Capture failed: %s", exc)
0764:                 self._db.log_event(
0765:                     self._device_id, "ERROR", "capture", f"Capture error: {exc}"
0766:                 )
0767:                 return False
0768: 
0769:             log.info(
0770:                 "Captured: %s (%.1f MB) sha256=%s…",
0771:                 result.filepath.name,
0772:                 result.filesize / 1e6,
0773:                 result.sha256[:12]
0774:             )
0775: 
0776:             # 5. Quality check
0777:             quality = self._quality.check(result.filepath, None)  # sha256 pre-XMP — skip disk re-verify
0778:             if not quality.passed:
0779:                 log.warning("Quality FAILED: %s — %s", result.filepath.name, quality.message)
0780:             else:
0781:                 log.info("Quality OK: %s", quality.message)
0782: 
0783:             # 6. Store in DB
0784:             capture_id = self._db.insert_capture(
0785:                 device_id    = self._device_id,
0786:                 filepath     = result.filepath,
0787:                 sha256       = result.sha256,
0788:                 captured_at  = result.timestamp,
0789:                 camera_model = result.camera_model,
0790:                 driver_name  = result.driver_name,
0791:                 filesize     = result.filesize,
0792:                 exposure_time= result.exposure_time,
0793:                 aperture     = result.aperture,
0794:                 iso          = result.iso,
0795:                 focus_mode   = result.focus_mode,
0796:                 quality_flag = quality.flag.value,
0797:                 quality_passed=quality.passed,
0798:                 blur_score   = quality.blur_score,
0799:                 brightness   = quality.brightness_mean,
0800:             )
0801: 
0802:             # 7. Enforce circular buffer BEFORE upload (free space first)
0803:             self._buffer.enforce(self._db)
0804: 
0805:             # 8. Upload — report connectivity result. Capture timing is not
0806:             # delayed by upload slots; files are queued locally if outside slot.
0807:             camera_id      = self._cfg.get("device", {}).get("device_id", "unknown")
0808:             upload_results = self._upload_capture_transports(capture_id, result.filepath, camera_id)
0809:             log.info("Upload results: %s", upload_results)
0810: 
0811:             if upload_results.get("primary"):
0812:                 self._connectivity.report_success()
0813:             else:
0814:                 self._connectivity.report_failure()
0815: 
0816:             # Camera diagnostics while the camera is still awake
0817:             # Disconnect driver first to free gphoto2 USB connection
0818:             try:
0819:                 self._driver.disconnect()
0820:             except Exception:
0821:                 pass
0822:             try:
0823:                 cam_model = self._cfg.get("camera", {}).get("model", "")
0824:                 # Byg expected_config fra den hierarkiske command liste
0825:                 # så drift-check sammenligner med den faktiske config vi sætter
0826:                 expected: dict[str, str] = {}
0827:                 for cmd in self._build_camera_commands():
0828:                     if "=" in cmd:
0829:                         k, v = cmd.split("=", 1)
0830:                         expected[k.strip()] = v.strip()
0831:                 self._last_cam_diag = collect_camera_diagnostics(cam_model, expected)
0832:                 log.info("Camera diagnostics collected: battery=%s shutter=%s drift=%s",
0833:                     self._last_cam_diag.get("camera_status", {}).get("battery_pct"),
0834:                     self._last_cam_diag.get("camera_status", {}).get("shutter_count"),
0835:                     len(self._last_cam_diag.get("camera_config_drift", [])))
0836:                 if self._last_cam_diag.get("camera_config_drift"):
0837:                     log.warning("Camera config drift: %s",
0838:                         [d["param"] for d in self._last_cam_diag["camera_config_drift"]])
0839:                 if self._last_cam_diag.get("shutter_alarm"):
0840:                     log.warning("Shutter alarm: %.1f%% of rated life",
0841:                         self._last_cam_diag["shutter_pct"])
0842:             except Exception as cam_exc:
0843:                 log.warning("Camera diagnostics failed: %s", cam_exc)
0844: 
0845:             # Send heartbeat immediately after capture with fresh camera diagnostics
0846:             self._send_heartbeat()
0847:             self._sync_captures()
0848:             success = True
0849: 
0850:         except Exception as exc:
0851:             log.exception("Unexpected error in capture cycle: %s", exc)
0852:             self._db.log_event(
0853:                 self._device_id, "ERROR", "capture",
0854:                 f"Unexpected capture cycle error: {exc}"
0855:             )
0856:         finally:
0857:             # Always disconnect and power off, even on error
0858:             try:
0859:                 self._driver.disconnect()
0860:             except Exception:
0861:                 pass
0862:             self._camera_power_off("capture cycle")
0863: 
0864:         log.info("─── Capture cycle complete (success=%s) ───", success)
0865:         return success
0866: 
0867:     # ── Scheduling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0868: 
0869:     def _should_capture(self, now: datetime, mode: str) -> bool:
0870:         """Return True if relay should power ON now (warmup-adjusted)."""
0871:         schedule = self._cfg.get("schedule", {})
0872:         warmup_s = self._camera_warmup_seconds()
0873:         lead_s   = warmup_s + 3
0874:         active_hours = schedule.get("active_hours")
0875:         if active_hours and len(active_hours) == 2:
0876:             tz_name   = schedule.get("timezone", "UTC")
0877:             local_now = self._to_local(now, tz_name)
0878:             start_t   = self._parse_time(active_hours[0])
0879:             end_t     = self._parse_time(active_hours[1])
0880:             if not (start_t <= local_now.time() <= end_t):
0881:                 return False
0882:         if mode == "interval":
0883:             interval_s   = int(schedule.get("interval_minutes", 60)) * 60
0884:             epoch_s      = int(now.timestamp())
0885:             pos_in_cycle = epoch_s % interval_s
0886:             return (interval_s - pos_in_cycle) <= lead_s
0887:         if mode == "fixed":
0888:             tz_name   = schedule.get("timezone", "UTC")
0889:             local_now = self._to_local(now, tz_name)
0890:             for t_str in schedule.get("capture_times", []):
0891:                 try:
0892:                     h, m   = map(int, t_str.split(":"))
0893:                     target = local_now.replace(hour=h, minute=m, second=0, microsecond=0)
0894:                     diff   = (target - local_now).total_seconds()
0895:                     if lead_s - 2 <= diff <= lead_s + 2:
0896:                         return True
0897:                 except Exception:
0898:                     pass
0899:         return False
0900: 
0901:     def _seconds_until_next_event(self, now: datetime, mode: str) -> int:
0902:         """Calculate seconds until next capture or heartbeat."""
0903:         schedule      = self._cfg.get("schedule", {})
0904:         warmup_s      = self._camera_warmup_seconds()
0905:         lead_s        = warmup_s + 3
0906:         heartbeat_min = int(self._cfg.get("diagnostics", {}).get("heartbeat_interval_minutes", 60))
0907:         if mode == "interval":
0908:             interval_s   = int(schedule.get("interval_minutes", 60)) * 60
0909:             epoch_s      = int(now.timestamp())
0910:             pos_in_cycle = epoch_s % interval_s
0911:             until_capture = max(1, interval_s - pos_in_cycle - lead_s)
0912:         elif mode == "fixed":
0913:             tz_name   = schedule.get("timezone", "UTC")
0914:             local_now = self._to_local(now, tz_name)
0915:             min_secs  = 3600
0916:             for t_str in schedule.get("capture_times", []):
0917:                 try:
0918:                     h, m   = map(int, t_str.split(":"))
0919:                     target = local_now.replace(hour=h, minute=m, second=0, microsecond=0)
0920:                     diff   = (target - local_now).total_seconds() - lead_s
0921:                     if diff < 0:
0922:                         diff += 86400
0923:                     min_secs = min(min_secs, diff)
0924:                 except Exception:
0925:                     pass
0926:             until_capture = max(1, int(min_secs))
0927:         else:
0928:             until_capture = int(self._cfg.get("system", {}).get("min_sleep_s", 60))
0929:         elapsed_heartbeat = (now - self._last_heartbeat).total_seconds()
0930:         until_heartbeat   = max(1, heartbeat_min * 60 - elapsed_heartbeat)
0931:         return int(min(until_capture, until_heartbeat))
0932:

0935:     def _pull_config(self) -> None:
0936:         """Fetch and apply updated config from headend."""
0937:         old_version = self._cfg.get("config_version", "")
0938:         ok, data = self._api.fetch_config()
0939:         if ok and data:
0940:             try:
0941:                 self._api.ensure_signing_enrolled(data.get("security", {}))
0942:                 new_version = data.get("config_version", "")
0943:                 self._cfg_mgr.save_config(data)
0944:                 self._cfg = self._cfg_mgr.load()
0945:                 self._uploader.update_config(data)
0946: 
0947:                 if new_version != old_version:
0948:                     log.info("Config version ændret %s→%s — anvender live", old_version[:8], new_version[:8])
0949:                     self._apply_config_changes(data)
0950:                 else:
0951:                     log.debug("Config uændret — ingen live apply nødvendig")
0952:             except Exception as exc:
0953:                 log.warning("Could not apply headend config: %s", exc)
0954:         else:
0955:             log.info("Config pull failed — using cached config")
0956:         self._last_config_pull = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

0958:     def _apply_config_changes(self, data: dict) -> None:
0959:         """Anvend config-ændringer live uden genstart."""
0960:         # SSH tunnel
0961:         try:
0962:             if hasattr(self, "_tunnel") and self._tunnel:
0963:                 tunnel_cfg = data.get("ssh_tunnel", {})
0964:                 self._tunnel.apply_config(tunnel_cfg)
0965:                 log.info("SSH tunnel config anvendt live")
0966:         except Exception as exc:
0967:             log.warning("SSH tunnel live apply fejl: %s", exc)
0968: 
0969:         # Lab mode
0970:         try:
0971:             debug_cfg = data.get("debug_mode", {})
0972:             lab_now = debug_cfg.get("enabled", False)
0973:             if lab_now:
0974:                 log.info("Lab mode aktiveret via config-ændring")
0975:             else:
0976:                 log.info("Lab mode deaktiveret via config-ændring")
0977:         except Exception as exc:
0978:             log.warning("Lab mode live apply fejl: %s", exc)
0979: 
0980:         # Capture interval (træder i kraft ved næste søvncyklus)
0981:         try:
0982:             interval = self._cfg.get("schedule", {}).get("interval_minutes")
0983:             if interval:
0984:                 log.info("Capture interval opdateret til %s min", interval)
0985:         except Exception:
0986:             pass

0988:     def _build_camera_commands(self) -> list[str]:
0989:         """Byg kamera kommandoliste fra hierarkisk config.
0990: 
0991:         Starter med initial_commands fra device_config (bagud-kompatibilitet),
0992:         derefter overskrives parametre fra camera.* overrides (kamera-laget).
0993: 
0994:         Mapping fra config nøgle til gphoto2 parameter navn:
0995:           camera.iso           → imgsettings/iso
0996:           camera.shutter_speed → capturesettings/shutterspeed
0997:           camera.aperture      → capturesettings/aperture
0998:           camera.whitebalance  → imgsettings/whitebalance
0999:         """
1000:         # Start med baseline initial_commands fra device_config
1001:         commands: list[str] = list(
1002:             self._cfg.get("camera", {}).get("initial_commands", [])
1003:         )
1004:         if hasattr(self._driver, "normalize_initial_commands"):
1005:             commands = self._driver.normalize_initial_commands(commands)
1006: 
1007:         # Mapping: config nøgle → gphoto2 parameter navn
1008:         PARAM_MAP = {
1009:             "iso":          "iso",
1010:             "shutter_speed": "shutterspeed",
1011:             "aperture":     "aperture",
1012:             "whitebalance": "whitebalance",
1013:             "picturestyle": "picturestyle",
1014:             "colorspace":   "colorspace",
1015:             "imageformat":  "imageformat",
1016:             "meteringmode": "meteringmode",
1017:             "exposurecompensation": "exposurecompensation",
1018:         }
1019: 
1020:         cam_cfg = self._cfg.get("camera", {})
1021:         for cfg_key, gphoto_key in PARAM_MAP.items():
1022:             value = cam_cfg.get(cfg_key)
1023:             if value is None:
1024:                 continue
1025:             if hasattr(self._driver, "build_config_command"):
1026:                 new_cmd = self._driver.build_config_command(cfg_key, str(value))
1027:                 if not new_cmd:
1028:                     log.info("Config override skipped by camera profile: %s=%s", cfg_key, value)
1029:                     continue
1030:                 prefix = new_cmd.split("=", 1)[0] + "="
1031:             else:
1032:                 prefix = f"{gphoto_key}="
1033:                 new_cmd = f"{gphoto_key}={value}"
1034:             # Erstat eksisterende kommando eller tilføj ny
1035:             replaced = False
1036:             for i, cmd in enumerate(commands):
1037:                 if cmd.startswith(prefix):
1038:                     if commands[i] != new_cmd:
1039:                         log.info("Config override: %s → %s (var: %s)", gphoto_key, value, cmd)
1040:                         commands[i] = new_cmd
1041:                     replaced = True
1042:                     break
1043:             if not replaced:
1044:                 commands.append(new_cmd)
1045:                 log.info("Config override: %s=%s (ny)", gphoto_key, value)
1046: 
1047:         return commands
1048: 
1049:     def _check_update(self) -> None:
1050:         """Legacy LAB-only git update path.
1051: 
1052:         Production updates must be distributed by Headend as signed artifacts.
1053:         """
1054:         import subprocess, os
1055:         update_requested = self._cfg.get("update_requested", False)
1056:         if not update_requested:
1057:             return
1058:         legacy_enabled = (
1059:             self._cfg.get("legacy_git_update_enabled") is True
1060:             or os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_ENABLE_LEGACY_GIT_UPDATE") == "1"
1061:         )
1062:         if not legacy_enabled:
1063:             log.warning(
1064:                 "Legacy git update_requested ignoreret; Headend artifact update er påkrævet"
1065:             )
1066:             try:
1067:                 self._api._post(f"/admin/devices/{self._device_id}/clear-update", {})
1068:             except Exception:
1069:                 pass
1070:             return
1071:         debug_cfg = self._cfg.get("debug_mode", {})
1072:         if debug_cfg.get("enabled"):
1073:             log.info("Opdatering anmodet men LAB mode aktiv — springer over")
1074:             return
1075:         version = self._cfg.get("update_version", "unknown")
1076:         log.info("Opdatering anmodet — version %s", version)
1077:         repo = "/opt/timelapse"
1078:         try:
1079:             git = "/usr/bin/git"
1080:             import os
1081:             env = os.environ.copy()
1082:             env["HOME"] = "/home/orangepi"
1083:             env["GIT_CONFIG_COUNT"] = "1"
1084:             env["GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0"] = "safe.directory"
1085:             env["GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0"] = "*"
1086:             # Fetch
1087:             r = subprocess.run([git, "-C", repo, "fetch", "origin", "main", "--quiet"],
1088:                                capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
1089:             if r.returncode != 0:
1090:                 log.warning("Opdatering fetch fejlede: %s", r.stderr.strip())
1091:                 return
1092:             # Check versions
1093:             current = subprocess.check_output([git, "-C", repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], env=env).decode().strip()
1094:             remote  = subprocess.check_output([git, "-C", repo, "rev-parse", "origin/main"], env=env).decode().strip()
1095:             if current == remote:
1096:                 log.info("Edge allerede opdateret — nulstiller update_requested flag")
1097:                 try:
1098:                     self._api._post(f"/admin/devices/{self._device_id}/clear-update", {})
1099:                 except Exception:
1100:                     pass
1101:                 return
1102:             log.info("Opdaterer edge: %s → %s", current[:7], remote[:7])
1103:             # Pull
1104:             subprocess.run([git, "-C", repo, "pull", "origin", "main", "--quiet"], env=env)
1105:             subprocess.run(["find", f"{repo}/edge", "-name", "__pycache__",
1106:                            "-exec", "rm", "-rf", "{}", "+"])
1107:             log.info("Opdatering OK — genstarter timelapse-edge")
1108:             subprocess.run(["systemctl", "restart", "timelapse-edge"])
1109:         except Exception as exc:
1110:             log.warning("Opdatering fejl: %s", exc)

1114:     def _check_and_apply_updates(self) -> None:
1115:         """Tjek om der er godkendte opdateringer og eksekvér dem."""
1116:         log.info("Update-check: starter...")
1117:         try:
1118:             ok, policy = self._api._get(f"/updates/policy/{self._device_id}")
1119:             if not ok or not policy:
1120:                 return
1121:             pending = policy.get("pending_updates", [])
1122:             if not pending:
1123:                 return
1124: 
1125:             for update in pending:
1126:                 uid    = update["id"]
1127:                 utype  = update["update_type"]
1128:                 status = update["status"]
1129: 
1130:                 if status == "rollback_requested":
1131:                     log.info("Rollback anmodet for opdatering %d (%s)", uid, utype)
1132:                     self._run_rollback(uid)
1133:                     return
1134: 
1135:                 if status == "approved":
1136:                     ok, reason = verify_update_artifact(update, self._cfg.get("security", {}))
1137:                     if not ok:
1138:                         log.error("Opdatering %d afvist af Edge trust policy: %s", uid, reason)
1139:                         self._api._post("/updates/report", {
1140:                             "update_id": uid,
1141:                             "status": "rolled_back",
1142:                             "reason": f"artifact_verification_failed: {reason}",
1143:                         })
1144:                         return
1145:                     log.info("Udfører opdatering %d: %s", uid, utype)
1146:                     self._run_update(uid, utype, update.get("artifact"))
1147:                     return  # Ét ad gangen
1148: 
1149:         except Exception as e:
1150:             log.warning("Update-check fejl: %s", e, exc_info=True)
1151: 
1152:     def _run_update(self, update_id: int, update_type: str, artifact: dict | None = None) -> None:
1153:         """Kør opdatering baseret på type og rapportér resultat."""
1154:         import subprocess as _sp, os as _os
1155: 
1156:         if update_type in ("os_security", "os_updates"):
1157:             log.warning(
1158:                 "OS update %d afvist: Edge må ikke køre apt-get upgrade; "
1159:                 "OS updates skal leveres som Headend-signeret offline artifact",
1160:                 update_id,
1161:             )
1162:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {
1163:                 "update_id": update_id,
1164:                 "status": "rolled_back",
1165:                 "reason": "os_update_requires_headend_signed_offline_artifact",
1166:             })
1167:             return
1168:         else:
1169:             if artifact:
1170:                 self._run_artifact_app_update(update_id, artifact)
1171:                 return
1172:             if _os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_ENABLE_LEGACY_GIT_UPDATE") != "1":
1173:                 log.warning("App update %d afvist: legacy git update er slået fra", update_id)
1174:                 self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1175:                 return
1176:             # LAB-only app opdateringer via git pull (edge_update.sh)
1177:             script = Path("/opt/timelapse/deploy/edge_update.sh")
1178:             if not script.exists():
1179:                 log.warning("edge_update.sh ikke fundet")
1180:                 self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1181:                 return
1182:             env = {**_os.environ, "UPDATE_TYPE": update_type, "UPDATE_ID": str(update_id)}
1183:             result = _sp.run(["bash", str(script)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300, env=env)
1184: 
1185:         if result.returncode == 0:
1186:             log.info("Opdatering %d gennemført OK", update_id)
1187:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "deployed"})
1188:         else:
1189:             log.warning("Opdatering %d fejlede (rc=%d)\n%s", update_id, result.returncode, result.stderr[-300:])
1190:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1191: 
1192:     def _run_artifact_app_update(self, update_id: int, artifact: dict) -> None:
1193:         """Installér app-opdatering fra Headend-signeret artifact uden GitHub adgang."""
1194:         import hashlib as _hashlib
1195:         import os as _os
1196:         import shutil as _shutil
1197:         import subprocess as _sp
1198:         import tempfile as _tempfile
1199: 
1200:         artifact_id = artifact.get("artifact_id")
1201:         manifest = artifact.get("manifest") if isinstance(artifact.get("manifest"), dict) else {}
1202:         outputs = [
1203:             item for item in manifest.get("outputs", [])
1204:             if isinstance(item, dict) and str(item.get("path", "")).startswith("edge/")
1205:         ]
1206:         if not artifact_id or not outputs:
1207:             log.warning("App update %d mangler edge artifact outputs", update_id)
1208:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1209:             return
1210: 
1211:         repo = Path("/opt/timelapse")
1212:         staging = Path(_tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tlp-artifact-", dir="/tmp"))
1213:         backup = repo / "prev"
1214:         try:
1215:             log.info("App update %d: henter %d edge-filer fra artifact %s", update_id, len(outputs), artifact_id)
1216:             for item in outputs:
1217:                 rel = str(item["path"])
1218:                 if rel.startswith("/") or ".." in Path(rel).parts:
1219:                     raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe artifact path: {rel}")
1220:                 ok, content = self._api.download_artifact_file(artifact_id, rel)
1221:                 if not ok or content is None:
1222:                     raise RuntimeError(f"download failed: {rel}")
1223:                 actual = _hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
1224:                 if actual != item.get("sha256"):
1225:                     raise RuntimeError(f"sha256 mismatch: {rel}")
1226:                 dest = staging / rel
1227:                 dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1228:                 dest.write_bytes(content)
1229: 
1230:             if backup.exists():
1231:                 _shutil.rmtree(backup)
1232:             for item in outputs:
1233:                 rel = Path(str(item["path"]))
1234:                 source = repo / rel
1235:                 if source.exists():
1236:                     backup_dest = backup / rel
1237:                     backup_dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1238:                     _shutil.copy2(source, backup_dest)
1239: 
1240:             for item in outputs:
1241:                 rel = Path(str(item["path"]))
1242:                 source = staging / rel
1243:                 dest = repo / rel
1244:                 dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1245:                 _shutil.copy2(source, dest)
1246:                 if dest.suffix == ".sh":
1247:                     dest.chmod(dest.stat().st_mode | 0o111)
1248: 
1249:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "deployed"})
1250:             log.info("App update %d installeret fra signeret artifact — genstarter agent", update_id)
1251:             _sp.Popen(["systemctl", "restart", "timelapse-edge"])
1252:         except Exception as exc:
1253:             log.warning("App artifact update %d fejlede: %s", update_id, exc)
1254:             try:
1255:                 if backup.exists():
1256:                     for source in backup.rglob("*"):
1257:                         if source.is_file():
1258:                             rel = source.relative_to(backup)
1259:                             dest = repo / rel
1260:                             dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1261:                             _shutil.copy2(source, dest)
1262:             except Exception as rollback_exc:
1263:                 log.warning("Rollback efter app artifact update fejlede: %s", rollback_exc)
1264:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1265:         finally:
1266:             try:
1267:                 _shutil.rmtree(staging)
1268:             except Exception:
1269:                 pass
1270: 
1271:     def _run_rollback(self, update_id: int) -> None:
1272:         """Tving rollback til forrige version."""
1273:         import subprocess as _sp
1274:         prev = Path("/opt/timelapse/prev")
1275:         if not prev.exists():
1276:             log.warning("Ingen forrige version til rollback")
1277:             self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})
1278:             return
1279:         _sp.run(["bash", "-c", f"cp -r {prev}/* /opt/timelapse/"], timeout=60)
1280:         log.info("Rollback til forrige version gennemført")
1281:         self._api._post("/updates/report", {"update_id": update_id, "status": "rolled_back"})

1283:     def _send_heartbeat(self) -> None:
1284:         """Collect diagnostics and send heartbeat to headend."""
1285:         try:
1286:             diag_data     = self._diag.collect()
1287:             capture_stats = self._db.capture_stats(self._device_id)
1288:             self._db.insert_diagnostics(self._device_id, diag_data)
1289: 
1290:             # Include last camera diagnostics from capture cycle
1291:             if hasattr(self, "_last_cam_diag") and self._last_cam_diag:
1292:                 diag_data["camera"] = self._last_cam_diag
1293: 
1294:             ok, _ = self._api.send_heartbeat(diag_data, capture_stats)
1295:             if ok:
1296:                 log.info("Heartbeat sent OK")
1297:                 self._connectivity.report_success()
1298:                 # Tjek om config er ændret siden sidst
1299:                 hb_version = (_ or {}).get("config_version", "") if isinstance(_, dict) else ""
1300:                 if hb_version and hb_version != self._cfg.get("config_version", ""):
1301:                     log.info("Config version ændret via heartbeat — henter ny config")
1302:                     self._pull_config()
1303:             else:
1304:                 log.warning("Heartbeat failed — headend unreachable")
1305:                 self._connectivity.report_failure()
1306:         except Exception as exc:
1307:             log.warning("Heartbeat error: %s", exc)
1308:             self._connectivity.report_failure()
1309:         finally:
1310:             self._last_heartbeat = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1311:             self._check_and_apply_updates()

1327:     def _upload_capture_transports(self, capture_id: int, filepath: Path, camera_id: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
1328:         """Upload a capture through primary API and optional SFTP destinations."""
1329:         results: dict[str, bool] = {}
1330:         row = self._db.get_capture(capture_id) if capture_id else None
1331:         if row:
1332:             allowed, wait_s, remaining_s = self._upload_slot_state()
1333:             if not allowed:
1334:                 log.info(
1335:                     "API upload deferred by Headend slot: capture_id=%s filename=%s next_slot_in_s=%s",
1336:                     capture_id,
1337:                     filepath.name,
1338:                     wait_s,
1339:                 )
1340:                 results["primary"] = False
1341:                 results["api_primary"] = False
1342:                 return results
1343:             log.info("API upload slot open: remaining_s=%s", remaining_s)
1344:             ok, _ = self._api.upload_capture_files(row, filepath)
1345:             results["primary"] = ok
1346:             results["api_primary"] = ok
1347:             if ok:
1348:                 self._db.mark_uploaded(capture_id, "primary")
1349:         else:
1350:             results["primary"] = False
1351:             results["api_primary"] = False
1352:         sftp_results = self._uploader.upload_capture(capture_id, filepath, camera_id)
1353:         results.update(sftp_results)
1354:         return results

1356:     def _retry_pending_uploads_if_slot(self) -> None:
1357:         allowed, wait_s, remaining_s = self._upload_slot_state()
1358:         if not allowed:
1359:             return
1360:         retried = self._retry_pending_api_uploads()
1361:         if retried:
1362:             log.info("API upload slot processed pending files: count=%d remaining_s=%s", retried, remaining_s)
1363: 
1364:     def _retry_pending_api_uploads(self) -> int:
1365:         """Retry primary API uploads from the local store-and-forward queue."""
1366:         count = 0
1367:         try:
1368:             max_pending = int(
1369:                 self._cfg.get("upload", {})
1370:                 .get("api", {})
1371:                 .get("timeslot", {})
1372:                 .get("max_pending_per_window", 3)
1373:             )
1374:             for row in self._db.get_pending_uploads("primary", limit=max(1, max_pending)):
1375:                 filepath = Path(row["filepath"])
1376:                 if not filepath.exists():
1377:                     continue
1378:                 ok, _ = self._api.upload_capture_files(row, filepath)
1379:                 if ok:
1380:                     self._db.mark_uploaded(row["id"], "primary")
1381:                     count += 1
1382:         except Exception as exc:
1383:             log.warning("API upload retry error: %s", exc)
1384:         return count
1385: 
1386:     def _upload_slot_state(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> tuple[bool, int, int]:
1387:         slot = (
1388:             self._cfg.get("upload", {})
1389:             .get("api", {})
1390:             .get("timeslot", {})
1391:         )
1392:         if not slot or not slot.get("enabled", False):
1393:             return True, 0, 999999
1394:         if not slot.get("enforced", False):
1395:             return True, 0, 999999
1396:         cycle_s = max(1, int(slot.get("cycle_seconds", 600)))
1397:         window_s = max(1, int(slot.get("window_seconds", 90)))
1398:         offset_s = int(slot.get("start_offset_seconds", 0)) % cycle_s
1399:         now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1400:         phase = int(now.timestamp()) % cycle_s
1401:         elapsed = (phase - offset_s) % cycle_s
1402:         if elapsed < window_s:
1403:             return True, 0, window_s - elapsed
1404:         wait_s = (cycle_s - elapsed) % cycle_s
1405:         if wait_s == 0:
1406:             wait_s = cycle_s
1407:         return False, wait_s, 0

1409:     # ── Lab / debug mode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

1411:     def _lab_tick(self, debug_cfg: dict) -> None:
1412:         """
1413:         Lab mode tick — relay stays ON, polls for commands from headend.
1414:         Supports: preview capture, full capture, set-param, relay toggle.
1415:         Poll interval: debug_cfg.config_poll_s (default 1 second).
1416:         """
1417:         poll_s = int(debug_cfg.get("config_poll_s", 1))
1418: 
1419:         # Ensure camera is ready
1420:         if not getattr(self, "_lab_relay_on", False):
1421:             log.info("LAB MODE — preparing camera (power_mode=%s)", self._camera_power_mode())
1422:             self._camera_power_on("lab mode")
1423:             self._lab_relay_on = True
1424:             warmup_s = self._camera_warmup_seconds()
1425:             if warmup_s:
1426:                 time.sleep(warmup_s)
1427:             try:
1428:                 self._driver.connect()
1429:                 commands = self._build_camera_commands()
1430:                 if commands:
1431:                     self._driver.apply_initial_commands(commands)
1432:                 log.info("LAB MODE — camera connected and ready")
1433:                 # Signal til headend at kamera er klar
1434:                 try:
1435:                     self._api._post("/lab/" + self._device_id + "/camera-ready", {"ready": True})
1436:                 except Exception:
1437:                     pass
1438:             except Exception as exc:
1439:                 log.warning("LAB MODE — camera connect failed: %s", exc)
1440: 
1441:         # Pull config for pending commands
1442:         ok, cfg_data = self._api.fetch_config()
1443:         if ok and cfg_data:
1444:             # Check if lab mode has been disabled
1445:             if not cfg_data.get("debug_mode", {}).get("enabled", False):
1446:                 log.info("LAB MODE — disabled from headend, exiting lab mode")
1447:                 try: self._driver.disconnect()
1448:                 except: pass
1449:                 self._camera_power_off("lab disabled", force=True)
1450:                 self._lab_relay_on = False
1451:                 # Save updated config
1452:                 self._cfg_mgr.save_config(cfg_data)
1453:                 self._cfg = self._cfg_mgr.load()
1454:                 self._uploader.update_config(cfg_data)
1455:                 self._last_config_pull = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1456:                 return
1457:             lab_cmd      = cfg_data.get("lab_command", {})
1458:             pending_params = cfg_data.get("pending_params", [])
1459: 
1460:             # Apply pending parameter changes
1461:             for param in pending_params:
1462:                 try:
1463:                     self._driver.set_config(param["key"], param["value"])
1464:                     log.info("LAB — set %s = %s", param["key"], param["value"])
1465:                 except Exception as exc:
1466:                     log.warning("LAB — set_config failed: %s = %s: %s", param["key"], param["value"], exc)
1467:             # Clear pending params on headend
1468:             if pending_params:
1469:                 self._api.clear_lab_params(self._device_id)
1470: 
1471:             # Execute lab command
1472:             cmd_type = lab_cmd.get("type")
1473:             if cmd_type == "preview":
1474:                 self._lab_capture_preview()
1475:                 self._api.clear_lab_command(self._device_id)
1476:             elif cmd_type == "capture":
1477:                 log.info("LAB — full capture requested — disconnecting before cycle")
1478:                 # Disconnect og frigiv kamera INDEN _do_capture_cycle kaldes.
1479:                 # _do_capture_cycle forventer at kameraet IKKE er forbundet —
1480:                 # den laver selv power-mode handling -> connect -> capture -> disconnect.
1481:                 # Dobbelt-connect på et allerede tilsluttet gphoto2-kamera fejler stille.
1482:                 try:
1483:                     self._driver.disconnect()
1484:                 except Exception:
1485:                     pass
1486:                 self._camera_power_off("lab full capture handoff")
1487:                 self._lab_relay_on = False          # tvinger re-init på næste tick
1488:                 self._do_capture_cycle()
1489:                 self._api.clear_lab_command(self._device_id)
1490:                 # _lab_relay_on er allerede False — næste _lab_tick re-initialiserer
1491:                 # relay + connect + camera-ready signal automatisk
1492: 
1493:             elif cmd_type == "get_params":
1494:                 log.info("LAB — fetching all camera params")
1495:                 try:
1496:                     params = self._driver.get_all_config()
1497:                     profile = {}
1498:                     if hasattr(self._driver, "get_profile_summary"):
1499:                         profile = self._driver.get_profile_summary()
1500:                     self._api._post("/lab/" + self._device_id + "/params", {
1501:                         "params": params,
1502:                         "profile": profile,
1503:                     })
1504:                     log.info("LAB — sent %d params to headend", len(params))
1505:                 except Exception as exc:
1506:                     log.warning("LAB — get_params failed: %s", exc)
1507:                 self._api.clear_lab_command(self._device_id)
1508: 
1509:             elif cmd_type == "relay_toggle":
1510:                 relay = lab_cmd.get("relay", "camera")
1511:                 state = lab_cmd.get("state", False)
1512:                 log.info("LAB — relay toggle: %s → %s", relay, "ON" if state else "OFF")
1513:                 try:
1514:                     if relay == "camera":
1515:                         if state:
1516:                             self._relay.camera.power_on()
1517:                         else:
1518:                             self._relay.camera.force_off()
1519:                     elif relay == "modem":
1520:                         if state:
1521:                             self._relay.modem.power_on()
1522:                         else:
1523:                             self._relay.modem.power_cycle(reason="manual OFF")
1524:                 except Exception as exc:
1525:                     log.warning("LAB — relay toggle failed: %s", exc)
1526:                 self._api.clear_lab_command(self._device_id)
1527: 
1528:             elif cmd_type == "wifi_scan":
1529:                 log.info("LAB — WiFi scan")
1530:                 try:
1531:                     from diagnostics.wifi import scan, status, list_saved
1532:                     networks = scan()

1534:                     saved    = list_saved()

1559:             elif cmd_type == "wifi_forget":

1566:                         "type": "forget", "result": result,
1567:                     })
1568:                 except Exception as exc:
1569:                     log.warning("LAB — WiFi forget failed: %s", exc)
1570:                 self._api.clear_lab_command(self._device_id)
1571: 
1572:         time.sleep(poll_s)

1574:     def _lab_capture_preview(self) -> None:

1607:                     sftp = ssh.open_sftp()

1619:                         except FileNotFoundError:

1629:                         except Exception: pass

1631:                         try: ssh.close()
1632:                         except Exception: pass

1638:     def _shutdown(self) -> None:

1640:         tunnel = getattr(self, "_tunnel", None)
1641:         if tunnel is not None:
1642:             try:

1644:             except Exception as exc:

1646:         # Ensure lab relay is OFF if we were in lab mode
1647:         if getattr(self, "_lab_relay_on", False):
1648:             log.info("Shutdown: releasing lab camera")
1649:             try:
1650:                 self._driver.disconnect()
1651:             except Exception:
1652:                 pass
1653:             try:
1654:                 self._camera_power_off("shutdown", force=True)
1655:             except Exception:
1656:                 pass
1657:             self._lab_relay_on = False
1658:         try:
1659:             self._relay.cleanup(camera=self._camera_uses_relay())
1660:         except Exception:
1661:             pass
1662:         self._send_heartbeat()
1663:         log.info("Edge agent stopped.")

1665:     # ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

1667:     @staticmethod
1668:     def _parse_time(t: str):
1669:         """Parse 'HH:MM' string to time object."""
1670:         from datetime import time as dt_time
1671:         h, m = t.split(":")
1672:         return dt_time(int(h), int(m))
1673: 
1674:     @staticmethod
1675:     def _to_local(dt: datetime, tz_name: str) -> datetime:
1676:         """Convert UTC datetime to local timezone."""
1677:         try:
1678:             from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
1679:             return dt.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name))
1680:         except Exception:

1686: def main():

1688:     parser.add_argument("--single-capture", action="store_true",
1689:                         help="Run one capture cycle and exit")
1690:     parser.add_argument("--debug",          action="store_true",
1691:                         help="Enable debug logging")
1692:     parser.add_argument("--config-dir",     type=str, default=None,
1693:                         help="Override config directory path")
1694:     args = parser.parse_args()
1695: 
1696:     setup_logging(args.debug)
1697: 
1698:     # Load config
1699:     base_dir = Path(args.config_dir) if args.config_dir else None
1700:     cfg_mgr  = ConfigManager(base_dir)
1701:     try:
1702:         config = cfg_mgr.load()
1703:     except FileNotFoundError as exc:
1704:         log.critical("Cannot start: %s", exc)
1705:         sys.exit(1)
1706: 
1707:     agent = EdgeAgent(config, cfg_mgr)
1708:

1710:         success = agent.run_single_capture()

0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Camera Abstraction Layer
0003: ========================================
0004: All camera drivers must implement this interface.
0005: The capture engine speaks only to this API — it never knows which
0006: physical camera is attached.
0007: 
0008: SABSA mapping:
0009:   Extensibility  — new cameras = new driver, zero changes to engine
0010:   Availability   — health_check() called before every capture cycle
0011:   Integrity      — capture returns CaptureResult with metadata
0012: """
0013: 
0014: from __future__ import annotations
0015: 
0016: import abc
0017: import dataclasses
0018: from datetime import datetime
0019: from enum import Enum
0020: from pathlib import Path
0021: from typing import Optional
0022: 
0023: 
0024: class CameraState(Enum):
0025:     UNKNOWN      = "unknown"
0026:     CONNECTED    = "connected"
0027:     DISCONNECTED = "disconnected"
0028:     ERROR        = "error"
0029:     BUSY         = "busy"
0030: 
0031: 
0032: @dataclasses.dataclass
0033: class CaptureResult:
0034:     """Returned by capture_image() on success."""
0035:     filepath:      Path            # absolute path to downloaded image
0036:     timestamp:     datetime        # UTC time of capture trigger
0037:     filesize:      int             # bytes
0038:     sha256:        str             # hex digest
0039:     camera_model:  str             # e.g. "Canon EOS 1300D"
0040:     driver_name:   str             # e.g. "gphoto2"
0041:     exposure_time: Optional[str]   # e.g. "1/250"
0042:     aperture:      Optional[str]   # e.g. "f/8.0"
0043:     iso:           Optional[int]   # e.g. 200
0044:     focus_mode:    Optional[str]   # e.g. "MF"
0045:     extra:         dict = dataclasses.field(default_factory=dict)
0046: 
0047: 
0048: @dataclasses.dataclass
0049: class CameraStatus:
0050:     """Returned by get_status()."""
0051:     state:          CameraState
0052:     model:          str
0053:     driver:         str
0054:     battery_pct:    Optional[int]   # 0-100, None if unavailable
0055:     storage_free_mb:Optional[int]   # camera internal storage
0056:     error_message:  Optional[str]
0057:     raw:            dict = dataclasses.field(default_factory=dict)
0058: 
0059: 
0060: class CameraError(Exception):
0061:     """Base exception for all camera driver errors."""
0062: 
0063: 
0064: class CameraNotFoundError(CameraError):
0065:     """Camera not detected on USB / serial."""
0066: 
0067: 
0068: class CameraTimeoutError(CameraError):
0069:     """Operation timed out."""
0070: 
0071: 
0072: class CaptureFailed(CameraError):
0073:     """Image capture did not produce a file."""
0074: 
0075: 
0076: class CameraBase(abc.ABC):
0077:     """
0078:     Abstract base class for all camera drivers.
0079: 
0080:     Lifecycle:
0081:         driver = GPhoto2Driver(config)
0082:         driver.connect()          # raises CameraNotFoundError if absent
0083:         result = driver.capture_image(dest_dir)
0084:         driver.disconnect()
0085: 
0086:     Feature detection (called once at startup):
0087:         driver.supports_autofocus()   -> bool
0088:         driver.supports_liveview()    -> bool
0089:         driver.supports_remote_focus()-> bool
0090:     """
0091: 
0092:     def __init__(self, config: dict):
0093:         """
0094:         Args:
0095:             config: the 'camera' section from config.yaml
0096:         """
0097:         self._config = config
0098:         self._connected = False
0099: 
0100:     # ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0101: 
0102:     @abc.abstractmethod
0103:     def connect(self) -> None:
0104:         """
0105:         Establish connection to the camera.
0106:         Raises CameraNotFoundError if camera is not detected.
0107:         """
0108: 
0109:     @abc.abstractmethod
0110:     def disconnect(self) -> None:
0111:         """Release camera connection. Safe to call if not connected."""
0112: 
0113:     @property
0114:     def connected(self) -> bool:
0115:         return self._connected
0116: 
0117:     # ── Core operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
0118: 
0119:     @abc.abstractmethod
0120:     def capture_image(self, dest_dir: Path) -> CaptureResult:
0121:         """
0122:         Trigger capture, wait for processing, download image, delete
0123:         from camera memory.
0124: 
0125:         Args:
0126:             dest_dir: directory where the downloaded image is saved
0127: 
0128:         Returns:
0129:             CaptureResult with filepath, hash, metadata
0130: 
0131:         Raises:
0132:             CaptureFailed  — shutter fired but no file produced
0133:             CameraTimeoutError — camera did not respond in time
0134:             CameraError    — any other camera error
0135:         """
0136: 
0137:     @abc.abstractmethod
0138:     def get_status(self) -> CameraStatus:
0139:         """
0140:         Return current camera state, battery, storage info.
0141:         Should not raise — return state=ERROR on failure.
0142:         """
0143: 
0144:     @abc.abstractmethod
0145:     def health_check(self) -> bool:
0146:         """
0147:         Quick liveness check. Returns True if camera is responsive.
0148:         Used before every capture cycle. Should complete in < 5 seconds.
0149:         """
0150: 
0151:     # ── Feature detection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
0152: 
0153:     @abc.abstractmethod
0154:     def supports_autofocus(self) -> bool:
0155:         """True if the camera + driver support remote AF trigger."""
0156: 
0157:     @abc.abstractmethod
0158:     def supports_liveview(self) -> bool:
0159:         """True if liveview / MJPEG stream is available."""
0160: 
0161:     @abc.abstractmethod
0162:     def supports_remote_focus(self) -> bool:
0163:         """True if focus position can be set remotely (step motor)."""
0164: 
0165:     # ── Optional operations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
0166: 
0167:     def run_autofocus(self) -> bool:
0168:         """
0169:         Trigger autofocus. Returns True on success.
0170:         Default: no-op, returns False. Override in capable drivers.
0171:         """
0172:         return False
0173: 
0174:     def run_refocus(self) -> bool:
0175:         """
0176:         Perform a scheduled refocus cycle (e.g. contrast AF + verify).
0177:         Default: no-op, returns False. Override in capable drivers.
0178:         """
0179:         return False
0180: 
0181:     def set_config(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
0182:         """
0183:         Set a camera configuration parameter.
0184:         Default: no-op. Override in drivers that support it.
0185: 
0186:         Args:
0187:             key:   gphoto2-style path e.g. '/main/capturesettings/iso'
0188:             value: string value e.g. '200'
0189:         """
0190: 
0191:     def apply_initial_commands(self, commands: list[str]) -> list[str]:
0192:         """
0193:         Apply a list of 'key=value' config strings from config.yaml.
0194:         Returns list of any that failed.
0195:         Default implementation calls set_config() for each.
0196:         """
0197:         failed = []
0198:         for cmd in commands:
0199:             try:
0200:                 if '=' not in cmd:
0201:                     continue
0202:                 key, _, value = cmd.partition('=')
0203:                 self.set_config(key.strip(), value.strip())
0204:             except Exception as exc:
0205:                 failed.append(f"{cmd}: {exc}")
0206:         return failed
0207: 
0208:     # ── Driver metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
0209: 
0210:     @property
0211:     @abc.abstractmethod
0212:     def driver_name(self) -> str:
0213:         """Short identifier e.g. 'gphoto2', 'canon_sdk'."""
0214: 
0215:     @property
0216:     @abc.abstractmethod
0217:     def supported_models(self) -> list[str]:
0218:         """
0219:         List of model strings this driver handles.
0220:         Used by driver auto-detection. Glob patterns supported.
0221:         e.g. ['Canon EOS 1300D', 'Canon EOS 2000D']
0222:         """
0223: 
0224:     def __repr__(self) -> str:
0225:         return (f"<{self.__class__.__name__} "
0226:                 f"driver={self.driver_name} "
0227:                 f"connected={self._connected}>")

0177: # ── Helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0178: 
0179: def _run(args: list[str], timeout: int, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
0180:     """Run gphoto2 subprocess, return CompletedProcess."""
0181:     cmd_text = " ".join(args)
0182:     started = time.monotonic()
0183:     log.info("gphoto2 exec: %s", cmd_text)
0184:     try:
0185:         result = subprocess.run(
0186:             args,
0187:             capture_output=True,
0188:             text=True,
0189:             timeout=timeout,
0190:         )
0191:         elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
0192:         stdout = (result.stdout or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
0193:         stderr = (result.stderr or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
0194:         log.info(
0195:             "gphoto2 result: rc=%s duration_ms=%s stdout=%r stderr=%r",
0196:             result.returncode,
0197:             elapsed_ms,
0198:             stdout[:300],
0199:             stderr[:300],
0200:         )
0201:         if check and result.returncode != 0:
0202:             raise CameraError(
0203:                 f"gphoto2 returned {result.returncode}: {result.stderr.strip()}"
0204:             )
0205:         return result
0206:     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
0207:         raise CameraTimeoutError(
0208:             f"gphoto2 timed out after {timeout}s: {' '.join(args)}"
0209:         ) from exc
0210:     except FileNotFoundError as exc:
0211:         raise CameraError(
0212:             "gphoto2 not found — run: apt install gphoto2"
0213:         ) from exc
0214: 
0215: 
0216: def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
0217:     h = hashlib.sha256()
0218:     with open(path, "rb") as f:
0219:         for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
0220:             h.update(chunk)
0221:     return h.hexdigest()
0222: 
0223: 
0224: def _run_external(args: list[str], timeout: int, label: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
0225:     cmd_text = " ".join(str(a) for a in args)
0226:     started = time.monotonic()
0227:     log.info("%s exec: %s", label, cmd_text)
0228:     result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
0229:     elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
0230:     stdout = (result.stdout or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
0231:     stderr = (result.stderr or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
0232:     log.info(
0233:         "%s result: rc=%s duration_ms=%s stdout=%r stderr=%r",
0234:         label,
0235:         result.returncode,
0236:         elapsed_ms,
0237:         stdout[:300],
0238:         stderr[:300],
0239:     )
0240:     return result

0245: def _parse_gphoto2_config(output: str) -> list[dict]:
0246:     """Parse output of gphoto2 --list-all-config into structured dicts."""
0247:     params = []
0248:     current: dict = {}
0249:     for line in output.splitlines():
0250:         line = line.strip()
0251:         if line.startswith("/main/"):
0252:             if current.get("path"):
0253:                 params.append(current)
0254:             current = {"path": line, "label": "", "type": "", "current": "",
0255:                        "choices": [], "readonly": False}
0256:         elif line.startswith("Label:"):
0257:             current["label"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
0258:         elif line.startswith("Type:"):
0259:             current["type"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
0260:         elif line.startswith("Readonly:"):
0261:             current["readonly"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip() == "1"
0262:         elif line.startswith("Current:"):
0263:             current["current"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
0264:         elif line.startswith("Choice:"):
0265:             parts = line.split(" ", 2)
0266:             if len(parts) >= 3:
0267:                 current["choices"].append({"index": parts[1], "label": parts[2]})
0268:         elif line == "END" and current.get("path"):
0269:             params.append(current)
0270:             current = {}
0271:     return params
