```python
0274: class GPhoto2Driver(CameraBase):
0275:     """
0276:     gPhoto2-based driver for USB/PTP cameras.
0277: 
0278:     Config keys (from config.yaml camera section):
0279:         gphoto2_port:          str   e.g. "usb:" or "usb:001,004"
0280:         capture_timeout:       int   seconds (default 60)
0281:         download_timeout:      int   seconds (default 30)
0282:         delete_after_download: bool  (default true)
0283:     """
0284: 
0285:     SUPPORTED = [
0286:         "Canon EOS 1300D", "Canon EOS 1200D", "Canon EOS 1100D",
0287:         "Canon EOS 2000D", "Canon EOS 4000D", "Canon EOS 800D",
0288:         "Canon EOS 750D", "Canon EOS 700D", "Canon EOS 650D",
0289:         "Canon EOS 600D", "Canon EOS 550D", "Canon EOS 100D",
0290:         "Canon EOS 200D", "Canon EOS 250D", "Canon EOS 90D",
0291:         "Canon EOS 80D",  "Canon EOS 77D",  "Canon EOS 760D",
0292:         "Nikon Z30",
0293:     ]
0294: 
0295:     def __init__(self, config: dict):
0296:         super().__init__(config)
0297:         self._port:         str           = config.get("gphoto2_port", "usb:")
0298:         self._model:        Optional[str] = None
0299:         self._cap_timeout:  int           = config.get("capture_timeout", CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_S)
0300:         self._dl_timeout:   int           = config.get("download_timeout", DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_S)
0301:         self._delete_after: bool          = config.get("delete_after_download", True)
0302:         self._profile:      dict          = CAMERA_PROFILES["default"]
0303:         self._profile_key:  str           = "default"
0304:         self._settings_cache: Optional[tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[int], Optional[str]]] = None
0305: 
0306:     # ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0307: 
0308:     def connect(self) -> None:
0309:         """Detect camera on USB, verify it responds."""
0310:         log.info("Connecting to camera via gphoto2 (port=%s)…", self._port)
0311: 
0312:         for attempt in range(1, MAX_DETECT_RETRIES + 1):
0313:             try:
0314:                 result = _run(
0315:                     [GPHOTO2_CMD, "--auto-detect"],
0316:                     timeout=CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S,
0317:                 )
0318:                 # Parse model from output:
0319:                 #   Model                          Port
0320:                 #   Canon EOS 1300D                usb:002,004
0321:                 lines = result.stdout.strip().splitlines()
0322:                 for line in lines[2:]:  # skip header rows
0323:                     if "usb" in line.lower() or "ptpip" in line.lower():
0324:                         self._model = line.split("  ")[0].strip()
0325:                         break
0326: 
0327:                 if not self._model:
0328:                     raise CameraNotFoundError("No camera found by gphoto2 --auto-detect")
0329: 
0330:                 self._profile_key, self._profile = self._profile_for_model(self._model)
0331:                 log.info("Camera detected: %s", self._model)
0332:                 self._connected = True
0333:                 return
0334: 
0335:             except (CameraNotFoundError, CameraError) as exc:
0336:                 if attempt < MAX_DETECT_RETRIES:
0337:                     log.warning(
0338:                         "Detection attempt %d/%d failed: %s — retrying in %ds",
0339:                         attempt, MAX_DETECT_RETRIES, exc, DETECT_RETRY_DELAY_S
0340:                     )
0341:                     time.sleep(DETECT_RETRY_DELAY_S)
0342:                 else:
0343:                     raise CameraNotFoundError(
0344:                         f"Camera not found after {MAX_DETECT_RETRIES} attempts: {exc}"
0345:                     ) from exc
0346: 
0347:     def disconnect(self) -> None:
0348:         """Release camera. For gphoto2 CLI this is a no-op."""
0349:         self._connected = False
0350:         self._model = None
0351:         self._profile = CAMERA_PROFILES["default"]
0352:         self._profile_key = "default"
0353:         self._settings_cache = None
0354:         log.debug("gPhoto2Driver disconnected")
0355: 
0356:     # ── Core operations ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0357: 
0358:     def capture_image(self, dest_dir: Path) -> CaptureResult:
0359:         """
0360:         Trigger capture, wait for processing, download, delete from camera.
0361:         Image filename includes UTC timestamp for unambiguous ordering.
0362:         """
0363:         if not self._connected:
0364:             raise CameraError("Not connected — call connect() first")
0365: 
0366:         self._settings_cache = None
0367:         dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0368:         timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0369: 
0370:         # Use a temp dir inside dest_dir so the atomic rename stays on the
0371:         # same filesystem (avoids cross-device link errors on SSD + tmpfs).
0372:         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=dest_dir, prefix=".tmp_capture_") as tmp:
0373:             tmp_path = Path(tmp)
0374: 
0375:             log.info("Triggering capture…")
0376:             try:
0377:                 result = _run(
0378:                     [
0379:                         GPHOTO2_CMD,
0380:                         "--port", self._port,
0381:                         "--capture-image-and-download",
0382:                         "--filename", str(tmp_path / "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S.%C"),
0383:                         "--force-overwrite",
0384:                         "--keep-raw",       # download all files camera produced
0385:                     ],
0386:                     timeout=self._cap_timeout,
0387:                 )
0388:             except CameraError as exc:
0389:                 raise CaptureFailed(f"Capture failed: {exc}") from exc
0390: 
0391:             # Find downloaded file(s) — pick largest (RAW > JPG if both exist)
0392:             files = sorted(tmp_path.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_size, reverse=True)
0393:             if not files:
0394:                 raise CaptureFailed(
0395:                     f"gphoto2 ran but no file downloaded to {tmp_path}. "
0396:                     f"stdout={result.stdout[:200]}"
0397:                 )
0398: 
0399:             tmp_file = files[0]
0400:             log.info("Downloaded: %s (%d bytes)", tmp_file.name, tmp_file.stat().st_size)
0401: 
0402:             # Compute hash before moving
0403:             sha256 = _sha256(tmp_file)
0404: 
0405:             # Build final filename: <kunde>_<site>_<kamera>_<timestamp>.<ext>
0406:             # Fallback til device_id hvis navne ikke er konfigureret
0407:             import re
0408:             def _sanitize(s):
0409:                 return re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9æøåÆØÅ]', '_', str(s)).strip('_') if s else ''
0410:             device_id = self._config.get("device_id", "unknown")
0411:             customer  = _sanitize(self._config.get("customer_name", ""))
0412:             site      = _sanitize(self._config.get("site_name", ""))
0413:             camera    = _sanitize(self._config.get("camera_name", ""))
0414:             ts_str    = timestamp.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
0415:             if customer and site and camera:
0416:                 final_name = f"{customer}_{site}_{camera}_{ts_str}{tmp_file.suffix}"
0417:             else:
0418:                 final_name = f"{device_id}_{ts_str}{tmp_file.suffix}"
0419:             final_path = dest_dir / final_name
0420: 
0421:             # Atomic rename within same filesystem
0422:             shutil.move(str(tmp_file), str(final_path))
0423: 
0424:         # Generer sidecar JSON med original SHA-256 FØR XMP
0425:         # Rækkefølge er kritisk: SHA-256 → Sidecar → XMP
0426:         xmp_written = False
0427:         try:
0428:             self._write_sidecar(final_path, sha256, timestamp, False)
0429:         except Exception as exc:
0430:             log.warning("Sidecar JSON fejlede (ikke kritisk): %s", exc)
0431: 
0432:         # Skriv XMP EFTER sidecar — sha256 i sidecar er af original
0433:         # Quality checker bruger sha256 variablen (pre-XMP) — ingen mismatch
0434:         try:
0435:             xmp_written = self._write_xmp_metadata(final_path, sha256)
0436:             if xmp_written:
0437:                 # Opdater sidecar med xmp_written=True
0438:                 self._write_sidecar(final_path, sha256, timestamp, True)
0439:         except Exception as exc:
0440:             log.warning("XMP fejlede (ikke kritisk): %s", exc)
0441: 
0442:         # Delete from camera if configured
0443:         if self._delete_after:
0444:             self._delete_camera_files()
0445: 
0446:         # Read EXIF-like data from gphoto2 config
0447:         exposure, aperture, iso, focus_mode = self._read_capture_settings()
0448: 
0449:         return CaptureResult(
0450:             filepath      = final_path,
0451:             timestamp     = timestamp,
0452:             filesize      = final_path.stat().st_size,
0453:             sha256        = sha256,
0454:             camera_model  = self._model or "Unknown Canon DSLR",
0455:             driver_name   = self.driver_name,
0456:             exposure_time = exposure,
0457:             aperture      = aperture,
0458:             iso           = iso,
0459:             focus_mode    = focus_mode,
0460:         )
0461: 
0462:     def _write_sidecar(self, image_path, sha256: str, timestamp, xmp_written: bool = False) -> None:
0463:         """Skriv metadata sidecar JSON ved siden af billedet.
0464: 
0465:         INTEGRITET: Original JPEG modificeres ALDRIG.
0466:         SHA-256 beregnes FØR enhver filoperation og gemmes her.
0467:         Sidecar beskriver præcist hvad der er originalt og hvad der er tilføjet.
0468:         """
0469:         import json as _json
0470:         from datetime import timezone as _tz
0471:         from pathlib import Path as _Path
0472: 
0473:         cfg      = self._config
0474:         loc      = cfg.get("location", {})
0475:         cam_cfg  = cfg.get("camera", {})
0476:         device   = cfg.get("device", {})
0477:         schedule = cfg.get("schedule", {})
0478: 
0479:         # Hent kamera EXIF parametre (allerede læst)
0480:         exposure, aperture, iso, focus_mode = self._read_capture_settings()
0481: 
0482:         # Byg sidecar struktur
0483:         sidecar = {
0484:             "timelapse_pro": {
0485:                 "version":        "2.2.0",
0486:                 "generated_at":   timestamp.astimezone(_tz.utc).isoformat(),
0487:             },
0488: 
0489:             # ── Integritet ───────────────────────────────────────────────
0490:             "integrity": {
0491:                 "sha256_original":      sha256,
0492:                 "captured_at_utc":      timestamp.astimezone(_tz.utc).isoformat(),
0493:                 "captured_at_local":    timestamp.astimezone(__import__("zoneinfo").ZoneInfo(schedule.get("timezone", "UTC"))).isoformat(),
0494:                 "timezone":             schedule.get("timezone", "UTC"),
0495:                 "image_file":           image_path.name,
0496:                 "original_unmodified":  True,
0497:                 "xmp_written":          xmp_written,
0498:                 "xmp_note":             "XMP skrevet i JPEG XMP sektion — påvirker ikke billedpixels" if xmp_written else "XMP ikke skrevet",
0499:                 "note": "SHA-256 beregnet af rå kamera download inden enhver filbehandling"
0500:             },
0501: 
0502:             # ── Tilføjet metadata (ikke i original JPEG) ─────────────────
0503:             "added_metadata": {
0504:                 "fields_added": [],
0505:                 "source":       "TimeLapse Pro konfiguration",
0506:             },
0507: 
0508:             # ── Lokation og orientering ──────────────────────────────────
0509:             "location": {
0510:                 "gps_lat":              loc.get("gps_lat"),
0511:                 "gps_lon":              loc.get("gps_lon"),
0512:                 "gps_alt_m":            loc.get("gps_alt"),
0513:                 "gps_source":           loc.get("gps_source", "manual"),
0514:                 "address":              loc.get("address"),
0515:                 "azimuth_deg":          cam_cfg.get("azimuth_deg"),
0516:                 "tilt_deg":             cam_cfg.get("tilt_deg"),
0517:                 "mount_height_m":       cam_cfg.get("mount_height_m"),
0518:                 "fov_horizontal_deg":   cam_cfg.get("fov_horizontal_deg"),
0519:                 "fov_vertical_deg":     cam_cfg.get("fov_vertical_deg"),
0520:                 "perspective":          cam_cfg.get("perspective"),
0521:             },
0522: 
0523:             # ── Site og projekt ──────────────────────────────────────────
0524:             "project": {
0525:                 "customer":     cfg.get("customer_name", "") or device.get("customer_name", ""),
0526:                 "site":         cfg.get("site_name", "") or device.get("site_name", ""),
0527:                 "camera_name":  cfg.get("camera_name", "") or device.get("camera_name", ""),
0528:                 "device_id":    device.get("device_id", ""),
0529:                 "camera_index": cam_cfg.get("camera_index", 0),
0530:             },
0531: 
0532:             # ── Kamera teknisk ───────────────────────────────────────────
0533:             "camera": {
0534:                 "model":          self._model or "Unknown",
0535:                 "iso":            iso,
0536:                 "aperture":       aperture,
0537:                 "shutter_speed":  exposure,
0538:                 "focus_mode":     focus_mode,
0539:                 "gphoto2_port":   self._port,
0540:                 "relay_gpio_pin": cam_cfg.get("relay_gpio_pin"),
0541:             },
0542:         }
0543: 
0544:         # Registrer hvilke felter der er tilføjet (ikke fra kamera)
0545:         added = []
0546:         if loc.get("gps_lat"):
0547:             added.append("gps_lat")
0548:         if loc.get("gps_lon"):
0549:             added.append("gps_lon")
0550:         if loc.get("gps_alt"):
0551:             added.append("gps_alt_m")
0552:         if cam_cfg.get("azimuth_deg") is not None:
0553:             added.append("azimuth_deg")
0554:         if cam_cfg.get("tilt_deg") is not None:
0555:             added.append("tilt_deg")
0556:         if cam_cfg.get("mount_height_m") is not None:
0557:             added.append("mount_height_m")
0558:         if cam_cfg.get("fov_horizontal_deg") is not None:
0559:             added.append("fov_horizontal_deg")
0560:         sidecar["added_metadata"]["fields_added"] = added
0561: 
0562:         # Skriv sidecar ved siden af billedet
0563:         sidecar_path = image_path.with_suffix('.json')
0564:         with open(sidecar_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
0565:             _json.dump(sidecar, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
0566: 
0567:         log.info("Sidecar skrevet: %s (%d tilføjede felter)",
0568:                  sidecar_path.name, len(added))
0569: 
0570:     def _write_xmp_metadata(self, filepath, sha256_original: str) -> bool:
0571:         """Skriv XMP metadata til JPEG via exiftool.
0572: 
0573:         INTEGRITET:
0574:         - sha256_original er SHA-256 af ren kamera output (beregnet FØR dette kald)
0575:         - XMP skrives i JPEG XMP sektion — påvirker IKKE billedpixels
0576:         - sha256_original gemmes i XMP så fremtidige systemer kan verificere originalen
0577:         - Returnerer True hvis XMP blev skrevet
0578: 
0579:         XMP data inkluderer:
0580:         - GPS koordinater (fra site-konfiguration)
0581:         - Orientering (azimuth, tilt, FOV, montagehøjde)
0582:         - Projekt (kunde, site, kamera)
0583:         - Integritet (sha256 af original, version)
0584:         """
0585:         import subprocess
0586:         cfg     = self._config
0587:         loc     = cfg.get("location", {})
0588:         cam_cfg = cfg.get("camera", {})
0589:         device  = cfg.get("device", {})
0590: 
0591:         cmd = [
0592:             "exiftool",
0593:             "-overwrite_original",
0594:             # Integritet — SHA-256 af original kamera output
0595:             f"-XMP-xmpMM:OriginalDocumentID={sha256_original}",
0596:             f"-XMP-dc:Source=TimeLapse Pro v2.2.0",
0597:             # Projekt metadata
0598:             f"-XMP-dc:Publisher={device.get('customer_name', '')}",
0599:             f"-XMP-dc:Title={device.get('site_name', '')} — {device.get('camera_name', '')}",
0600:             f"-IPTC:By-line={device.get('customer_name', '')}",
0601:             f"-IPTC:CaptionAbstract=TimeLapse Pro | {device.get('customer_name','')} | {device.get('site_name','')} | {device.get('camera_name','')}",
0602:         ]
0603: 
0604:         # GPS (hvis konfigureret og kamera ikke har GPS)
0605:         gps_lat = loc.get("gps_lat")
0606:         gps_lon = loc.get("gps_lon")
0607:         gps_alt = loc.get("gps_alt")
0608:         if gps_lat and gps_lon:
0609:             # Tjek om kamera allerede har GPS
0610:             check = _run_external(
0611:                 ["exiftool", "-GPSLatitude", str(filepath)],
0612:                 timeout=10,
0613:                 label="exiftool",
0614:             )
0615:             if "GPS Latitude" not in check.stdout:
0616:                 lat_ref = "N" if gps_lat >= 0 else "S"
0617:                 lon_ref = "E" if gps_lon >= 0 else "W"
0618:                 cmd += [
0619:                     f"-GPSLatitudeRef={lat_ref}",
0620:                     f"-GPSLatitude={abs(gps_lat):.6f}",
0621:                     f"-GPSLongitudeRef={lon_ref}",
0622:                     f"-GPSLongitude={abs(gps_lon):.6f}",
0623:                 ]
0624:                 if gps_alt is not None:
0625:                     cmd += [
0626:                         f"-GPSAltitudeRef={'0' if gps_alt >= 0 else '1'}",
0627:                         f"-GPSAltitude={abs(gps_alt):.1f}",
0628:                     ]
0629: 
0630:         # Custom XMP namespace til orientering
0631:         if cam_cfg.get("azimuth_deg") is not None:
0632:             cmd.append(f"-XMP-aux:Lens=Azimuth:{cam_cfg['azimuth_deg']}deg")
0633:         if cam_cfg.get("tilt_deg") is not None:
0634:             cmd.append(f"-XMP-exifEX:CameraElevationAngle={cam_cfg['tilt_deg']}")
0635: 
0636:         # Billedrettigheder og beskrivelse
0637:         cmd += [
0638:             f"-XMP-dc:Rights=Copyright {device.get('customer_name', '')}",
0639:             f"-XMP-photoshop:City={loc.get('address', '')}",
0640:             str(filepath)
0641:         ]
0642: 
0643:         try:
0644:             result = _run_external(cmd, timeout=30, label="exiftool")
0645:             if result.returncode == 0:
0646:                 log.info("XMP skrevet: %s (GPS=%s, azimuth=%s)",
0647:                          filepath.name,
0648:                          f"{gps_lat:.4f},{gps_lon:.4f}" if gps_lat else "nej",
0649:                          cam_cfg.get("azimuth_deg", "ej konfigureret"))
0650:                 return True
0651:             else:
0652:                 log.warning("exiftool XMP fejl: %s", result.stderr.strip())
0653:                 return False
0654:         except FileNotFoundError:
0655:             log.warning("exiftool ikke fundet — XMP skipped (apt install exiftool)")
0656:             return False
0657:         except Exception as exc:
0658:             log.warning("XMP fejl: %s", exc)
0659:             return False
0660:

0674:                 state           = state,

0676:                 driver          = self.driver_name,

0678:                 storage_free_mb = None,   # not easily available via gphoto2
0679:                 error_message   = result.stderr.strip() if result.returncode != 0 else None,
0680:                 raw             = {"stdout": result.stdout[:500]},

0682:         except Exception as exc:

0732:     def capture_preview(self, dest_dir: Path) -> Path:
0733:         """
0734:         Capture a low-resolution preview image (no shutter count increment).
0735:         Returns path to saved JPEG (1056x704 on Canon EOS 1300D).
0736:         """
0737:         import tempfile, shutil, time
0738:         dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0739:         ts_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
0740:         filename = f"preview_{ts_str}.jpg"
0741:         # gphoto2 adds 'thumb_' prefix for previews
0742:         tmp_path = dest_dir / f"thumb_{filename}"
0743:         target   = dest_dir / filename
0744:         _run(
0745:             [GPHOTO2_CMD, "--capture-preview",
0746:              "--filename", str(dest_dir / filename)],
0747:             timeout=15,
0748:         )
0749:         # gphoto2 may save as thumb_<filename>
0750:         if tmp_path.exists() and not target.exists():
0751:             shutil.move(str(tmp_path), str(target))
0752:         elif not target.exists():
0753:             # Find any recently created preview
0754:             previews = sorted(dest_dir.glob("*.jpg"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
0755:             if previews:
0756:                 target = previews[-1]
0757:         log.info("Preview captured: %s (%d KB)", target.name, target.stat().st_size // 1024)
0758:         return target

0787:     def build_config_command(self, cfg_key: str, value: str) -> Optional[str]:
0788:         """Map a logical TimeLapse camera config key to a profile-specific gphoto2 command."""
0789:         command_map = self._profile.get("config_commands", {})
0790:         spec = command_map.get(cfg_key)
0791:         if not spec:
0792:             default_map = {
0793:                 "iso": "iso",
0794:                 "shutter_speed": "shutterspeed",
0795:                 "aperture": "aperture",
0796:                 "whitebalance": "whitebalance",
0797:                 "picturestyle": "picturestyle",
0798:                 "colorspace": "colorspace",
0799:                 "imageformat": "imageformat",
0800:                 "meteringmode": "meteringmode",
0801:                 "exposurecompensation": "exposurecompensation",
0802:             }
0803:             key = default_map.get(cfg_key)
0804:             return f"{key}={value}" if key else None
0805:         if spec.get("skip"):
0806:             return None
0807:         raw_value = "" if value is None else str(value)
0808:         if raw_value in set(spec.get("skip_values", [])):
0809:             return None
0810:         mapped_value = spec.get("value_map", {}).get(raw_value, raw_value)
0811:         path = spec.get("path")
0812:         if not path:
0813:             return None
0814:         return f"{path}={mapped_value}"
0815: 
0816:     def normalize_initial_commands(self, commands: list[str]) -> list[str]:
0817:         """Translate legacy short gphoto2 commands through the active camera profile."""
0818:         normalized: list[str] = []
0819:         legacy_aliases = {
0820:             "shutterspeed": "shutter_speed",
0821:             "whitebalance": "whitebalance",
0822:             "focusmode": "focusmode",
0823:             "iso": "iso",
0824:             "aperture": "aperture",
0825:             "colorspace": "colorspace",
0826:             "imageformat": "imageformat",
0827:         }
0828:         for cmd in commands:
0829:             if "=" not in cmd:
0830:                 normalized.append(cmd)
0831:                 continue
0832:             key, value = cmd.split("=", 1)
0833:             cfg_key = legacy_aliases.get(key.strip().split("/")[-1].lower())
0834:             if not cfg_key:
0835:                 normalized.append(cmd)
0836:                 continue
0837:             mapped = self.build_config_command(cfg_key, value.strip())
0838:             if mapped:
0839:                 normalized.append(mapped)
0840:             else:
0841:                 log.info("Profile %s skipped incompatible camera command: %s", self._profile_key, cmd)
0842:         return normalized

0877:     def _profile_for_model(self, model: str) -> tuple[str, dict]:
0878:         """Return the first camera profile whose key matches the detected model."""
0879:         model_l = (model or "").lower()
0880:         for key, profile in CAMERA_PROFILES.items():
0881:             if key == "default":
0882:                 continue
0883:             if key.lower() in model_l:
0884:                 log.info("Using gphoto2 camera profile: %s", key)
0885:                 return key, profile
0886:         log.info("Using gphoto2 camera profile: default")
0887:         return "default", CAMERA_PROFILES["default"]

0889:     def _read_config_current(self, paths: list[str]) -> Optional[str]:
0890:         """Read Current from the first working gphoto2 config path."""
0891:         for key in paths:
0892:             try:
0893:                 result = _run(
0894:                     [GPHOTO2_CMD, "--port", self._port, "--get-config", key],
0895:                     timeout=STATUS_TIMEOUT_S,
0896:                     check=False,
0897:                 )
0898:                 if result.returncode != 0:
0899:                     continue
0900:                 match = re.search(r"Current:\s*(.+)", result.stdout)
0901:                 if match:
0902:                     return match.group(1).strip()
0903:             except Exception:
0904:                 continue
0905:         return None
0906: 
0907:     def _parse_battery(self, summary_text: str) -> Optional[int]:
0908:         """Extract battery percentage from gphoto2 --summary output."""
0909:         # Typical line: "Battery Level: 75%"
0910:         match = re.search(r"[Bb]attery[^:]*:\s*(\d+)\s*%", summary_text)
0911:         if match:
0912:             return int(match.group(1))
0913:         return None
0914: 
0915:     def _read_capture_settings(self) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str], Optional[int], Optional[str]]:
0916:         """
0917:         Read current shutter speed, aperture, ISO, focus mode from camera.
0918:         Returns (exposure, aperture, iso, focus_mode). Any may be None.
0919:         """
0920:         if self._settings_cache is not None:
0921:             return self._settings_cache
0922: 
0923:         paths = self._profile.get("capture_settings", CAMERA_PROFILES["default"]["capture_settings"])
0924:         exposure   = self._read_config_current(paths.get("exposure_time", []))
0925:         aperture   = self._read_config_current(paths.get("aperture", []))
0926:         iso_str    = self._read_config_current(paths.get("iso", []))
0927:         focus_mode = self._read_config_current(paths.get("focus_mode", []))
0928: 
0929:         try:
0930:             iso = int(iso_str) if iso_str else None
0931:         except ValueError:
0932:             iso = None
0933: 
0934:         self._settings_cache = (exposure, aperture, iso, focus_mode)
0935:         return self._settings_cache
```

### Raw source with line numbers

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Camera Driver Registry
0003: ========================================
0004: Auto-selects and instantiates the correct camera driver
0005: based on configuration or USB auto-detection.
0006: 
0007: To add a new driver:
0008:   1. Create camera/drivers/my_driver.py implementing CameraBase
0009:   2. Import it here and add to DRIVERS list
0010:   3. Populate its supported_models property
0011: """
0012: 
0013: from __future__ import annotations
0014: 
0015: import logging
0016: from typing import Type
0017: 
0018: from camera.base import CameraBase, CameraNotFoundError
0019: from camera.drivers.gphoto2_driver import GPhoto2Driver
0020: 
0021: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0022: 
0023: # Ordered list — first matching driver wins
0024: DRIVERS: list[Type[CameraBase]] = [
0025:     GPhoto2Driver,
0026:     # Future: CanonSDKDriver, SonyDriver, NikonDriver, ...
0027: ]
0028: 
0029: 
0030: def get_driver(config: dict) -> CameraBase:
0031:     """
0032:     Return an instantiated (but not yet connected) camera driver.
0033: 
0034:     Selection order:
0035:       1. If config['camera']['driver'] is set explicitly, use that.
0036:       2. Otherwise try each driver's supported_models list against
0037:          config['camera']['model'] (if set).
0038:       3. Otherwise return GPhoto2Driver as the universal fallback
0039:          (it does its own detection at connect() time).
0040: 
0041:     Args:
0042:         config: the full config dict (camera section read via
0043:                 config['camera'])
0044: 
0045:     Returns:
0046:         An instantiated CameraBase subclass, not yet connected.
0047: 
0048:     Raises:
0049:         CameraNotFoundError: if an explicitly named driver is unknown.
0050:     """
0051:     cam_cfg = dict(config.get("camera", {}))
0052:     # Inject device identity for structured filenames
0053:     device_cfg = config.get("device", {})
0054:     cam_cfg.setdefault("device_id",     device_cfg.get("device_id", "unknown"))
0055:     cam_cfg.setdefault("customer_name", device_cfg.get("customer_name", ""))
0056:     cam_cfg.setdefault("site_name",     device_cfg.get("site_name", ""))
0057:     cam_cfg.setdefault("camera_name",   device_cfg.get("camera_name", ""))
0058: 
0059:     explicit_driver = cam_cfg.get("driver", "").lower()
0060:     if explicit_driver:
0061:         for cls in DRIVERS:
0062:             if cls(cam_cfg).driver_name == explicit_driver:
0063:                 log.info("Using explicitly configured driver: %s", explicit_driver)
0064:                 return cls(cam_cfg)
0065:         raise CameraNotFoundError(
0066:             f"Driver '{explicit_driver}' not found. "
0067:             f"Available: {[cls(cam_cfg).driver_name for cls in DRIVERS]}"
0068:         )
0069: 
0070:     model = cam_cfg.get("model", "").strip()
0071:     if model:
0072:         for cls in DRIVERS:
0073:             instance = cls(cam_cfg)
0074:             if any(model.lower() in m.lower() or m.lower() in model.lower()
0075:                    for m in instance.supported_models):
0076:                 log.info(
0077:                     "Auto-selected driver '%s' for model '%s'",
0078:                     instance.driver_name, model
0079:                 )
0080:                 return instance
0081: 
0082:     log.info("No specific driver matched — using gPhoto2 (universal fallback)")
0083:     return GPhoto2Driver(cam_cfg)
0084: 
0085: 
0086: def list_drivers() -> list[str]:
0087:     """Return names of all registered drivers."""
0088:     return [cls({}).driver_name for cls in DRIVERS]
```

## `edge/camera/relay.py`

### Raw source with line numbers

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — GPIO Relay Controller (Dual Channel)
0003: =====================================================
0004: Controls both relays on the HW-383A 5V dual-channel relay module.
0005: 
0006: Supports two hardware backends — auto-detected at runtime:
0007: 
0008:   rk3588  (Orange Pi 4 Pro)   → _SysfsGPIO  (direct sysfs, no library)
0009:   h3      (Orange Pi PC Plus)  → _OpiGPIO    (OPi.GPIO, BOARD numbering)
0010: 
0011: Pin mapping:
0012:   Platform   Relay    Physical pin   GPIO id
0013:   --------   ------   ------------   --------
0014:   rk3588     camera   pin 7          GPIO 356
0015:   rk3588     modem    pin 11         GPIO 361
0016:   h3         camera   pin 7          BOARD 7 (PA6)
0017:   h3         modem    —              not fitted
0018: 
0019: HW-383A is active-low: GPIO LOW = relay ON = load powered.
0020: 
0021: SABSA: Availability — camera only powered during capture window
0022:                       modem can be power-cycled without physical access
0023: """
0024: 
0025: from __future__ import annotations
0026: 
0027: import logging
0028: import os
0029: import time
0030: from pathlib import Path
0031: 
0032: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0033: 
0034: GPIO_ROOT = Path("/sys/class/gpio")
0035: # HW-383A active-low: "0" = relay ON, "1" = relay OFF
0036: _RELAY_ON  = "0"
0037: _RELAY_OFF = "1"
0038: 
0039: 
0040: # ── Platform detection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0041: 
0042: def _detect_platform() -> str:
0043:     """Returns 'rk3588' or 'h3'.
0044: 
0045:     Detection order:
0046:       1. /proc/device-tree/compatible  (most reliable on Armbian)
0047:       2. /proc/cpuinfo                 (fallback)
0048:       3. Default to rk3588 with warning
0049:     """
0050:     # 1. Device tree — preferred
0051:     try:
0052:         dt = Path("/proc/device-tree/compatible").read_bytes().replace(b"\x00", b"\n").decode()
0053:         if "orangepi-4-pro" in dt or "sun60iw2p1" in dt:
0054:             return "rk3588"
0055:         if "orangepi-pc-plus" in dt or "sun8i-h3" in dt:
0056:             return "h3"
0057:     except OSError:
0058:         pass
0059: 
0060:     # 2. cpuinfo — fallback
0061:     try:
0062:         info = Path("/proc/cpuinfo").read_text()
0063:         if "RK3588" in info:
0064:             return "rk3588"
0065:         if "Allwinner" in info or "sun8i" in info:
0066:             return "h3"
0067:     except OSError:
0068:         pass
0069: 
0070:     log.warning("Unknown platform — defaulting to rk3588 (sysfs)")
0071:     return "rk3588"
0072: 
0073: 
0074: PLATFORM = _detect_platform()
0075: log.info("GPIO platform: %s", PLATFORM)
0076: 
0077: # Default GPIO pins per platform
0078: _DEFAULTS = {
0079:     "rk3588": {"camera_pin": 356, "modem_pin": 361},
0080:     "h3":     {"camera_pin": 7,   "modem_pin": None},   # modem not fitted on PC Plus
0081: }
0082: 
0083: 
0084: # ── Backend: sysfs (RK3588S) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
0085: 
0086: class _SysfsGPIO:
0087:     """Direct sysfs GPIO driver — no library dependency."""
0088: 
0089:     def __init__(self, pins: list[int], simulate: bool):
0090:         self._simulate = simulate
0091:         self._pins     = pins
0092:         if not simulate:
0093:             self._init(pins)
0094: 
0095:     def _init(self, pins: list[int]) -> None:
0096:         for pin in pins:
0097:             try:
0098:                 self._export(pin)
0099:                 self._set_direction(pin, "out")
0100:                 self._write(pin, _RELAY_OFF)   # safe state: OFF
0101:                 log.debug("sysfs GPIO %d initialised → OFF", pin)
0102:             except Exception as exc:
0103:                 log.error("Failed to init GPIO %d: %s", pin, exc)
0104: 
0105:     def _export(self, pin: int) -> None:
0106:         gpio_dir = GPIO_ROOT / f"gpio{pin}"
0107:         if gpio_dir.exists():
0108:             log.debug("GPIO %d already exported", pin)
0109:             return
0110:         try:
0111:             (GPIO_ROOT / "export").write_text(str(pin))
0112:             time.sleep(0.1)
0113:         except OSError as exc:
0114:             if "517" in str(exc) or "busy" in str(exc).lower():
0115:                 log.debug("GPIO %d already exported (busy)", pin)
0116:             else:
0117:                 raise
0118: 
0119:     def _unexport(self, pin: int) -> None:
0120:         try:
0121:             (GPIO_ROOT / "unexport").write_text(str(pin))
0122:         except OSError:
0123:             pass
0124: 
0125:     def _set_direction(self, pin: int, direction: str) -> None:
0126:         (GPIO_ROOT / f"gpio{pin}" / "direction").write_text(direction)
0127: 
0128:     def _write(self, pin: int, value: str) -> None:
0129:         (GPIO_ROOT / f"gpio{pin}" / "value").write_text(value)
0130: 
0131:     def set(self, pin: int, energise: bool) -> None:
0132:         """energise=True → relay ON (active-low: write 0)."""
0133:         if self._simulate:
0134:             log.info("[SIMULATE] GPIO %d → %s", pin, "ON" if energise else "OFF")
0135:             return
0136:         value = _RELAY_ON if energise else _RELAY_OFF
0137:         try:
0138:             self._write(pin, value)
0139:         except Exception as exc:
0140:             log.error("GPIO %d write failed: %s", pin, exc)
0141: 
0142:     def cleanup(self, pins: list[int]) -> None:
0143:         if self._simulate:
0144:             return
0145:         for pin in pins:
0146:             try:
0147:                 self._write(pin, _RELAY_OFF)
0148:                 self._unexport(pin)
0149:             except Exception:
0150:                 pass
0151: 
0152: 
0153: # ── Backend: OPi.GPIO (Allwinner H3) ─────────────────────────────────────────
0154: 
0155: class _OpiGPIO:
0156:     """OPi.GPIO backend — BOARD numbering, for Orange Pi PC Plus (H3)."""
0157: 
0158:     def __init__(self, pins: list[int], simulate: bool):
0159:         self._simulate = simulate
0160:         self._pins     = pins
0161:         self._GPIO     = None
0162:         if not simulate:
0163:             self._init(pins)
0164: 
0165:     def _init(self, pins: list[int]) -> None:
0166:         try:
0167:             import OPi.GPIO as GPIO
0168:             self._GPIO = GPIO
0169:             GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BOARD)
0170:             GPIO.setwarnings(False)
0171:             for pin in pins:
0172:                 GPIO.setup(pin, GPIO.OUT)
0173:                 GPIO.output(pin, GPIO.HIGH)   # active-low: HIGH = OFF (safe state)
0174:                 log.debug("OPi.GPIO BOARD pin %d initialised → OFF", pin)
0175:         except Exception as exc:
0176:             log.error("OPi.GPIO init failed: %s", exc)
0177: 
0178:     def set(self, pin: int, energise: bool) -> None:
0179:         """energise=True → relay ON (active-low: GPIO.LOW)."""
0180:         if self._simulate:
0181:             log.info("[SIMULATE] OPi BOARD pin %d → %s", pin, "ON" if energise else "OFF")
0182:             return
0183:         try:
0184:             level = self._GPIO.LOW if energise else self._GPIO.HIGH
0185:             self._GPIO.output(pin, level)
0186:         except Exception as exc:
0187:             log.error("OPi.GPIO pin %d write failed: %s", pin, exc)
0188: 
0189:     def cleanup(self, pins: list[int]) -> None:
0190:         if self._simulate:
0191:             return
0192:         try:
0193:             for pin in pins:
0194:                 self._GPIO.output(pin, self._GPIO.HIGH)   # safe state before cleanup
0195:             self._GPIO.cleanup()
0196:         except Exception:
0197:             pass
0198: 
0199: 
0200: # ── Relay channel classes (platform-agnostic) ─────────────────────────────────
0201: 
0202: class CameraRelay:
0203:     """
0204:     Relay 1 — controls camera power.
0205:     Pin is platform-dependent (see _DEFAULTS).
0206: 
0207:     Config keys (camera section):
0208:         relay_gpio_pin:          int   GPIO/BOARD pin (platform default if omitted)
0209:         relay_on_seconds_before: int   warm-up after power-on (default 10)
0210:         relay_off_seconds_after: int   settle before power-off (default 5)
0211:     """
0212: 
0213:     def __init__(self, backend: _SysfsGPIO | _OpiGPIO, config: dict, pin: int):
0214:         self._be     = backend
0215:         self._pin    = pin
0216:         self._warmup = int(config.get("relay_on_seconds_before", 10))
0217:         self._settle = int(config.get("relay_off_seconds_after", 5))
0218:         self._on     = False
0219: 
0220:     def power_on(self) -> None:
0221:         if self._on:
0222:             log.debug("Camera relay already ON")
0223:             return
0224:         log.info("Camera relay ON (pin %d)", self._pin)
0225:         self._be.set(self._pin, True)
0226:         self._on = True
0227:         if self._warmup > 0:
0228:             log.info("Waiting %ds for camera warm-up…", self._warmup)
0229:             time.sleep(self._warmup)
0230: 
0231:     def power_off(self) -> None:
0232:         if not self._on:
0233:             log.debug("Camera relay already OFF")
0234:             return
0235:         if self._settle > 0:
0236:             log.info("Waiting %ds for camera settle…", self._settle)
0237:             time.sleep(self._settle)
0238:         log.info("Camera relay OFF (pin %d)", self._pin)
0239:         self._be.set(self._pin, False)
0240:         self._on = False
0241: 
0242:     def force_off(self) -> None:
0243:         log.warning("Camera relay FORCE OFF (pin %d)", self._pin)
0244:         self._be.set(self._pin, False)
0245:         self._on = False
0246: 
0247:     @property
0248:     def is_on(self) -> bool:
0249:         return self._on
0250: 
0251:     def __enter__(self):
0252:         self.power_on()
0253:         return self
0254: 
0255:     def __exit__(self, *_):
0256:         self.power_off()
0257: 
0258: 
0259: class ModemRelay:
0260:     """
0261:     Relay 2 — controls 5G USB modem power.
0262:     Only fitted on rk3588 (Orange Pi 4 Pro). Physical pin 11 = GPIO 361.
0263: 
0264:     Config keys (modem section):
0265:         modem_relay_gpio_pin:        int   sysfs GPIO number (default 361)
0266:         modem_power_cycle_off_s:     int   seconds off during cycle (default 5)
0267:         modem_power_cycle_recover_s: int   recovery wait (default 15)
0268:     """
0269: 
0270:     DEFAULT_PIN       = 361
0271:     DEFAULT_OFF_S     = 5
0272:     DEFAULT_RECOVER_S = 15
0273: 
0274:     def __init__(self, backend: _SysfsGPIO | _OpiGPIO, config: dict, pin: int):
0275:         self._be        = backend
0276:         self._pin       = pin
0277:         modem_cfg       = config.get("modem", {})
0278:         self._off_s     = int(modem_cfg.get("modem_power_cycle_off_s", self.DEFAULT_OFF_S))
0279:         self._recover_s = int(modem_cfg.get("modem_power_cycle_recover_s", self.DEFAULT_RECOVER_S))
0280:         self._on        = False
0281:         self._startup()
0282: 
0283:     def _startup(self) -> None:
0284:         log.info("Modem relay ON at startup (pin %d)", self._pin)
0285:         self._be.set(self._pin, True)
0286:         self._on = True
0287: 
0288:     def power_cycle(self, reason: str = "manual") -> None:
0289:         log.warning("Modem power-cycle (pin %d) — reason: %s", self._pin, reason)
0290:         self._be.set(self._pin, False)
0291:         self._on = False
0292:         log.info("Modem OFF — waiting %ds…", self._off_s)
0293:         time.sleep(self._off_s)
0294:         self._be.set(self._pin, True)
0295:         self._on = True
0296:         log.info("Modem ON — waiting %ds for registration…", self._recover_s)
0297:         time.sleep(self._recover_s)
0298:         log.info("Modem power-cycle complete")
0299: 
0300:     def force_off(self) -> None:
0301:         log.info("Modem relay OFF (pin %d)", self._pin)
0302:         self._be.set(self._pin, False)
0303:         self._on = False
0304: 
0305:     @property
0306:     def is_on(self) -> bool:
0307:         return self._on
0308: 
0309: 
0310: class _NoModem:
0311:     """Null-object for platforms without a modem relay (e.g. PC Plus)."""
0312:     is_on = False
0313: 
0314:     def power_cycle(self, reason: str = "") -> None:
0315:         log.info("_NoModem: power_cycle ignored (%s)", reason)
0316: 
0317:     def force_off(self) -> None:
0318:         log.info("_NoModem: force_off ignored")

0320: 
0321: class RelayController:
0322:     """
0323:     Top-level relay manager for HW-383A dual-channel module.
0324:     Auto-detects platform (rk3588/h3) and selects GPIO backend.
0325: 
0326:     rk3588 (Orange Pi 4 Pro):  sysfs, camera GPIO 356, modem GPIO 361
0327:     h3     (Orange Pi PC Plus): OPi.GPIO BOARD, camera pin 7, no modem
0328: 
0329:     Set relay_simulate: true in config to skip GPIO entirely.
0330:     """
0331: 
0332:     def __init__(self, config: dict):
0333:         cam_cfg  = config.get("camera", {})
0334:         simulate = cam_cfg.get("relay_simulate", False)
0335:         defaults = _DEFAULTS[PLATFORM]
0336: 
0337:         cam_pin   = int(cam_cfg.get("relay_gpio_pin", defaults["camera_pin"]))
0338:         modem_pin = defaults["modem_pin"]
0339:         if modem_pin is not None:
0340:             modem_pin = int(config.get("modem", {}).get("modem_relay_gpio_pin", modem_pin))
0341: 
0342:         # Select backend
0343:         active_pins = [cam_pin] + ([modem_pin] if modem_pin is not None else [])
0344:         if PLATFORM == "rk3588":

0350:

0355: 
0356:         self._connectivity = ConnectivityMonitor(self.modem, config)
0357: 
0358:         log.info(

0360:             PLATFORM, cam_pin, modem_pin, simulate
0361:         )
0362: 
0363:     @property
0364:     def connectivity(self) -> "ConnectivityMonitor":
0365:         return self._connectivity
0366: 
0367:     def cleanup(self, *, camera: bool = True, modem: bool = True) -> None:
0368:         log.info("RelayController cleanup")
0369:         if camera:
0370:             self.camera.force_off()
0371:         if modem:
0372:             self.modem.force_off()
0373:         pins = []
0374:         if camera:
0375:             pins.append(self.camera._pin)
0376:         if modem and not isinstance(self.modem, _NoModem):
0377:             pins.append(self.modem._pin)

0382: class ConnectivityMonitor:
0383:     """
0384:     Watches network connectivity and triggers modem power-cycle
0385:     automatically when failures exceed the configured threshold.
0386:     """
0387: 
0388:     def __init__(self, modem_relay: ModemRelay | _NoModem, config: dict):
0389:         modem_cfg          = config.get("modem", {})
0390:         self._relay        = modem_relay
0391:         self._max_failures = int(modem_cfg.get("modem_cycle_after_failures", 3))
0392:         self._min_interval = int(modem_cfg.get("modem_min_cycle_interval_s", 600))
0393:         self._failures     = 0
0394:         self._last_cycle_t = 0.0

0396:     def report_success(self) -> None:
0397:         if self._failures > 0:
0398:             log.debug("Connectivity restored after %d failures", self._failures)
0399:         self._failures = 0
0400: 
0401:     def report_failure(self) -> None:

0403:         log.debug("Connectivity failure %d/%d", self._failures, self._max_failures)
0404:         if self._failures < self._max_failures:
0405:             return
0406:         now        = time.monotonic()
0407:         since_last = now - self._last_cycle_t
0408:         if since_last < self._min_interval:
0409:             log.info("Modem cycle suppressed — %.0fs since last (min %ds)",
0410:                      since_last, self._min_interval)
0411:             return
0412:         log.warning("%d consecutive failures — power-cycling modem", self._failures)
0413:         self._relay.power_cycle(reason=f"{self._failures} consecutive failures")
0414:         self._failures     = 0
0415:         self._last_cycle_t = time.monotonic()
0416: 
0417:     @property
0418:     def consecutive_failures(self) -> int:
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Circular Buffer Manager
0003: =========================================
0004: Enforces a maximum disk usage on the local capture directory by
0005: deleting the oldest already-uploaded images first.
0006: 
0007: SABSA: Availability — disk never fills completely, captures always possible.
0008:        Integrity    — only uploaded images are eligible for deletion.
0009: """
0010: 
0011: from __future__ import annotations
0012: 
0013: import logging
0014: from pathlib import Path
0015: from typing import Optional
0016: 
0017: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0018: 
0019: # Delete until usage drops to this fraction of the limit
0020: HYSTERESIS = 0.90
0021: 
0022: 
0023: class CircularBuffer:
0024:     """
0025:     Manages local image storage within a size limit.
0026: 
0027:     Config keys (from config.yaml storage section):
0028:         local_path:           str  e.g. "/data/captures"
0029:         circular_buffer_gb:   int  max GB to use (default 50)
0030: 
0031:     The buffer tracks which files have been uploaded via a simple
0032:     SQLite query (injected via the db_session parameter). Files that
0033:     have NOT yet been uploaded are protected from deletion.
0034:     """
0035: 
0036:     def __init__(self, config: dict):
0037:         storage_cfg = config.get("storage", {})
0038:         self._path        = Path(storage_cfg.get("local_path", "/data/captures"))
0039:         self._max_bytes   = int(storage_cfg.get("circular_buffer_gb", 50)) * 1_073_741_824
0040:         self._target_bytes = int(self._max_bytes * HYSTERESIS)
0041:         self._path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0042: 
0043:     @property
0044:     def path(self) -> Path:
0045:         return self._path
0046: 
0047:     def usage_bytes(self) -> int:
0048:         """Return total bytes used by capture directory."""
0049:         return sum(
0050:             f.stat().st_size
0051:             for f in self._path.rglob("*")
0052:             if f.is_file()
0053:         )
0054: 
0055:     def usage_gb(self) -> float:
0056:         return self.usage_bytes() / 1_073_741_824
0057: 
0058:     def is_full(self) -> bool:
0059:         return self.usage_bytes() >= self._max_bytes
0060: 
0061:     def enforce(self, db=None) -> int:
0062:         """
0063:         Delete oldest uploaded files until usage is below target.
0064: 
0065:         Args:
0066:             db: optional database session for querying upload status.
0067:                 If None, deletion candidates are selected by mtime only
0068:                 (least safe — only use if DB is unavailable).
0069: 
0070:         Returns:
0071:             Number of files deleted.
0072:         """
0073:         current = self.usage_bytes()
0074:         if current < self._max_bytes:
0075:             return 0
0076: 
0077:         log.warning(
0078:             "Buffer full: %.1f GB / %.1f GB — pruning…",
0079:             current / 1e9, self._max_bytes / 1e9
0080:         )
0081: 
0082:         candidates = self._get_candidates(db)
0083:         deleted = 0
0084: 
0085:         for filepath in candidates:
0086:             if self.usage_bytes() <= self._target_bytes:
0087:                 break
0088:             try:
0089:                 size = filepath.stat().st_size
0090:                 filepath.unlink()
0091:                 log.info("Buffer prune: deleted %s (%.1f MB)", filepath.name, size / 1e6)
0092:                 deleted += 1
0093:             except OSError as exc:
0094:                 log.warning("Could not delete %s: %s", filepath, exc)
0095: 
0096:         remaining = self.usage_bytes()
0097:         log.info(
0098:             "Buffer prune complete: deleted %d files, now %.1f GB",
0099:             deleted, remaining / 1e9
0100:         )
0101:         return deleted
0102: 
0103:     def _get_candidates(self, db) -> list[Path]:
0104:         """
0105:         Return list of files eligible for deletion, oldest first.
0106:         Priority: uploaded files first, then unuploaded if necessary.
0107:         """
0108:         all_files = sorted(
0109:             (f for f in self._path.rglob("*") if f.is_file()),
0110:             key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime,
0111:         )
0112: 
0113:         if db is None:
0114:             log.warning("No DB available — deleting oldest files regardless of upload status")
0115:             return all_files
0116: 
0117:         # Split into uploaded and not-uploaded
0118:         uploaded     = []
0119:         not_uploaded = []
0120: 
0121:         for f in all_files:
0122:             try:
0123:                 is_uploaded = db.is_file_uploaded(str(f))
0124:                 if is_uploaded:
0125:                     uploaded.append(f)
0126:                 else:
0127:                     not_uploaded.append(f)
0128:             except Exception:
0129:                 uploaded.append(f)   # assume safe to delete on DB error
0130: 
0131:         # Delete uploaded first (safest), then non-uploaded if still over limit
0132:         candidates = uploaded + not_uploaded
0133: 
0134:         if not_uploaded:
0135:             log.warning(
0136:                 "%d non-uploaded files may need pruning — "
0137:                 "consider increasing circular_buffer_gb or reducing capture frequency",
0138:                 len(not_uploaded)
0139:             )
0140: 
0141:         return candidates
0142: 
0143:     def stats(self) -> dict:
0144:         """Return buffer statistics as a dict."""
0145:         used = self.usage_bytes()
0146:         return {
0147:             "path":       str(self._path),
0148:             "used_gb":    round(used / 1e9, 2),
0149:             "max_gb":     round(self._max_bytes / 1e9, 2),
0150:             "used_pct":   round(100 * used / self._max_bytes, 1),
0151:             "file_count": sum(1 for f in self._path.rglob("*") if f.is_file()),
0152:         }
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Image Quality Checker
0003: =======================================
0004: OpenCV-based quality assessment for captured images.
0005: Runs on CPU — no GPU/NPU dependency.
0006: 
0007: Checks performed:
0008:   1. Blur (Laplacian variance)  — detects focus drift, dirt, condensation
0009:   2. Under-exposure             — detects night captures, lens cap, relay failure
0010:   3. Over-exposure              — detects direct sun, wrong exposure settings
0011:   4. File integrity             — verifies SHA-256 matches what was recorded at download
0012: 
0013: SABSA: Integrity — every image is assessed and flagged, but still stored
0014:        and transmitted. Operators review flagged images via web UI.
0015: """
0016: 
0017: from __future__ import annotations
0018: 
0019: import dataclasses
0020: import hashlib
0021: import logging
0022: from enum import Enum
0023: from pathlib import Path
0024: from typing import Optional
0025: 
0026: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0027: 
0028: 
0029: class QualityFlag(Enum):
0030:     OK            = "ok"
0031:     BLURRY        = "blurry"           # Laplacian variance below threshold
0032:     UNDEREXPOSED  = "underexposed"     # mean brightness too low
0033:     OVEREXPOSED   = "overexposed"      # mean brightness too high
0034:     HASH_MISMATCH = "hash_mismatch"    # file corrupted after download
0035:     ERROR         = "error"            # assessment itself failed
0036: 
0037: 
0038: @dataclasses.dataclass
0039: class QualityResult:
0040:     flag:            QualityFlag
0041:     passed:          bool             # True only if flag == OK
0042:     blur_score:      Optional[float]  # Laplacian variance (higher = sharper)
0043:     brightness_mean: Optional[float]  # 0–255
0044:     blur_threshold:  float
0045:     dark_threshold:  float
0046:     bright_threshold:float
0047:     sha256_verified: bool
0048:     message:         str              # human-readable summary
0049: 
0050:     def as_dict(self) -> dict:
0051:         return {
0052:             "flag":             self.flag.value,
0053:             "passed":           self.passed,
0054:             "blur_score":       self.blur_score,
0055:             "brightness_mean":  self.brightness_mean,
0056:             "blur_threshold":   self.blur_threshold,
0057:             "dark_threshold":   self.dark_threshold,
0058:             "bright_threshold": self.bright_threshold,
0059:             "sha256_verified":  self.sha256_verified,
0060:             "message":          self.message,
0061:         }
0062: 
0063: 
0064: class QualityChecker:
0065:     """
0066:     Assess image quality using OpenCV (CPU-only).
0067: 
0068:     Config keys (from config.yaml quality section):
0069:         check_enabled:     bool  (default true)
0070:         blur_threshold:    float Laplacian variance; below = blurry (default 80)
0071:         dark_threshold:    float mean brightness; below = underexposed (default 25)
0072:         bright_threshold:  float mean brightness; above = overexposed (default 230)
0073:     """
0074: 
0075:     def __init__(self, config: dict):
0076:         quality_cfg = config.get("quality", {})
0077:         self._enabled         = quality_cfg.get("check_enabled", True)
0078:         self._blur_thresh     = float(quality_cfg.get("blur_threshold", 80.0))
0079:         self._dark_thresh     = float(quality_cfg.get("dark_threshold", 25.0))
0080:         self._bright_thresh   = float(quality_cfg.get("bright_threshold", 230.0))
0081:         self._cv2_available   = self._check_opencv()
0082: 
0083:     def _check_opencv(self) -> bool:
0084:         try:
0085:             import cv2  # noqa: F401
0086:             return True
0087:         except ImportError:
0088:             log.warning(
0089:                 "opencv-python not installed — quality checks disabled. "
0090:                 "Install with: pip install opencv-python-headless"
0091:             )
0092:             return False
0093: 
0094:     def check(self, filepath: Path, expected_sha256: Optional[str] = None) -> QualityResult:
0095:         """
0096:         Assess image quality.
0097: 
0098:         Args:
0099:             filepath:        path to the JPEG/RAW image
0100:             expected_sha256: if provided, verify file hash
0101: 
0102:         Returns:
0103:             QualityResult — always returns, never raises.
0104:             Flag is ERROR if assessment itself fails.
0105:         """
0106:         if not self._enabled:
0107:             return QualityResult(
0108:                 flag=QualityFlag.OK, passed=True,
0109:                 blur_score=None, brightness_mean=None,
0110:                 blur_threshold=self._blur_thresh,
0111:                 dark_threshold=self._dark_thresh,
0112:                 bright_threshold=self._bright_thresh,
0113:                 sha256_verified=False,
0114:                 message="Quality checks disabled",
0115:             )
0116: 
0117:         # ── Hash verification ──────────────────────────────────────────────
0118:         sha256_ok = True
0119:         if expected_sha256:
0120:             actual = self._compute_sha256(filepath)
0121:             sha256_ok = (actual == expected_sha256)
0122:             if not sha256_ok:
0123:                 log.error(
0124:                     "SHA-256 mismatch for %s: expected %s got %s",
0125:                     filepath.name, expected_sha256[:12], actual[:12]
0126:                 )
0127:                 return QualityResult(
0128:                     flag=QualityFlag.HASH_MISMATCH, passed=False,
0129:                     blur_score=None, brightness_mean=None,
0130:                     blur_threshold=self._blur_thresh,
0131:                     dark_threshold=self._dark_thresh,
0132:                     bright_threshold=self._bright_thresh,
0133:                     sha256_verified=False,
0134:                     message=f"File corruption detected: SHA-256 mismatch",
0135:                 )
0136: 
0137:         # ── OpenCV analysis ────────────────────────────────────────────────
0138:         if not self._cv2_available:
0139:             return QualityResult(
0140:                 flag=QualityFlag.OK, passed=True,
0141:                 blur_score=None, brightness_mean=None,
0142:                 blur_threshold=self._blur_thresh,
0143:                 dark_threshold=self._dark_thresh,
0144:                 bright_threshold=self._bright_thresh,
0145:                 sha256_verified=sha256_ok,
0146:                 message="OpenCV not available — checks skipped",
0147:             )
0148: 
0149:         try:
0150:             blur_score, brightness = self._analyse(filepath)
0151:         except Exception as exc:
0152:             log.exception("Quality analysis failed for %s", filepath.name)
0153:             return QualityResult(
0154:                 flag=QualityFlag.ERROR, passed=False,
0155:                 blur_score=None, brightness_mean=None,
0156:                 blur_threshold=self._blur_thresh,
0157:                 dark_threshold=self._dark_thresh,
0158:                 bright_threshold=self._bright_thresh,
0159:                 sha256_verified=sha256_ok,
0160:                 message=f"Analysis error: {exc}",
0161:             )
0162: 
0163:         # ── Apply thresholds ───────────────────────────────────────────────
0164:         if blur_score < self._blur_thresh:
0165:             flag = QualityFlag.BLURRY
0166:             msg  = (f"Blur score {blur_score:.1f} below threshold {self._blur_thresh} "
0167:                     f"— possible focus drift, dirt or condensation on glass")
0168:         elif brightness < self._dark_thresh:
0169:             flag = QualityFlag.UNDEREXPOSED
0170:             msg  = (f"Mean brightness {brightness:.1f} below {self._dark_thresh} "
0171:                     f"— image too dark (night? lens cap? relay failure?)")
0172:         elif brightness > self._bright_thresh:
0173:             flag = QualityFlag.OVEREXPOSED
0174:             msg  = (f"Mean brightness {brightness:.1f} above {self._bright_thresh} "
0175:                     f"— image too bright (sun in lens? wrong exposure?)")
0176:         else:
0177:             flag = QualityFlag.OK
0178:             msg  = (f"OK — blur={blur_score:.1f} brightness={brightness:.1f}")
0179: 
0180:         passed = (flag == QualityFlag.OK)
0181:         if not passed:
0182:             log.warning("Quality check FAILED for %s: %s", filepath.name, msg)
0183:         else:
0184:             log.info("Quality check PASSED for %s: %s", filepath.name, msg)
0185: 
0186:         return QualityResult(
0187:             flag=flag, passed=passed,
0188:             blur_score=blur_score,
0189:             brightness_mean=brightness,
0190:             blur_threshold=self._blur_thresh,
0191:             dark_threshold=self._dark_thresh,
0192:             bright_threshold=self._bright_thresh,
0193:             sha256_verified=sha256_ok,
0194:             message=msg,
0195:         )
0196: 
0197:     def _analyse(self, filepath: Path) -> tuple[float, float]:
0198:         """
0199:         Load image, compute Laplacian variance (blur) and mean brightness.
0200:         Returns (blur_score, brightness_mean).
0201:         """
0202:         import cv2
0203:         import numpy as np
0204: 
0205:         img = cv2.imread(str(filepath))
0206:         if img is None:
0207:             raise ValueError(f"cv2.imread returned None for {filepath}")
0208: 
0209:         # Resize to max 1024px on longest side for speed (quality unaffected)
0210:         h, w = img.shape[:2]
0211:         max_dim = 1024
0212:         if max(h, w) > max_dim:
0213:             scale = max_dim / max(h, w)
0214:             img = cv2.resize(img, (int(w * scale), int(h * scale)))
0215: 
0216:         gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
0217: 
0218:         # Blur detection: Laplacian variance
0219:         # High variance = sharp image, low variance = blurry
0220:         blur_score = float(cv2.Laplacian(gray, cv2.CV_64F).var())
0221: 
0222:         # Brightness: mean pixel value of greyscale image
0223:         brightness = float(np.mean(gray))
0224: 
0225:         return blur_score, brightness
0226: 
0227:     @staticmethod
0228:     def _compute_sha256(filepath: Path) -> str:
0229:         h = hashlib.sha256()
0230:         with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
0231:             for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
0232:                 h.update(chunk)
0233:         return h.hexdigest()
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Configuration Manager
0003: =======================================
0004: Handles the three-layer configuration model:
0005: 
0006:   1. bootstrap.yaml    — device identity (written at provisioning, never changed)
0007:   2. local_network.yaml — connectivity settings (can be overwritten by headend)
0008:   3. config.yaml       — operational config (pulled from headend, cached locally)
0009: 
0010: SABSA: Manageability — central config control with local autonomous fallback.
0011:        Availability  — agent always has a valid config even if headend unreachable.
0012: """
0013: 
0014: from __future__ import annotations
0015: 
0016: import logging
0017: import re
0018: import uuid
0019: from pathlib import Path
0020: from typing import Any, Optional
0021: 
0022: import yaml
0023: 
0024: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0025: 
0026: BASE_DIR     = Path("/opt/timelapse/edge")
0027: BOOTSTRAP    = BASE_DIR / "bootstrap.yaml"
0028: NETWORK_CFG  = BASE_DIR / "local_network.yaml"
0029: CONFIG_FILE  = BASE_DIR / "config.yaml"
0030: TOKEN_FILE   = BASE_DIR / "api_token.txt"
0031: 
0032: 
0033: class ConfigManager:

0035:     Loads and merges all configuration layers into a single dict.
0036: 
0037:     The merged config is the authoritative source of truth for all
0038:     other agent components.
0039:     """

0041:     def __init__(self, base_dir: Optional[Path] = None):
0042:         self._base = base_dir or BASE_DIR

0044:         self._network:     dict = {}
0045:         self._operational: dict = {}
0046:         self._merged:      dict = {}
0047: 
0048:     def load(self) -> dict:
0049:         """
0050:         Load and merge all config layers.
0051:         Returns the merged config dict.
0052:         Raises on missing bootstrap (fatal).
0053:         """
0054:         self._bootstrap   = self._load_bootstrap()
0055:         self._network     = self._load_network()
0056:         self._operational = self._load_operational()
0057:         self._merged      = self._merge()
0058:         log.info(
0059:             "Config loaded — device_id=%s location=%s",
0060:             self._merged.get("device", {}).get("device_id"),
0061:             self._merged.get("device", {}).get("location_name"),
0062:         )
0063:         return self._merged
0064: 
0065:     @property
0066:     def device_id(self) -> str:
0067:         return self._bootstrap.get("device_id") or self._derive_device_id()
0068: 
0069:     @property
0070:     def headend_url(self) -> str:
0071:         return self._bootstrap.get("headend_url", "https://timelapse.example.com/api")
0072: 
0073:     @property
0074:     def bootstrap_token(self) -> Optional[str]:
0075:         return self._bootstrap.get("bootstrap_token")
0076: 
0077:     @property
0078:     def api_token(self) -> Optional[str]:
0079:         token_path = self._base / "api_token.txt"
0080:         if token_path.exists():
0081:             return token_path.read_text().strip() or None
0082:         return None
0083: 
0084:     def save_api_token(self, token: str) -> None:
0085:         token_path = self._base / "api_token.txt"
0086:         token_path.write_text(token.strip())
0087:         log.info("API token saved")
0088: 
0089:     @property
0090:     def base_dir(self) -> Path:
0091:         return self._base
0092: 
0093:     def save_config(self, config_dict: dict) -> None:
0094:         """Write updated operational config to disk (from headend).
0095:         SFTP credentials are NOT cached to disk — always fetched fresh from headend.
0096:         """
0097:         cfg_path = self._base / "config.yaml"
0098:         safe_dict = {k: v for k, v in config_dict.items() if k != "sftp"}
0099:         with open(cfg_path, "w") as f:
0100:             yaml.dump(safe_dict, f, default_flow_style=False, allow_unicode=True)
0101:         log.info("Operational config saved to %s", cfg_path)
0102:         # Cache SFTP separately for cold-start resilience
0103:         if "sftp" in config_dict:
0104:             sftp_path = self._base / "sftp_cache.yaml"
0105:             with open(sftp_path, "w") as f:
0106:                 yaml.dump({"sftp": config_dict["sftp"]}, f, default_flow_style=False, allow_unicode=True)
0107:             sftp_path.chmod(0o600)
0108:             log.info("SFTP config cached to %s", sftp_path)
0109:         # Reload
0110:         self._operational = config_dict
0111:         self._merged      = self._merge()
0112: 
0113:     def save_network_config(self, network_dict: dict) -> None:
0114:         """Write updated network config to disk (from headend)."""
0115:         net_path = self._base / "local_network.yaml"
0116:         with open(net_path, "w") as f:
0117:             yaml.dump(network_dict, f, default_flow_style=False, allow_unicode=True)
0118:         log.info("Network config saved to %s", net_path)
0119:         self._network = network_dict
0120:         self._merged  = self._merge()
0121: 
0122:     # ── Private loaders ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0123: 
0124:     def _load_bootstrap(self) -> dict:
0125:         path = self._base / "bootstrap.yaml"
0126:         if not path.exists():
0127:             raise FileNotFoundError(
0128:                 f"bootstrap.yaml not found at {path}. "
0129:                 "Has the device been provisioned?"
0130:             )
0131:         data = _load_yaml(path)
0132:         # Inject device_id derived from MAC if not present
0133:         if not data.get("device_id"):
0134:             data["device_id"] = self._derive_device_id()
0135:             log.warning(
0136:                 "device_id not in bootstrap.yaml — derived from MAC: %s",
0137:                 data["device_id"]
0138:             )
0139:         return data
0140: 
0141:     def _load_network(self) -> dict:
0142:         path = self._base / "local_network.yaml"
0143:         if not path.exists():
0144:             log.info("local_network.yaml not found — using defaults")
0145:             return {"connectivity": {"preferred_order": ["ethernet", "wifi"]}}
0146:         return _load_yaml(path)
0147: 
0148:     def _load_operational(self) -> dict:
0149:         path = self._base / "config.yaml"
0150:         if not path.exists():
0151:             log.warning("config.yaml not found — agent will attempt bootstrap from headend")
0152:             return {}
0153:         data = _load_yaml(path)
0154:         # Inject cached SFTP config for cold-start resilience
0155:         sftp_path = self._base / "sftp_cache.yaml"
0156:         if sftp_path.exists() and "sftp" not in data:
0157:             sftp_data = _load_yaml(sftp_path)
0158:             if "sftp" in sftp_data:
0159:                 data["sftp"] = sftp_data["sftp"]
0160:                 log.info("SFTP config loaded from cold-start cache")
0161:         return data
0162: 
0163:     def _merge(self) -> dict:
0164:         """Deep merge all layers. Operational config wins on conflict."""
0165:         merged = {}
0166:         # Start from operational config as base
0167:         _deep_update(merged, self._operational)
0168:         # Inject bootstrap identity into device section
0169:         device = merged.setdefault("device", {})
0170:         device["device_id"] = self._bootstrap.get("device_id", self._derive_device_id())
0171:         device.setdefault("headend_url", self._bootstrap.get("headend_url", ""))
0172:         # Inject network into connectivity section
0173:         merged["connectivity"] = self._network.get("connectivity", {})
0174:         return merged
0175: 
0176:     @staticmethod
0177:     def _derive_device_id() -> str:
0178:         """Derive device_id from primary MAC address."""
0179:         mac_int = uuid.getnode()
0180:         mac_str = ":".join(f"{(mac_int >> (8 * i)) & 0xFF:02X}"
0181:                            for i in reversed(range(6)))
0182:         mac_clean = re.sub(":", "", mac_str)
0183:         return f"TL-{mac_clean}"
0184: 
0185: 
0186: # ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0187: 
0188: def _load_yaml(path: Path) -> dict:
0189:     with open(path, "r") as f:
0190:         data = yaml.safe_load(f)
0191:     return data or {}
0192: 
0193: 
0194: def _deep_update(base: dict, update: dict) -> dict:
0195:     """Recursively merge update into base (in-place). Returns base."""
0196:     for key, value in update.items():
0197:         if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(base.get(key), dict):
0198:             _deep_update(base[key], value)
0199:         else:
0200:             base[key] = value
0201:     return base
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Camera Diagnostics Collector
0003: =============================================
0004: Reads camera status and configuration via gphoto2 and compares
0005: against expected fleet defaults. Called once per capture cycle.
0006: 
0007: SABSA: Accountability — full camera telemetry per device.
0008:        Manageability — detect config drift from fleet standard.
0009: """
0010: 
0011: from __future__ import annotations
0012: 
0013: import logging
0014: import subprocess
0015: from typing import Optional
0016: 
0017: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0018: 
0019: # Parameters to read from camera and their gphoto2 config paths
0020: CAMERA_STATUS_PARAMS = {
0021:     "battery_pct":      "/main/status/batterylevel",
0022:     "shutter_count":    "/main/status/shuttercounter",
0023:     "available_shots":  "/main/status/availableshots",
0024:     "lens_name":        "/main/status/lensname",
0025:     "serial_number":    "/main/status/eosserialnumber",
0026: }
0027: 
0028: CAMERA_CONFIG_PARAMS = {
0029:     "focus_mode":        "/main/capturesettings/focusmode",
0030:     "image_format":      "/main/imgsettings/imageformat",
0031:     "iso":               "/main/imgsettings/iso",
0032:     "white_balance":     "/main/imgsettings/whitebalance",
0033:     "color_space":       "/main/imgsettings/colorspace",
0034:     "exposure_comp":     "/main/capturesettings/exposurecompensation",
0035:     "ae_mode":           "/main/capturesettings/autoexposuremode",
0036:     "picture_style":     "/main/capturesettings/picturestyle",
0037:     "metering_mode":     "/main/capturesettings/meteringmode",
0038:     "capture_target":    "/main/settings/capturetarget",
0039: }
0040: 
0041: # Default expected values for fleet — overridable per device
0042: # Note: capture_target excluded — Canon EOS resets to Internal RAM at power-on,
0043: #       always controlled via initial_commands instead
0044: FLEET_DEFAULTS = {
0045:     "focus_mode":    "Manual",
0046:     "image_format":  "Large Fine JPEG",
0047:     "iso":           "Auto",
0048:     "white_balance": "AWB White",
0049:     "color_space":   "sRGB",
0050:     "exposure_comp": "0",
0051:     "ae_mode":       "P",
0052:     "picture_style": "Neutral",
0053:     "metering_mode": "Evaluative",
0054: }
0055: 
0056: # Shutter life ratings per camera model (conservative estimate)
0057: SHUTTER_RATINGS = {
0058:     "Canon EOS 1300D": 100_000,
0059:     "Canon EOS 2000D": 100_000,
0060:     "Canon EOS 250D": 100_000,
0061:     "Canon EOS 90D": 150_000,
0062:     "Canon EOS 5D Mark IV": 150_000,
0063: }
0064: DEFAULT_SHUTTER_RATING = 100_000
0065: 
0066: 
0067: def _read_gphoto2_param(param_path: str, timeout: int = 5) -> Optional[str]:
0068:     """Read a single gphoto2 config parameter value."""
0069:     try:
0070:         result = subprocess.run(
0071:             ["gphoto2", "--get-config", param_path],
0072:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout
0073:         )
0074:         for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
0075:             if line.startswith("Current:"):
0076:                 return line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
0077:     except Exception as exc:
0078:         log.debug("gphoto2 read failed for %s: %s", param_path, exc)
0079:     return None
0080: 
0081: 
0082: def collect_camera_diagnostics(
0083:     camera_model: Optional[str] = None,
0084:     expected_overrides: Optional[dict] = None,
0085: ) -> dict:
0086:     """
0087:     Read camera status and config via gphoto2.
0088:     Returns a dict with:
0089:       - camera_status: battery, shutter, available shots, lens
0090:       - camera_config: current config values
0091:       - camera_config_drift: list of parameters that differ from expected
0092:       - shutter_pct: percentage of rated shutter life used
0093:       - shutter_alarm: True if > 80% of rated life used
0094:     """
0095:     result = {
0096:         "camera_status": {},
0097:         "camera_config": {},
0098:         "camera_config_drift": [],
0099:         "shutter_pct": None,
0100:         "shutter_alarm": False,
0101:     }
0102: 
0103:     # Read status parameters
0104:     for key, path in CAMERA_STATUS_PARAMS.items():
0105:         val = _read_gphoto2_param(path)
0106:         if val is not None:
0107:             # Convert numeric fields
0108:             if key in ("shutter_count", "available_shots"):
0109:                 try:
0110:                     val = int(val)
0111:                 except ValueError:
0112:                     pass
0113:             elif key == "battery_pct":
0114:                 try:
0115:                     val = int(val.replace("%", "").strip())
0116:                 except ValueError:
0117:                     pass
0118:             result["camera_status"][key] = val
0119: 
0120:     # Calculate shutter life percentage
0121:     shutter = result["camera_status"].get("shutter_count")
0122:     if shutter is not None:
0123:         rating = SHUTTER_RATINGS.get(camera_model or "", DEFAULT_SHUTTER_RATING)
0124:         pct = round(100 * shutter / rating, 1)
0125:         result["shutter_pct"] = pct
0126:         result["shutter_alarm"] = pct >= 80
0127:         result["shutter_rating"] = rating
0128:         if pct >= 80:
0129:             log.warning(
0130:                 "Shutter count %d is %.1f%% of rated life (%d) — replacement recommended",
0131:                 shutter, pct, rating
0132:             )
0133: 
0134:     # Read config parameters
0135:     for key, path in CAMERA_CONFIG_PARAMS.items():
0136:         val = _read_gphoto2_param(path)
0137:         if val is not None:
0138:             result["camera_config"][key] = val
0139: 
0140:     # Check for config drift against expected values
0141:     expected = dict(FLEET_DEFAULTS)
0142:     if expected_overrides:
0143:         expected.update(expected_overrides)
0144: 
0145:     drift = []
0146:     for key, expected_val in expected.items():
0147:         actual_val = result["camera_config"].get(key)
0148:         if actual_val is not None and str(actual_val) != str(expected_val):
0149:             drift.append({
0150:                 "param":    key,
0151:                 "expected": expected_val,
0152:                 "actual":   actual_val,
0153:             })
0154:             log.warning(
0155:                 "Camera config drift: %s expected=%s actual=%s",
0156:                 key, expected_val, actual_val
0157:             )
0158: 
0159:     result["camera_config_drift"] = drift
0160: 
0161:     return result
```
