```python
0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """
0003: TimeLapse Pro — AI Tag Backfill
0004: ================================
0005: Kører objekt-genkendelse på alle eksisterende billeder og gemmer
0006: tags i ai_tags-kolonnen (JSON-array) i PostgreSQL.
0007: 
0008: Tags bruges til søgning: #kran, #bil, #røg, #person osv.
0009: 
0010: Brug:
0011:   python ai/backfill_tags.py                          # Alle billeder uden tags
0012:   python ai/backfill_tags.py --device-id TL-xxx       # Kun én enhed
0013:   python ai/backfill_tags.py --limit 100              # Test med 100 billeder
0014:   python ai/backfill_tags.py --rerun                  # Genanalyser alle (inkl. eksisterende)
0015:   python ai/backfill_tags.py --dry-run                # Se hvad der ville ske
0016: 
0017: Krav:
0018:   DATABASE_URL og SFTP_BASE som environment-variabler.
0019: """
0020: 
0021: import argparse
0022: import json
0023: import re
0024: import sys
0025: import time
0026: from datetime import datetime, timezone
0027: from pathlib import Path
0028: 
0029: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))
0030: 
0031: import os
0032: from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
0033: from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
0034: 
0035: DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///./timelapse_headend.db")
0036: SFTP_BASE    = Path(os.getenv("SFTP_BASE", "/Users/Shared/timelapse/incoming"))
0037: 
0038: GREEN  = "\033[92m"; YELLOW = "\033[93m"; RED = "\033[91m"
0039: CYAN   = "\033[96m"; BOLD   = "\033[1m";  RESET = "\033[0m"
0040: 
0041: MIN_FILE_BYTES = 50_000
0042: 
0043: 
0044: def get_sftp_base(session) -> Path:
0045:     try:
0046:         result = session.execute(text("SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key='sftp_base'")).fetchone()
0047:         if result:
0048:             return Path(result[0])
0049:     except Exception:
0050:         pass
0051:     return SFTP_BASE
0052: 
0053: 
0054: def find_image(sftp_base: Path, device_id: str, filename: str) -> Path | None:
0055:     m = re.search(r"_(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_\d{6}\.\w+$", filename)
0056:     if m:
0057:         yyyy, mm, dd = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
0058:         matches = list(sftp_base.glob(f"*/data/*/*/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{filename}"))
0059:         if matches:
0060:             return matches[0]
0061:     flat = sftp_base / device_id / filename
0062:     if flat.exists():
0063:         return flat
0064:     return None
0065: 
0066: 
0067: def run_migration(engine) -> None:
0068:     """Tilføj ai_tags-kolonne hvis den ikke findes."""
0069:     # Kolonne allerede tilføjet via psql
0070:     print(f"  · ai_tags kolonne klar")
0071: 
0072: 
0073: def update_sidecar_tags(image_path: Path, tags: list[str]) -> None:
0074:     """Tilføj tags til eksisterende sidecar JSON."""
0075:     sidecar = image_path.with_suffix(".json")
0076:     if not sidecar.exists():
0077:         return
0078:     try:
0079:         data = json.loads(sidecar.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
0080:         if "ai_analysis" in data:
0081:             data["ai_analysis"]["tags"] = tags
0082:         else:
0083:             data["ai_tags"] = tags
0084:         sidecar.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
0085:     except Exception as e:
0086:         pass  # Sidecar-fejl er ikke kritisk
0087: 
0088: 
0089: def main():
0090:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="TimeLapse Pro AI Tag Backfill")
0091:     parser.add_argument("--device-id",  help="Kun denne device")
0092:     parser.add_argument("--limit",      type=int, default=0, help="Max antal (0=alle)")
0093:     parser.add_argument("--rerun",      action="store_true", help="Genanalyser alle, inkl. eksisterende tags")
0094:     parser.add_argument("--dry-run",    action="store_true", help="Vis uden at køre")
0095:     parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=10, help="Pause-interval")
0096:     args = parser.parse_args()
0097: 
0098:     print(f"\n{BOLD}TimeLapse Pro — AI Tag Backfill{RESET}")
0099:     print(f"Database: {DATABASE_URL}")
0100:     print(f"Tilstand: {'dry-run' if args.dry_run else 'rerun alle' if args.rerun else 'kun nye'}\n")
0101: 
0102:     engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
0103:                            if DATABASE_URL.startswith("sqlite") else {})
0104:     Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
0105:     db = Session()
0106: 
0107:     # Migration
0108:     print(f"{BOLD}── DB Migration ──{RESET}")
0109:     run_migration(engine)
0110: 
0111:     sftp_base = get_sftp_base(db)
0112:     print(f"\nSFTP base: {sftp_base}")
0113: 
0114:     # Hent captures
0115:     from database import Capture
0116:     query = db.query(Capture)
0117:     if not args.rerun:
0118:         query = query.filter(Capture.ai_tags.is_(None))
0119:     if args.device_id:
0120:         query = query.filter_by(device_id=args.device_id)
0121:     # Prioritér billeder med eksisterende ai_result (quality allerede analyseret)
0122:     query = query.order_by(Capture.ai_result.desc(), Capture.id.desc())
0123:     if args.limit:
0124:         query = query.limit(args.limit)
0125: 
0126:     captures = query.all()
0127:     total = len(captures)
0128: 
0129:     print(f"\n{BOLD}── {total} billeder til tag-analyse ──{RESET}\n")
0130: 
0131:     if total == 0:
0132:         print(f"{GREEN}✓ Alle billeder har allerede tags{RESET}")
0133:         return
0134: 
0135:     if args.dry_run:
0136:         print(f"{YELLOW}Dry-run — viser de første 10:{RESET}")
0137:         for c in captures[:10]:
0138:             path = find_image(sftp_base, c.device_id, c.filename)
0139:             print(f"  [{c.id}] {c.filename[:60]}  {'✓' if path else '✗ mangler'}")
0140:         if total > 10:
0141:             print(f"  ... og {total - 10} flere")
0142:         return
0143: 
0144:     # Ollama check
0145:     from ai.ollama_service import get_ollama_service
0146:     svc = get_ollama_service()
0147:     if not svc.is_available():
0148:         print(f"{RED}✗ Ollama ikke tilgængelig{RESET}")
0149:         sys.exit(1)
0150:     print(f"{GREEN}✓ Ollama klar — bruger {svc._model} med ORIGINALBILLEDER{RESET}\n")
0151: 
0152:     ok = skipped = errors = 0
0153:     all_tags: dict[str, int] = {}
0154:     t_start = time.monotonic()
0155: 
0156:     for i, capture in enumerate(captures, 1):
0157:         image_path = find_image(sftp_base, capture.device_id, capture.filename)
0158: 
0159:         if not image_path:
0160:             print(f"  [{i}/{total}] {YELLOW}↷ Fil ikke fundet:{RESET} {capture.filename[:50]}")
0161:             skipped += 1
0162:             continue
0163: 
0164:         if image_path.stat().st_size < MIN_FILE_BYTES:
0165:             skipped += 1
0166:             continue
0167: 
0168:         print(f"  [{i}/{total}] {capture.filename[:55]}", end="", flush=True)
0169: 
0170:         result = svc.extract_tags(image_path)
0171: 
0172:         if result.error:
0173:             print(f"  {RED}✗ {result.error[:40]}{RESET}")
0174:             errors += 1
0175:             continue
0176: 
0177:         # Gem i DB
0178:         capture.ai_tags = json.dumps(result.tags, ensure_ascii=False)
0179:         db.commit()
0180: 
0181:         # Opdater sidecar
0182:         update_sidecar_tags(image_path, result.tags)
0183: 
0184:         # Tæl tags til statistik
0185:         for t in result.tags:
0186:             all_tags[t] = all_tags.get(t, 0) + 1
0187: 
0188:         tag_str = " ".join(f"#{t}" for t in result.tags[:5])
0189:         if len(result.tags) > 5:
0190:             tag_str += f" +{len(result.tags)-5}"
0191:         print(f"  {CYAN}{tag_str}{RESET}  {result.latency_ms}ms")
0192:         ok += 1
0193: 
0194:         if i % args.batch_size == 0:
0195:             elapsed = time.monotonic() - t_start
0196:             rate    = i / elapsed
0197:             eta_min = int((total - i) / rate / 60) if rate > 0 else 0
0198:             print(f"\n  {BOLD}── {i}/{total} — ETA ~{eta_min} min ──{RESET}\n")
0199: 
0200:     # ── Opsummering ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0201:     elapsed = time.monotonic() - t_start
0202:     print(f"\n{BOLD}{'═' * 55}")
0203:     print(f"  TAG BACKFILL FÆRDIG — {total} billeder")
0204:     print(f"{'═' * 55}{RESET}")
0205:     print(f"  {GREEN}✓ Taggede:       {ok}{RESET}")
0206:     print(f"  {YELLOW}↷ Sprunget over: {skipped}{RESET}")
0207:     if errors:
0208:         print(f"  {RED}✗ Fejl:          {errors}{RESET}")
0209:     print(f"  Tid:             {int(elapsed/60)} min {int(elapsed%60)} sek")
0210: 
0211:     if all_tags:
0212:         print(f"\n{BOLD}  Top 20 tags:{RESET}")
0213:         for tag, count in sorted(all_tags.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:
0214:             pct = count / ok * 100
0215:             bar = "█" * int(pct / 3)
0216:             print(f"  #{tag:<25} {bar:<20} {count:4d} ({pct:.0f}%)")
0217: 
0218: 
0219: if __name__ == "__main__":
0220:     main()
```

## `headend/ai/feedback_manager.py`

### Raw source with line numbers

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Feedback Manager
0003: ==================================
0004: Human-in-the-loop feedback loop til AI-analyse.
0005: 
0006: To workflows:
0007: 
0008: 1. ESKALERING (should_escalate)
0009:    - Lokal model markerer usikre billeder
0010:    - Admin godkender batch i UI
0011:    - Gemini analyserer godkendte billeder
0012:    - Resultater merges ind i analyse
0013: 
0014: 2. MANUEL KORREKTION
0015:    - Admin gennemgår en dags billeder
0016:    - Retter tags, kvalitet og scene-beskrivelse
0017:    - Korrektioner gemmes som ground truth
0018:    - PromptOptimizer genererer few-shot eksempler
0019:    - Næste analyse inkluderer eksemplerne
0020: """
0021: 
0022: from __future__ import annotations
0023: 
0024: import logging
0025: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
0026: from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
0027: from typing import Optional
0028: 
0029: from sqlalchemy import text
0030: from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
0031: 
0032: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0033: 
0034: 
0035: # =============================================================================
0036: # ESKALERINGS-KRITERIER
0037: # Justér thresholds her — ét sted, ingen kode-ændringer
0038: # =============================================================================
0039: 
0040: ESCALATION_RULES = {
0041:     "low_confidence":      0.70,   # escalate hvis confidence < denne
0042:     "many_new_tags":       4,      # escalate hvis > N nye/ukendte tags
0043:     "critical_tags": [             # escalate altid hvis disse tags ses
0044:         "brand", "røg", "ild", "vandskade", "oversvømmelse",
0045:         "konstruktionsskade", "kollaps_risiko", "ulykke",
0046:         "hærværk", "uvedkommende",
0047:     ],
0048:     "always_escalate_change": True,  # change_detected = True → altid eskalér
0049:     "poor_quality_flags": [
0050:         "beskidt_linse", "kondens_på_linse", "forhindring_foran_kamera",
0051:         "overeksponeret", "undereksponeret", "kamera_bevæget",
0052:     ],
0053: }
0054: 
0055: 
0056: def should_escalate(
0057:     confidence:      float,
0058:     tags:            list[str],
0059:     new_tags:        list[str],
0060:     change_detected: bool,
0061:     quality_flag:    str,
0062:     quality_ok:      bool,
0063: ) -> tuple[bool, float, list[str]]:
0064:     """
0065:     Beregn om et billede skal eskaleres til Gemini.
0066: 
0067:     Returnerer: (should_escalate, score, reasons)
0068:       score: 0.0–1.0 — jo højere, jo mere usikker
0069:       reasons: hvilke regler der triggede
0070:     """
0071:     reasons = []
0072:     score_components = []
0073: 
0074:     # Lav confidence
0075:     if confidence < ESCALATION_RULES["low_confidence"]:
0076:         reasons.append(f"lav_confidence:{confidence:.2f}")
0077:         score_components.append(1.0 - confidence)
0078: 
0079:     # Mange nye tags (modellen ser noget ukendt)
0080:     if len(new_tags) > ESCALATION_RULES["many_new_tags"]:
0081:         reasons.append(f"mange_nye_tags:{len(new_tags)}")
0082:         score_components.append(min(len(new_tags) / 10.0, 1.0))
0083: 
0084:     # Kritiske tags
0085:     critical_found = [t for t in tags if t in ESCALATION_RULES["critical_tags"]]
0086:     if critical_found:
0087:         reasons.append(f"kritiske_tags:{','.join(critical_found)}")
0088:         score_components.append(0.9)
0089: 
0090:     # Change detection
0091:     if change_detected and ESCALATION_RULES["always_escalate_change"]:
0092:         reasons.append("change_detected")
0093:         score_components.append(0.6)
0094: 
0095:     # Dårlig billedkvalitet
0096:     if quality_flag in ESCALATION_RULES["poor_quality_flags"] or not quality_ok:
0097:         reasons.append(f"dårlig_kvalitet:{quality_flag}")
0098:         score_components.append(0.5)
0099: 
0100:     escalate = len(reasons) > 0
0101:     score = max(score_components) if score_components else 0.0
0102: 
0103:     return escalate, score, reasons
0104: 
0105: 
0106: # =============================================================================
0107: # ESCALATION MANAGER
0108: # =============================================================================
0109: 
0110: @dataclass
0111: class EscalationItem:
0112:     analysis_id:    int
0113:     capture_id:     int
0114:     filename:       str
0115:     captured_at:    datetime
0116:     location_id:    Optional[str]
0117:     scene_dk:       str
0118:     escalation_score: float
0119:     escalation_reasons: list[str]
0120:     current_tags:   list[str]
0121:     quality_flag:   str
0122:     change_detected: bool
0123: 
0124: 
0125: @dataclass
0126: class EscalationBatchResult:
0127:     approved_count: int
0128:     gemini_called:  int
0129:     tags_updated:   int
0130:     errors:         int
0131: 
0132: 
0133: class EscalationManager:
0134:     """
0135:     Håndterer eskalerings-workflow:
0136:       mark_for_escalation() → kaldes af ai_router efter analyse
0137:       get_pending()         → UI henter billeder til review
0138:       approve_batch()       → admin godkender udvalgte
0139:       run_approved()        → Gemini analyserer godkendte
0140:     """
0141: 
0142:     def __init__(self, db: Session):
0143:         self.db = db
0144: 
0145:     def mark_for_escalation(
0146:         self,
0147:         analysis_id: int,
0148:         score:       float,
0149:         reasons:     list[str],
0150:     ):
0151:         """Markér en analyse til eskalering (pending_review)."""
0152:         self.db.execute(text("""
0153:             UPDATE ai_analyses SET
0154:                 should_escalate    = TRUE,
0155:                 escalation_score   = :score,
0156:                 escalation_reasons = :reasons,
0157:                 escalation_status  = 'pending_review'
0158:             WHERE id = :aid
0159:         """), {"aid": analysis_id, "score": score, "reasons": reasons})
0160:         self.db.commit()
0161:         log.info("Marked analysis %d for escalation (score=%.2f, reasons=%s)",
0162:                  analysis_id, score, reasons)
0163: 
0164:     def get_pending(
0165:         self,
0166:         location_id: Optional[str] = None,
0167:         date_filter: Optional[date] = None,
0168:         limit:       int = 100,
0169:     ) -> list[EscalationItem]:
0170:         """Hent billeder der afventer admin-review."""
0171:         query = "SELECT * FROM v_escalation_queue WHERE TRUE"
0172:         params: dict = {"limit": limit}
0173: 
0174:         if location_id:
0175:             query += " AND location_id = :loc"
0176:             params["loc"] = location_id
0177:         if date_filter:
0178:             query += " AND DATE(captured_at) = :dt"
0179:             params["dt"] = date_filter
0180: 
0181:         query += " ORDER BY escalation_score DESC LIMIT :limit"
0182:         rows = self.db.execute(text(query), params).mappings().all()
0183: 
0184:         return [EscalationItem(
0185:             analysis_id        = r["analysis_id"],
0186:             capture_id         = r["capture_id"],
0187:             filename           = r["filename"],
0188:             captured_at        = r["captured_at"],
0189:             location_id        = r["location_id"],
0190:             scene_dk           = r["scene_dk"] or "",
0191:             escalation_score   = r["escalation_score"] or 0.0,
0192:             escalation_reasons = list(r["escalation_reasons"] or []),
0193:             current_tags       = list(r["current_tags"] or []),
0194:             quality_flag       = r["ai_quality_flag"] or "",
0195:             change_detected    = bool(r["change_detected"]),
0196:         ) for r in rows]
0197: 
0198:     def approve_batch(self, analysis_ids: list[int], approved_by: str):
0199:         """Admin godkender en liste af analyser til Gemini-eskalering."""
0200:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0201:         self.db.execute(text("""
0202:             UPDATE ai_analyses SET
0203:                 escalation_status      = 'approved',
0204:                 escalation_approved_by = :by,
0205:                 escalation_approved_at = :now
0206:             WHERE id = ANY(:ids)
0207:               AND escalation_status = 'pending_review'
0208:         """), {"ids": analysis_ids, "by": approved_by, "now": now})
0209:         self.db.commit()
0210:         log.info("Admin %s approved %d analyses for escalation", approved_by, len(analysis_ids))
0211: 
0212:     def reject_batch(self, analysis_ids: list[int], rejected_by: str):
0213:         """Admin afviser eskalering — billederne behøver ikke Gemini."""
0214:         self.db.execute(text("""
0215:             UPDATE ai_analyses SET escalation_status = 'rejected'
0216:             WHERE id = ANY(:ids)
0217:         """), {"ids": analysis_ids})
0218:         self.db.commit()
0219: 
0220:     def get_approved_for_gemini(self, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
0221:         """Hent analyser godkendt til Gemini, endnu ikke kørt."""
0222:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0223:             SELECT a.id AS analysis_id, c.id AS capture_id,
0224:                    c.filename, a.location_id, a.escalation_reasons
0225:             FROM ai_analyses a
0226:             JOIN captures c ON c.id = a.capture_id
0227:             WHERE a.escalation_status = 'approved'
0228:               AND a.gemini_analysed_at IS NULL
0229:             ORDER BY a.escalation_score DESC
0230:             LIMIT :limit
0231:         """), {"limit": limit}).mappings().all()
0232:         return [dict(r) for r in rows]
0233: 
0234:     def save_gemini_result(
0235:         self,
0236:         analysis_id:  int,
0237:         gemini_model: str,
0238:         tags:         list[str],
0239:         scene_dk:     str,
0240:         raw_result:   dict,
0241:     ):
0242:         """Gem Gemini-svar og mergé tags ind i capture_tags."""
0243:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0244:         self.db.execute(text("""
0245:             UPDATE ai_analyses SET
0246:                 gemini_result       = :raw::jsonb,
0247:                 gemini_model        = :model,
0248:                 gemini_analysed_at  = :now,
0249:                 gemini_tags         = :tags,
0250:                 gemini_scene_dk     = :scene,
0251:                 escalation_status   = 'completed'
0252:             WHERE id = :aid
0253:         """), {
0254:             "aid":   analysis_id,
0255:             "raw":   str(raw_result).replace("'", '"'),
0256:             "model": gemini_model,
0257:             "now":   now,
0258:             "tags":  tags,
0259:             "scene": scene_dk,
0260:         })
0261:         self.db.commit()
0262:         log.info("Gemini result saved for analysis %d: %d tags", analysis_id, len(tags))
0263: 
0264:     def get_stats(self, days: int = 7) -> dict:
0265:         """Eskalerings-statistik til dashboard."""
0266:         row = self.db.execute(text("""
0267:             SELECT
0268:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE should_escalate)                 AS total_flagged,
0269:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE escalation_status = 'pending_review') AS pending,
0270:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE escalation_status = 'approved')  AS approved,
0271:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE escalation_status = 'rejected')  AS rejected,
0272:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE escalation_status = 'completed') AS completed,
0273:                 AVG(escalation_score) FILTER (WHERE should_escalate)    AS avg_score
0274:             FROM ai_analyses
0275:             WHERE analysed_at > NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
0276:         """), {"days": days}).mappings().first()
0277:         return dict(row) if row else {}
0278:

0280: # =============================================================================
0281: # CORRECTIONS MANAGER
0282: # =============================================================================
0283: 
0284: @dataclass
0285: class CaptureForReview:
0286:     capture_id:     int
0287:     filename:       str
0288:     captured_at:    datetime
0289:     location_id:    Optional[str]
0290:     scene_dk:       str
0291:     current_tags:   list[str]
0292:     quality_flag:   str
0293:     quality_ok:     bool
0294:     change_detected: bool
0295:     should_escalate: bool
0296:     gemini_tags:    Optional[list[str]]
0297:     corrected_tags: Optional[list[str]]   # None = ikke korrigeret endnu
0298:     correction_id:  Optional[int]
0299: 
0300: 
0301: class CorrectionsManager:
0302:     """
0303:     Håndterer manuel korrektions-workflow.
0304: 
0305:     Typisk flow:
0306:       1. Admin åbner "Gennemgå dag" i UI
0307:       2. start_session() → opretter feedback-session
0308:       3. get_day_captures() → henter dagens billeder med nuværende analyse
0309:       4. save_correction() × N → admin retter tags/kvalitet
0310:       5. complete_session() → afslutter session
0311:       6. PromptOptimizer.generate_examples() → opdaterer prompts
0312:     """
0313: 
0314:     def __init__(self, db: Session):
0315:         self.db = db
0316: 
0317:     def start_session(
0318:         self,
0319:         session_date: date,
0320:         admin_id:     str,
0321:         location_id:  Optional[str] = None,
0322:         notes:        Optional[str] = None,
0323:     ) -> int:
0324:         """Opret ny feedback-session. Returnerer session_id."""
0325:         result = self.db.execute(text("""
0326:             INSERT INTO ai_feedback_sessions
0327:                 (session_date, admin_id, location_id, notes)
0328:             VALUES (:dt, :admin, :loc, :notes)
0329:             RETURNING id
0330:         """), {
0331:             "dt":    session_date,
0332:             "admin": admin_id,
0333:             "loc":   location_id,
0334:             "notes": notes,
0335:         }).fetchone()
0336:         self.db.commit()
0337:         log.info("Feedback session %d started by %s for %s", result[0], admin_id, session_date)
0338:         return result[0]
0339: 
0340:     def get_day_captures(
0341:         self,
0342:         review_date: date,
0343:         location_id: Optional[str] = None,
0344:         only_escalated: bool = False,
0345:         limit: int = 200,
0346:     ) -> list[CaptureForReview]:
0347:         """Hent alle analyserede captures for en dag til gennemgang."""
0348:         query = """
0349:             SELECT * FROM v_daily_review
0350:             WHERE DATE(captured_at) = :dt
0351:         """
0352:         params: dict = {"dt": review_date, "limit": limit}
0353: 
0354:         if location_id:
0355:             query += " AND location_id = :loc"
0356:             params["loc"] = location_id
0357:         if only_escalated:
0358:             query += " AND should_escalate = TRUE"
0359: 
0360:         query += " ORDER BY captured_at ASC LIMIT :limit"
0361:         rows = self.db.execute(text(query), params).mappings().all()
0362: 
0363:         return [CaptureForReview(
0364:             capture_id      = r["capture_id"],
0365:             filename        = r["filename"],
0366:             captured_at     = r["captured_at"],
0367:             location_id     = r["location_id"],
0368:             scene_dk        = r["scene_dk"] or "",
0369:             current_tags    = list(r["current_tags"] or []),
0370:             quality_flag    = r["ai_quality_flag"] or "",
0371:             quality_ok      = bool(r["ai_quality_ok"]),
0372:             change_detected = bool(r["change_detected"]),
0373:             should_escalate = bool(r["should_escalate"]),
0374:             gemini_tags     = list(r["gemini_tags"]) if r["gemini_tags"] else None,
0375:             corrected_tags  = list(r["corrected_tags"]) if r["corrected_tags"] else None,
0376:             correction_id   = r["correction_id"],
0377:         ) for r in rows]
0378: 
0379:     def save_correction(
0380:         self,
0381:         capture_id:           int,
0382:         session_id:           int,
0383:         admin_id:             str,
0384:         corrected_tags:       list[str],
0385:         corrected_quality_flag: str,
0386:         corrected_quality_ok: bool,
0387:         corrected_scene:      Optional[str] = None,
0388:         corrected_change:     Optional[bool] = None,
0389:         notes:                Optional[str] = None,
0390:     ) -> int:
0391:         """
0392:         Gem manuel korrektion for ét capture.
0393:         Beregner automatisk diff (tilføjede/fjernede tags).
0394:         Returnerer correction_id.
0395:         """
0396:         # Hent original analyse
0397:         original = self.db.execute(text("""
0398:             SELECT a.id AS analysis_id,
0399:                    a.ai_quality_flag, a.ai_quality_ok,
0400:                    a.scene_dk, a.change_detected,
0401:                    array_agg(tv.tag) AS original_tags
0402:             FROM ai_analyses a
0403:             LEFT JOIN capture_tags ct ON ct.capture_id = a.capture_id
0404:             LEFT JOIN ai_tag_vocabulary tv ON tv.id = ct.tag_id AND tv.approved = TRUE
0405:             WHERE a.capture_id = :cid
0406:             GROUP BY a.id, a.ai_quality_flag, a.ai_quality_ok, a.scene_dk, a.change_detected
0407:         """), {"cid": capture_id}).mappings().first()
0408: 
0409:         if not original:
0410:             log.warning("Ingen analyse fundet for capture %d", capture_id)
0411:             return -1
0412: 
0413:         orig_tags = set(original["original_tags"] or [])
0414:         corr_tags = set(corrected_tags)
0415: 
0416:         tags_added   = sorted(corr_tags - orig_tags)
0417:         tags_removed = sorted(orig_tags - corr_tags)
0418: 
0419:         quality_changed = (
0420:             corrected_quality_flag != original["ai_quality_flag"] or
0421:             corrected_quality_ok   != original["ai_quality_ok"]
0422:         )
0423:         scene_changed = bool(
0424:             corrected_scene and corrected_scene != original["scene_dk"]
0425:         )
0426: 
0427:         result = self.db.execute(text("""
0428:             INSERT INTO ai_corrections (
0429:                 capture_id, analysis_id, session_id,
0430:                 original_tags, original_scene, original_quality_flag,
0431:                 original_quality_ok, original_change_detected,
0432:                 corrected_tags, corrected_scene, corrected_quality_flag,
0433:                 corrected_quality_ok, corrected_change_detected,
0434:                 tags_added, tags_removed,
0435:                 quality_changed, scene_changed,
0436:                 notes, corrected_by
0437:             ) VALUES (
0438:                 :cid, :aid, :sid,
0439:                 :orig_tags, :orig_scene, :orig_qflag,
0440:                 :orig_qok, :orig_change,
0441:                 :corr_tags, :corr_scene, :corr_qflag,
0442:                 :corr_qok, :corr_change,
0443:                 :added, :removed,
0444:                 :qchg, :schg,
0445:                 :notes, :admin
0446:             )
0447:             ON CONFLICT (capture_id, session_id) DO UPDATE SET
0448:                 corrected_tags        = EXCLUDED.corrected_tags,
0449:                 corrected_quality_flag= EXCLUDED.corrected_quality_flag,
0450:                 corrected_quality_ok  = EXCLUDED.corrected_quality_ok,
0451:                 tags_added            = EXCLUDED.tags_added,
0452:                 tags_removed          = EXCLUDED.tags_removed,
0453:                 quality_changed       = EXCLUDED.quality_changed,
0454:                 notes                 = EXCLUDED.notes
0455:             RETURNING id
0456:         """), {
0457:             "cid":         capture_id,
0458:             "aid":         original["analysis_id"],
0459:             "sid":         session_id,
0460:             "orig_tags":   sorted(orig_tags),
0461:             "orig_scene":  original["scene_dk"],
0462:             "orig_qflag":  original["ai_quality_flag"],
0463:             "orig_qok":    original["ai_quality_ok"],
0464:             "orig_change": original["change_detected"],
0465:             "corr_tags":   corrected_tags,
0466:             "corr_scene":  corrected_scene,
0467:             "corr_qflag":  corrected_quality_flag,
0468:             "corr_qok":    corrected_quality_ok,
0469:             "corr_change": corrected_change,
0470:             "added":       tags_added,
0471:             "removed":     tags_removed,
0472:             "qchg":        quality_changed,
0473:             "schg":        scene_changed,
0474:             "notes":       notes,
0475:             "admin":       admin_id,
0476:         }).fetchone()
0477: 
0478:         self.db.commit()
0479: 
0480:         # Opdatér session-tæller
0481:         self.db.execute(text("""
0482:             UPDATE ai_feedback_sessions
0483:             SET corrections_made = corrections_made + 1
0484:             WHERE id = :sid
0485:         """), {"sid": session_id})
0486:         self.db.commit()
0487: 
0488:         log.info("Correction saved: capture=%d +%d -%d tags",
0489:                  capture_id, len(tags_added), len(tags_removed))
0490:         return result[0]
0491: 
0492:     def complete_session(self, session_id: int) -> dict:
0493:         """Afslut session og returnér statistik."""
0494:         self.db.execute(text("""
0495:             UPDATE ai_feedback_sessions
0496:             SET completed_at = NOW(),
0497:                 captures_reviewed = (
0498:                     SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_corrections WHERE session_id = :sid
0499:                 )
0500:             WHERE id = :sid
0501:         """), {"sid": session_id})
0502:         self.db.commit()
0503: 
0504:         row = self.db.execute(text("""
0505:             SELECT session_date, admin_id, captures_reviewed,
0506:                    corrections_made, started_at, completed_at
0507:             FROM ai_feedback_sessions WHERE id = :sid
0508:         """), {"sid": session_id}).mappings().first()
0509: 
0510:         return dict(row) if row else {}
0511: 
0512:     def get_correction_stats(self, days: int = 30) -> list[dict]:
0513:         """Korrektions-statistik til at vurdere model-fremgang over tid."""
0514:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0515:             SELECT * FROM v_correction_stats
0516:             WHERE correction_date > NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
0517:             ORDER BY correction_date DESC
0518:         """), {"days": days}).mappings().all()
0519:         return [dict(r) for r in rows]
0520: 
0521: 
0522: # =============================================================================
0523: # PROMPT OPTIMIZER
0524: # Genererer few-shot eksempler fra korrektioner
0525: # =============================================================================
0526: 
0527: class PromptOptimizer:
0528:     """
0529:     Analyserer korrektioner og genererer forbedrede prompt-eksempler.
0530: 
0531:     Logik:
0532:       1. Find tags der konsekvent tilføjes (model glemmer dem)
0533:       2. Find tags der konsekvent fjernes (model fejltagger)
0534:       3. Generer "når du ser X, husk at tagge Y"-eksempler
0535:       4. Gem i ai_prompt_examples
0536:       5. OllamaVisionService inkluderer disse i næste prompt
0537:     """
0538: 
0539:     def __init__(self, db: Session):
0540:         self.db = db
0541: 
0542:     def generate_examples(
0543:         self,
0544:         min_occurrences: int = 3,   # tag skal være glemt/fejltagget mindst N gange
0545:         location_id:     Optional[str] = None,
0546:     ) -> int:
0547:         """
0548:         Generer few-shot eksempler fra ubrugte korrektioner.
0549:         Returnerer antal nye eksempler genereret.
0550:         """
0551:         # Tags der oftest tilføjes af admin (model glemmer dem)
0552:         forgotten_tags = self._get_frequently_added(min_occurrences, location_id)
0553: 
0554:         # Tags der oftest fjernes af admin (model ser dem der ikke er der)
0555:         false_tags = self._get_frequently_removed(min_occurrences, location_id)
0556: 
0557:         examples_created = 0
0558: 
0559:         for tag, count in forgotten_tags:
0560:             context = self._get_tag_context(tag, added=True)
0561:             example_text = (
0562:                 f"Husk at tilføje '{tag}' når: {context}. "
0563:                 f"(Korrigeret {count} gange — du glemmer dette tag)"
0564:             )
0565:             self._save_example(
0566:                 example_text = example_text,
0567:                 example_type = "tags",
0568:                 based_on_tag = tag,
0569:                 priority     = max(1, 10 - count),
0570:                 location_id  = location_id,
0571:             )
0572:             examples_created += 1
0573: 
0574:         for tag, count in false_tags:
0575:             context = self._get_tag_context(tag, added=False)
0576:             example_text = (
0577:                 f"Brug IKKE '{tag}' medmindre: {context}. "
0578:                 f"(Fjernet {count} gange — du bruger dette tag forkert)"
0579:             )
0580:             self._save_example(
0581:                 example_text = example_text,
0582:                 example_type = "tags",
0583:                 based_on_tag = tag,
0584:                 priority     = max(1, 10 - count),
0585:                 location_id  = location_id,
0586:             )
0587:             examples_created += 1
0588: 
0589:         # Markér korrektioner som brugt
0590:         self.db.execute(text("""
0591:             UPDATE ai_corrections
0592:             SET used_in_prompt = TRUE, used_in_prompt_at = NOW()
0593:             WHERE used_in_prompt = FALSE
0594:         """))
0595:         self.db.commit()
0596: 
0597:         log.info("Generated %d prompt examples from corrections", examples_created)
0598:         return examples_created
0599: 
0600:     def get_active_examples(
0601:         self,
0602:         location_id: Optional[str] = None,
0603:         limit:       int = 20,
0604:     ) -> list[str]:
0605:         """
0606:         Hent aktive few-shot eksempler til inkludering i prompt.
0607:         Returnerer liste af eksempel-tekster, sorteret efter prioritet.
0608:         """
0609:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0610:             SELECT example_text FROM ai_prompt_examples
0611:             WHERE active = TRUE
0612:               AND (location_id IS NULL OR location_id = :loc)
0613:             ORDER BY priority ASC, times_used ASC
0614:             LIMIT :limit
0615:         """), {"loc": location_id, "limit": limit}).fetchall()
0616: 
0617:         # Tæl brug
0618:         self.db.execute(text("""
0619:             UPDATE ai_prompt_examples SET times_used = times_used + 1
0620:             WHERE active = TRUE
0621:               AND (location_id IS NULL OR location_id = :loc)
0622:         """), {"loc": location_id})
0623:         self.db.commit()
0624: 
0625:         return [r[0] for r in rows]
0626: 
0627:     def get_accuracy_trend(self, days: int = 30) -> list[dict]:
0628:         """
0629:         Beregn model-nøjagtighed over tid baseret på korrektioner.
0630:         Metric: (tags der IKKE blev ændret) / (total tags i periode)
0631:         """
0632:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0633:             SELECT
0634:                 DATE(corrected_at) AS dt,
0635:                 COUNT(*) AS total,
0636:                 COUNT(*) FILTER (
0637:                     WHERE array_length(tags_added, 1) = 0
0638:                       AND array_length(tags_removed, 1) = 0
0639:                       AND NOT quality_changed
0640:                 ) AS no_changes_needed,
0641:                 ROUND(
0642:                     100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
0643:                         WHERE array_length(tags_added, 1) = 0
0644:                           AND array_length(tags_removed, 1) = 0
0645:                           AND NOT quality_changed
0646:                     ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1
0647:                 ) AS accuracy_pct
0648:             FROM ai_corrections
0649:             WHERE corrected_at > NOW() - :days * INTERVAL '1 day'
0650:             GROUP BY DATE(corrected_at)
0651:             ORDER BY dt ASC
0652:         """), {"days": days}).mappings().all()
0653:         return [dict(r) for r in rows]
0654: 
0655:     # ── Private helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0656: 
0657:     def _get_frequently_added(
0658:         self, min_count: int, location_id: Optional[str]
0659:     ) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
0660:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0661:             SELECT unnest(tags_added) AS tag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
0662:             FROM ai_corrections
0663:             WHERE used_in_prompt = FALSE
0664:             GROUP BY tag
0665:             HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min
0666:             ORDER BY cnt DESC
0667:             LIMIT 15
0668:         """), {"min": min_count}).fetchall()
0669:         return [(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows]
0670: 
0671:     def _get_frequently_removed(
0672:         self, min_count: int, location_id: Optional[str]
0673:     ) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
0674:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0675:             SELECT unnest(tags_removed) AS tag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
0676:             FROM ai_corrections
0677:             WHERE used_in_prompt = FALSE
0678:             GROUP BY tag
0679:             HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min
0680:             ORDER BY cnt DESC
0681:             LIMIT 15
0682:         """), {"min": min_count}).fetchall()
0683:         return [(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows]
0684: 
0685:     def _get_tag_context(self, tag: str, added: bool) -> str:
0686:         """Byg kontekst-beskrivelse for et tag baseret på co-occurring tags."""
0687:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0688:             SELECT unnest(corrected_tags) AS co_tag, COUNT(*) AS cnt
0689:             FROM ai_corrections
0690:             WHERE :tag = ANY(CASE WHEN :added THEN tags_added ELSE tags_removed END)
0691:             GROUP BY co_tag
0692:             HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
0693:             ORDER BY cnt DESC
0694:             LIMIT 5
0695:         """), {"tag": tag, "added": added}).fetchall()
0696:         co_tags = [r[0] for r in rows if r[0] != tag]
0697:         if co_tags:
0698:             return f"billedet indeholder {', '.join(co_tags[:3])}"
0699:         return "relevante byggeplacads-situationer"
0700:

0705:         based_on_tag: str,

0708:     ):
0709:         self.db.execute(text("""
```

0203:         delays = (2, 5, 10)

0216:                     raise
0217: 
0218:                 delay = delays[attempt]
0219:                 log.warning(
0220:                     "Gemini transient fejl (%s). Proever igen om %s sekunder (%s/%s)",
0221:                     exc,
0222:                     delay,
0223:                     attempt + 1,
0224:                     len(delays),
0225:                 )
0226:                 time.sleep(delay)

0239:         from google.genai import types
0240: 
0241:         data = Path(path).read_bytes()
0242:         if len(data) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES or self._should_resize_by_dimensions(data):
0243:             data = self._resize(data)
0244:         return types.Part.from_bytes(data=data, mime_type="image/jpeg")

0246:     def _should_resize_by_dimensions(self, data: bytes) -> bool:
0247:         try:
0248:             import cv2
0249:             import numpy as np
0250: 
0251:             arr = np.frombuffer(data, np.uint8)
0252:             img = cv2.imdecode(arr, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
0253:             if img is None:
0254:                 return False
0255:             h, w = img.shape[:2]
0256:             return max(w, h) > GEMINI_MAX_IMAGE_EDGE
0257:         except Exception:
0258:             return False
0259: 
0260:     def _resize(self, data: bytes) -> bytes:
0261:         try:
0262:             import cv2
0263:             import numpy as np
0264: 
0265:             arr = np.frombuffer(data, np.uint8)
0266:             img = cv2.imdecode(arr, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
0267:             if img is None:
0268:                 return data[:MAX_IMAGE_BYTES]
0269:             h, w = img.shape[:2]
0270:             dimension_scale = min(1.0, GEMINI_MAX_IMAGE_EDGE / max(w, h))
0271:             byte_scale = min(1.0, (MAX_IMAGE_BYTES / len(data)) ** 0.5 * 0.9)
0272:             scale = min(dimension_scale, byte_scale)
0273:             if scale >= 1.0:
0274:                 return data
0275:             img = cv2.resize(img, (int(w * scale), int(h * scale)))
0276:             _, buf = cv2.imencode(".jpg", img, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85])
0277:             return buf.tobytes()
0278:         except Exception:
0279:             return data[:MAX_IMAGE_BYTES]

0281:     def _is_retryable_error(self, exc: Exception) -> bool:
0282:         text = str(exc)
0283:         upper_text = text.upper()
0284:         return any(marker in text or marker in upper_text for marker in RETRYABLE_ERROR_MARKERS)
0285: 
0286:     def _parse(self, text: str) -> dict:
0287:         clean = re.sub(r"```(?:json)?\s*", "", text).strip()
0288:         clean = re.sub(r"```\s*$", "", clean).strip()
0289:         clean = re.sub(r",\s*([}\]])", r"\1", clean)
0290: 
0291:         try:
0292:             return json.loads(clean)
0293:         except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
0294:             first_error = exc
0295: 
0296:         match = re.search(r"({.*})", clean, re.DOTALL)
0297:         if match:
0298:             try:
0299:                 return json.loads(match.group(1))
0300:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
0301:                 first_error = exc
0302: 
0303:         tail = clean[-160:].replace("\n", "\\n")
0304:         raise ValueError(
0305:             f"Gemini returnerede ugyldig eller afkortet JSON "
0306:             f"(laengde={len(clean)}, fejl={first_error}, tail={tail!r})"
0307:         )
0308: 
0309:     def _build(
0310:         self,
0311:         parsed: dict,
0312:         approved_tag_set: set[str],
0313:         has_ref: bool,
0314:         duration_ms: int,
0315:         raw_text: str,
0316:     ) -> ImageAnalysisResult:
0317:         all_tags = [str(tag).lower().strip() for tag in parsed.get("tags", [])]
0318:         raw_new = [str(tag).lower().strip() for tag in parsed.get("new_tags", [])]
0319:         approved = [tag for tag in all_tags if tag in approved_tag_set]
0320:         new = list(dict.fromkeys([tag for tag in all_tags if tag not in approved_tag_set] + raw_new))
0321: 
0322:         change = parsed.get("change", {}) if has_ref else {}
0323:         change_detected = bool(change.get("detected", False))
0324:         change_tags = []
0325:         if change_detected:
0326:             change_tags = list(change.get("new_items", [])) + [
0327:                 f"fjernet_{item}" for item in change.get("removed_items", [])
0328:             ]
0329: 
0330:         quality = parsed.get("quality", {})
0331:         gdpr = parsed.get("gdpr", {})
0332:         gdpr_flags = []
0333:         has_gdpr = bool(gdpr.get("has_data", False))
0334: 
0335:         for detection in gdpr.get("detections", []):
0336:             detection_type = str(detection.get("type", ""))
0337:             if detection_type in ("face", "license_plate", "person_counted", "vehicle_detail"):
0338:                 gdpr_flags.append(
0339:                     GDPRFlag(
0340:                         detection_type=detection_type,
0341:                         detail=detection.get("detail", {}),
0342:                         bounding_box=detection.get("bbox"),
0343:                     )
0344:                 )
0345:                 has_gdpr = True
0346: 
0347:         return ImageAnalysisResult(
0348:             scene_dk=str(parsed.get("scene", "")),
0349:             approved_tags=approved,
0350:             new_tags=new,
0351:             change_detected=change_detected,
0352:             change_summary=change.get("summary") if change_detected else None,
0353:             change_tags=change_tags,
0354:             quality_flag=str(quality.get("flag", "ukendt")),
0355:             quality_ok=bool(quality.get("ok", True)),
0356:             has_gdpr_data=has_gdpr,
0357:             gdpr_detections=gdpr_flags,
0358:             model=self.model,
0359:             duration_ms=duration_ms,
0360:             raw_response={"response": raw_text},
0361:         )

```python
0152:         "change_tags": result.change_tags,
0153:         "quality_flag": result.quality_flag,
0154:         "quality_ok": result.quality_ok,
0155:         "has_gdpr_data": result.has_gdpr_data,
0156:         "gdpr_detections": [
0157:             {
0158:                 "type": item.detection_type,
0159:                 "detail": item.detail,
0160:                 "bbox": item.bounding_box,
0161:             }
0162:             for item in result.gdpr_detections
0163:         ],
0164:         "model": result.model,
0165:         "duration_ms": result.duration_ms,
0166:         "raw_response": result.raw_response,
0167:     }

0169: 
0170: def _worker(get_db_fn, find_image_fn):
0171:     """
0172:     Baggrundstråd der analyserer captures fra køen.
0173:     Kører som daemon — stopper automatisk ved shutdown.
0174:     """
0175:     from ai.ollama_service import OllamaVisionService; get_ollama_service = lambda *a, **kw: OllamaVisionService(*a, **kw)
0176:     from ai.alarm_engine import AlarmEngine, run_alarm_migration
0177: 
0178:     log.info("AI analyse-worker startet")
0179:     while True:
0180:         if _open_webui_priority_enabled(get_db_fn):
0181:             global _last_play_mode_log
0182:             now = time.monotonic()
0183:             if now - _last_play_mode_log > 60:
0184:                 log.info("AI: Timelapse-analyse pauset; Open WebUI har Ollama-prioritet")
0185:                 _last_play_mode_log = now
0186:             time.sleep(10)
0187:             continue
0188: 
0189:         try:
0190:             capture_id = _analysis_queue.get(timeout=5)
0191:         except queue.Empty:
0192:             continue
0193: 
0194:         try:
0195:             from database import Capture
0196: 
0197:             db_gen = get_db_fn()
0198:             db = next(db_gen)
0199:             try:
0200:                 capture = db.query(Capture).filter_by(id=capture_id).first()
0201:                 if not capture:
0202:                     continue
0203:                 if capture.ai_result:
0204:                     continue  # Allerede analyseret
0205:                 device_id = capture.device_id
0206:                 filename = capture.filename
0207:                 captured_at = capture.captured_at
0208:             finally:
0209:                 db_gen.close()
0210: 
0211:             image_path = find_image_fn(device_id, filename)
0212:             if not image_path:
0213:                 log.debug("AI: billede ikke fundet for capture %d", capture_id)
0214:                 continue
0215: 
0216:             svc = get_ollama_service()
0217:             if not svc.health_check():
0218:                 log.debug("AI: Ollama ikke tilgængelig — springer over capture %d", capture_id)
0219:                 continue
0220: 
0221:             vocab, vocabulary_by_cat, approved_tag_set = _load_vocabulary(get_db_fn)
0222:             with _ollama_analysis_lock:
0223:                 result = svc.analyse(
0224:                     image_path=image_path,
0225:                     vocabulary_by_cat=vocabulary_by_cat,
0226:                     approved_tag_set=approved_tag_set,
0227:                 )
0228:             payload = _analysis_payload(result)
0229:             tags = result.approved_tags + result.new_tags
0230: 
0231:             db_gen = get_db_fn()
0232:             db = next(db_gen)
0233:             try:
0234:                 capture = db.query(Capture).filter_by(id=capture_id).first()
0235:                 if capture:
0236:                     capture.ai_result      = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
0237:                     capture.ai_tags        = json.dumps(tags, ensure_ascii=False)
0238:                     capture.ai_analyzed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0239:                     db.commit()
0240: 
0241:                     try:
0242:                         alarm_engine = AlarmEngine(db)
0243:                         alarm_engine.evaluate(
0244:                             capture_id  = capture_id,
0245:                             device_id   = device_id,
0246:                             ai_result   = payload,
0247:                             tags        = tags,
0248:                             captured_at = captured_at,
0249:                         )
0250:                     except Exception as _ae:
0251:                         log.debug("Alarm engine fejl: %s", _ae)
0252:             except Exception:
0253:                 db.rollback()
0254:                 raise
0255:             finally:
0256:                 db_gen.close()
0257: 
0258:             vocab.record_usage(result.approved_tags, result.new_tags)
0259:             update_sidecar_with_ai(image_path, payload)
0260: 
0261:             log.info(
0262:                 "AI: capture=%d %s → %d tags, quality=%s, change=%s, %dms",
0263:                 capture_id, filename, len(tags), result.quality_flag,
0264:                 result.change_detected, result.duration_ms,
0265:             )
0266: 
0267:         except Exception as e:
0268:             log.exception("AI worker fejl for capture %d: %s", capture_id, e)
0269:         finally:
0270:             _analysis_queue.task_done()
0271: 
0272: 
0273: def queue_capture_for_analysis(capture_id: int) -> None:
0274:     """Læg et capture i AI-analysekøen. Non-blocking."""
0275:     try:
0276:         _analysis_queue.put_nowait(capture_id)
0277:     except queue.Full:
0278:         log.warning("AI kø fuld — springer over capture %d", capture_id)

0281: def setup_ai(get_db_fn, find_image_fn) -> None:
0282:     """
0283:     Start AI baggrundstråd.
0284:     Kald fra main.py startup efter DB er klar.
0285: 
0286:     Args:
0287:         get_db_fn:     get_db generator fra main.py
0288:         find_image_fn: _find_image funktion fra main.py

0290:     global _worker_thread
0291:     _worker_thread = threading.Thread(
0292:         target=_worker,
0293:         args=(get_db_fn, find_image_fn),
0294:         daemon=True,
0295:         name="ai-worker",
0296:     )
0297:     _worker_thread.start()
0298:     log.info("AI analyse-worker klar")

0444:     @ai_router.get("/alarms")
0445:     def list_alarms(
0446:         device_id:    Optional[str] = None,
0447:         severity:     Optional[str] = None,
0448:         acknowledged: Optional[bool] = None,
0449:         limit:        int = 50,
0450:         db: Session = Depends(get_db_fn),
0451:     ):
0452:         """
0453:         Hent alarm-events, nyeste først.
0454:         ?severity=critical|warning|maintenance
0455:         ?acknowledged=false → kun ubehandlede
0456:         """
0457:         from sqlalchemy import text as _text
0458:         conditions = ["1=1"]
0459:         params     = {}
0460:         if device_id:
0461:             conditions.append("device_id = :device_id")
0462:             params["device_id"] = device_id
0463:         if severity:
0464:             conditions.append("severity = :severity")
0465:             params["severity"] = severity
0466:         if acknowledged is False:
0467:             conditions.append("acknowledged_at IS NULL")
0468:         elif acknowledged is True:
0469:             conditions.append("acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL")
0470: 
0471:         where = " AND ".join(conditions)
0472:         rows  = db.execute(_text(f"""
0473:             SELECT id, rule_id, rule_name, severity, capture_id, device_id,
0474:                    description, matched_on, confidence, triggered_at,
0475:                    acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by, notes
0476:             FROM alarm_events
0477:             WHERE {where}
0478:             ORDER BY triggered_at DESC
0479:             LIMIT :limit
0480:         """), {**params, "limit": limit}).fetchall()
0481: 
0482:         return [
0483:             {
0484:                 "id":             r[0],
0485:                 "rule_id":        r[1],
0486:                 "rule_name":      r[2],
0487:                 "severity":       r[3],
0488:                 "capture_id":     r[4],
0489:                 "device_id":      r[5],
0490:                 "description":    r[6],
0491:                 "matched_on":     json.loads(r[7]) if r[7] else [],
0492:                 "confidence":     r[8],
0493:                 "triggered_at":   r[9].isoformat() if r[9] else None,
0494:                 "acknowledged_at": r[10].isoformat() if r[10] else None,
0495:                 "acknowledged_by": r[11],
0496:                 "notes":           r[12],
0497:             }
0498:             for r in rows
0499:         ]

0565:     @ai_router.get("/tags/search")
0566:     def search_by_tags(
0567:         tags:         str,
0568:         device_id:    Optional[str] = None,
0569:         device_ids:   Optional[str] = None,
0570:         date_from:    Optional[str] = None,
0571:         date_to:      Optional[str] = None,
0572:         limit:        int = 500,
0573:         user = Depends(auth_dep),
0574:         db: Session = Depends(get_db_fn),
0575:     ):
0576:         """Søg billeder efter AI-tags. ?tags=crane,car"""
0577:         from database import Capture
0578:         import json as _json
0579:         _require_authenticated(user)
0580: 
0581:         tag_list = [t.strip().lower() for t in tags.split(",") if t.strip()]
0582:         if not tag_list:
0583:             raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Angiv mindst ét tag")
0584: 
0585:         from datetime import datetime as _dt, timedelta as _td
0586:         q = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.ai_tags.isnot(None))
0587:         allowed_device_ids = _allowed_devices(db, user)
0588:         if allowed_device_ids is not None:
0589:             if not allowed_device_ids:
0590:                 return {"query": tag_list, "total": 0, "results": []}
0591:             q = q.filter(Capture.device_id.in_(allowed_device_ids))
0592: 
0593:         # Multi-device filter
0594:         all_devs = []
0595:         if device_ids:
0596:             all_devs = [d.strip() for d in device_ids.split(",") if d.strip()]
0597:         elif device_id:
0598:             all_devs = [device_id]
0599:         if all_devs:
0600:             if allowed_device_ids is not None:
0601:                 forbidden = [d for d in all_devs if d not in allowed_device_ids]
0602:                 if forbidden:
0603:                     raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til en eller flere enheder")
0604:             q = q.filter(Capture.device_id.in_(all_devs))
0605: 
0606:         # Dato filter i SQL
0607:         if date_from:
0608:             try: q = q.filter(Capture.captured_at >= _dt.fromisoformat(date_from))
0609:             except Exception: pass
0610:         if date_to:
0611:             try: q = q.filter(Capture.captured_at < _dt.fromisoformat(date_to) + _td(days=1))
0612:             except Exception: pass
0613: 
0614:         captures = q.order_by(Capture.captured_at.desc()).limit(limit * 3).all()
0615: 
0616:         results = []
0617:         for c in captures:
0618:             try:
0619:                 c_tags = _json.loads(c.ai_tags) if c.ai_tags else []
0620:                 if any(t in c_tags for t in tag_list):
0621:                     results.append({
0622:                         "id":             c.id,
0623:                         "device_id":      c.device_id,
0624:                         "filename":       c.filename,
0625:                         "captured_at":    c.captured_at.isoformat() if c.captured_at else None,
0626:                         "tags":           c_tags,
0627:                         "blur_score":     c.blur_score,
0628:                         "quality_passed": c.quality_passed,
0629:                         "ai_result":      c.ai_result,
0630:                         "filesize_mb":    round(c.filesize / 1e6, 1) if c.filesize else None,
0631:                     })
0632:             except Exception:
0633:                 pass
0634:             if len(results) >= limit:
0635:                 break
0636: 
0637:         return {"query": tag_list, "total": len(results), "results": results}
0638: 
0639:     @ai_router.get("/tags/all")
0640:     def all_tags(device_id: Optional[str] = None, user = Depends(auth_dep), db: Session = Depends(get_db_fn)):
0641:         """Returner alle kendte tags med antal — merger gammel ai_tags + ny vocabulary."""
0642:         from database import Capture
0643:         from sqlalchemy import text
0644:         import json as _json
0645:         from collections import Counter
0646:         _require_authenticated(user)
0647: 
0648:         tag_counter: Counter = Counter()
0649:         allowed_device_ids = _allowed_devices(db, user)
0650:         if device_id and allowed_device_ids is not None and device_id not in allowed_device_ids:
0651:             raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til denne enhed")
0652: 
0653:         # 1. Gammel ai_tags kolonne
0654:         q = db.query(Capture.ai_tags).filter(Capture.ai_tags.isnot(None))
0655:         if allowed_device_ids is not None:
0656:             if not allowed_device_ids:
0657:                 return {"total_tagged": 0, "tags": []}
0658:             q = q.filter(Capture.device_id.in_(allowed_device_ids))
0659:         if device_id:
0660:             q = q.filter(Capture.device_id == device_id)
0661:         for (tags_json,) in q.all():
0662:             try:
0663:                 for t in _json.loads(tags_json):
0664:                     tag_counter[t] += 1
0665:             except Exception:
0666:                 pass
0667: 
0668:         # 2. Ny capture_tags tabel (Sprint D) er global; vis kun for uscopede admin-brugere.
0669:         try:
0670:             if allowed_device_ids is not None:
0671:                 raise RuntimeError("global vocabulary hidden for scoped user")
0672:             vocab_q = """
0673:                 SELECT tv.tag, tv.count
0674:                 FROM ai_tag_vocabulary tv
0675:                 WHERE tv.approved = TRUE AND tv.rejected = FALSE AND tv.count > 0
0676:                 ORDER BY tv.count DESC
0677:                 LIMIT 200
0678:             """
0679:             rows = db.execute(text(vocab_q)).fetchall()
0680:             for tag, count in rows:
0681:                 tag_counter[tag] = max(tag_counter.get(tag, 0), count)
0682:         except Exception:
0683:             pass
0684: 
0685:         total_q = db.query(Capture.id).filter(Capture.ai_tags.isnot(None))
0686:         if allowed_device_ids is not None:
0687:             total_q = total_q.filter(Capture.device_id.in_(allowed_device_ids))
0688:         if device_id:

0690:         total = total_q.count()
0691:         return {
0692:             "total_tagged": total,
0693:             "tags": [{"tag": t, "count": c} for t, c in tag_counter.most_common(200)],
0694:         }
0695: 
0696:     @ai_router.get("/flagged")
0697:     def ai_flagged(
0698:         limit: int = 20,
0699:         device_id: Optional[str] = None,
0700:         db: Session = Depends(get_db_fn),
0701:     ):
0702:         """Captures med AI-anomalier eller alarmer."""
0703:         from database import Capture
0704:         q = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.ai_result.isnot(None))
0705:         if device_id:
0706:             q = q.filter_by(device_id=device_id)
0707:         captures = q.order_by(Capture.id.desc()).limit(limit * 5).all()
0708: 
0709:         results = []
0710:         for c in captures:
0711:             try:
0712:                 ai = json.loads(c.ai_result)
0713:                 if ai.get("is_anomaly") or ai.get("alarm"):
0714:                     results.append({
0715:                         "capture_id":  c.id,
0716:                         "device_id":   c.device_id,
0717:                         "filename":    c.filename,
0718:                         "captured_at": c.captured_at.isoformat() if c.captured_at else None,
0719:                         "ai":          ai,
0720:                     })
0721:             except Exception:
0722:                 pass
0723:             if len(results) >= limit:
0724:                 break
0725: 
0726:         return {"total": len(results), "results": results}
```

```python
0261: def _send_gatewayapi(message: str, recipients: list[str], cfg: dict) -> bool:
0262:     """GatewayAPI REST v3."""
0263:     try:
0264:         r = requests.post(
0265:             "https://gatewayapi.com/rest/mtsms",
0266:             auth=(cfg["api_token"], ""),
0267:             json={
0268:                 "sender":     cfg.get("sender", "TimeLapse")[:11],
0269:                 "message":    message,
0270:                 "recipients": [{"msisdn": int(n.replace("+", "").replace(" ", ""))} for n in recipients],
0271:             },
0272:             timeout=10,
0273:         )
0274:         if r.ok:
0275:             log.info("SMS sendt via GatewayAPI til %s", recipients)
0276:             return True
0277:         else:
0278:             log.error("GatewayAPI fejl %d: %s", r.status_code, r.text[:200])
0279:             return False
0280:     except Exception as e:
0281:         log.error("SMS fejl: %s", e)
0282:         return False

0285: def _send_twilio(message: str, recipients: list[str], cfg: dict) -> bool:
0286:     """Twilio SMS API."""
0287:     try:
0288:         import base64
0289:         auth = base64.b64encode(f"{cfg['account_sid']}:{cfg['auth_token']}".encode()).decode()
0290:         for to in recipients:
0291:             r = requests.post(
0292:                 f"https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{cfg['account_sid']}/Messages.json",
0293:                 headers={"Authorization": f"Basic {auth}"},
0294:                 data={"Body": message, "From": cfg.get("from_number"), "To": to},
0295:                 timeout=10,
0296:             )
0297:             if not r.ok:
0298:                 log.error("Twilio fejl: %s", r.text[:200])

0358:                             {"title": "Matchede på","value": matched_str or "—"},
0359:                         ],
0360:                     },

0392: def notify(alarm: dict, db, image_url: Optional[str] = None) -> dict[str, bool]:
0393:     """
0394:     Send notifikationer for en alarm via alle aktiverede kanaler.
0395:

0397:       {"email": True, "sms": False, "teams": True}

0399:     Fejl i én kanal stopper ikke de andre.

0402:     if not config:
0403:         return {}
0404:

0407:         return {}
0408: 
0409:     results = {}
0410: 
0411:     # Email
0412:     if config.get("email", {}).get("enabled"):
0413:         results["email"] = send_email(alarm, config, image_url)
0414: 
0415:     # SMS

0417:         results["sms"] = send_sms(alarm, config)
0418: 
0419:     # Teams

0421:         results["teams"] = send_teams(alarm, config, image_url)
0422: 
0423:     if results:
0424:         log.info("Notifikationer sendt for '%s': %s", alarm.get("rule_name"), results)
0425: 
0426:     return results
0427: 
0428: 
0429: # ── Hjælpefunktioner ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0430: 
0431: def _format_time(iso_str: Optional[str], tz: str = "Europe/Copenhagen") -> str:
0432:     if not iso_str:
0433:         return "—"
0434:     try:
0435:         from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
0436:         dt = datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
0437:         dt = dt.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz))
0438:         return dt.strftime("%d. %b %Y kl. %H:%M")
0439:     except Exception:
0440:         return iso_str[:16]
```

```python
0363:             if not ok:

0366:                       len(data) // 1024, w, h, len(buf) // 1024, img.shape[1], img.shape[0])

0400:             except json.JSONDecodeError:
0401:                 pass
0402: 
0403:         # Forsøg 3: find første { ... } blok
0404:         match = re.search(r"(\{.*\})", text, re.DOTALL)
0405:         if match:
0406:             candidate = match.group(1)
0407:             # Fjern trailing commas (common model-fejl)
0408:             candidate = re.sub(r",\s*([}\]])", r"\1", candidate)
0409:             try:
0410:                 return json.loads(candidate)
0411:             except json.JSONDecodeError:
0412:                 pass
0413: 
0414:         salvaged = self._salvage_response(text)
0415:         if salvaged:
0416:             return salvaged
0417: 
0418:         log.warning("Kunne ikke parse model-svar som JSON. Rå svar: %s", text[:300])
0419:         return {}
0420: 
0421:     def _salvage_response(self, text: str) -> dict:
0422:         """Best-effort parsing når modellen returnerer næsten-JSON."""
0423:         result: dict = {}
0424: 
0425:         scene = re.search(r'"scene"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.DOTALL)
0426:         if scene:
0427:             result["scene"] = scene.group(1).strip()
0428: 
0429:         for key in ("tags", "new_tags"):
0430:             match = re.search(rf'"{key}"\s*:\s*\[(.*?)\]', text, re.DOTALL)
0431:             if not match:
0432:                 match = re.search(rf'"{key}"\s*:\s*\[(.*?)(?:"(?:new_tags|quality|gdpr)"\s*:|$)', text, re.DOTALL)
0433:             if match:
0434:                 result[key] = re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"', match.group(1))
0435: 
0436:         quality_flag = re.search(r'"flag"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.DOTALL)
0437:         quality_ok = re.search(r'"ok"\s*:\s*(true|false)', text, re.IGNORECASE)
0438:         if quality_flag or quality_ok:
0439:             result["quality"] = {
0440:                 "flag": quality_flag.group(1).strip() if quality_flag else "ukendt",
0441:                 "ok": quality_ok.group(1).lower() == "true" if quality_ok else True,
0442:             }
0443: 
0444:         has_gdpr = re.search(r'"has_data"\s*:\s*(true|false)', text, re.IGNORECASE)
0445:         if has_gdpr:
0446:             result["gdpr"] = {
0447:                 "has_data": has_gdpr.group(1).lower() == "true",
0448:                 "detections": [],
0449:             }
0450: 
0451:         return result
0452: 
0453:     # ── Intern: Byg resultat ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
0454: 
0455:     def _build_result(
0456:         self,
0457:         parsed:          dict,
0458:         approved_tag_set: set[str],
0459:         has_reference:   bool,
0460:         model:           str,
0461:         duration_ms:     int,
0462:         raw_response:    dict,
0463:     ) -> ImageAnalysisResult:
0464: 
0465:         # Tags — opdel i kendte (approved) og nye
0466:         all_tags  = [str(t).lower().strip().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_") for t in parsed.get("tags", [])]
0467:         raw_new   = [str(t).lower().strip().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_") for t in parsed.get("new_tags", [])]
0468:         all_tags  = list(dict.fromkeys(t for t in all_tags if t))[:60]
0469:         raw_new   = list(dict.fromkeys(t for t in raw_new if t))[:60]
0470: 
0471:         approved_tags = [t for t in all_tags if t in approved_tag_set]
0472:         new_tags      = [t for t in all_tags if t not in approved_tag_set] + raw_new
0473:         new_tags      = list(dict.fromkeys(new_tags))   # deduplicate
0474: 
0475:         # Change detection
0476:         change_block   = parsed.get("change", {}) if has_reference else {}
0477:         change_detected = bool(change_block.get("detected", False))
0478:         change_summary  = change_block.get("summary") if change_detected else None
0479:         change_tags     = (
0480:             change_block.get("new_items", []) +
0481:             ["fjernet_" + t for t in change_block.get("removed_items", [])]
0482:         ) if change_detected else []
0483: 
0484:         # Kvalitet
0485:         quality_block = parsed.get("quality", {})
0486:         quality_flag  = str(quality_block.get("flag", "ukendt"))
0487:         quality_ok    = bool(quality_block.get("ok", True))
0488: 
0489:         # GDPR
0490:         gdpr_block  = parsed.get("gdpr", {})
0491:         has_gdpr    = bool(gdpr_block.get("has_data", False))
0492:         gdpr_flags  = []
0493:         for det in gdpr_block.get("detections", []):
0494:             dtype = str(det.get("type", ""))
0495:             if dtype in ("face", "license_plate", "person_counted", "vehicle_detail"):
0496:                 gdpr_flags.append(GDPRFlag(
0497:                     detection_type=dtype,
0498:                     detail=det.get("detail", {}),
0499:                     bounding_box=det.get("bbox"),
0500:                 ))
0501:                 has_gdpr = True
0502: 
0503:         return ImageAnalysisResult(
0504:             scene_dk        = str(parsed.get("scene", "Ingen beskrivelse")),
0505:             approved_tags   = approved_tags,
0506:             new_tags        = new_tags,
0507:             change_detected = change_detected,
0508:             change_summary  = change_summary,
0509:             change_tags     = change_tags,
0510:             quality_flag    = quality_flag,
0511:             quality_ok      = quality_ok,
0512:             has_gdpr_data   = has_gdpr,
0513:             gdpr_detections = gdpr_flags,
0514:             model           = model,
0515:             duration_ms     = duration_ms,
0516:             raw_response    = raw_response,
0517:         )
```

```python
0124: # =============================================================================

0128: class CaptureRepository:
0129:     """
0130:     Læseadgang til captures med AI-data.
0131:     Bruger v_capture_public view — ingen GDPR-data.
0132:     """
0133: 
0134:     def __init__(self, db: Session):
0135:         self.db = db
0136: 
0137:     def get_by_id(self, capture_id: int) -> Optional[CapturePublicDTO]:
0138:         row = self.db.execute(
0139:             text("SELECT * FROM v_capture_public WHERE id = :id"),
0140:             {"id": capture_id}
0141:         ).mappings().first()
0142:         if not row:
0143:             return None
0144:         tags = self._get_tags_for_capture(capture_id)
0145:         return CapturePublicDTO(**dict(row), tags=tags)
0146: 
0147:     def list_by_location(
0148:         self,
0149:         location_id: str,
0150:         from_dt: Optional[datetime] = None,
0151:         to_dt: Optional[datetime] = None,
0152:         quality_passed: Optional[bool] = None,
0153:         tags: Optional[list[str]] = None,
0154:         limit: int = 50,
0155:         offset: int = 0,
0156:     ) -> list[CapturePublicDTO]:
0157:         """
0158:         Hent captures for en lokation med filtrering.
0159:         tags-filter: returnér kun captures der har ALLE de angivne tags.
0160:         """
0161:         query = "SELECT cp.* FROM v_capture_public cp"
0162:         params: dict = {"loc": location_id, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}
0163:         where = ["cp.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE location_id = :loc)"]
0164: 
0165:         if from_dt:
0166:             where.append("cp.captured_at >= :from_dt")
0167:             params["from_dt"] = from_dt
0168:         if to_dt:
0169:             where.append("cp.captured_at <= :to_dt")
0170:             params["to_dt"] = to_dt
0171:         if quality_passed is not None:
0172:             where.append("cp.quality_passed = :qp")
0173:             params["qp"] = quality_passed
0174: 
0175:         if tags:
0176:             # Subquery: kun captures der har alle ønskede tags
0177:             tag_placeholders = ", ".join(f":tag_{i}" for i in range(len(tags)))
0178:             for i, t in enumerate(tags):
0179:                 params[f"tag_{i}"] = t
0180:             query += f"""
0181:                 JOIN (
0182:                     SELECT ct.capture_id
0183:                     FROM capture_tags ct
0184:                     JOIN ai_tag_vocabulary tv ON tv.id = ct.tag_id
0185:                     WHERE tv.tag IN ({tag_placeholders}) AND tv.approved = TRUE
0186:                     GROUP BY ct.capture_id
0187:                     HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tv.tag) = :tag_count
0188:                 ) tagged ON tagged.capture_id = cp.id
0189:             """
0190:             params["tag_count"] = len(tags)
0191: 
0192:         query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where)
0193:         query += " ORDER BY cp.captured_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset"
0194: 
0195:         rows = self.db.execute(text(query), params).mappings().all()
0196:         result = []
0197:         for row in rows:
0198:             tags_for = self._get_tags_for_capture(row["id"])
0199:             result.append(CapturePublicDTO(**dict(row), tags=tags_for))
0200:         return result
0201: 
0202:     def _get_tags_for_capture(self, capture_id: int) -> list[str]:
0203:         rows = self.db.execute(
0204:             text("""
0205:                 SELECT tv.tag FROM capture_tags ct
0206:                 JOIN ai_tag_vocabulary tv ON tv.id = ct.tag_id
0207:                 WHERE ct.capture_id = :cid AND tv.approved = TRUE AND tv.rejected = FALSE
0208:                 ORDER BY ct.confidence DESC
0209:             """),
0210:             {"cid": capture_id}
0211:         ).fetchall()
0212:         return [r[0] for r in rows]
0213: 
0214:     def count_by_location(self, location_id: str) -> int:
0215:         row = self.db.execute(
0216:             text("""
0217:                 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_capture_public cp
0218:                 WHERE cp.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE location_id = :loc)
0219:             """),
0220:             {"loc": location_id}
0221:         ).scalar()
0222:         return row or 0
0223: 
0224:     def get_captures_needing_analysis(self, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
0225:         """Captures der endnu ikke er AI-analyseret."""
0226:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0227:             SELECT c.id, c.filename, c.device_id

0229:             LEFT JOIN ai_analyses a ON a.capture_id = c.id
0230:             WHERE a.id IS NULL

0232:             ORDER BY c.captured_at DESC
0233:             LIMIT :limit
0234:         """), {"limit": limit}).mappings().all()
0235:         return [dict(r) for r in rows]

0309:     def get_similar_tag_suggestions(self, limit: int = 50, threshold: float = 0.72) -> list[dict]:
0310:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""
0311:             SELECT id, tag, category, count, approved, rejected
0312:             FROM ai_tag_vocabulary
0313:             WHERE rejected = FALSE
0314:             ORDER BY count DESC, tag
0315:             LIMIT 1000
0316:         """)).mappings().all()
0317: 
0318:         tags = [dict(r) for r in rows]
0319:         normalized = {t["id"]: self._normalize_tag_for_similarity(t["tag"]) for t in tags}
0320:         groups: list[dict] = []
0321:         used: set[int] = set()
0322: 
0323:         for tag in tags:
0324:             if tag["id"] in used:
0325:                 continue
0326: 
0327:             left = normalized[tag["id"]]
0328:             scored = []
0329:             for other in tags:
0330:                 if other["id"] == tag["id"] or other["id"] in used:
0331:                     continue
0332:                 score = self._tag_similarity(left, normalized[other["id"]])
0333:                 if score >= threshold:
0334:                     scored.append((score, other))
0335: 
0336:             if not scored:
0337:                 continue
0338: 
0339:             candidates = [tag] + [item for _, item in sorted(scored, key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)[:8]]
0340:             canonical = max(
0341:                 candidates,
0342:                 key=lambda item: (bool(item["approved"]), int(item["count"] or 0), -len(item["tag"])),
0343:             )
0344:             groups.append({
0345:                 "canonical_tag": canonical["tag"],
0346:                 "score": round(max(score for score, _ in scored), 3),
0347:                 "reason": self._similarity_reason([item["tag"] for item in candidates]),
0348:                 "tags": candidates,
0349:                 "total_count": sum(int(item["count"] or 0) for item in candidates),
0350:             })
0351:             used.update(item["id"] for item in candidates)
0352: 
0353:             if len(groups) >= limit:
0354:                 break
0355: 
0356:         return groups

0454:         row = self.db.execute(
0455:             text("SELECT id FROM ai_tag_vocabulary WHERE tag = :tag"),

0457:         ).fetchone()
0458:         if row:
0459:             return row[0]
0460:         result = self.db.execute(text("""
0461:             INSERT INTO ai_tag_vocabulary (tag, category, approved, first_seen, last_seen)
0462:             VALUES (:tag, 'model_opfundet', :approved, :now, :now)
0463:             ON CONFLICT (tag) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = :now
```
