```python
0468:     @staticmethod
0469:     def _clean_tag(tag: str) -> str:
0470:         return re.sub(r"_+", "_", tag.lower().strip().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")).strip("_")
0471: 
0472:     def _normalize_tag_for_similarity(tag: str) -> str:
0473:         normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", tag.lower())
0474:         normalized = "".join(ch for ch in normalized if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
0475:         normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", normalized)
0476:         words = [
0477:             self._stem_tag_word(word) for word in normalized.split("_")
0478:             if word and word not in {"og", "i", "det", "den", "de", "paa", "på"}
0479:         ]
0480:         return "_".join(words)
0481: 
0482:     @staticmethod
0483:     def _stem_tag_word(word: str) -> str:
0484:         if word.startswith("over") and len(word) > 7:
0485:             word = word[4:]
0486:         for suffix in ("ende", "et", "ede", "e"):
0487:             if len(word) > len(suffix) + 4 and word.endswith(suffix):
0488:                 return word[:-len(suffix)]
0489:         return word
0490: 
0491:     @staticmethod
0492:     def _tag_similarity(left: str, right: str) -> float:
0493:         if not left or not right:
0494:             return 0.0
0495:         if left == right:
0496:             return 1.0
0497:         ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, left, right).ratio()
0498:         left_words = set(left.split("_"))
0499:         right_words = set(right.split("_"))
0500:         overlap = len(left_words & right_words) / max(1, len(left_words | right_words))
0501:         prefix_bonus = 0.12 if left.split("_")[0] == right.split("_")[0] else 0.0
0502:         suffix_bonus = 0.18 if left.split("_")[-1] == right.split("_")[-1] else 0.0
0503:         containment_bonus = 0.20 if left in right or right in left else 0.0
0504:         return min(1.0, (ratio * 0.55) + (overlap * 0.45) + prefix_bonus + suffix_bonus + containment_bonus)
0505: 
0506:     @staticmethod
0507:     def _similarity_reason(tags: list[str]) -> str:
0508:         word_sets = [set(tag.split("_")) for tag in tags]
0509:         common = set.intersection(*word_sets) if word_sets else set()
0510:         if common:
0511:             return "Deler ordene: " + ", ".join(sorted(common))
0512:         return "Hoj tekstlig lighed"

0544:             ORDER BY captured_at DESC
0545:             LIMIT :limit

0570:             params["tags"] = tags

0573:             params["from_date"] = from_date

0576:             params["to_date"] = to_date
0577: 
0578:         query += " ORDER BY capture_date, occurrences DESC"

0582:     def co_occurring_tags(self, tag: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
0583:         """Hvilke andre tags optræder oftest sammen med dette tag?"""
0584:         rows = self.db.execute(text("""

0587:             JOIN ai_tag_vocabulary tv1 ON tv1.id = ct1.tag_id AND tv1.tag = :tag
0588:             JOIN capture_tags ct2      ON ct2.capture_id = ct1.capture_id
0589:             JOIN ai_tag_vocabulary tv2 ON tv2.id = ct2.tag_id AND tv2.tag != :tag AND tv2.approved = TRUE
0590:             GROUP BY tv2.tag
0591:             ORDER BY co_count DESC
0592:             LIMIT :limit
0593:         """), {"tag": tag, "limit": limit}).fetchall()
```

```python
0118:     """Baggrundsjob: kald Gemini for godkendte analyser."""
0119:     from database import SessionLocal
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — System Settings Helper
0003: Læser/skriver system_settings tabellen.
0004: Bruges af backfill, ai_router og headend til at hente API-nøgler fra DB.
0005: """
0006: from __future__ import annotations
0007: from typing import Optional
0008: from sqlalchemy import text
0009: 
0010: 
0011: def _ensure_table(db):
0012:     """Opret system_settings hvis den ikke findes (SQLite + PostgreSQL)."""
0013:     try:
0014:         from sqlalchemy import text
0015:         db.execute(text("""
0016:             CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_settings (
0017:                 key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
0018:                 value TEXT,
0019:                 description TEXT,
0020:                 is_secret BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
0021:                 updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
0022:                 updated_by TEXT
0023:             )
0024:         """))
0025:         db.commit()
0026:     except Exception:
0027:         db.rollback()
0028: 
0029: 
0030: def get_setting(db, key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
0031:     """Hent én indstilling fra system_settings."""
0032:     _ensure_table(db)
0033:     try:
0034:         row = db.execute(
0035:             text("SELECT value FROM system_settings WHERE key = :k"),
0036:             {"k": key}
0037:         ).fetchone()
0038:         return row[0] if row and row[0] else default
0039:     except Exception:
0040:         return default
0041: 
0042: 
0043: def set_setting(db, key: str, value: str, updated_by: str = "system"):
0044:     """Gem én indstilling i system_settings."""
0045:     db.execute(text("""
0046:         INSERT INTO system_settings (key, value, updated_by, updated_at)
0047:         VALUES (:k, :v, :by, NOW())
0048:         ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET
0049:             value = EXCLUDED.value,
0050:             updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by,
0051:             updated_at = NOW()
0052:     """), {"k": key, "v": value, "by": updated_by})
0053:     db.commit()
0054: 
0055: 
0056: def get_all_settings(db) -> list[dict]:
0057:     """Hent alle indstillinger (til UI — secrets maskeres)."""
0058:     _ensure_table(db)
0059:     rows = db.execute(text("""
0060:         SELECT key, value, description, is_secret, updated_at, updated_by
0061:         FROM system_settings
0062:         ORDER BY key
0063:     """)).mappings().all()
0064:     return [{
0065:         "key":         r["key"],
0066:         "value":       "••••••••" if r["is_secret"] and r["value"] else r["value"],
0067:         "description": r["description"],
0068:         "is_secret":   r["is_secret"],
0069:         "updated_at":  str(r["updated_at"]) if r["updated_at"] else None,
0070:         "updated_by":  r["updated_by"],
0071:     } for r in rows]
```

0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — AI-drevet Tag Lighed via Gemini (Vertex AI)
0003: ============================================================
0004: Sender alle brugte tags til Gemini og beder den gruppere semantisk
0005: lignende tags og foreslå fælles canonical tag-navne.
0006: Data forbliver i EU (europe-west1/west4).
0007: """
0008: from __future__ import annotations
0009: import json, logging, os, re
0010: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0011: 
0012: SIMILARITY_PROMPT = """Du er ekspert i dansk tagklassificering for byggeplads-dokumentation.
0013: 
0014: Her er ALLE tags fra vores system (format: id:tag_navn ×antal_gange_brugt):
0015: 
0016: {tag_list}
0017: 
0018: Find grupper af tags der BETYDER DET SAMME eller næsten det samme.
0019: 
0020: Eksempler der BØR grupperes:
0021: - overskyet_vejr + skyet_vejr + overskyet → én gruppe
0022: - worker + arbejder → én gruppe
0023: - byggeplads_på_afstand + byggeplads_i_baggrunden → én gruppe
0024: 
0025: Eksempler der IKKE må grupperes:
0026: - råhus vs råhus_opførelse (forskellig detaljegrad)
0027: - arbejder vs arbejder_aktiv (forskellig tilstand)
0028: - kran vs tårnkran (forskellig type)
0029: 
0030: For canonical tag: vælg det mest præcise danske tag.
0031: 
0032: Returner KUN dette JSON:
0033: {{
0034:   "groups": [
0035:     {{
0036:       "canonical": "bedste_tag_navn",
0037:       "ids": [1, 2, 3],
0038:       "reason": "Kort forklaring på dansk"
0039:     }}
0040:   ]
0041: }}
0042: 
0043: Kun grupper med mindst 2 tags. KUN JSON."""
0044: 
0045: 
0046: def get_ai_similar_tags(db, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
0047:     """Send alle brugte tags til Gemini og få semantiske grupper tilbage."""
0048:     from sqlalchemy import text
0049: 
0050:     rows = db.execute(text("""
0051:         SELECT id, tag, category, count, approved, rejected
0052:         FROM ai_tag_vocabulary
0053:         WHERE rejected = FALSE AND count > 0
0054:         ORDER BY count DESC, tag
0055:         LIMIT 400
0056:     """)).mappings().all()
0057: 
0058:     tags = [dict(r) for r in rows]
0059:     if not tags:
0060:         return []
0061: 
0062:     tag_map = {t["id"]: t for t in tags}
0063:     tag_list = "\n".join(
0064:         f'{t["id"]}:{t["tag"]} ×{t.get("count", 0)}'
0065:         for t in tags
0066:     )
0067: 
0068:     prompt = SIMILARITY_PROMPT.format(tag_list=tag_list)
0069: 
0070:     # Hent Gemini-konfiguration fra DB
0071:     try:
0072:         from ai.settings_helper import get_setting
0073:         sa_path    = get_setting(db, "gcp_service_account_path", "")
0074:         project_id = get_setting(db, "gcp_project_id", "")
0075:         location   = get_setting(db, "gcp_location", "europe-west1")
0076:     except Exception:
0077:         from settings_helper import get_setting
0078:         sa_path    = get_setting(db, "gcp_service_account_path", "")
0079:         project_id = get_setting(db, "gcp_project_id", "")
0080:         location   = get_setting(db, "gcp_location", "europe-west1")
0081: 
0082:     from google import genai
0083:     from google.genai import types
0084: 
0085:     # Tag-analyse: brug AI Studio nøgle (ingen persondata i tags)
0086:     try:
0087:         from ai.settings_helper import get_setting as _gs
0088:     except Exception:
0089:         from settings_helper import get_setting as _gs
0090:     api_key = _gs(db, "gemini_api_key", "")
0091: 
0092:     if api_key:
0093:         client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
0094:     elif sa_path and os.path.exists(sa_path):
0095:         os.environ["GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"] = sa_path
0096:         client = genai.Client(vertexai=True, project=project_id, location=location)
0097:     else:
0098:         raise ValueError("Ingen Gemini API-nøgle eller service account konfigureret")
0099: 
0100:     log.info("Sender %d tags til Gemini for lighed-analyse...", len(tags))
0101:     response = client.models.generate_content(
0102:         model="gemini-2.5-flash",
0103:         contents=prompt,
0104:         config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
0105:             temperature=0.1,
0106:             max_output_tokens=4000,
0107:             thinking_config=types.ThinkingConfig(thinking_budget=0),
0108:         ),
0109:     )
0110: 
0111:     parsed = _parse_json(response.text)
0112:     groups = []
0113: 
0114:     for grp in parsed.get("groups", []):
0115:         ids = [int(x) for x in grp.get("ids", []) if x]
0116:         members = [tag_map[i] for i in ids if i in tag_map]
0117:         if len(members) < 2:
0118:             continue
0119: 
0120:         canonical = grp.get("canonical", "")
0121:         if not canonical:
0122:             canonical = max(members,
0123:                 key=lambda t: (bool(t.get("approved")), t.get("count") or 0, -len(t["tag"]))
0124:             )["tag"]
0125: 
0126:         groups.append({
0127:             "canonical_tag":  canonical,
0128:             "score":          1.0,
0129:             "reason":         grp.get("reason", ""),
0130:             "tags":           members,
0131:             "total_count":    sum(t.get("count") or 0 for t in members),
0132:         })
0133: 
0134:     return sorted(groups, key=lambda g: -g["total_count"])[:limit]
0135: 
0136: 
0137: def _parse_json(text: str) -> dict:
0138:     clean = re.sub(r"```(?:json)?\s*", "", text).strip()
0139:     clean = re.sub(r"```\s*$", "", clean).strip()
0140:     clean = re.sub(r",\s*([}\]])", r"\1", clean)
0141:     try:
0142:         return json.loads(clean)
0143:     except Exception:
0144:         m = re.search(r"(\{.*\})", clean, re.DOTALL)
0145:         if m:
0146:             try:
0147:                 return json.loads(m.group(1))
0148:             except Exception:
0149:                 pass
0150:     return {}

```python
0215: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vocab_tag ON ai_tag_vocabulary(tag);
0216: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vocab_approved ON ai_tag_vocabulary(approved, rejected);

0237:         from sqlalchemy import text
0238:         db_gen = self._get_db()
0239:         db = next(db_gen)
0240:         try:
0241:             try:
0242:                 db.execute(text("SELECT 1 FROM ai_tag_vocabulary LIMIT 1")).fetchone()
0243:                 return
0244:             except Exception:
0245:                 db.rollback()
0246: 
0247:             try:
0248:                 db.execute(text(VOCABULARY_DDL))
0249:                 db.commit()
0250:             except Exception as e:
0251:                 log.warning("Vocabulary DDL: %s", e)
0252:                 db.rollback()
0253:         finally:
0254:             db_gen.close()
0255: 
0256:     def _seed_predefined(self):
0257:         """Indsæt foruddefinerede tags hvis tabellen er tom."""

0260:         try:

0263:             ).scalar()
0264:             if result == 0:

0270:                             VALUES (:tag, :cat, TRUE, TRUE)
0271:                             ON CONFLICT (tag) DO NOTHING
0272:                         """), {"tag": tag, "cat": category})
0273:                 db.commit()
0274:                 log.info("Tag vocabulary seeded.")
0275:         except Exception as e:

0277:             db.rollback()

0282:         """Returnér alle godkendte tags (bruges i prompt)."""
0283:         from sqlalchemy import text

0297:         try:

0299:                 "SELECT tag, category FROM ai_tag_vocabulary WHERE approved=TRUE AND rejected=FALSE ORDER BY category, tag"
0300:             )).fetchall()
0301:             result: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

0309:     def record_usage(self, tags: list[str], new_tags: list[str] | None = None):
0310:         """
0311:         Registrér at tags blev brugt.
0312:         new_tags: tags modellen opfandt selv — gemmes med approved=False til review.
0313:         """
0314:         from sqlalchemy import text
0315:         now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0316:         db = next(self._get_db())
0317:         try:
0318:             for tag in tags:
0319:                 db.execute(text("""
0320:                     UPDATE ai_tag_vocabulary
0321:                     SET count = count + 1, last_seen = :now
0322:                     WHERE tag = :tag
0323:                 """), {"tag": tag, "now": now})
0324: 
0325:             if new_tags:

0338:

0342:             db.rollback()
0343:         finally:
0344:             db.close()

0346:     def get_pending_review(self) -> list[dict]:

0353:                 FROM ai_tag_vocabulary

0355:                 ORDER BY count DESC, first_seen ASC

0357:             return [{"id": r[0], "tag": r[1], "count": r[2],
```

```python
0001: """
0002: TimeLapse Pro — Tekst-model Services
0003: ======================================
0004: SIEM-analyse og CMDB-enrichment via llama3.2:latest (tekstmodel).
0005: 
0006: SIEMAnalyser:
0007:   - Korrelerer heartbeats, fejllog og capture-statistik
0008:   - Returnerer strukturerede hændelser med alvorlighedsgrad
0009:   - Dansk output
0010: 
0011: CMDBEnricher:
0012:   - Vurderer device-helbred baseret på historiske data
0013:   - Foreslår vedligehold og klassificerer status
0014:   - Dansk output
0015: """
0016: 
0017: from __future__ import annotations
0018: 
0019: import json
0020: import logging
0021: import re
0022: import time
0023: from dataclasses import dataclass
0024: from typing import Optional, Any
0025: 
0026: import httpx
0027: 
0028: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0029: 
0030: OLLAMA_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:11434"
0031: TEXT_MODEL      = "llama3.2:latest"
0032: TIMEOUT_TEXT    = 60
0033: 
0034: 
0035: # =============================================================================
0036: # DATAKLASSER
0037: # =============================================================================
0038: 
0039: @dataclass
0040: class SIEMEvent:
0041:     severity:         str           # info / warning / critical
0042:     event_type:       str           # heartbeat_gap / temp_spike / capture_failure / osv.
0043:     summary:          str           # dansk, menneskevenlig beskrivelse
0044:     device_id:        Optional[str]
0045:     location_id:      Optional[str]
0046:     recommended_action: str
0047:     affects_captures: bool
0048:     raw_indicators:   list[str]     # de faktiske datapunkter der trigede det
0049:     confidence:       float         # 0.0–1.0
0050: 
0051: 
0052: @dataclass
0053: class CMDBAssessment:
0054:     device_id:                str
0055:     health_status:            str           # healthy / degraded / critical / unknown
0056:     issues:                   list[str]     # konkrete problemer
0057:     recommendations:          list[str]     # hvad skal gøres
0058:     maintenance_due:          bool
0059:     estimated_days_to_issue:  Optional[int] # None = ukendt
0060:     tags:                     list[str]     # cmdb-tags: outdoor / indoor / high_humidity / osv.
0061:     summary:                  str
0062: 
0063: 
0064: # =============================================================================
0065: # BASE — fælles HTTP-klient
0066: # =============================================================================
0067: 
0068: class _OllamaTextBase:
0069: 
0070:     def __init__(self, base_url: str = OLLAMA_BASE_URL, model: str = TEXT_MODEL):
0071:         self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
0072:         self.model    = model
0073:         self._client  = httpx.Client(timeout=TIMEOUT_TEXT)
0074: 
0075:     def _call(self, prompt: str, system: str = "") -> str:
0076:         """Kald tekstmodel. Returnerer rå tekst fra modellen."""
0077:         payload: dict[str, Any] = {
0078:             "model":  self.model,
0079:             "stream": False,
0080:             "options": {"temperature": 0.1, "num_predict": 800},
0081:         }
0082:         if system:
0083:             payload["system"] = system
0084:             payload["prompt"] = prompt
0085:         else:
0086:             payload["prompt"] = prompt
0087: 
0088:         try:
0089:             resp = self._client.post(
0090:                 f"{self.base_url}/api/generate",
0091:                 json=payload,
0092:                 timeout=TIMEOUT_TEXT,
0093:             )
0094:             resp.raise_for_status()
0095:             return resp.json().get("response", "")
0096:         except httpx.TimeoutException:
0097:             log.error("Ollama tekst-model timeout")
0098:             raise
0099:         except Exception as e:
0100:             log.error("Ollama tekst-fejl: %s", e)
0101:             raise
0102: 
0103:     def _parse_json(self, text: str) -> dict:
0104:         """Robust JSON-parsing af model-output."""
0105:         for pattern in [
0106:             r"```(?:json)?\s*(\{.*?\})\s*```",
0107:             r"(\{.*\})",
0108:         ]:
0109:             match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
0110:             if match:
0111:                 candidate = re.sub(r",\s*([}\]])", r"\1", match.group(1))
0112:                 try:
0113:                     return json.loads(candidate)
0114:                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
0115:                     continue
0116:         return {}
0117: 
0118: 
0119: # =============================================================================
0120: # SIEM ANALYSER
0121: # =============================================================================
0122: 
0123: SIEM_SYSTEM = """Du er et dansk SIEM-system (Security Information and Event Management)
0124: specialiseret i IoT-kameraer og edge-enheder på byggepladser.
0125: Du analyserer tekniske data og returnerer KUN JSON.
0126: Vær præcis, konkret og handlingsorienteret. Dansk output."""
0127: 
0128: SIEM_PROMPT = """
0129: Analyser disse systemhændelser og returner en SIEM-vurdering.
0130: 
0131: ## DATA
0132: {data_block}
0133: 
0134: ## RETURNER PRÆCIS DETTE JSON:
0135: {{
0136:   "severity": "info",
0137:   "event_type": "type_af_hændelse",
0138:   "summary": "Dansk beskrivelse af hvad der er observeret",
0139:   "recommended_action": "Konkret handling der skal tages",
0140:   "affects_captures": false,
0141:   "confidence": 0.85,
0142:   "raw_indicators": ["indikator1", "indikator2"]
0143: }}
0144: 
0145: Mulige severity-værdier: info, warning, critical
0146: Mulige event_type-værdier:
0147:   heartbeat_gap, heartbeat_storm, temperature_spike, temperature_normal,
0148:   capture_failure_rate, upload_backlog, reboot_loop, config_drift,
0149:   gpio_fault, disk_pressure, memory_pressure, network_instability,
0150:   break_glass_access, unauthorized_access, service_restart, normal
0151: 
0152: Returner KUN JSON."""
0153: 
0154: 
0155: class SIEMAnalyser(_OllamaTextBase):
0156:     """
0157:     Analyserer systemhændelser og returnerer strukturerede SIEM-events.
0158: 
0159:     Input: dict med relevante datapunkter (heartbeats, temperatur, capture-statistik)
0160:     Output: SIEMEvent
0161:     """
0162: 
0163:     def analyse_heartbeats(
0164:         self,
0165:         device_id:   str,
0166:         location_id: str,
0167:         heartbeats:  list[dict],
0168:         captures:    list[dict],
0169:         system_info: dict,
0170:     ) -> SIEMEvent:
0171:         """
0172:         Analysér heartbeat-historik for en device.
0173: 
0174:         heartbeats: liste af heartbeat-records (captured_at, cpu_temp, free_disk, ...)
0175:         captures:   seneste capture-resultater (quality_passed, uploaded, ...)
0176:         system_info: dict med os, platform, service_version, uptime, ...
0177:         """
0178:         data_block = json.dumps({
0179:             "device_id":    device_id,
0180:             "location_id":  location_id,
0181:             "heartbeats":   heartbeats[-48:],   # maks 48 (seneste 24t ved 30-min interval)
0182:             "captures_24h": captures[-50:],
0183:             "system_info":  system_info,
0184:         }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
0185: 
0186:         prompt = SIEM_PROMPT.format(data_block=data_block)
0187: 
0188:         try:
0189:             raw = self._call(prompt=prompt, system=SIEM_SYSTEM)
0190:             parsed = self._parse_json(raw)
0191:             return SIEMEvent(
0192:                 severity          = parsed.get("severity", "info"),
0193:                 event_type        = parsed.get("event_type", "unknown"),
0194:                 summary           = parsed.get("summary", "Ingen analyse tilgængelig"),
0195:                 device_id         = device_id,
0196:                 location_id       = location_id,
0197:                 recommended_action= parsed.get("recommended_action", "Ingen handling nødvendig"),
0198:                 affects_captures  = bool(parsed.get("affects_captures", False)),
0199:                 raw_indicators    = list(parsed.get("raw_indicators", [])),
0200:                 confidence        = float(parsed.get("confidence", 0.5)),
0201:             )
0202:         except Exception as e:
0203:             log.error("SIEM analyse fejlede for %s: %s", device_id, e)
0204:             return SIEMEvent(
0205:                 severity="warning", event_type="analysis_error",
0206:                 summary=f"SIEM-analyse fejlede: {e}",
0207:                 device_id=device_id, location_id=location_id,
0208:                 recommended_action="Tjek Ollama-service",
0209:                 affects_captures=False, raw_indicators=[], confidence=0.0,
0210:             )
0211: 
0212:     def analyse_break_glass(
0213:         self,
0214:         device_id:  str,
0215:         admin_id:   str,
0216:         session_log: list[str],
0217:         duration_s:  int,
0218:     ) -> SIEMEvent:
0219:         """Analysér en break-glass SSH-session."""
0220:         data_block = json.dumps({
0221:             "event":       "break_glass_access",
0222:             "device_id":   device_id,
0223:             "admin_id":    admin_id,
0224:             "duration_s":  duration_s,
0225:             "session_log": session_log[:100],   # maks 100 linjer
0226:         }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
0227: 
0228:         prompt = SIEM_PROMPT.format(data_block=data_block)
0229:         raw    = self._call(prompt=prompt, system=SIEM_SYSTEM)
0230:         parsed = self._parse_json(raw)
0231: 
0232:         return SIEMEvent(
0233:             severity          = parsed.get("severity", "warning"),
0234:             event_type        = "break_glass_access",
0235:             summary           = parsed.get("summary", f"Break-glass adgang til {device_id} af {admin_id}"),
0236:             device_id         = device_id,
0237:             location_id       = None,
0238:             recommended_action= parsed.get("recommended_action", "Verificer handlinger i session-log"),
0239:             affects_captures  = bool(parsed.get("affects_captures", False)),
0240:             raw_indicators    = [f"admin:{admin_id}", f"duration:{duration_s}s"],
0241:             confidence        = 0.95,
0242:         )
0243: 
0244:     def correlate_events(self, events: list[SIEMEvent]) -> Optional[SIEMEvent]:
0245:         """
0246:         Korrelér flere SIEM-events til én overordnet vurdering.
0247:         Relevant når samme device har gentagne warnings.
0248:         """
0249:         if not events:
0250:             return None
0251:         if len(events) == 1:
0252:             return events[0]
0253: 
0254:         summary_data = [
0255:             {"severity": e.severity, "event_type": e.event_type, "summary": e.summary}
0256:             for e in events
0257:         ]
0258:         data_block = json.dumps({
0259:             "task":   "correlate",
0260:             "device": events[0].device_id,
0261:             "events": summary_data,
0262:         }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
0263: 
0264:         prompt = SIEM_PROMPT.format(data_block=data_block)
0265:         raw    = self._call(prompt=prompt, system=SIEM_SYSTEM)
0266:         parsed = self._parse_json(raw)
0267: 
0268:         return SIEMEvent(
0269:             severity          = parsed.get("severity", "warning"),
0270:             event_type        = "correlated_" + events[0].event_type,
0271:             summary           = parsed.get("summary", "Korreleret hændelse"),
0272:             device_id         = events[0].device_id,
0273:             location_id       = events[0].location_id,
0274:             recommended_action= parsed.get("recommended_action", ""),
0275:             affects_captures  = any(e.affects_captures for e in events),
0276:             raw_indicators    = [e.event_type for e in events],
0277:             confidence        = float(parsed.get("confidence", 0.6)),
0278:         )

0285: CMDB_SYSTEM = """Du er en CMDB-specialist (Configuration Management Database)

0287: Du analyserer enhedsdata og returnerer KUN JSON med driftsvurderinger.

0321: class CMDBEnricher(_OllamaTextBase):

0326:     def assess_device(
0327:         self,
0328:         device_id:      str,

0330:         location_id:    Optional[str],
0331:         environment:    str,
0332:         uptime_days:    Optional[float],
0333:         cpu_temp_history: list[float],
0334:         disk_usage_pct: Optional[float],

0337:         reboot_count_7d: int,
0338:         software_version: Optional[str],
0339:         last_inspection: Optional[str],
0340:         notes:          Optional[str] = None,
0341:     ) -> CMDBAssessment:
0342:         """
0343:         Fuld device-vurdering til CMDB.
0344:         """
0345:         device_block = json.dumps({
0346:             "device_id":         device_id,
0347:             "platform":          platform,
0348:             "location_id":       location_id,
0349:             "environment":       environment,
0350:             "uptime_days":       uptime_days,
0351:             "cpu_temp_history":  cpu_temp_history[-48:] if cpu_temp_history else [],
0352:             "cpu_temp_avg":      round(sum(cpu_temp_history) / len(cpu_temp_history), 1) if cpu_temp_history else None,
0353:             "cpu_temp_max":      max(cpu_temp_history) if cpu_temp_history else None,
0354:             "disk_usage_pct":    disk_usage_pct,
0355:             "capture_success_7d": capture_success_rate_7d,

0357:             "reboot_count_7d":   reboot_count_7d,

0360:             "notes":             notes,
0361:         }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
0362: 
0363:         try:
0364:             raw    = self._call(prompt=CMDB_PROMPT.format(device_block=device_block), system=CMDB_SYSTEM)
0365:             parsed = self._parse_json(raw)
0366:             return CMDBAssessment(
0367:                 device_id                = device_id,
0368:                 health_status            = parsed.get("health_status", "unknown"),
0369:                 issues                   = list(parsed.get("issues", [])),
0370:                 recommendations          = list(parsed.get("recommendations", [])),
0371:                 maintenance_due          = bool(parsed.get("maintenance_due", False)),
0372:                 estimated_days_to_issue  = parsed.get("estimated_days_to_issue"),
0373:                 tags                     = list(parsed.get("tags", [])),
0374:                 summary                  = parsed.get("summary", "Ingen vurdering tilgængelig"),
0375:             )
0376:         except Exception as e:
0377:             log.error("CMDB assessment fejlede for %s: %s", device_id, e)
0378:             return CMDBAssessment(
0379:                 device_id=device_id, health_status="unknown",
0380:                 issues=["assessment_failed"], recommendations=["Tjek Ollama-service"],
0381:                 maintenance_due=False, estimated_days_to_issue=None,
0382:                 tags=[], summary=f"Vurdering fejlede: {e}",
0383:             )
0384: 
0385:     def batch_assess(
0386:         self,
0387:         devices: list[dict],
0388:     ) -> list[CMDBAssessment]:
0389:         """Vurdér flere devices — bruges til daglig CMDB-opdatering."""
0390:         results = []
0391:         for d in devices:
0392:             try:
0393:                 assessment = self.assess_device(**d)
0394:                 results.append(assessment)
0395:             except Exception as e:
0396:                 log.error("Batch assess fejl for %s: %s", d.get("device_id"), e)
0397:         return results
```

```python
0001: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0002: # TimeLapse Pro — cmdb.py (Headend)

0010: """
0011: TimeLapse Pro — CMDB API
0012: =========================
0013: Monteres på FastAPI-appen i main.py:
0014: 
0015:     from cmdb import router as cmdb_router
0016:     app.include_router(cmdb_router, prefix="/api/cmdb")
0017: 
0018: Endpoints:
0019:     GET  /api/cmdb/                         → liste alle enheder (inventory summary)
0020:     GET  /api/cmdb/{device_id}              → fuld CMDB-post for enhed
0021:     PUT  /api/cmdb/{device_id}              → admin opdaterer felt (environment, notes, location_id)
0022:     POST /api/inventory/{device_id}         → edge rapporterer inventar ved startup
0023:     POST /api/cmdb/{device_id}/break-glass  → admin opretter break-glass konto
0024:     GET  /api/cmdb/{device_id}/break-glass  → list break-glass konti (ingen passwords)
0025:     POST /api/cmdb/{device_id}/break-glass/checkout → checkout: vis password + roter
0026:     DELETE /api/cmdb/{device_id}/break-glass/{account_id} → slet konto
0027: """
0028: 
0029: from __future__ import annotations
0030: 
0031: import json
0032: import logging
0033: import os
0034: import secrets
0035: import string
0036: from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
0037: from typing import Optional
0038: 
0039: from cryptography.fernet import Fernet, InvalidToken
0040: from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
0041: from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
0042: 
0043: from database import Device, DeviceInventory, BreakGlassAccount, get_db, now_utc
0044: 
0045: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

0047: router = APIRouter(tags=["CMDB"])
0048: 
0049: 
0050: # ── Kryptering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0051: 
0052: def _get_fernet() -> Fernet:
0053:     """
0054:     Henter Fernet-instansen fra env-variablen BREAK_GLASS_ENC_KEY.
0055: 
0056:     Generér nøgle (én gang, gem i launchd plist / .env):
0057:         python3 -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"
0058:     """
0059:     key = os.environ.get("BREAK_GLASS_ENC_KEY")
0060:     if not key:
0061:         raise RuntimeError(
0062:             "BREAK_GLASS_ENC_KEY ikke sat — kan ikke håndtere break-glass konti. "
0063:             "Generér med: python3 -c \"from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; "
0064:             "print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())\""
0065:         )
0066:     return Fernet(key.encode())
0067: 
0068: 
0069: def _encrypt(plaintext: str) -> str:
0070:     """Kryptér streng → base64url ciphertext."""
0071:     return _get_fernet().encrypt(plaintext.encode()).decode()
0072: 
0073: 
0074: def _decrypt(ciphertext: str) -> str:
0075:     """Dekryptér ciphertext → plaintext. Kaster HTTPException ved fejl."""
0076:     try:
0077:         return _get_fernet().decrypt(ciphertext.encode()).decode()
0078:     except InvalidToken:
0079:         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Break-glass dekryptering fejlede — forkert nøgle?")
0080: 
0081: 
0082: def _generate_password(length: int = 24) -> str:
0083:     """Generér kryptografisk stærkt password (alphanumerisk, ingen tvetydige tegn)."""
0084:     alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
0085:     # Fjern tvetydige: O, 0, l, 1, I
0086:     alphabet = alphabet.translate(str.maketrans("", "", "O0lI1"))
0087:     return "".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))
0088:

0097:     Opdaterer hardware-/software-felter og inventory_reported_at.

0099:     Kræver ikke auth-token i denne version (edge rapporterer under bootstrap).
0100:     TODO: Kræv edge JWT-token i næste sprint.
0101:     """

0307: 
0308:     Body:
0309:         admin_username  (str)  Hvilken admin-konto der ejer denne adgang
0310:         ssh_username    (str, optional) Standard: "emergency"
0311:         public_key      (str, optional) SSH public key til authorized_keys
0312:         expires_days    (int, optional) Antal dage til udløb (0 = udløber ikke)
0313: 
0314:     Password genereres automatisk og krypteres. Admin ser det IKKE ved oprettelse
0315:     — brug /checkout for at hente det.
0316:     """
0317:     admin_username = payload.get("admin_username")
0318:     if not admin_username:
0319:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="admin_username påkrævet")
0320: 
0321:     # Tjek om der allerede eksisterer en aktiv konto
0322:     existing = db.query(BreakGlassAccount).filter_by(
0323:         device_id=device_id, admin_username=admin_username, is_active=True
0324:     ).first()
0325:     if existing:
0326:         raise HTTPException(
0327:             status_code=409,
0328:             detail=f"Aktiv break-glass konto eksisterer allerede for {admin_username} på {device_id}. "
0329:                    "Brug /checkout for at hente password eller slet den eksisterende først."
0330:         )
0331: 
0332:     password = _generate_password()
0333:     encrypted = _encrypt(password)
0334: 
0335:     expires_days = payload.get("expires_days", 0)
0336:     expires_at = (now_utc() + timedelta(days=expires_days)) if expires_days else None
0337: 
0338:     account = BreakGlassAccount(
0339:         device_id       = device_id,
0340:         admin_username  = admin_username,
0341:         ssh_username    = payload.get("ssh_username", "emergency"),
0342:         password_enc    = encrypted,
0343:         public_key      = payload.get("public_key"),
0344:         expires_at      = expires_at,
0345:         rotation_reason = "initial",
0346:     )
0347:     db.add(account)
0348:     db.commit()
0349:     db.refresh(account)
0350: 
0351:     log.info("Break-glass oprettet: device=%s admin=%s id=%d", device_id, admin_username, account.id)
0352:

0354:     return {

0358:         "admin_username": admin_username,
0359:         "ssh_username":   account.ssh_username,
0360:         "expires_at":     account.expires_at.isoformat() if account.expires_at else None,
0361:         "message":  "Konto oprettet. Brug /checkout for at hente password.",
0362:     }

0388: @router.post("/{device_id}/break-glass/checkout")
0389: def checkout_break_glass(device_id: str, payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0390:     """
0391:     Checkout break-glass password.
0392: 
0393:     - Dekrypterer og returnerer det aktuelle password
0394:     - Genererer straks et NYT password og krypterer det (rotation)
0395:     - Logger tidspunkt og bruger
0396:     - TODO Sprint CMDB-2: push nyt password til edge via SSH
0397: 
0398:     Body:
0399:         admin_username  (str)  Hvilken admin der checker ud
0400:         reason          (str)  Årsag til adgang (til audit log)
0401: 
0402:     SIKKERHED: Denne endpoint skal i produktion kræve:
0403:         1. Stærk MFA (ikke bare session-cookie)
0404:         2. IP-whitelisting
0405:         3. Rate limiting (maks 3 checkouts pr. time)
0406:     """
0407:     admin_username = payload.get("admin_username")
0408:     reason = payload.get("reason", "Ikke angivet")
0409: 
0410:     if not admin_username:
0411:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="admin_username påkrævet")
0412: 
0413:     account = db.query(BreakGlassAccount).filter_by(
0414:         device_id=device_id, admin_username=admin_username, is_active=True
0415:     ).first()
0416:     if not account:
0417:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ingen aktiv break-glass konto fundet")
0418: 
0419:     # Tjek udløb
0420:     if account.expires_at and account.expires_at < now_utc():
0421:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Break-glass konto er udløbet")
0422: 
0423:     # Dekryptér det aktuelle password (til returnering)
0424:     current_password = _decrypt(account.password_enc)
0425: 
0426:     # Generer og kryptér nyt password (rotation)
0427:     new_password = _generate_password()
0428:     account.password_enc    = _encrypt(new_password)
0429:     account.rotated_at      = now_utc()
0430:     account.rotation_reason = f"checkout af {admin_username}: {reason}"
0431:     account.last_used_at    = now_utc()
0432:     account.last_used_by    = admin_username
0433:     account.checkout_count  = (account.checkout_count or 0) + 1
0434: 
0435:     db.commit()
0436: 
0437:     log.warning(
0438:         "BREAK-GLASS CHECKOUT: device=%s admin=%s reason='%s' checkout_count=%d",
0439:         device_id, admin_username, reason, account.checkout_count
0440:     )
0441: 
0442:     # TODO Sprint CMDB-2: push nyt password til edge
0443:     # Dette kræver SSH-forbindelse til edge (break-glass giver jo netop adgang
0444:     # til enheder der måske ikke er tilgængelige via normal kanal — så det er
0445:     # komplekst. For nu: admin er ansvarlig for at rotere manuelt efter brug.)
0446: 
0447:     return {
0448:         "device_id":        device_id,
0449:         "ssh_username":     account.ssh_username,
0450:         "password":         current_password,
0451:         # ⚠️ Dette er det AKTUELLE password (inden rotation).
0452:         # Det nye password er allerede gemt i DB.
0453:         # Gem dette password sikkert — det vises kun denne ene gang.
0454:         "rotated":          True,
0455:         "checkout_count":   account.checkout_count,
0456:         "warning":          "Password vises kun denne ene gang. Gem det nu. Rotation er sket.",
0457:     }
```

```python
0517: def ensure_utc(dt):
0518:     """Ensure datetime is timezone-aware UTC."""
0519:     if dt is None:
0520:         return None
0521:     if dt.tzinfo is None:
0522:         return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
0523:     return dt
0524: 
0525: class DeviceInventory(Base):
0526:     """
0527:     CMDB-registrering af en edge-enhed.
0528: 
0529:     Oprettes første gang edge rapporterer inventar (POST /api/inventory/{device_id}).
0530:     Opdateres ved hvert genstart af edge-agenten.
0531: 
0532:     Relation: 1:1 med devices.device_id (ikke FK constraint — edge kan rapportere
0533:     før den er fuldt registreret, men headend-siden validerer device_id).
0534:     """
0535:     __tablename__ = "device_inventory"
0536: 
0537:     id                      = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
0538:     device_id               = Column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
0539: 
0540:     # ── Miljø ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0541:     environment             = Column(String(20), default="production")
0542:     # Mulige værdier: lab | staging | production
0543: 
0544:     # ── Hardware (rapporteret af edge) ───────────────────────────────────
0545:     hardware_model          = Column(String(100))   # "Orange Pi 4 Pro"
0546:     soc_model               = Column(String(50))    # "RK3588S" | "Allwinner H3"
0547:     cpu_cores               = Column(Integer)
0548:     ram_mb                  = Column(Integer)
0549:     mac_address             = Column(String(20))    # primær ethernet MAC
0550:     serial_number           = Column(String(100))   # /proc/cpuinfo Serial
0551:     hostname                = Column(String(100))
0552: 
0553:     # ── OS / Software ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0554:     os_name                 = Column(String(100))   # "Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS"
0555:     kernel_version          = Column(String(100))   # "6.1.0-armbian"
0556:     firmware_version        = Column(String(200))
0557:     python_version          = Column(String(20))    # "3.12.3"
0558:     app_version             = Column(String(50))    # TimeLapse Pro edge version
0559:     package_manager         = Column(String(50))
0560:     os_packages             = Column(Text)
0561:     venv_packages           = Column(Text)
0562:     # JSON: {"gphoto2": "2.5.28", "paramiko": "3.4.0", ...}
0563:     software_inventory      = Column(Text)
0564: 
0565:     # ── Storage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0566:     boot_storage_type       = Column(String(20))    # emmc | sd | nvme
0567:     boot_storage_total_gb   = Column(Float)
0568:     boot_storage_used_pct   = Column(Float)
0569:     data_partition_path     = Column(String(100))   # "/data"
0570:     data_partition_total_gb = Column(Float)
0571:     data_partition_used_pct = Column(Float)
0572: 
0573:     # ── Netværk ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0574:     primary_interface       = Column(String(20))    # "end0" | "eth0"
0575:     wifi_capable            = Column(Boolean, default=False)
0576:     wifi_ssid               = Column(String(100))   # hvis tilsluttet WiFi
0577: 
0578:     # ── Signering ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0579:     gpg_fingerprint         = Column(String(64))
0580:     # GPG-nøglens fingerprint — til verifikation af pakke-signaturer
0581: 
0582:     # ── Lokation (pre-Location Model) ────────────────────────────────────
0583:     location_id             = Column(String(36))
0584:     # Udfyldes af admin efter provisioning. FK til kommende locations-tabel.
0585: 
0586:     # ── Provisioning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

0603: class BreakGlassAccount(Base):
0604:     """
0605:     Break-the-glass SSH-konto til nødadgang på edge-enheder.
0606: 
0607:     Én konto pr. device pr. admin. Adgangskoden:
0608:       - Genereres tilfældigt (24 tegn, alphanumerisk)
0609:       - Krypteres med Fernet (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) inden lagring
0610:       - Vises ÉN gang ved checkout (GET /api/cmdb/{device_id}/break-glass/checkout)
0611:       - Roteres AUTOMATISK ved checkout — næste checkout giver nyt password
0612:       - Rotation sker i baggrunden via headend → edge SSH-kommando (TODO: Sprint CMDB-2)
0613: 
0614:     Nøgle: env-variabel BREAK_GLASS_ENC_KEY (Fernet-format, base64url 32 bytes)
0615:     Generér med: python3 -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"
0616:     """
0617:     __tablename__ = "break_glass_accounts"
0618:     __table_args__ = (
0619:         UniqueConstraint("device_id", "admin_username",
0620:                          name="uq_breakglass_device_admin"),
0621:     )
0622: 
0623:     id              = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
0624:     device_id       = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
0625:     admin_username  = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
0626:     # Ejerskab: hvilken admin-konto der har adgang til denne instans
0627: 
0628:     # ── SSH-konto på edge ────────────────────────────────────────────────
0629:     ssh_username    = Column(String(50), default="emergency")
0630:     # Bruges til: ssh emergency@<edge-ip>
0631:     # Denne bruger oprettes på edge ved provisioning (TODO: edge-side)
0632: 
0633:     password_enc    = Column(Text, nullable=False)
0634:     # Fernet-krypteret adgangskode — ALDRIG vist i logs eller API-response
0635:     # undtagen ved eksplicit checkout
0636: 
0637:     public_key      = Column(Text)
0638:     # Admin's SSH public key uploadet til edge som authorized_keys (backup)
0639:     # Gør at admin kan logge ind uden password hvis password-rotation fejler
0640: 
0641:     # ── Livscyklus ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0642:     is_active       = Column(Boolean, default=True)
0643:     created_at      = Column(DateTime,
0644:                         default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
0645:     last_used_at    = Column(DateTime)
0646:     last_used_by    = Column(String(100))   # admin der sidst checkede ud
0647:     rotated_at      = Column(DateTime)      # tidspunkt for seneste rotation
0648:     expires_at      = Column(DateTime)
0649:     # Udløb — headend advarer 7 dage før. None = udløber ikke.
0650: 
0651:     # ── Audit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0652:     checkout_count  = Column(Integer, default=0)
0653:     rotation_reason = Column(Text)
0654:     # Årsag til seneste rotation (manuel, checkout, scheduled)

0657: def create_tables():

0661: def get_db():
0662:     """FastAPI dependency — yields a database session."""
0663:     db = SessionLocal()
0664:     try:
0665:         yield db
0666:     finally:
0667:         try:
0668:             db.rollback()
0669:         except Exception:
0670:             pass
0671:         db.close()

0674: def now_utc() -> datetime:
0675:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0676:

0678: def ensure_utc(dt) -> datetime | None:
0679:     """Ensure datetime is timezone-aware UTC. Fixes naive vs aware mismatch."""
0680:     if dt is None:
0681:         return None
0682:     if dt.tzinfo is None:
0683:         return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
0684:     return dt
```

```python
0011: 
0012: # Læs DATABASE_URL fra plist hvis ikke sat i environment
0013: if not os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL"):
0014:     try:
0015:         import subprocess
0016:         url = subprocess.run(
0017:             ["plutil", "-extract", "EnvironmentVariables.DATABASE_URL",
0018:              "raw", "/Library/LaunchDaemons/dk.froekjaer.timelapse-headend.plist"],
0019:             capture_output=True, text=True
0020:         ).stdout.strip()
0021:         if url:
0022:             os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = url
0023:     except Exception:
0024:         pass
0025:

0028: db = SessionLocal()
0029: try:

0031:     count = 0

0039: except Exception as e:

0041:     sys.exit(1)
0042: finally:
0043:     db.close()
```

```python
0091: def table_exists(conn, table: str) -> bool:
0092:     with conn.cursor() as cur:
0093:         cur.execute(
0094:             """
0095:             SELECT EXISTS (
0096:                 SELECT 1
0097:                 FROM information_schema.tables
0098:                 WHERE table_schema = 'public'
0099:                   AND table_name = %s
0100:             ) AS exists
0101:             """,
0102:             (table,),
0103:         )
0104:         return bool(cur.fetchone()["exists"])
0105: 
0106: 
0107: def get_columns(conn, table: str) -> list[str]:
0108:     with conn.cursor() as cur:
0109:         cur.execute(
0110:             """
0111:             SELECT column_name
0112:             FROM information_schema.columns
0113:             WHERE table_schema = 'public'
0114:               AND table_name = %s
0115:             ORDER BY ordinal_position
0116:             """,

0122: def export_table_to_csv(conn, table: str, output_file: Path) -> int:

0124:         output_file.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
0125:         return 0
0126:

0143:         query += f' ORDER BY "{order_col}" {direction}'

0473:         user, _password = auth.split(":", 1)
0474:         return f"{scheme}://{user}:********@{hostpart}"
0475: 
0476:     return url
```

```python
0105:                 exif["datetime_utc"] = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()

0107:             except ValueError:

0114: def _parse_datetime_from_filename(filename: str) -> Optional[datetime]:
0115:     """Parser timestamp fra filnavn: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS eller YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS."""
0116:     patterns = [
0117:         r"(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})[_T](\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})",
0118:         r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})[_T](\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})",
0119:     ]
0120:     for pat in patterns:
0121:         m = re.search(pat, filename)
0122:         if m:
0123:             try:
0124:                 g = [int(x) for x in m.groups()]
0125:                 return datetime(g[0], g[1], g[2], g[3], g[4], g[5], tzinfo=timezone.utc)
0126:             except ValueError:
0127:                 continue
0128:     return None

0131: def _quality_check(path: Path) -> dict:
0132:     result = {"flag": "ok", "passed": True, "blur_score": None, "brightness_mean": None}
0133:     try:
0134:         import cv2
0135:         import numpy as np
0136:         img = cv2.imread(str(path), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
0137:         if img is None:
0138:             raise ValueError("Kunne ikke læse billede")
0139:         # Downscale
0140:         h, w = img.shape
0141:         if max(h, w) > 800:
0142:             scale = 800 / max(h, w)
0143:             img = cv2.resize(img, (int(w*scale), int(h*scale)), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
0144:         # Blur: Laplacian variance (identisk med edge/capture/quality.py)
0145:         lap = cv2.Laplacian(img, cv2.CV_64F)
0146:         blur_score = float(lap.var())
0147:         brightness = float(img.mean())
0148:         result["blur_score"]      = round(blur_score, 1)
0149:         result["brightness_mean"] = round(brightness, 1)
0150:         BLUR_THRESHOLD   = 80.0
0151:         DARK_THRESHOLD   = 25.0
0152:         BRIGHT_THRESHOLD = 230.0
0153:         if blur_score < BLUR_THRESHOLD:
0154:             result["flag"] = "blurry";      result["passed"] = False
0155:         elif brightness < DARK_THRESHOLD:
0156:             result["flag"] = "underexposed"; result["passed"] = False
0157:         elif brightness > BRIGHT_THRESHOLD:
0158:             result["flag"] = "overexposed";  result["passed"] = False
0159:     except Exception as e:
0160:         import logging
0161:         logging.getLogger(__name__).debug("Kvalitetstjek fejl: %s", e)
0162:         result["flag"] = "error"
0163:     return result
```

0299: def _hash_password(pw: str) -> str:
0300:     return _bcrypt_lib.hashpw(pw.encode(), _bcrypt_lib.gensalt()).decode()
0301: 
0302: def _verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
0303:     try:
0304:         return _bcrypt_lib.checkpw(plain.encode(), hashed.encode())
0305:     except Exception:
0306:         return False
0307: 
0308: def _create_token(data: dict, expire_hours: int = JWT_EXPIRE_H) -> str:
0309:     from datetime import timedelta
0310:     payload = data.copy()
0311:     payload["exp"] = now_utc() + timedelta(hours=expire_hours)
0312:     return _jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
0313: 
0314: def _decode_token(token: str) -> dict | None:
0315:     try:
0316:         return _jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM])
0317:     except JWTError:
0318:         return None

0320: def _cookie_header(name: str, value: str, max_age: int, *, domain: str | None = None) -> str:
0321:     parts = [
0322:         f"{name}={value}",
0323:         "Path=/",
0324:         "HttpOnly",
0325:         "SameSite=Lax",
0326:         f"Max-Age={max_age}",
0327:     ]
0328:     if domain:
0329:         parts.append(f"Domain={domain}")
0330:     if COOKIE_SECURE:
0331:         parts.append("Secure")
0332:     return "; ".join(parts)
0333: 
0334: def _delete_cookie_header(name: str, *, domain: str | None = None) -> str:
0335:     parts = [
0336:         f"{name}=",
0337:         "Path=/",
0338:         "HttpOnly",
0339:         "Max-Age=0",
0340:         "Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT",
0341:     ]
0342:     if domain:
0343:         parts.append(f"Domain={domain}")
0344:     if COOKIE_SECURE:
0345:         parts.append("Secure")
0346:     return "; ".join(parts)

0348: def _session_payload(request: Request) -> dict | None:
0349:     token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
0350:     return _decode_token(token) if token else None

0352: def _session_is_mfa_verified(payload: dict | None) -> bool:
0353:     if not payload:
0354:         return False
0355:     if payload.get("mfa_verified") is True:
0356:         return True
0357:     amr = payload.get("amr") or []
0358:     if isinstance(amr, str):
0359:         amr = [amr]
0360:     return bool({"totp", "webauthn", "passkey", "fido2"}.intersection(set(amr)))

0362: def _ensure_super_admin(db):
0363:     """Opretter standard super_admin hvis ingen brugere findes."""
0364:     from database import User
0365:     if db.query(User).count() == 0:
0366:         admin = User(
0367:             username      = "admin",
0368:             email         = "admin@timelapse.local",
0369:             password_hash = _hash_password("changeme"),
0370:             role          = "super_admin",
0371:             is_active     = True,
0372:         )
0373:         db.add(admin)
0374:         db.commit()
0375:         log.warning("Standard super_admin oprettet — SKIFT PASSWORD STRAKS via /api/auth/change-password")
0376: 
0377: def get_current_user(
0378:     request: Request,
0379:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
0380: ):
0381:     """FastAPI dependency — returnerer current user fra cookie eller None."""
0382:     token = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
0383:     if not token:
0384:         return None
0385:     payload = _decode_token(token)
0386:     if not payload:
0387:         return None
0388:     user = db.query(User).filter_by(username=payload.get("sub"), is_active=True).first()
0389:     return user
0390: 
0391: # Rollehierarki — højere roller inkluderer lavere rollers rettigheder
0392: _ROLE_HIERARCHY = {
0393:     "super_admin": {"super_admin", "admin", "operator", "viewer"},
0394:     "admin":       {"admin", "operator", "viewer"},
0395:     "operator":    {"operator", "viewer"},
0396:     "viewer":      {"viewer"},
0397: }
0398: 
0399: def require_role(*roles: str):
0400:     """FastAPI dependency factory — kræver en af de angivne roller.
0401:     Rollehierarki: super_admin > admin > operator > viewer.
0402:     """
0403:     def _check(user=Depends(get_current_user)):
0404:         if user is None:
0405:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ikke autentificeret")
0406:         allowed = _ROLE_HIERARCHY.get(user.role, {user.role})
0407:         if not allowed.intersection(set(roles)):
0408:             raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=f"Kræver rolle: {', '.join(roles)}")
0409:         return user
0410:     return Depends(_check)
0411: 
0412: 
0413: def _is_platform_admin(user: User | None) -> bool:
0414:     """Return True for users allowed to see all tenants."""
0415:     if user is None:
0416:         return False
0417:     return user.role == "super_admin" or (user.role == "admin" and not user.customer_id)
0418: 
0419: 
0420: def _ensure_customer_access(user: User | None, customer_id: str | None) -> None:
0421:     """Enforce tenant boundary for customer scoped records."""
0422:     if _is_platform_admin(user):
0423:         return
0424:     if not user or not user.customer_id or customer_id != user.customer_id:
0425:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til denne kunde")
0426: 
0427: 
0428: def _ensure_site_access(db: Session, user: User | None, site_id: str | None) -> Site:
0429:     site = db.query(Site).filter_by(id=site_id).first()
0430:     if not site:
0431:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
0432:     _ensure_customer_access(user, site.customer_id)
0433:     return site
0434: 
0435: 
0436: def _visible_customer_query(db: Session, user: User | None):
0437:     q = db.query(Customer)
0438:     if _is_platform_admin(user):
0439:         return q
0440:     if not user or not user.customer_id:
0441:         return q.filter(Customer.id == "__none__")
0442:     return q.filter(Customer.id == user.customer_id)
0443: 
0444: 
0445: def _visible_site_query(db: Session, user: User | None):
0446:     q = db.query(Site)
0447:     if _is_platform_admin(user):
0448:         return q
0449:     if not user or not user.customer_id:
0450:         return q.filter(Site.id == "__none__")
0451:     return q.filter(Site.customer_id == user.customer_id)

0454: def _visible_device_query(db: Session, user: User | None):
0455:     q = db.query(Device)
0456:     if _is_platform_admin(user):
0457:         return q
0458:     if not user or not user.customer_id:
0459:         return q.filter(Device.device_id == "__none__")
0460:     site_ids = db.query(Site.id).filter(Site.customer_id == user.customer_id)
0461:     return q.filter(or_(Device.customer_id == user.customer_id, Device.site_id.in_(site_ids)))

0467: @app.get("/api/auth/session-policy")
0468: def get_session_policy(request: Request, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0469:     """Returnerer resolved session policy for den indloggede bruger."""
0470:     if current_user is None:
0471:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0472: 
0473:     policy = {
0474:         "session_duration_hours": 12,
0475:         "remember_me_days":       30,
0476:         "absolute_max_days":      90,
0477:         "rolling_enabled":        True,
0478:         "remember_me_allowed":    True,
0479:         "mfa_required":           False,
0480:         "webauthn_required":      False,
0481:     }
0482: 
0483:     try:
0484:         defaults = db.query(ConfigDefaults).first()
0485:         if defaults and defaults.session_policy:
0486:             policy.update(json.loads(defaults.session_policy))
0487: 
0488:         if current_user.customer_id:
0489:             customer = db.query(Customer).filter_by(id=current_user.customer_id).first()
0490:             if customer and customer.config_overrides:
0491:                 overrides = json.loads(customer.config_overrides)
0492:                 if "session_policy" in overrides:
0493:                     policy.update(overrides["session_policy"])
0494:     except Exception as e:
0495:         log.warning("session_policy resolver fejl: %s", e)
0496: 
0497:     # Find godkendte opdateringer til denne enhed
0498:     from database import PendingUpdate as _PU
0499:     from sqlalchemy import or_
0500: 
0501:     approved = db.query(_PU).filter(
0502:         _PU.status.in_(["approved", "rollback_requested"]),
0503:         or_(
0504:             _PU.scope == "global",
0505:             _PU.scope_id == device_id,
0506:         )
0507:     ).all()
0508: 
0509:     # Filtrer target_device_ids hvis sat
0510:     filtered = []
0511:     for u in approved:
0512:         if u.target_device_ids:
0513:             targets = json.loads(u.target_device_ids)
0514:             if device_id not in targets:
0515:                 continue
0516:         artifact = _find_artifact_for_update(db, u)
0517:         filtered.append({
0518:             "id":          u.id,
0519:             "update_type": u.update_type,
0520:             "version":     u.version,
0521:             "status":      u.status,
0522:             "environment": u.environment,
0523:             "severity":    u.severity,
0524:             "artifact":    _artifact_for_edge_policy(db, artifact),
0525:         })
0526: 
0527:     return {**policy, "pending_updates": filtered}

0531: WEBAUTHN_RP_ID   = os.getenv("WEBAUTHN_RP_ID",   "timelapse.froekjaer.dk")
0532: WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME = os.getenv("WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME",  "TimeLapse Pro")
0533: WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN  = os.getenv("WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN",   "https://timelapse.froekjaer.dk")

0535: @app.post("/api/auth/webauthn/register-begin")
0536: def webauthn_register_begin(payload: dict, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0537:     """Trin 1: Generer WebAuthn registreringsudfordring."""
0538:     import webauthn
0539:     from webauthn.helpers.structs import (
0540:         AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria, UserVerificationRequirement,
0541:         ResidentKeyRequirement
0542:     )
0543:     from database import WebAuthnCredential
0544:     if current_user is None:
0545:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0546: 
0547:     existing = db.query(WebAuthnCredential).filter_by(user_id=current_user.id).all()
0548:     exclude_creds = [
0549:         webauthn.helpers.structs.PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=c.credential_id)
0550:         for c in existing
0551:     ]
0552: 
0553:     options = webauthn.generate_registration_options(
0554:         rp_id                    = WEBAUTHN_RP_ID,
0555:         rp_name                  = WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME,
0556:         user_id                  = str(current_user.id).encode(),
0557:         user_name                = current_user.username,
0558:         user_display_name        = current_user.username,
0559:         exclude_credentials      = exclude_creds,
0560:         authenticator_selection  = AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria(
0561:             user_verification    = UserVerificationRequirement.PREFERRED,
0562:             resident_key         = ResidentKeyRequirement.DISCOURAGED,
0563:         ),
0564:     )
0565: 
0566:     import json as _json
0567:     opts_json = webauthn.options_to_json(options)
0568:     # Gem challenge i session (midlertidigt i DB via settings)
0569:     db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_challenge_{current_user.id}").delete()
0570:     db.add(Settings(key=f"wabauthn_challenge_{current_user.id}", value=opts_json))
0571:     db.commit()
0572:     return _json.loads(opts_json)
0573: 
0574: @app.post("/api/auth/webauthn/register-complete")
0575: def webauthn_register_complete(payload: dict, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0576:     """Trin 2: Valider og gem WebAuthn credential."""
0577:     import webauthn, json as _json
0578:     from database import WebAuthnCredential
0579:     if current_user is None:
0580:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0581: 
0582:     setting = db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_challenge_{current_user.id}").first()
0583:     if not setting:
0584:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ingen aktiv udfordring")
0585: 
0586:     opts = _json.loads(setting.value)
0587:     challenge = webauthn.base64url_to_bytes(opts["challenge"])
0588: 
0589:     try:
0590:         verification = webauthn.verify_registration_response(
0591:             credential          = payload,
0592:             expected_challenge  = challenge,
0593:             expected_rp_id      = WEBAUTHN_RP_ID,
0594:             expected_origin     = WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN,
0595:         )
0596:     except Exception as e:
0597:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Verifikation fejlede: {e}")
0598: 
0599:     device_name = payload.get("deviceName", "Ukendt enhed")
0600:     db.add(WebAuthnCredential(
0601:         user_id       = current_user.id,
0602:         credential_id = verification.credential_id,
0603:         public_key    = verification.credential_public_key,
0604:         sign_count    = verification.sign_count,
0605:         device_name   = device_name,
0606:     ))
0607:     db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_challenge_{current_user.id}").delete()
0608:     db.commit()
0609:     log.info("WebAuthn credential registreret for %s (%s)", current_user.username, device_name)
0610:     return {"ok": True}

0612: @app.post("/api/auth/webauthn/login-begin")
0613: def webauthn_login_begin(payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

0615:     import webauthn, json as _json
0616:     from database import WebAuthnCredential

0618:     user = db.query(User).filter_by(username=username, is_active=True).first()
0619:     if not user:
0620:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bruger ikke fundet")
0621: 
0622:     creds = db.query(WebAuthnCredential).filter_by(user_id=user.id).all()
0623:     if not creds:
0624:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ingen WebAuthn credentials registreret")
0625: 
0626:     allow_creds = [
0627:         webauthn.helpers.structs.PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor(id=c.credential_id)
0628:         for c in creds
0629:     ]
0630:     options = webauthn.generate_authentication_options(

0632:         allow_credentials = allow_creds,
0633:     )
0634:     opts_json = webauthn.options_to_json(options)
0635:     db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_auth_challenge_{user.id}").delete()
0636:     db.add(Settings(key=f"wabauthn_auth_challenge_{user.id}", value=opts_json))
0637:     db.commit()
0638:     return _json.loads(opts_json)

0640: @app.post("/api/auth/webauthn/login-complete")
0641: def webauthn_login_complete(payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0642:     """Trin 2 login: Valider WebAuthn og udsted session cookie."""
0643:     import webauthn, json as _json
0644:     from database import WebAuthnCredential
0645:     username = payload.get("username", "")
0646:     user = db.query(User).filter_by(username=username, is_active=True).first()
0647:     if not user:
0648:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0649: 
0650:     setting = db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_auth_challenge_{user.id}").first()
0651:     if not setting:
0652:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ingen aktiv udfordring")
0653: 
0654:     opts = _json.loads(setting.value)
0655:     challenge = webauthn.base64url_to_bytes(opts["challenge"])
0656: 
0657:     credential_id = webauthn.base64url_to_bytes(payload.get("rawId", ""))
0658:     cred = db.query(WebAuthnCredential).filter_by(
0659:         user_id=user.id, credential_id=credential_id
0660:     ).first()
0661:     if not cred:
0662:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Credential ikke fundet")
0663: 
0664:     try:
0665:         verification = webauthn.verify_authentication_response(
0666:             credential          = payload,
0667:             expected_challenge  = challenge,
0668:             expected_rp_id      = WEBAUTHN_RP_ID,
0669:             expected_origin     = WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN,
0670:             credential_public_key = cred.public_key,
0671:             credential_current_sign_count = cred.sign_count,
0672:         )
0673:     except Exception as e:
0674:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail=f"Autentificering fejlede: {e}")
0675: 
0676:     cred.sign_count = verification.new_sign_count
0677:     db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=f"wabauthn_auth_challenge_{user.id}").delete()
0678:     db.commit()
0679: 
0680:     session_token = _create_token({
0681:         "sub": user.username,
0682:         "role": user.role,
0683:         "cid": user.customer_id,
0684:         "amr": ["webauthn"],
0685:         "mfa_verified": True,
0686:     })
0687:     log.info("WebAuthn login OK: %s", user.username)
0688:     from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse as _JR
0689:     _resp = _JR(content={"ok": True, "role": user.role, "username": user.username, "customer_id": user.customer_id})
0690:     _resp.headers.append("Set-Cookie", _cookie_header(COOKIE_NAME, session_token, JWT_EXPIRE_H * 3600))
0691:     return _resp

0723: 
0724: @app.post("/api/auth/setup-mfa")
0725: def setup_mfa(current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0726:     """Generér TOTP secret og returner QR-kode til authenticator app."""
0727:     import pyotp, qrcode, base64
0728:     from io import BytesIO
0729:     if current_user is None:
0730:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0731:     secret = pyotp.random_base32()
0732:     current_user.totp_secret = secret
0733:     db.commit()
0734:     uri = pyotp.totp.TOTP(secret).provisioning_uri(
0735:         name=current_user.username,
0736:         issuer_name="TimeLapse Pro"
0737:     )
0738:     img = qrcode.make(uri)
0739:     buf = BytesIO()
0740:     img.save(buf, format="PNG")
0741:     qr_b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
0742:     return {"secret": secret, "qr_code": f"data:image/png;base64,{qr_b64}"}
0743: 
0744: @app.post("/api/auth/confirm-mfa")
0745: def confirm_mfa(payload: dict, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0746:     """Bekræft TOTP-kode og aktiver MFA."""
0747:     import pyotp
0748:     if current_user is None:
0749:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0750:     code = payload.get("code", "")
0751:     if not current_user.totp_secret:
0752:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Kør setup-mfa først")
0753:     totp = pyotp.TOTP(current_user.totp_secret)
0754:     if not totp.verify(code, valid_window=1):
0755:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Forkert kode — prøv igen")
0756:     current_user.mfa_enabled = True
0757:     db.commit()
0758:     log.info("MFA aktiveret for %s", current_user.username)
0759:     return {"ok": True}
0760: 
0761: @app.post("/api/auth/disable-mfa")
0762: def disable_mfa(payload: dict, current_user=Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0763:     """Deaktiver MFA — super_admin kan deaktivere for andre brugere via user_id."""
0764:     if current_user is None:
0765:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0766:     user_id = payload.get("user_id")
0767:     if user_id and current_user.role in ("super_admin", "admin"):
0768:         target = db.query(User).filter_by(id=user_id).first()
0769:         if not target:
0770:             raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
0771:     else:
0772:         target = current_user
0773:     target.mfa_enabled = False
0774:     target.totp_secret = None
0775:     db.commit()
0776:     log.info("MFA deaktiveret for %s af %s", target.username, current_user.username)
0777:     return {"ok": True}

0779: @app.post("/api/auth/verify-mfa")
0780: def verify_mfa(payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
0781:     """Trin 2 login: valider TOTP-kode og udsted session cookie."""
0782:     import pyotp
0783:     from database import User as _User
0784:     mfa_token = payload.get("mfa_token", "")
0785:     code      = payload.get("code", "")
0786:     if not mfa_token or not code:
0787:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="mfa_token og code påkrævet")
0788:     payload_data = _decode_token(mfa_token)
0789:     if not payload_data or payload_data.get("type") != "mfa_pending":
0790:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldig eller udløbet MFA token")
0791:     user = db.query(_User).filter_by(username=payload_data.get("sub")).first()
0792:     if not user or not user.mfa_enabled or not user.totp_secret:
0793:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0794:     totp = pyotp.TOTP(user.totp_secret)
0795:     if not totp.verify(code, valid_window=1):
0796:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Forkert kode")
0797:     session_token = _create_token({
0798:         "sub": user.username,
0799:         "role": user.role,
0800:         "cid": user.customer_id,
0801:         "amr": ["password", "totp"],
0802:         "mfa_verified": True,
0803:     })
0804:     log.info("MFA login OK: %s", user.username)
0805:     from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse as _JR
0806:     _resp = _JR(content={"ok": True, "role": user.role, "username": user.username, "customer_id": user.customer_id})
0807:     _resp.headers.append("Set-Cookie", _cookie_header(COOKIE_NAME, session_token, JWT_EXPIRE_H * 3600))
0808:     return _resp

0853:     if not user or not _verify_password(req.password, user.password_hash):
0854:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Forkert brugernavn eller adgangskode")
0855:     user.last_login = now_utc()
0856:     db.commit()
0857:     # MFA check
0858:     if user.mfa_enabled:
0859:         mfa_token = _create_token({"sub": user.username, "type": "mfa_pending"}, expire_hours=5/60)
0860:         log.info("Login MFA påkrævet: %s", user.username)
0861:         return {"mfa_required": True, "mfa_token": mfa_token}
0862:     log.info("Login: %s (%s)", user.username, user.role)
0863:     from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse as _JR
0864:     _resp = _JR(content={
0865:         "ok":          True,
0866:         "role":        user.role,
0867:         "username":    user.username,
0868:         "customer_id": user.customer_id,
0869:     })
0870:     # Hent session policy
0871:     try:
0872:         defaults = db.query(ConfigDefaults).first()
0873:         sp = json.loads(defaults.session_policy or "{}") if defaults and defaults.session_policy else {}
0874:     except Exception:
0875:         sp = {}
0876:     remember_me_days      = int(sp.get("remember_me_days",       30))
0877:     session_duration_hours = int(sp.get("session_duration_hours", JWT_EXPIRE_H))
0878:     remember_me_allowed   = bool(sp.get("remember_me_allowed",   True))
0879: 
0880:     if req.remember and remember_me_allowed:
0881:         max_age = remember_me_days * 24 * 3600
0882:     else:
0883:         max_age = session_duration_hours * 3600
0884:     token = _create_token({
0885:         "sub": user.username,
0886:         "role": user.role,
0887:         "cid": user.customer_id,
0888:         "max_age": max_age,
0889:         "amr": ["password"],
0890:         "mfa_verified": False,
0891:     })
0892:     _resp.headers.append("Set-Cookie", _cookie_header(COOKIE_NAME, token, max_age))
0893:     return _resp

0924:     """Returnerer brugerinfo og fornyr rolling session cookie."""

0926:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
0927:     from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse as _JR
0928:     data = {
0929:         "username":    current_user.username,
0930:         "email":       current_user.email,
0931:         "role":        current_user.role,
0932:         "customer_id": current_user.customer_id,
0933:     }
0934:     # Forny rolling session
0935:     existing = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
0936:     if existing:
0937:         token = existing
0938:         payload_data = _decode_token(token)
0939:         max_age = payload_data.get("max_age", JWT_EXPIRE_H * 3600) if payload_data else JWT_EXPIRE_H * 3600
0940:         new_token = _create_token({
0941:             "sub": current_user.username,
0942:             "role": current_user.role,
0943:             "cid": current_user.customer_id,
0944:             "max_age": max_age,
0945:             "amr": payload_data.get("amr", ["password"]) if payload_data else ["password"],
0946:             "mfa_verified": _session_is_mfa_verified(payload_data),
0947:         })
0948:         resp = _JR(content=data)
0949:         resp.headers.append("Set-Cookie", _cookie_header(COOKIE_NAME, new_token, max_age))
0950:         return resp
0951:     return data

1048: @app.post("/api/bootstrap", response_model=BootstrapResponse)
1049: def bootstrap(req: BootstrapRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
1050:     """
1051:     Edge node first contact. Validates bootstrap token, creates/updates
1052:     device record, returns API token and config URL.
1053:     """
1054:     # In test phase: accept any token starting with "test-"
1055:     # In production: look up token in a provisioning table
1056:     # Valider bootstrap token — tjek DB eller accepter "test-" prefix i DEV
1057:     token_record = db.query(BootstrapToken).filter_by(
1058:         token=req.bootstrap_token, revoked=False
1059:     ).first()
1060:     if token_record:
1061:         # Produktions-token fra DB
1062:         if token_record.expires_at and now_utc() > token_record.expires_at.replace(tzinfo=_tz.utc):
1063:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Bootstrap token udløbet")
1064:         if token_record.used_at:
1065:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Bootstrap token allerede brugt")
1066:         # Marker som brugt
1067:         token_record.used_at = now_utc()
1068:         token_record.used_by_device = req.device_id
1069:     # DEV-mode fjernet — alle tokens skal være i DB
1070:     else:
1071:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldigt eller ukendt bootstrap token")
1072: 
1073:     # Create or update device
1074:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=req.device_id).first()
1075:     if not device:
1076:         device = Device(device_id=req.device_id)
1077:         db.add(device)
1078:         log.info("New device registered: %s", req.device_id)
1079:     else:
1080:         log.info("Device re-bootstrapping: %s", req.device_id)
1081: 
1082:     # Issue a simple test token (use proper JWT in production)
1083:     api_token = f"tk-{req.device_id}-{now_utc().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"
1084:     device.api_token  = api_token
1085:     device.last_seen  = now_utc()
1086:     device.status     = "online"
1087:     for old in db.query(KeyCredential).filter_by(
1088:         entity_type="edge",
1089:         entity_id=req.device_id,
1090:         key_type="api",
1091:         status="active",
1092:     ).all():
1093:         old.status = "rotated"
1094:         old.revoked_at = now_utc()
1095:         old.revoked_by = "bootstrap"
1096:         old.revoke_reason = "Device re-bootstrapped and received a new API credential"
1097:     credential = KeyCredential(
1098:         credential_id=f"TL-KEY-{now_utc():%Y%m%d}-{_secrets.token_hex(6)}",
1099:         entity_type="edge",
1100:         entity_id=req.device_id,
1101:         key_type="api",
1102:         label=f"Bootstrap API credential for {req.device_id}",
1103:         status="active",
1104:         scopes_json=_canonical_json(_key_scopes("api")),
1105:         fingerprint=_fingerprint_material(_secret_hash(api_token)),
1106:         secret_hash=_secret_hash(api_token),
1107:         algorithm="sha256-token-hash",
1108:         compliance_domains="SABSA,IEC62443,ISO27000,NIS2,CRA",
1109:         created_by="bootstrap",
1110:         created_at=now_utc(),
1111:         metadata_json=_canonical_json({"bootstrap_token_device_label": token_record.device_label if token_record else None}),
1112:     )
1113:     db.add(credential)
1114:     _audit_key_event(db, credential, "created_by_bootstrap", "bootstrap", {"device_id": req.device_id})
1115:     db.commit()
1116: 
1117:     base_url   = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://192.168.86.132:8000")
1118:     config_url = f"{base_url}/api/config/{req.device_id}"
1119: 
1120:     return BootstrapResponse(
1121:         api_token  = api_token,
1122:         config_url = config_url,
1123:         device_id  = req.device_id,
1124:     )
