1133: async def _verify_device_token(
1134:     device_id: str,
1135:     request: Request,
1136:     authorization: str = Header(default=""),
1137:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1138: ) -> None:
1139:     """Validér per-device Bearer token på edge-vendte endpoints."""
1140:     scheme, _, provided = authorization.partition(" ")
1141:     if scheme.lower() != "bearer" or not provided:
1142:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Manglende Bearer token")
1143:     token_hash = _secret_hash(provided)
1144:     credential = (
1145:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1146:         .filter_by(entity_type="edge", entity_id=device_id, key_type="api", secret_hash=token_hash)
1147:         .first()
1148:     )
1149:     active_secret = None
1150:     if credential:
1151:         if credential.status != "active":
1152:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="API token er ikke aktiv")
1153:         if credential.expires_at and ensure_utc(credential.expires_at) < now_utc():
1154:             credential.status = "expired"
1155:             db.commit()
1156:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="API token er udløbet")
1157:         active_secret = provided
1158:         await _verify_edge_request_signature(request, active_secret)
1159:         await _verify_edge_attestation_signature(request, device_id, db)
1160:         credential.last_used_at = now_utc()
1161:         credential.last_used_from = request.client.host if request.client else None
1162:         credential.use_count = (credential.use_count or 0) + 1
1163:         db.commit()
1164:         return
1165:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
1166:     if not device or not device.api_token:
1167:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ukendt device eller token ikke sat")
1168:     if not hmac.compare_digest(provided, device.api_token):
1169:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldig API token for dette device")
1170:     await _verify_edge_request_signature(request, provided)
1171:     await _verify_edge_attestation_signature(request, device_id, db)
1172:     migrated = _upsert_legacy_device_api_credential(db, device, actor="legacy-auth")
1173:     if migrated:
1174:         migrated.last_used_at = now_utc()
1175:         migrated.last_used_from = request.client.host if request.client else None
1176:         migrated.use_count = (migrated.use_count or 0) + 1
1177:         db.commit()
1178: 
1179: 
1180: async def _verify_edge_request_signature(request: Request, secret: str) -> None:
1181:     """Validate optional Edge request signature.
1182: 
1183:     Legacy devices may omit signatures for now. If signature headers are present,
1184:     they must be correct. This gives immediate tamper/replay metadata without
1185:     breaking existing LAB nodes.
1186:     """
1187:     signature = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Signature")
1188:     if not signature:
1189:         return
1190:     alg = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Signature-Alg", "")
1191:     timestamp = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Timestamp", "")
1192:     nonce = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Nonce", "")
1193:     if alg != "hmac-sha256-v1" or not timestamp or not nonce:
1194:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldige Edge signatur-headere")
1195:     try:
1196:         ts = int(timestamp)
1197:     except ValueError:
1198:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldigt Edge signatur-tidspunkt")
1199:     if abs(int(now_utc().timestamp()) - ts) > 300:
1200:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Edge signatur er udenfor tidsvindue")
1201:     body_text = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Signature-Payload-SHA256", "")
1202:     if body_text and request.headers.get("X-TLP-Signature-Scope") != "payload-sha256":
1203:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldig Edge signatur-scope")
1204:     if not body_text:
1205:         body = await request.body()
1206:         if body:
1207:             try:
1208:                 body_text = _canonical_json(json.loads(body.decode("utf-8")))
1209:             except Exception:
1210:                 body_text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
1211:     signed = "\n".join([request.method.upper(), request.url.path.removeprefix("/api"), timestamp, nonce, body_text])
1212:     expected = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), signed.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
1213:     if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected):
1214:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Edge request signature mismatch")
1215: 
1216: 
1217: async def _verify_edge_attestation_signature(request: Request, device_id: str, db: Session) -> None:
1218:     """Validate optional Ed25519 Edge payload attestation.
1219: 
1220:     This is optional until edge_signal_signing_required is enabled. The Edge can
1221:     therefore roll out signing before we enforce it fleet-wide.
1222:     """
1223:     signature = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature")
1224:     required = _get_setting(db, "edge_signal_signing_required", "false").lower() == "true"
1225:     if not signature:
1226:         if required:
1227:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Edge attestation signature mangler")
1228:         return
1229:     alg = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Alg", "")
1230:     key_fingerprint = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Key", "")
1231:     timestamp = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Timestamp", "")
1232:     nonce = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Nonce", "")
1233:     if alg != "ed25519-v1" or not key_fingerprint or not timestamp or not nonce:
1234:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldige Edge attestation-headere")
1235:     try:
1236:         ts = int(timestamp)
1237:     except ValueError:
1238:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldigt Edge attestation-tidspunkt")
1239:     if abs(int(now_utc().timestamp()) - ts) > 300:
1240:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Edge attestation er udenfor tidsvindue")
1241:     credential = (
1242:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1243:         .filter_by(
1244:             entity_type="edge",
1245:             entity_id=device_id,
1246:             key_type="signing",
1247:             status="active",
1248:             fingerprint=key_fingerprint,
1249:         )
1250:         .first()
1251:     )
1252:     if not credential or not credential.public_key:
1253:         if not required:
1254:             return
1255:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ukendt Edge signing key")
1256:     try:
1257:         from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
1258:         from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import load_ssh_public_key
1259: 
1260:         public_key = load_ssh_public_key(credential.public_key.encode("utf-8"))
1261:         if not isinstance(public_key, Ed25519PublicKey):
1262:             raise ValueError("not ed25519")
1263:         body_text = request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Payload-SHA256", "")
1264:         if body_text and request.headers.get("X-TLP-Edge-Signature-Scope") != "payload-sha256":
1265:             raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Ugyldig Edge attestation-scope")
1266:         if not body_text:
1267:             body = await request.body()
1268:             if body:
1269:                 try:
1270:                     body_text = _canonical_json(json.loads(body.decode("utf-8")))
1271:                 except Exception:
1272:                     body_text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
1273:         signed = "\n".join([request.method.upper(), request.url.path.removeprefix("/api"), timestamp, nonce, body_text])
1274:         public_key.verify(base64.b64decode(signature), signed.encode("utf-8"))
1275:     except HTTPException:
1276:         raise
1277:     except Exception:
1278:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Edge attestation signature mismatch")
1279:     credential.last_used_at = now_utc()
1280:     credential.last_used_from = request.client.host if request.client else None
1281:     credential.use_count = (credential.use_count or 0) + 1
1282: 
1283:

1307: def _secret_hash(secret: str) -> str:
1308:     return hashlib.sha256(secret.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
1309: 
1310: 
1311: def _fingerprint_material(value: str) -> str:
1312:     return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
1313: 
1314: 
1315: def _key_scopes(key_type: str, scopes: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
1316:     if scopes:
1317:         return [str(s) for s in scopes if str(s).strip()]
1318:     defaults = {
1319:         "api": ["config:read", "heartbeat:write", "capture:write", "updates:poll"],
1320:         "ssh": ["ssh:manual-debug", "ssh:reverse-tunnel"],
1321:         "signing": ["artifact:sign", "change-ticket:sign", "inventory:sign"],
1322:         "bootstrap": ["device:bootstrap"],
1323:     }
1324:     return defaults.get(key_type, [])
1325: 
1326: 
1327: def _credential_state(credential: KeyCredential) -> str:
1328:     if credential.status != "active":
1329:         return credential.status
1330:     if credential.expires_at and ensure_utc(credential.expires_at) < now_utc():
1331:         return "expired"
1332:     return "active"
1333:

1335: def _audit_key_event(
1336:     db: Session,
1337:     credential: KeyCredential,
1338:     event_type: str,
1339:     actor: str,
1340:     details: dict | None = None,
1341: ) -> None:
1342:     db.add(KeyAuditEvent(
1343:         credential_id=credential.credential_id,
1344:         event_type=event_type,
1345:         actor=actor,
1346:         entity_type=credential.entity_type,
1347:         entity_id=credential.entity_id,
1348:         details_json=_canonical_json(details or {}),
1349:         occurred_at=now_utc(),
1350:     ))
1351: 
1352: 
1353: def _upsert_legacy_device_api_credential(
1354:     db: Session,
1355:     device: Device,
1356:     actor: str = "migration",
1357: ) -> KeyCredential | None:
1358:     """Representer et eksisterende legacy device.api_token som lifecycle credential.
1359: 
1360:     Dette ændrer ikke Edge-hemmeligheden og er derfor en non-breaking bro fra
1361:     LAB-tokenmodellen til key_credentials, audit og senere revocation/rotation.
1362:     """
1363:     if not device or not device.device_id or not device.api_token:
1364:         return None
1365:     token_hash = _secret_hash(device.api_token)
1366:     existing = (
1367:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1368:         .filter_by(
1369:             entity_type="edge",
1370:             entity_id=device.device_id,
1371:             key_type="api",
1372:             secret_hash=token_hash,
1373:         )
1374:         .first()
1375:     )
1376:     if existing:
1377:         changed = False
1378:         if existing.status != "active":
1379:             existing.status = "active"
1380:             existing.revoked_at = None
1381:             existing.revoked_by = None
1382:             existing.revoke_reason = None
1383:             changed = True
1384:         if not existing.metadata_json:
1385:             existing.metadata_json = _canonical_json({
1386:                 "migrated_from_legacy_device_api_token": True,
1387:                 "secret_material_stored": False,
1388:                 "legacy_token_retained_for_agent_compatibility": True,
1389:             })
1390:             changed = True
1391:         if changed:
1392:             _audit_key_event(db, existing, "legacy_token_reactivated", actor, {
1393:                 "device_id": device.device_id,
1394:                 "reason": "Existing device.api_token matched credential hash",
1395:             })
1396:         return existing
1397: 
1398:     now = now_utc()
1399:     credential = KeyCredential(
1400:         credential_id=f"TL-KEY-{now:%Y%m%d}-{_secrets.token_hex(6)}",
1401:         entity_type="edge",
1402:         entity_id=device.device_id,
1403:         key_type="api",
1404:         label=f"Legacy API credential for {device.device_id}",
1405:         status="active",
1406:         scopes_json=_canonical_json(_key_scopes("api")),
1407:         fingerprint=_fingerprint_material(token_hash),
1408:         secret_hash=token_hash,
1409:         algorithm="sha256-token-hash",
1410:         compliance_domains="SABSA,IEC62443,ISO27000,NIS2,CRA",
1411:         created_by=actor,
1412:         created_at=now,
1413:         metadata_json=_canonical_json({
1414:             "migrated_from_legacy_device_api_token": True,
1415:             "secret_material_stored": False,
1416:             "legacy_token_retained_for_agent_compatibility": True,
1417:             "next_step": "Rotate device to a managed API credential and remove devices.api_token after agent confirmation.",
1418:         }),
1419:     )
1420:     db.add(credential)
1421:     _audit_key_event(db, credential, "legacy_token_migrated", actor, {
1422:         "device_id": device.device_id,
1423:         "legacy_token_retained": True,
1424:     })
1425:     return credential
1426: 
1427: 
1428: def _credential_to_dict(credential: KeyCredential) -> dict:
1429:     try:
1430:         scopes = json.loads(credential.scopes_json or "[]")
1431:     except Exception:
1432:         scopes = []
1433:     try:
1434:         metadata = json.loads(credential.metadata_json or "{}")
1435:     except Exception:
1436:         metadata = {}
1437:     status = _credential_state(credential)
1438:     return {
1439:         "id": credential.id,
1440:         "credential_id": credential.credential_id,
1441:         "entity_type": credential.entity_type,
1442:         "entity_id": credential.entity_id,
1443:         "key_type": credential.key_type,
1444:         "label": credential.label,
1445:         "status": status,
1446:         "scopes": scopes,
1447:         "public_key": credential.public_key,
1448:         "fingerprint": credential.fingerprint,
1449:         "algorithm": credential.algorithm,
1450:         "compliance_domains": credential.compliance_domains,
1451:         "created_by": credential.created_by,
1452:         "created_at": credential.created_at.isoformat() if credential.created_at else None,
1453:         "expires_at": credential.expires_at.isoformat() if credential.expires_at else None,
1454:         "last_used_at": credential.last_used_at.isoformat() if credential.last_used_at else None,
1455:         "last_used_from": credential.last_used_from,
1456:         "use_count": credential.use_count or 0,
1457:         "revoked_at": credential.revoked_at.isoformat() if credential.revoked_at else None,
1458:         "revoked_by": credential.revoked_by,
1459:         "revoke_reason": credential.revoke_reason,
1460:         "rotated_from_id": credential.rotated_from_id,
1461:         "metadata": metadata,
1462:         "has_secret": bool(credential.secret_hash),
1463:     }
1464: 
1465: 
1466: def _trusted_release_signers(db: Session) -> list[dict]:
1467:     signers = (
1468:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1469:         .filter_by(entity_type="headend", key_type="signing", status="active")
1470:         .order_by(KeyCredential.created_at.desc())
1471:         .all()
1472:     )
1473:     result = []
1474:     for signer in signers:
1475:         try:
1476:             scopes = json.loads(signer.scopes_json or "[]")
1477:         except Exception:
1478:             scopes = []
1479:         try:
1480:             metadata = json.loads(signer.metadata_json or "{}")
1481:         except Exception:
1482:             metadata = {}
1483:         if "artifact:sign" not in scopes and "change-ticket:sign" not in scopes:
1484:             continue
1485:         result.append({
1486:             "credential_id": signer.credential_id,
1487:             "entity_id": signer.entity_id,
1488:             "label": signer.label,
1489:             "algorithm": signer.algorithm,
1490:             "fingerprint": signer.fingerprint,
1491:             "gpg_fingerprint": metadata.get("gpg_fingerprint"),
1492:             "public_key": signer.public_key,
1493:             "scopes": scopes,
1494:             "expires_at": signer.expires_at.isoformat() if signer.expires_at else None,
1495:         })
1496:     return result
1497: 
1498: 
1499: @app.get("/api/admin/key-management")
1500: def list_key_management(
1501:     _user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
1502:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1503: ):
1504:     credentials = db.query(KeyCredential).order_by(KeyCredential.created_at.desc()).all()
1505:     devices = db.query(Device).order_by(Device.device_id).all()
1506:     inventories = {i.device_id: i for i in db.query(DeviceInventory).all()}
1507:     rows = [_credential_to_dict(c) for c in credentials]
1508:     counts = {
1509:         "active": sum(1 for c in rows if c["status"] == "active"),
1510:         "revoked": sum(1 for c in rows if c["status"] == "revoked"),
1511:         "expired": sum(1 for c in rows if c["status"] == "expired"),
1512:         "legacy_device_tokens": sum(1 for d in devices if d.api_token),
1513:         "missing_edge_api_key": 0,
1514:         "missing_signing_key": 0,
1515:         "trusted_release_signers": 0,
1516:     }
1517:     trusted_release_signers = _trusted_release_signers(db)
1518:     counts["trusted_release_signers"] = len(trusted_release_signers)
1519:     active_by_entity_type = {
1520:         (c.entity_type, c.entity_id, c.key_type)
1521:         for c in credentials
1522:         if _credential_state(c) == "active"
1523:     }
1524:     device_rows = []
1525:     for device in devices:
1526:         inv = inventories.get(device.device_id)
1527:         has_api = ("edge", device.device_id, "api") in active_by_entity_type
1528:         has_signing = ("edge", device.device_id, "signing") in active_by_entity_type
1529:         if not has_api:
1530:             counts["missing_edge_api_key"] += 1
1531:         if not has_signing:
1532:             counts["missing_signing_key"] += 1
1533:         device_rows.append({
1534:             "device_id": device.device_id,
1535:             "status": device.status,
1536:             "customer_name": device.customer_name,
1537:             "site_name": device.site_name,
1538:             "hostname": inv.hostname if inv else None,
1539:             "hardware_model": inv.hardware_model if inv else None,
1540:             "has_api_key": has_api,
1541:             "has_signing_key": has_signing,
1542:             "has_legacy_token": bool(device.api_token),
1543:         })
1544:     controls = [
1545:         {
1546:             "status": "warning" if counts["legacy_device_tokens"] else "pass",
1547:             "title": "Legacy device tokens",
1548:             "evidence": f"{counts['legacy_device_tokens']} device(s) har stadig plain legacy api_token i devices-tabellen.",
1549:             "domains": ["ISO27000", "IEC62443", "CRA"],
1550:             "recommendation": "Roter edge-enheder over på key_credentials og fjern plain legacy token efter agent update.",
1551:         },
1552:         {
1553:             "status": "warning" if counts["missing_edge_api_key"] else "pass",
1554:             "title": "Edge API identities",
1555:             "evidence": f"{counts['missing_edge_api_key']} device(s) mangler aktiv Edge API credential.",
1556:             "domains": ["SABSA", "IEC62443", "NIS2"],
1557:             "recommendation": "Udsted én aktiv API credential pr. Edge og bind den til CMDB device_id.",
1558:         },
1559:         {
1560:             "status": "warning" if counts["missing_signing_key"] else "pass",
1561:             "title": "Device signing identities",
1562:             "evidence": f"{counts['missing_signing_key']} device(s) mangler signing credential til inventory/update attestation.",
1563:             "domains": ["IEC62443", "ISO27000", "CRA"],
1564:             "recommendation": "Registrer public signing key pr. Headend og Edge; private keys må aldrig gemmes i Headend DB.",
1565:         },
1566:         {
1567:             "status": "pass" if counts["trusted_release_signers"] else "fail",
1568:             "title": "Code-signing trust root",
1569:             "evidence": f"{counts['trusted_release_signers']} aktiv(e) Headend signing key(s) kan bruges til artifact/change-ticket verification.",
1570:             "domains": ["IEC62443", "ISO27000", "NIS2", "CRA"],
1571:             "recommendation": "Edge må kun installere artifacts med signatur fra en trusted Headend/release key. Pin root public key i base image og distribuer rotation via signeret trust policy.",
1572:         },
1573:         {
1574:             "status": "warning" if counts["missing_signing_key"] or counts["missing_edge_api_key"] else "pass",
1575:             "title": "Signal mutual authentication",
1576:             "evidence": "Edge API credentials autentificerer Edge til Headend; signing credentials skal bruges til attestation af Edge-signaler og update-resultater.",
1577:             "domains": ["SABSA", "IEC62443", "ISO27000", "NIS2"],
1578:             "recommendation": "Udvid agenten med request-signatures eller mTLS, så Headend validerer signeret payload og Edge validerer Headend-signeret policy/artifact.",
1579:         },
1580:     ]
1581:     return {
1582:         "credentials": rows,
1583:         "devices": device_rows,
1584:         "summary": counts,
1585:         "controls": controls,
1586:         "trust_policy": {
1587:             "artifact_verification_required": True,
1588:             "mutual_auth_required": True,
1589:             "trusted_release_signers": trusted_release_signers,
1590:             "edge_acceptance_rule": "Edge must verify manifest signature, artifact sha256 and signer fingerprint before install.",
1591:         },
1592:     }
1593: 
1594: 
1595: @app.post("/api/admin/key-management/migrate-legacy-device-tokens")
1596: def migrate_legacy_device_tokens(
1597:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
1598:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1599: ):
1600:     """Migrer eksisterende devices.api_token til KeyCredential uden at ændre token.
1601: 
1602:     Bruges til LAB/R&D-overgangen, hvor Edge allerede har en hemmelighed lokalt.
1603:     Det giver revocation, audit, last-used og compliance-evidens nu, mens vi
1604:     planlægger egentlig rotation og fjernelse af legacy-feltet senere.
1605:     """
1606:     devices = db.query(Device).order_by(Device.device_id).all()
1607:     migrated = 0
1608:     already_registered = 0
1609:     skipped = 0
1610:     rows = []
1611:     actor = current_user.username
1612:     for device in devices:
1613:         if not device.api_token:
1614:             skipped += 1
1615:             rows.append({
1616:                 "device_id": device.device_id,
1617:                 "status": "skipped_no_legacy_token",
1618:                 "credential_id": None,
1619:             })
1620:             continue
1621:         before = (
1622:             db.query(KeyCredential)
1623:             .filter_by(
1624:                 entity_type="edge",
1625:                 entity_id=device.device_id,
1626:                 key_type="api",
1627:                 secret_hash=_secret_hash(device.api_token),
1628:             )
1629:             .first()
1630:         )
1631:         credential = _upsert_legacy_device_api_credential(db, device, actor=actor)
1632:         if before:
1633:             already_registered += 1
1634:             status = "already_registered"
1635:         else:
1636:             migrated += 1
1637:             status = "migrated"
1638:         rows.append({
1639:             "device_id": device.device_id,
1640:             "status": status,
1641:             "credential_id": credential.credential_id if credential else None,
1642:         })
1643:     db.commit()
1644:     return {
1645:         "migrated": migrated,
1646:         "already_registered": already_registered,
1647:         "skipped": skipped,
1648:         "devices": rows,
1649:     }
1650: 
1651: 
1652: @app.post("/api/admin/key-management/credentials")
1653: def create_key_credential(
1654:     payload: KeyCredentialPayload,
1655:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
1656:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1657: ):
1658:     entity_type = payload.entity_type.strip().lower()
1659:     key_type = payload.key_type.strip().lower()
1660:     if entity_type not in {"headend", "edge", "user", "service"}:
1661:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldig entity_type")
1662:     if key_type not in {"api", "ssh", "signing", "bootstrap"}:
1663:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldig key_type")
1664:     if not payload.entity_id.strip():
1665:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="entity_id er påkrævet")
1666: 
1667:     now = now_utc()
1668:     expires_at = None
1669:     if payload.expires_days and payload.expires_days > 0:
1670:         from datetime import timedelta
1671:         expires_at = now + timedelta(days=int(payload.expires_days))
1672:     credential_id = f"TL-KEY-{now:%Y%m%d}-{_secrets.token_hex(6)}"
1673:     secret_once = None
1674:     private_key_once = None
1675:     public_key = payload.public_key.strip() if payload.public_key else None
1676:     secret_hash = None
1677:     algorithm = "external"
1678: 
1679:     if key_type in {"ssh", "signing"} and payload.generate_keypair and not public_key:
1680:         private_key_once, public_key = _generate_ed25519_keypair()
1681:         algorithm = "ed25519"
1682:     elif public_key:
1683:         algorithm = "ed25519" if public_key.startswith("ssh-ed25519") else "public-key"
1684: 
1685:     if key_type == "api":
1686:         secret_once = f"tlp_{entity_type}_{_secrets.token_urlsafe(32)}"
1687:         secret_hash = _secret_hash(secret_once)
1688:         algorithm = "sha256-token-hash"
1689:         if entity_type == "edge":
1690:             device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=payload.entity_id).first()
1691:             if device:
1692:                 device.api_token = secret_once
1693:     elif key_type in {"ssh", "signing"} and not public_key:
1694:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="SSH/signing credential kræver public_key eller generate_keypair")
1695: 
1696:     fingerprint_source = public_key or secret_hash or credential_id
1697:     credential = KeyCredential(
1698:         credential_id=credential_id,
1699:         entity_type=entity_type,
1700:         entity_id=payload.entity_id.strip(),
1701:         key_type=key_type,
1702:         label=payload.label or f"{entity_type}:{payload.entity_id}:{key_type}",
1703:         status="active",
1704:         scopes_json=_canonical_json(_key_scopes(key_type, payload.scopes)),
1705:         public_key=public_key,
1706:         fingerprint=_fingerprint_material(fingerprint_source),
1707:         secret_hash=secret_hash,
1708:         algorithm=algorithm,
1709:         compliance_domains="SABSA,IEC62443,ISO27000,NIS2,CRA",
1710:         created_by=current_user.username,
1711:         created_at=now,
1712:         expires_at=expires_at,
1713:         rotated_from_id=payload.rotated_from_id,
1714:         metadata_json=_canonical_json(payload.metadata or {}),
1715:     )
1716:     db.add(credential)
1717:     _audit_key_event(db, credential, "created", current_user.username, {
1718:         "key_type": key_type,
1719:         "entity_type": entity_type,
1720:         "rotated_from_id": payload.rotated_from_id,
1721:         "generated_private_key_returned_once": bool(private_key_once),
1722:     })
1723:     if payload.rotated_from_id:
1724:         old = db.query(KeyCredential).filter_by(credential_id=payload.rotated_from_id).first()
1725:         if old and old.status == "active":
1726:             old.status = "rotated"
1727:             old.revoked_at = now
1728:             old.revoked_by = current_user.username
1729:             old.revoke_reason = f"Rotated to {credential_id}"
1730:             _audit_key_event(db, old, "rotated", current_user.username, {"rotated_to": credential_id})
1731:     db.commit()
1732:     data = _credential_to_dict(credential)
1733:     if secret_once:
1734:         data["secret_once"] = secret_once
1735:     if private_key_once:
1736:         data["private_key_once"] = private_key_once
1737:     return data
1738: 
1739: 
1740: @app.post("/api/admin/key-management/credentials/{credential_id}/revoke")
1741: def revoke_key_credential(
1742:     credential_id: str,
1743:     payload: KeyRevokePayload = KeyRevokePayload(),
1744:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
1745:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1746: ):
1747:     credential = db.query(KeyCredential).filter_by(credential_id=credential_id).first()
1748:     if not credential:
1749:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Credential ikke fundet")
1750:     credential.status = "revoked"
1751:     credential.revoked_at = now_utc()
1752:     credential.revoked_by = current_user.username
1753:     credential.revoke_reason = payload.reason or "Manuelt revokeret"
1754:     if credential.entity_type == "edge" and credential.key_type == "api":
1755:         device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=credential.entity_id).first()
1756:         if device and device.api_token and credential.secret_hash == _secret_hash(device.api_token):
1757:             device.api_token = None
1758:     _audit_key_event(db, credential, "revoked", current_user.username, {"reason": credential.revoke_reason})
1759:     db.commit()
1760:     return {"ok": True, "credential_id": credential.credential_id}
1761:

1763: @app.post("/api/keys/signing/enroll/{device_id}")
1764: def enroll_edge_signing_key(
1765:     device_id: str,
1766:     payload: EdgeSigningEnrollmentPayload,
1767:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
1768:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1769: ):
1770:     """Registrer Edge public signing key uden at Headend modtager privat nøgle."""
1771:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
1772:     if not device:
1773:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Device ikke fundet")
1774:     public_key = (payload.public_key or "").strip()
1775:     if not public_key:
1776:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="public_key er påkrævet")
1777:     if not public_key.startswith("ssh-ed25519 "):
1778:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Kun ssh-ed25519 public keys accepteres for Edge signing")
1779: 
1780:     now = now_utc()
1781:     fingerprint = _fingerprint_material(public_key)
1782:     existing = (
1783:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1784:         .filter_by(entity_type="edge", entity_id=device_id, key_type="signing", fingerprint=fingerprint)
1785:         .first()
1786:     )
1787:     if existing:
1788:         if existing.status != "active":
1789:             existing.status = "active"
1790:             existing.revoked_at = None
1791:             existing.revoked_by = None
1792:             existing.revoke_reason = None
1793:             _audit_key_event(db, existing, "edge_signing_key_reactivated", "edge", {"device_id": device_id})
1794:         existing.last_used_at = now
1795:         existing.use_count = (existing.use_count or 0) + 1
1796:         db.commit()
1797:         return {
1798:             "status": "already_registered",
1799:             "credential_id": existing.credential_id,
1800:             "fingerprint": existing.fingerprint,
1801:         }
1802: 
1803:     for old in (
1804:         db.query(KeyCredential)
1805:         .filter_by(entity_type="edge", entity_id=device_id, key_type="signing", status="active")
1806:         .all()
1807:     ):
1808:         old.status = "rotated"
1809:         old.revoked_at = now
1810:         old.revoked_by = "edge"
1811:         old.revoke_reason = "Rotated by Edge signing enrollment"
1812:         _audit_key_event(db, old, "rotated", "edge", {"rotated_by_device": device_id})
1813: 
1814:     credential = KeyCredential(
1815:         credential_id=f"TL-KEY-{now:%Y%m%d}-{_secrets.token_hex(6)}",
1816:         entity_type="edge",
1817:         entity_id=device_id,
1818:         key_type="signing",
1819:         label=payload.label or f"Edge signing key for {device_id}",
1820:         status="active",
1821:         scopes_json=_canonical_json(_key_scopes("signing", ["inventory:sign", "heartbeat:sign", "update-result:sign"])),
1822:         public_key=public_key,
1823:         fingerprint=fingerprint,
1824:         algorithm=payload.algorithm or "ed25519",
1825:         compliance_domains="SABSA,IEC62443,ISO27000,NIS2,CRA",
1826:         created_by="edge",
1827:         created_at=now,

1852: @app.post("/api/admin/provisioning-tokens")
1853: def create_provisioning_token(
1854:     payload: dict,
1855:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
1856:     current_user = Depends(get_current_user),
1857: ):
1858:     """Generer et nyt bootstrap-token til en edge-enhed."""
1859:     import secrets as _secrets
1860:     from sqlalchemy import text as _text
1861:     from datetime import timedelta as _timedelta
1862: 
1863:     token = _secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
1864:     hours = int(payload.get("expires_hours", 24))
1865:     expires = now_utc() + _timedelta(hours=hours)
1866: 
1867:     db.execute(_text("""
1868:         INSERT INTO provisioning_tokens
1869:             (token, device_id, customer_id, site_id, note, created_by, expires_at)
1870:         VALUES
1871:             (:token, :device_id, :customer_id, :site_id, :note, :created_by, :expires_at)
1872:     """), {
1873:         "token":       token,
1874:         "device_id":   payload.get("device_id"),
1875:         "customer_id": payload.get("customer_id"),
1876:         "site_id":     payload.get("site_id"),
1877:         "note":        payload.get("note", ""),
1878:         "created_by":  current_user.username,
1879:         "expires_at":  expires,
1880:     })
1881:     db.commit()
1882:     log.info("Provisioning token oprettet af %s — udløber %s", current_user.username, expires)
1883:     return {"token": token, "expires_at": expires.isoformat()}

2105:     # Apply hierarchical config overrides (Sprint A)

2109:         customer = db.query(Customer).filter_by(id=site.customer_id).first() if site else None

2119:                             cfg[section] = _deep_merge(d, cfg[section])

2134:             if site.config_overrides:

2137:                         cfg[section] = _deep_merge(cfg[section], values)
2138:                     else:
2139:                         cfg[section] = values
2140:             if site.gps_lat:

2142:                 cfg["location"]["gps_lon"] = site.gps_lon
2143:             if site.timezone:

2145:         # Lag 4: device config_overrides

2148:                 if section in cfg and isinstance(cfg[section], dict):

2150:                 else:
2151:                     cfg[section] = values

2159:         cfg["multi_camera_mode"]= node_cfg.get("multi_camera_mode", "single")
2160:         # SSH tunnel config — edgen bruger dette til at styre tunnelen
2161:         if "ssh_tunnel" in node_cfg:

2163:         # Opdateringspolitik
2164:         if "update_policy" in node_cfg:

2166:     except Exception:

2169:

2202: @app.put("/api/admin/devices/{device_id}/config")
2203: def update_device_config(
2204:     device_id: str,
2205:     config: dict,
2206:     _user=require_role("admin"),
2207:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
2208: ):
2209:     """Update per-device config overrides.
2210:     Only provided sections are updated — others preserved.
2211:     Example: PUT {"schedule": {"interval_minutes": 10}}
2212:     """
2213:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2214:     if not device:
2215:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Device not found")
2216: 
2217:     existing = {}
2218:     if device.device_config:
2219:         try:
2220:             existing = json.loads(device.device_config or "{}")
2221:         except Exception:
2222:             existing = {}
2223: 
2224:     for section, values in config.items():
2225:         if section in existing and isinstance(existing[section], dict):
2226:             existing[section].update(values)
2227:         else:
2228:             existing[section] = values
2229: 
2230:     device.device_config = json.dumps(existing, ensure_ascii=False)
2231:     # Genberegn config_version så edge opdager ændringen
2232:     import hashlib as _hl
2233:     device.config_version = _hl.md5(device.device_config.encode()).hexdigest()
2234:     db.commit()
2235:     log.info("Updated device config for %s: %s", device_id, list(config.keys()))
2236:     return {"status": "ok", "device_id": device_id, "config": existing}

2240: def _process_update_report(device_id: str, diag: dict, db) -> None:
2241:     """Opret PendingUpdate-poster baseret på update-info fra heartbeat."""
2242:     from database import PendingUpdate
2243:     updates = diag.get("updates", {})
2244:     if not updates:
2245:         return
2246: 
2247:     os_security  = int(updates.get("os_security_count", 0))
2248:     os_total     = int(updates.get("os_updates_count", 0))
2249:     edge_version = updates.get("app_version", "")
2250: 
2251:     # Headend's egen git-commit som reference
2252:     try:
2253:         import subprocess as _sp
2254:         repo_dir = _os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_REPO_DIR", "/Users/peter/projects/timelapse-pro")
2255:         headend_version = _sp.run(
2256:             ["git", "-C", repo_dir, "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
2257:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5
2258:         ).stdout.strip()[:7]
2259:     except Exception:
2260:         headend_version = ""
2261: 
2262:     def _has_pending(update_type: str) -> bool:
2263:         return db.query(PendingUpdate).filter_by(
2264:             update_type=update_type, scope="device",
2265:             scope_id=device_id, status="pending"
2266:         ).first() is not None
2267: 
2268:     if os_security > 0 and not _has_pending("os_security"):
2269:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
2270:             update_type = "os_security",
2271:             version     = f"{os_security} pakker",
2272:             description = f"{os_security} sikkerhedsopdatering(er) klar til installation (apt)",
2273:             severity    = "high" if os_security >= 10 else "medium",
2274:             scope="device", scope_id=device_id, status="pending",
2275:         ))
2276:         log.info("PendingUpdate oprettet: os_security for %s (%d pakker)", device_id, os_security)
2277: 
2278:     if os_total > 0 and not _has_pending("os_updates"):
2279:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
2280:             update_type = "os_updates",
2281:             version     = f"{os_total} pakker",
2282:             description = f"{os_total} funktionelle OS-opdatering(er) klar via apt",
2283:             severity    = "low",
2284:             scope="device", scope_id=device_id, status="pending",
2285:         ))
2286:         log.info("PendingUpdate oprettet: os_updates for %s (%d pakker)", device_id, os_total)
2287: 
2288:     if edge_version and headend_version and edge_version != headend_version:
2289:         if not _has_pending("app_updates"):
2290:             db.add(PendingUpdate(
2291:                 update_type = "app_updates",
2292:                 version     = headend_version,
2293:                 description = f"TimeLapse Pro opdatering tilgængelig (edge: {edge_version} → headend: {headend_version})",
2294:                 severity    = "medium",
2295:                 scope="device", scope_id=device_id, status="pending",
2296:             ))
2297:             log.info("PendingUpdate oprettet: app_updates for %s", device_id)
2298:

2301: @app.post("/api/heartbeat/{device_id}")
2302: def heartbeat(
2303:     device_id: str,
2304:     req: HeartbeatRequest,
2305:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
2306:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
2307: ):
2308:     """Receive periodic heartbeat with diagnostics from edge node."""
2309:     # Update device record
2310:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2311:     if not device:
2312:         device = Device(device_id=device_id)
2313:         db.add(device)
2314:         log.info("Auto-creating device from heartbeat: %s", device_id)
2315: 
2316:     device.last_seen  = now_utc()
2317:     device.status     = "online"
2318:     if req.ip_address:
2319:         device.ip_address = req.ip_address
2320: 
2321:     # Store diagnostics
2322:     diag = req.diagnostics
2323:     stats = req.capture_stats
2324:     # Extract camera diagnostics sub-dict
2325:     cam = diag.get("camera", {})
2326:     cam_status = cam.get("camera_status", {})
2327:     cam_config = cam.get("camera_config", {})
2328: 
2329:     db.add(Diagnostic(
2330:         device_id    = device_id,
2331:         cpu_temp_c   = diag.get("cpu_temperature"),
2332:         cpu_load_pct = diag.get("cpu_load"),
2333:         ram_used_mb  = diag.get("memory_used_mb"),
2334:         disk_used_gb = diag.get("disk_used_gb"),
2335:         battery_v    = diag.get("battery_voltage"),
2336:         solar_v      = diag.get("solar_voltage"),
2337:         connectivity = diag.get("connectivity_type"),
2338:         uptime_s     = diag.get("uptime_s"),
2339:         capture_total   = stats.get("total"),
2340:         capture_passed  = stats.get("passed"),
2341:         capture_uploaded= stats.get("uploaded"),
2342:         # Extended diagnostics
2343:         ntp_offset_s    = diag.get("ntp_offset_s"),
2344:         ssd_total_gb    = diag.get("ssd_total_gb"),
2345:         ssd_used_pct    = diag.get("ssd_used_pct"),
2346:         ssd_free_gb     = diag.get("ssd_free_gb"),
2347:         service_restarts= diag.get("service_restarts"),
2348:         upload_queue    = diag.get("upload_queue_size"),
2349:         # Camera diagnostics
2350:         cam_battery_pct = cam_status.get("battery_pct"),
2351:         cam_shutter_cnt = cam_status.get("shutter_count"),
2352:         cam_shutter_pct = cam.get("shutter_pct"),
2353:         cam_shutter_alarm = cam.get("shutter_alarm", False),
2354:         cam_available_shots = cam_status.get("available_shots"),
2355:         cam_lens_name   = cam_status.get("lens_name"),
2356:         cam_config_json = json.dumps(cam_config) if cam_config else None,
2357:         cam_drift_json  = json.dumps(cam.get("camera_config_drift", [])),
2358:     ))
2359:     db.commit()
2360: 
2361:     log.info("UPDATE DEBUG: updates felt=%s", diag.get('updates'))
2362:     _process_update_report(device_id, diag, db)
2363:     db.commit()
2364: 
2365:     log.info(
2366:         "Heartbeat: %s | temp=%.1f°C | disk=%.1fGB | connectivity=%s",
2367:         device_id,
2368:         diag.get("cpu_temperature") or 0,
2369:         diag.get("disk_used_gb") or 0,
2370:         diag.get("connectivity_type", "?"),
2371:     )

2378: @app.post("/api/captures/{device_id}")
2379: def receive_capture(
2380:     device_id: str,
2381:     req: CaptureRequest,
2382:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
2383:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
2384: ):
2385:     """Receive capture metadata from edge node."""
2386:     # Parse captured_at
2387:     captured_at = None
2388:     if req.captured_at:
2389:         try:
2390:             captured_at = datetime.fromisoformat(req.captured_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
2391:         except ValueError:
2392:             pass
2393: 
2394:     capture = _upsert_capture_record(
2395:         db,
2396:         device_id=device_id,
2397:         filename=req.filename,
2398:         sha256=req.sha256,
2399:         sha256_pre_xmp=req.sha256_pre_xmp,
2400:         captured_at=captured_at,
2401:         filesize=req.filesize,
2402:         camera_model=req.camera_model,
2403:         quality_flag=req.quality_flag,
2404:         quality_passed=req.quality_passed,
2405:         blur_score=req.blur_score,
2406:         brightness_mean=req.brightness_mean,
2407:         uploaded=req.uploaded_primary or False,
2408:         exposure_time=req.exposure_time,
2409:         aperture=req.aperture,
2410:         iso=req.iso,
2411:     )
2412: 
2413:     # Update device last_seen
2414:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2415:     if device:
2416:         device.last_seen = now_utc()
2417:         device.status    = "online"
2418: 
2419:     db.commit()
2420: 
2421:     # Læs EXIF fra filen i baggrunden og gem i DB
2422:     _cap_id = capture.id
2423:     _dev_id = device_id
2424:     _fname  = req.filename
2425:     def _enrich_exif():
2426:         try:
2427:             import exifread
2428:             src = _find_image(_dev_id, _fname)
2429:             if not src or not src.exists():
2430:                 return
2431:             with open(str(src), "rb") as fh:
2432:                 tags = exifread.process_file(fh, details=True)
2433:             if not tags:
2434:                 return
2435:             exif_json = _json.dumps({k: str(v) for k, v in tags.items()}, ensure_ascii=False)
2436:             # Opdater capture record
2437:             db2_gen = get_db()
2438:             db2 = next(db2_gen)
2439:             try:
2440:                 c2 = db2.query(Capture).filter(Capture.id == _cap_id).first()
2441:                 if c2:
2442:                     c2.exif_data = exif_json
2443:                     db2.commit()
2444:                     log.info("EXIF gemt for capture %d (%d felter)", _cap_id, len(tags))
2445:             finally:
2446:                 db2_gen.close()
2447:         except Exception as exc:
2448:             log.warning("EXIF baggrunds-læsning fejl: %s", exc)
2449:     _threading.Thread(target=_enrich_exif, daemon=True).start()
2450: 
2451:     # ── AI KØDNING ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2452:     try:
2453:         queue_capture_for_analysis(capture.id)
2454:     except Exception:
2455:         pass
2456: 
2457:     quality = "PASS" if req.quality_passed else "FAIL"
2458:     log.info(
2459:         "Capture: %s | %s | %s | blur=%.1f brightness=%.1f",
2460:         device_id,
2461:         req.filename or "?",
2462:         quality,
2463:         req.blur_score or 0,
2464:         req.brightness_mean or 0,
2465:     )
2466: 
2467:     return {"status": "ok", "capture_id": capture.id}
2468: 
2469: 
2470: def _safe_storage_segment(value: str | None, fallback: str) -> str:
2471:     cleaned = _re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9æøåÆØÅ_-]", "_", str(value or fallback)).strip("_")
2472:     return cleaned[:120] or fallback
2473: 
2474: 
2475: def _capture_storage_dir(db: Session, device_id: str, filename: str, captured_at: datetime | None = None) -> _Path:
2476:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2477:     customer = _safe_storage_segment(device.customer_name if device else None, "UnknownCustomer")
2478:     site = _safe_storage_segment(device.site_name if device else None, "UnknownSite")
2479:     camera = _safe_storage_segment(device.camera_name if device else None, device_id)
2480:     when = captured_at
2481:     if when is None:
2482:         m = _re.search(r"_(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_\d{6}\.\w+$", filename)
2483:         if m:
2484:             when = datetime(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)), tzinfo=timezone.utc)
2485:     if when is None:
2486:         when = now_utc()
2487:     return SFTP_BASE / customer / site / camera / f"{when.year:04d}" / f"{when.month:02d}" / f"{when.day:02d}"
2488: 
2489: 
2490: def _parse_capture_timestamp(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
2491:     if not value:
2492:         return None
2493:     try:
2494:         return datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
2495:     except ValueError:
2496:         return None
2497: 
2498: 
2499: def _safe_upload_filename(filename: str | None) -> str:
2500:     name = _Path(filename or "").name
2501:     if not name or name in {".", ".."}:
2502:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldigt filnavn")
2503:     if not _re.match(r"^[A-Za-z0-9æøåÆØÅ_.-]{3,220}$", name):
2504:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldigt filnavn format")
2505:     if _Path(name).suffix.lower() not in {".jpg", ".jpeg"}:
2506:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Kun JPEG-billeder er tilladt")
2507:     return name
2508: 
2509: 
2510: def _upsert_capture_record(db: Session, **values) -> Capture:
2511:     device_id = values.get("device_id")
2512:     sha256 = values.get("sha256")
2513:     filename = values.get("filename")
2514:     q = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.device_id == device_id)
2515:     capture = None
2516:     if sha256:
2517:         capture = q.filter(Capture.sha256 == sha256).order_by(Capture.id.desc()).first()
2518:     if not capture and filename:
2519:         capture = q.filter(Capture.filename == filename).order_by(Capture.id.desc()).first()
2520:     if not capture:
2521:         capture = Capture(device_id=device_id)
2522:         db.add(capture)
2523:     for key, value in values.items():
2524:         if value is not None and hasattr(capture, key):
2525:             setattr(capture, key, value)
2526:     return capture
2527: 
2528: 
2529: @app.post("/api/captures/{device_id}/files")
2530: async def receive_capture_files(
2531:     device_id: str,
2532:     manifest: str = Form(...),
2533:     image: UploadFile = File(...),
2534:     sidecar: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
2535:     thumbnail: UploadFile | None = File(default=None),
2536:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
2537:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
2538: ):
2539:     """Receive image payloads from an Edge over the signed Headend API."""
2540:     _sanitize_device_id(device_id)
2541:     try:
2542:         meta = json.loads(manifest)
2543:     except Exception:
2544:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldigt upload manifest")
2545:     if meta.get("device_id") and meta["device_id"] != device_id:
2546:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Manifest device_id matcher ikke URL")
2547: 
2548:     filename = _safe_upload_filename(meta.get("filename") or image.filename)
2549:     captured_at = _parse_capture_timestamp(meta.get("captured_at"))
2550:     dest_dir = _capture_storage_dir(db, device_id, filename, captured_at)
2551:     dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2552:     dest_path = dest_dir / filename
2553:     tmp_path = dest_dir / f".{filename}.uploading"
2554: 
2555:     hasher = hashlib.sha256()
2556:     size = 0
2557:     with open(tmp_path, "wb") as out:
2558:         while True:
2559:             chunk = await image.read(1024 * 1024)
2560:             if not chunk:
2561:                 break
2562:             size += len(chunk)
2563:             hasher.update(chunk)
2564:             out.write(chunk)
2565:     actual_sha = hasher.hexdigest()
2566:     expected_sha = meta.get("sha256")
2567:     if expected_sha and not hmac.compare_digest(str(expected_sha), actual_sha):
2568:         try:
2569:             tmp_path.unlink()
2570:         except OSError:
2571:             pass
2572:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Billedets SHA-256 matcher ikke manifest")
2573:     os.replace(tmp_path, dest_path)
2574: 
2575:     sidecar_path = dest_path.with_suffix(".json")
2576:     sidecar_received = False
2577:     if sidecar:
2578:         raw_sidecar = await sidecar.read()
2579:         if raw_sidecar:
2580:             try:
2581:                 _json.loads(raw_sidecar.decode("utf-8"))
2582:             except Exception:
2583:                 raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Sidecar JSON er ugyldig")
2584:             sidecar_path.write_bytes(raw_sidecar)
2585:             sidecar_received = True
2586:     elif meta:
2587:         sidecar_path.write_text(_json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
2588: 
2589:     thumbnail_received = False
2590:     if thumbnail:
2591:         thumb_dir = dest_dir / ".thumbs"
2592:         thumb_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
2593:         raw_thumb = await thumbnail.read()
2594:         if raw_thumb:
2595:             (thumb_dir / filename).write_bytes(raw_thumb)
2596:             thumbnail_received = True
2597: 
2598:     capture = _upsert_capture_record(
2599:         db,
2600:         device_id=device_id,
2601:         filename=filename,
2602:         sha256=actual_sha,
2603:         sha256_pre_xmp=meta.get("sha256_pre_xmp"),
2604:         captured_at=captured_at,
2605:         filesize=size,
2606:         camera_model=meta.get("camera_model"),
2607:         quality_flag=meta.get("quality_flag"),
2608:         quality_passed=meta.get("quality_passed"),
2609:         blur_score=meta.get("blur_score"),
2610:         brightness_mean=meta.get("brightness_mean"),
2611:         uploaded=True,
2612:         exposure_time=meta.get("exposure_time"),
2613:         aperture=meta.get("aperture"),
2614:         iso=meta.get("iso"),
2615:         sidecar_path=str(sidecar_path) if sidecar_path.exists() else None,
2616:     )
2617:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2618:     if device:
2619:         device.last_seen = now_utc()
2620:         device.status = "online"
2621:     db.commit()
2622:     try:
2623:         queue_capture_for_analysis(capture.id)
2624:     except Exception:
2625:         pass
2626:     log.info(
2627:         "Capture API files received: device=%s filename=%s image_bytes=%s sidecar=%s thumbnail=%s",
2628:         device_id,
2629:         filename,
2630:         size,
2631:         "uploaded" if sidecar_received else ("manifest_fallback" if sidecar_path.exists() else "missing"),
2632:         thumbnail_received,
2633:     )
2634:     return {
2635:         "status": "ok",
2636:         "capture_id": capture.id,
2637:         "sha256": actual_sha,
2638:         "bytes": size,
2639:         "storage": "canonical",
2640:     }
2641:

2696: @app.get("/api/ssh-tunnel/active")
2697: def ssh_tunnel_active(
2698:     _user=require_role("super_admin", "admin", "operator"),
2699:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
2700: ):
2701:     """Returnerer liste af devices med aktiv SSH tunnel."""
2702:     from database import SshTunnelLog
2703:     from sqlalchemy import text as _t
2704: 
2705:     # Find seneste event pr. device — aktiv = seneste event er "connected"
2706:     rows = db.execute(_t("""
2707:         SELECT s.device_id, s.remote_port, s.local_port, s.event_at, s.extra
2708:         FROM ssh_tunnel_log s
2709:         INNER JOIN (
2710:             SELECT device_id, MAX(event_at) as max_at
2711:             FROM ssh_tunnel_log
2712:             GROUP BY device_id
2713:         ) latest ON s.device_id = latest.device_id AND s.event_at = latest.max_at
2714:         WHERE s.event = 'connected'
2715:         ORDER BY s.event_at DESC
2716:     """)).fetchall()
2717: 
2718:     return [
2719:         {
2720:             "device_id":   r[0],
2721:             "remote_port": r[1],
2722:             "local_port":  r[2],
2723:             "connected_at": r[3],
2724:         }
2725:         for r in rows
2726:     ]
2727:

2814: @app.post("/api/admin/cameras/{camera_id}/assign")
2815: def assign_camera_to_device(
2816:     camera_id: str,
2817:     payload: dict,
2818:     _user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
2819:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
2820: ):
2821:     """Tildel et logisk kamera til en fysisk device (Orange Pi).
2822:     Afslutter eventuel eksisterende assignment automatisk.
2823:     """
2824:     from database import Camera, DeviceAssignment, Device
2825:     import uuid as _u
2826: 
2827:     camera = db.query(Camera).filter_by(id=camera_id).first()
2828:     if not camera:
2829:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Kamera ikke fundet")
2830: 
2831:     device_id = payload.get("device_id")
2832:     if not device_id:
2833:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="device_id påkrævet")
2834: 
2835:     # Afslut eksisterende aktive assignments for dette kamera
2836:     old = (
2837:         db.query(DeviceAssignment)
2838:         .filter_by(camera_id=camera_id)
2839:         .filter(DeviceAssignment.unassigned_at.is_(None))
2840:         .all()
2841:     )
2842:     for o in old:
2843:         o.unassigned_at = now_utc()
2844:         log.info("Assignment afsluttet: device=%s kamera=%s", o.device_id, camera_id)
2845: 
2846:     # Afslut også eksisterende assignments for denne device (til andre kameraer)
2847:     old_dev = (
2848:         db.query(DeviceAssignment)
2849:         .filter_by(device_id=device_id)
2850:         .filter(DeviceAssignment.unassigned_at.is_(None))
2851:         .all()

2853:     for o in old_dev:
2854:         o.unassigned_at = now_utc()
2855: 
2856:     # Opret ny assignment
2857:     assignment = DeviceAssignment(
2858:         device_id   = device_id,
2859:         camera_id   = camera_id,
2860:         assigned_by = payload.get("assigned_by", "admin"),
2861:         notes       = payload.get("notes"),
2862:     )
2863:     db.add(assignment)
2864: 
2865:     # Synkroniser camera_name, site, customer til device (for bagudkompatibilitet)
2866:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
2867:     if device:
2868:         device.camera_name   = camera.camera_name
2869:         device.site_id       = camera.site_id
2870:         device.customer_id   = camera.customer_id
2871: 
2872:     db.commit()
2873:     log.info("Kamera %s tildelt device %s", camera_id, device_id)
2874:     return {"ok": True, "camera_id": camera_id, "device_id": device_id}

3002: def _parse_target_device_ids(value: str | None) -> list[str]:
3003:     if not value:
3004:         return []
3005:     try:

3012: def _update_applies_to_device(update: PendingUpdate, device: Device | None, inv: DeviceInventory) -> bool:
3013:     target_ids = _parse_target_device_ids(update.target_device_ids)
3014:     if target_ids:
3015:         return inv.device_id in target_ids
3016:     if update.scope == "global":
3017:         return True
3018:     if update.scope == "device":
3019:         return update.scope_id == inv.device_id
3020:     if update.scope == "customer" and device:
3021:         return update.scope_id == device.customer_id
3022:     if update.scope == "site" and device:
3023:         return update.scope_id == device.site_id
3024:     return False

3027: def _installed_value(inv: DeviceInventory, category_key: str) -> str | None:
3028:     if category_key.startswith("os_"):
3029:         parts = [p for p in [inv.os_name, inv.kernel_version] if p]
3030:         return " / ".join(parts) if parts else None
3031:     if category_key.startswith("timelapse_"):
3032:         return inv.app_version
3033:     if inv.venv_packages:
3034:         try:
3035:             packages = json.loads(inv.venv_packages)
3036:             if isinstance(packages, dict):
3037:                 return f"{len(packages)} Python package(s)"
3038:         except Exception:
3039:             return "Package inventory rapporteret"
3040:     return None
3041: 
3042: 
3043: def _business_impact(inv: DeviceInventory | None, device: Device | None, update_type: str | None = None) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
3044:     factors: list[str] = []
3045:     score = 35
3046:     env = (inv.environment if inv else None) or (device.environment if device and hasattr(device, "environment") else None) or "production"
3047:     if env == "production":
3048:         score += 25
3049:         factors.append("produktionsmiljø")
3050:     elif env == "staging":
3051:         score += 12
3052:         factors.append("stagingmiljø")
3053:     else:
3054:         score -= 12
3055:         factors.append("LAB/R&D miljø")
3056: 
3057:     device_id = (inv.device_id if inv else None) or (device.device_id if device else "")
3058:     hostname = (inv.hostname if inv else "") or ""
3059:     if "headend" in device_id.lower() or "headend" in hostname.lower() or "macmini" in device_id.lower():
3060:         score += 20
3061:         factors.append("headend/central komponent")
3062:     if device and (device.customer_id or device.site_id):
3063:         score += 8
3064:         factors.append("kunde/site-tilknytning")
3065:     if device and device.status and device.status != "online":
3066:         score += 6
3067:         factors.append(f"enhedsstatus: {device.status}")
3068:     if inv and inv.data_partition_used_pct and inv.data_partition_used_pct >= 85:
3069:         score += 8
3070:         factors.append("høj data-partition udnyttelse")
3071:     if update_type and "security" in update_type:
3072:         score += 10
3073:         factors.append("sikkerhedsrettelse")
3074:     return max(0, min(100, score)), factors
3075: 
3076: 
3077: def _risk_assessment(
3078:     update_type: str | None,
3079:     severity: str | None,
3080:     inv: DeviceInventory | None = None,
3081:     device: Device | None = None,
3082:     status: str | None = None,
3083: ) -> dict:
3084:     severity_score = {
3085:         "critical": 95,
3086:         "high": 78,
3087:         "medium": 55,
3088:         "low": 28,
3089:     }.get((severity or "low").lower(), 35)
3090:     category = UPDATE_TYPE_TO_CATEGORY.get(update_type or "", update_type or "unknown")
3091:     category_score = {
3092:         "timelapse_security": 90,
3093:         "os_security": 84,
3094:         "application_security": 78,
3095:         "timelapse_update": 58,
3096:         "application_update": 48,
3097:         "os_update": 42,
3098:     }.get(category, 45)
3099:     impact_score, factors = _business_impact(inv, device, update_type)
3100:     process_score = 0
3101:     if status in ("failed", "rolled_back", "rollback_requested"):
3102:         process_score = 18
3103:         factors.append(f"tidligere deployment-status: {status}")
3104:     elif status == "approved":
3105:         process_score = 6
3106:         factors.append("godkendt men endnu ikke deployet")
3107: 
3108:     score = round((severity_score * 0.38) + (category_score * 0.22) + (impact_score * 0.32) + process_score)
3109:     score = max(0, min(100, score))
3110:     if score >= 85:
3111:         level = "critical"
3112:     elif score >= 70:
3113:         level = "high"
3114:     elif score >= 45:
3115:         level = "medium"
3116:     else:
3117:         level = "low"
3118:     return {
3119:         "score": score,
3120:         "level": level,
3121:         "severity_component": severity_score,
3122:         "category_component": category_score,
3123:         "business_impact_component": impact_score,
3124:         "factors": factors,
3125:     }

3128: @app.get("/api/updates/device-matrix")
3129: def list_update_device_matrix(
3130:     _user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
3131:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
3132: ):
3133:     """CMDB-forankret opdateringsmatrix pr. enhed og update-kategori."""
3134:     inventories = db.query(DeviceInventory).order_by(DeviceInventory.device_id).all()
3135:     device_map = {d.device_id: d for d in db.query(Device).all()}
3136:     updates = db.query(PendingUpdate).order_by(PendingUpdate.created_at.desc()).all()
3137:     category_meta = [
3138:         {"key": c["key"], "label": c["label"], "types": c["types"]}
3139:         for c in UPDATE_CATEGORIES
3140:     ]
3141:     devices = []
3142:     for inv in inventories:
3143:         if inv.device_id.lower() == "test" and not inv.hostname:
3144:             continue
3145:         device = device_map.get(inv.device_id)
3146:         categories = {}
3147:         device_updates = [u for u in updates if _update_applies_to_device(u, device, inv)]
3148:         for category in UPDATE_CATEGORIES:
3149:             candidates = [
3150:                 u for u in device_updates
3151:                 if u.update_type in category["types"]
3152:             ]
3153:             candidates.sort(
3154:                 key=lambda u: (
3155:                     _status_rank(u.status),
3156:                     -((u.created_at or now_utc()).timestamp()),
3157:                 )
3158:             )
3159:             update = candidates[0] if candidates else None
3160:             installed = _installed_value(inv, category["key"])
3161:             if update:
3162:                 state = "needs_approval" if update.status == "pending" else update.status
3163:                 risk = _risk_assessment(update.update_type, update.severity, inv, device, update.status)
3164:                 categories[category["key"]] = {
3165:                     "state": state,
3166:                     "installed": installed,
3167:                     "available": update.version,
3168:                     "missing": update.status in ("pending", "approved", "rollback_requested"),
3169:                     "pending_update_id": update.id,
3170:                     "update_type": update.update_type,
3171:                     "description": update.description,
3172:                     "severity": update.severity,
3173:                     "status": update.status,
3174:                     "created_at": update.created_at.isoformat() if update.created_at else None,
3175:                     "risk": risk,
3176:                 }
3177:             else:
3178:                 categories[category["key"]] = {
3179:                     "state": "no_update_reported" if installed else "no_inventory",
3180:                     "installed": installed,
3181:                     "available": None,
3182:                     "missing": False,
3183:                     "pending_update_id": None,
3184:                     "update_type": None,
3185:                     "description": None,
3186:                     "severity": None,
3187:                     "status": None,
3188:                     "created_at": None,
3189:                     "risk": _risk_assessment(category["types"][0], "low", inv, device, None),
3190:                 }
3191:         device_risks = [c["risk"]["score"] for c in categories.values() if c.get("missing")]
3192:         devices.append({
3193:             "device_id": inv.device_id,
3194:             "cmdb_ref": f"CMDB:{inv.device_id}",
3195:             "environment": inv.environment,
3196:             "hardware_model": inv.hardware_model,
3197:             "hostname": inv.hostname,
3198:             "os_name": inv.os_name,
3199:             "kernel_version": inv.kernel_version,
3200:             "app_version": inv.app_version,
3201:             "customer_name": device.customer_name if device else None,
3202:             "site_name": device.site_name if device else None,
3203:             "status": device.status if device else "unknown",
3204:             "last_seen": device.last_seen.isoformat() if device and device.last_seen else None,
3205:             "inventory_reported_at": inv.inventory_reported_at.isoformat() if inv.inventory_reported_at else None,
3206:             "categories": categories,
3207:             "risk_score": max(device_risks) if device_risks else 0,
3208:             "missing_count": sum(1 for c in categories.values() if c.get("missing")),
3209:         })
3210:     return {"categories": category_meta, "devices": devices}

3232: def _canonical_json(data: dict) -> str:
3233:     return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
3234:

3236: def _sha256_text(value: str) -> str:
3237:     return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
3238: 
3239: 
3240: def _sign_payload(payload: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
3241:     """Signér payload med OpenPGP hvis en key er konfigureret.
3242: 
3243:     Uden signing key returneres en hash-binding, som er nyttig i LAB men ikke
3244:     en kryptografisk bruger-/release-signatur.
3245:     """
3246:     digest = _sha256_text(payload)
3247:     key_id = os.getenv("CHANGE_TICKET_GPG_KEY") or os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_GPG_KEY")
3248:     if not key_id:
3249:         return f"sha256:{digest}", "system-hash"
3250:     try:
3251:         with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", encoding="utf-8", delete=False) as f:
3252:             f.write(payload)
3253:             payload_path = f.name
3254:         result = _subprocess.run(
3255:             [
3256:                 "gpg", "--batch", "--yes", "--armor",
3257:                 "--local-user", key_id,
3258:                 "--detach-sign", "--output", "-", payload_path,
3259:             ],
3260:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15,
3261:         )
3262:         try:
3263:             os.unlink(payload_path)
3264:         except Exception:
3265:             pass
3266:         if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
3267:             return result.stdout.strip(), key_id
3268:         log.warning("GPG signering fejlede, bruger hash-binding: %s", result.stderr[-300:])
3269:     except Exception as exc:
3270:         log.warning("GPG signering utilgængelig, bruger hash-binding: %s", exc)
3271:     return f"sha256:{digest}", "system-hash"
3272:

3344: def _git_text(args: list[str]) -> str | None:
3345:     try:
3346:         result = _subprocess.run(
3347:             ["git", *args],
3348:             cwd=str(_repo_root()),
3349:             capture_output=True,
3350:             text=True,
3351:             timeout=10,
3352:         )
3353:         if result.returncode == 0:
3354:             return result.stdout.strip()
3355:     except Exception as exc:
3356:         log.warning("Kunne ikke læse git metadata: %s", exc)
3357:     return None

3360: def _release_worktree_dirty() -> bool:
3361:     ignored = {"headend/.webui_secret_key"}
3362:     status = _git_text(["status", "--porcelain"]) or ""
3363:     for line in status.splitlines():
3364:         path = line[3:].strip()
3365:         if path and path not in ignored:
3366:             return True
3367:     return False

3370: def _file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
3371:     digest = hashlib.sha256()
3372:     with path.open("rb") as handle:
3373:         for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
3374:             digest.update(chunk)
3375:     return digest.hexdigest()

3389:     ]
3390:     outputs: list[dict] = []
3391: 
3392:     def _include_release_file(file_path: Path) -> bool:
3393:         rel = str(file_path.relative_to(root))
3394:         if "__pycache__" in file_path.parts:
3395:             return False
3396:         if any(ord(ch) < 32 for ch in rel):
3397:             return False
3398:         if file_path.name in {".DS_Store", "Icon\r"}:
3399:             return False
3400:         return True
3401: 
3402:     for candidate in candidates:
3403:         if candidate.is_file():
3404:             if not _include_release_file(candidate):
3405:                 continue
3406:             outputs.append({
3407:                 "path": str(candidate.relative_to(root)),
3408:                 "size_bytes": candidate.stat().st_size,
3409:                 "sha256": _file_sha256(candidate),
3410:             })
3411:         elif candidate.is_dir():
3412:             for file_path in sorted(p for p in candidate.rglob("*") if p.is_file()):
3413:                 if not _include_release_file(file_path):
3414:                     continue
3415:                 outputs.append({
3416:                     "path": str(file_path.relative_to(root)),
3417:                     "size_bytes": file_path.stat().st_size,
3418:                     "sha256": _file_sha256(file_path),
3419:                 })
3420:     return outputs
3421: 
3422: 
3423: def _find_artifact_for_update(db: Session, update: PendingUpdate) -> UpdateArtifact | None:
3424:     version = (update.version or "").strip()
3425:     if not version:
3426:         return None
3427:     q = db.query(UpdateArtifact).order_by(UpdateArtifact.created_at.desc())
3428:     artifact = q.filter(UpdateArtifact.source_commit == version).first()
3429:     if artifact:
3430:         return artifact
3431:     return q.filter(UpdateArtifact.version == version).first()
3432: 
3433: 
3434: def _artifact_for_edge_policy(db: Session, artifact: UpdateArtifact | None) -> dict | None:
3435:     if not artifact:
3436:         return None
3437:     signer_fingerprint = None
3438:     for signer in _trusted_release_signers(db):
3439:         if artifact.signed_by and artifact.signed_by in {
3440:             signer.get("credential_id"),
3441:             signer.get("gpg_fingerprint"),
3442:         }:
3443:             signer_fingerprint = signer.get("fingerprint")
3444:             break
3445:     return {
3446:         "artifact_id": artifact.artifact_id,
3447:         "artifact_type": artifact.artifact_type,
3448:         "version": artifact.version,
3449:         "source_commit": artifact.source_commit,
3450:         "source_ref": artifact.source_ref,
3451:         "sha256": artifact.sha256,
3452:         "manifest": json.loads(artifact.manifest_json) if artifact.manifest_json else None,
3453:         "signature": artifact.signature,
3454:         "signed_by": artifact.signed_by,
3455:         "signed_at": artifact.signed_at.isoformat() if artifact.signed_at else None,
3456:         "signer_fingerprint": signer_fingerprint,
3457:     }
3458: 
3459: 
3460: def _update_requires_headend_artifact(update_type: str | None) -> bool:
3461:     return (update_type or "") in {
3462:         "app_security",
3463:         "app_updates",
3464:         "app_update",
3465:         "timelapse_update",
3466:         "timelapse_pro_update",
3467:         "os_security",
3468:         "os_updates",
3469:     }
3470: 
3471: 
3472: def _assert_update_has_required_artifact(db: Session, update: PendingUpdate) -> UpdateArtifact:
3473:     artifact = _find_artifact_for_update(db, update)
3474:     if _update_requires_headend_artifact(update.update_type) and not artifact:
3475:         raise HTTPException(
3476:             status_code=409,
3477:             detail=(
3478:                 "Opdateringen mangler Headend-signeret artifact. "
3479:                 "Edge må ikke installere via direkte internet/GitHub/apt."
3480:             ),
3481:         )
3482:     return artifact

3485: @app.get("/api/updates/artifacts/{artifact_id}/files/{file_path:path}")
3486: def download_update_artifact_file(
3487:     artifact_id: str,
3488:     file_path: str,
3489:     device_id: str,
3490:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
3491:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
3492: ):
3493:     """Edge henter kun filer, som er bundet i det signerede artifact-manifest."""
3494:     artifact = db.query(UpdateArtifact).filter_by(artifact_id=artifact_id).first()
3495:     if not artifact or not artifact.manifest_json:
3496:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Artifact ikke fundet")
3497:     normalized = str(Path(file_path))
3498:     if normalized.startswith("../") or normalized.startswith("/") or "/../" in normalized:
3499:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldig artifact path")
3500:     manifest = json.loads(artifact.manifest_json)
3501:     outputs = {
3502:         str(item.get("path")): item
3503:         for item in manifest.get("outputs", [])
3504:         if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("path")
3505:     }
3506:     expected = outputs.get(normalized)
3507:     if not expected:
3508:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fil er ikke del af artifact manifest")
3509:     root = Path(artifact.storage_path or _repo_root()).resolve()
3510:     full_path = (root / normalized).resolve()
3511:     if root not in full_path.parents and full_path != root:
3512:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Artifact path udenfor storage root")
3513:     if not full_path.is_file():
3514:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Artifact fil mangler på Headend")
3515:     actual_sha = _file_sha256(full_path)
3516:     if actual_sha != expected.get("sha256"):
3517:         raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Artifact fil matcher ikke manifest SHA-256")
3518:     return FileResponse(
3519:         str(full_path),
3520:         media_type="application/octet-stream",
3521:         filename=Path(normalized).name,
3522:         headers={
3523:             "X-TLP-Artifact-Id": artifact_id,
3524:             "X-TLP-Artifact-Path": normalized,
3525:             "X-TLP-Artifact-Sha256": actual_sha,
3526:         },
3527:     )

3539: @app.post("/api/updates/artifacts/catalog-current")
3540: def catalog_current_release_artifact(
3541:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
3542:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
3543: ):
3544:     """Registrer den aktuelle Headend/UI release-manifest som signeret artifact."""
3545:     root = _repo_root()
3546:     commit = _git_text(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
3547:     if not commit:
3548:         raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Kunne ikke fastslå git commit for release artifact")
3549:     ref = _git_text(["rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD"]) or "unknown"
3550:     dirty = _release_worktree_dirty()
3551:     created_at = now_utc()
3552:     artifact_id = f"TL-ART-{created_at:%Y%m%d}-{commit[:12]}"
3553:     existing = db.query(UpdateArtifact).filter_by(artifact_id=artifact_id).first()
3554:     if existing:
3555:         return _artifact_to_dict(existing)
3556: 
3557:     outputs = _collect_release_outputs(root)
3558:     manifest = {
3559:         "schema": "timelapse.update_artifact.v1",
3560:         "artifact_id": artifact_id,
3561:         "artifact_type": "app",
3562:         "version": commit,
3563:         "source": {
3564:             "commit": commit,
3565:             "ref": ref,
3566:             "dirty_worktree": dirty,
3567:         },
3568:         "distribution_model": "headend_signed_artifact_catalog_edge_pull",
3569:         "edge_constraints": {
3570:             "edge_requires_direct_internet": False,
3571:             "edge_requires_direct_github": False,
3572:             "headend_is_update_authority": True,
3573:         },
3574:         "rollback": {
3575:             "required": True,
3576:             "strategy": "keep previous known-good artifact and rollback automatically on failed healthcheck",
3577:         },
3578:         "controls": ["SABSA", "IEC62443", "ISO27000", "NIS2", "CRA"],
3579:         "outputs": outputs,
3580:         "created": {
3581:             "by": current_user.username,
3582:             "at": created_at.isoformat(),
3583:         },
3584:     }
3585:     manifest_json = _canonical_json(manifest)
3586:     manifest_sha = _sha256_text(manifest_json)
3587:     signature, signed_by = _sign_payload(manifest_json)
3588:     artifact = UpdateArtifact(
3589:         artifact_id=artifact_id,
3590:         artifact_type="app",
3591:         version=commit,
3592:         source_commit=commit,
3593:         source_ref=ref,
3594:         filename=f"{artifact_id}.manifest.json",
3595:         storage_path=str(root),
3596:         size_bytes=sum(int(o.get("size_bytes") or 0) for o in outputs),
3597:         sha256=manifest_sha,
3598:         manifest_json=manifest_json,
3599:         sbom_ref=None,
3600:         signature=signature,
3601:         signed_by=signed_by,
3602:         signed_at=created_at,
3603:         created_at=created_at,
3604:     )
3605:     db.add(artifact)
3606:     db.commit()
3607:     return _artifact_to_dict(artifact)
3608:
