3610: def _build_change_ticket(
3611:     update: PendingUpdate,
3612:     payload: ChangeTicketPayload,
3613:     user: User,
3614:     artifact: UpdateArtifact | None = None,
3615: ) -> ChangeTicket:
3616:     created_at = now_utc()
3617:     ticket_id = f"TL-CHG-{created_at:%Y%m%d}-{update.id:05d}"
3618:     title = payload.title or f"{update.update_type} {update.version}"
3619:     summary = payload.summary or update.description or ""
3620:     rollback_plan = payload.rollback_plan or "Automatisk rollback ved fejlet healthcheck; manuel intervention hvis rollback fejler."
3621:     maintenance_window = payload.maintenance_window or "Efter gældende update policy"
3622:     risk = _risk_assessment(update.update_type, update.severity, None, None, update.status)
3623:     machine = {
3624:         "schema": "timelapse.change_ticket.v1",
3625:         "ticket_id": ticket_id,
3626:         "pending_update_id": update.id,
3627:         "title": title,
3628:         "summary": summary,
3629:         "update": {
3630:             "type": update.update_type,
3631:             "version": update.version,
3632:             "severity": update.severity,
3633:             "environment": update.environment or "production",
3634:             "scope": update.scope,
3635:             "scope_id": update.scope_id,
3636:             "target_device_ids": json.loads(update.target_device_ids) if update.target_device_ids else None,
3637:             "distribution_model": "edge_pull_via_headend",
3638:             "internet_dependency": "edge_must_not_require_direct_internet_or_github",
3639:         },
3640:         "risk": {
3641:             "score": risk["score"],
3642:             "level": risk["level"],
3643:             "factors": risk["factors"],
3644:             "reboot_required": bool(payload.reboot_required),
3645:             "maintenance_window": maintenance_window,
3646:             "rollback_plan": rollback_plan,
3647:         },
3648:         "created": {
3649:             "by": user.username,
3650:             "at": created_at.isoformat(),
3651:         },
3652:     }
3653:     if artifact:
3654:         machine["artifact"] = {
3655:             "artifact_id": artifact.artifact_id,
3656:             "artifact_type": artifact.artifact_type,
3657:             "version": artifact.version,
3658:             "source_commit": artifact.source_commit,
3659:             "source_ref": artifact.source_ref,
3660:             "sha256": artifact.sha256,
3661:             "signed_by": artifact.signed_by,
3662:             "signed_at": artifact.signed_at.isoformat() if artifact.signed_at else None,
3663:         }
3664:     machine_json = _canonical_json(machine)
3665:     content_sha256 = _sha256_text(machine_json)
3666:     signature, signed_by = _sign_payload(machine_json)
3667:     human_md = "\n".join([
3668:         f"# {ticket_id} - {title}",
3669:         "",
3670:         f"**Status:** {payload.status or 'ready'}",
3671:         f"**Update:** {update.update_type} {update.version}",
3672:         f"**Severity:** {update.severity}",
3673:         f"**Risk score:** {risk['score']}/100 ({risk['level']})",
3674:         f"**Miljø:** {update.environment or 'production'}",
3675:         f"**Scope:** {update.scope or 'device'}{f' / {update.scope_id}' if update.scope_id else ''}",
3676:         f"**Oprettet af:** {user.username}",
3677:         f"**Oprettet:** {created_at.isoformat()}",
3678:         "",
3679:         "## Beskrivelse",
3680:         summary or "Ingen beskrivelse angivet.",
3681:         "",
3682:         "## Deployment-flow",
3683:         "Edge rapporterer inventory og tilgængelige opdateringer til Headend. Headend er update authority og holder signerede artifacts/change tickets. Edge henter kun godkendte opdateringer fra Headend ved næste poll; Headend pusher ikke til Edge i normal drift. SSH-tunnel bruges kun til manuel fejlsøgning.",
3684:         "",
3685:         "## Artifact",
3686:         f"Artifact ID: `{artifact.artifact_id}`" if artifact else "Ingen artifact er bundet endnu. Opret/registrer artifact i Headend-kataloget før produktionsgodkendelse.",
3687:         f"Artifact SHA-256: `{artifact.sha256}`" if artifact else "",
3688:         f"Artifact signeret af: {artifact.signed_by or '-'}" if artifact else "",
3689:         "",
3690:         "## Rollback-plan",
3691:         rollback_plan,
3692:         "",
3693:         "## Risikovurdering",
3694:         "Score beregnes ud fra teknisk severity, update-kategori, miljø/business impact og deployment-status.",
3695:         f"Faktorer: {', '.join(risk['factors']) if risk['factors'] else 'ingen særlige faktorer'}",
3696:         "",
3697:         "## Vedligehold/reboot",
3698:         f"Maintenance window: {maintenance_window}",
3699:         f"Reboot required: {bool(payload.reboot_required)}",
3700:         "",
3701:         "## Maskinlæsbar binding",
3702:         f"SHA-256: `{content_sha256}`",
3703:     ])
3704:     return ChangeTicket(
3705:         ticket_id=ticket_id,
3706:         title=title,
3707:         summary=summary,
3708:         pending_update_id=update.id,
3709:         update_type=update.update_type,
3710:         severity=update.severity,
3711:         environment=update.environment or "production",
3712:         scope=update.scope,
3713:         scope_id=update.scope_id,
3714:         status=payload.status or "ready",
3715:         source_commit=artifact.source_commit if artifact else (update.version if update.update_type in ("app_security", "app_updates") else None),
3716:         source_ref=artifact.source_ref if artifact else None,
3717:         artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id if artifact else None,
3718:         sbom_ref=artifact.sbom_ref if artifact else None,
3719:         rollback_plan=rollback_plan,
3720:         reboot_required=bool(payload.reboot_required),
3721:         maintenance_window=maintenance_window,
3722:         human_readable_md=human_md,
3723:         machine_json=machine_json,
3724:         content_sha256=content_sha256,
3725:         signature=signature,
3726:         signed_by=signed_by,
3727:         signed_at=created_at,
3728:         created_by=user.username,
3729:         created_at=created_at,
3730:         updated_at=created_at,
3731:     )
3732:

3734: def _resolve_update_targets(db: Session, update: PendingUpdate) -> list[Device]:
3735:     if update.target_device_ids:
3736:         ids = json.loads(update.target_device_ids)
3737:         return db.query(Device).filter(Device.device_id.in_(ids)).all()
3738:     if update.scope == "global":
3739:         return db.query(Device).all()
3740:     if update.scope == "customer" and update.scope_id:
3741:         return db.query(Device).filter(Device.customer_id == update.scope_id).all()
3742:     if update.scope == "site" and update.scope_id:
3743:         return db.query(Device).filter(Device.site_id == update.scope_id).all()
3744:     if update.scope == "device" and update.scope_id:
3745:         device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=update.scope_id).first()
3746:         return [device] if device else []
3747:     return []
3748: 
3749: 
3750: def _ensure_update_targets(db: Session, update: PendingUpdate, ticket: ChangeTicket | None = None) -> int:
3751:     created = 0
3752:     for device in _resolve_update_targets(db, update):
3753:         existing = db.query(UpdateTarget).filter_by(
3754:             pending_update_id=update.id,
3755:             device_id=device.device_id,
3756:         ).first()
3757:         if existing:
3758:             continue
3759:         db.add(UpdateTarget(
3760:             pending_update_id=update.id,
3761:             ticket_id=ticket.ticket_id if ticket else None,
3762:             artifact_id=ticket.artifact_id if ticket else None,
3763:             device_id=device.device_id,
3764:             camera_id=None,
3765:             customer_id=device.customer_id,
3766:             site_id=device.site_id,
3767:             status="queued" if update.status == "approved" else "pending",
3768:             current_version=device.app_version,
3769:             target_version=update.version,
3770:         ))
3771:         created += 1
3772:     return created
3773:

3814: @app.post("/api/updates/{update_id}/change-ticket")
3815: def create_change_ticket_for_update(
3816:     update_id: int,
3817:     payload: ChangeTicketPayload = ChangeTicketPayload(),
3818:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
3819:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
3820: ):
3821:     """Generér et hash-bundet change ticket for en PendingUpdate."""
3822:     update = db.query(PendingUpdate).filter_by(id=update_id).first()
3823:     if not update:
3824:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Opdatering ikke fundet")
3825:     existing = db.query(ChangeTicket).filter_by(pending_update_id=update_id).first()
3826:     if existing:
3827:         return _ticket_to_dict(existing)
3828:     artifact = _find_artifact_for_update(db, update)
3829:     ticket = _build_change_ticket(update, payload, current_user, artifact)
3830:     db.add(ticket)
3831:     db.flush()
3832:     created_targets = _ensure_update_targets(db, update, ticket)
3833:     db.commit()
3834:     log.info("Change ticket %s oprettet for update %d af %s", ticket.ticket_id, update_id, current_user.username)
3835:     data = _ticket_to_dict(ticket)
3836:     data["created_targets"] = created_targets
3837:     return data

3840: @app.post("/api/change-tickets/{ticket_id}/approve")
3841: def approve_change_ticket(
3842:     ticket_id: str,
3843:     payload: ChangeDecisionPayload = ChangeDecisionPayload(),
3844:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
3845:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
3846: ):
3847:     """Godkend et change ticket og bind godkendelsen til en hash."""
3848:     ticket = db.query(ChangeTicket).filter_by(ticket_id=ticket_id).first()
3849:     if not ticket:
3850:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Change ticket ikke fundet")
3851:     decided_at = now_utc()
3852:     signed_payload = {
3853:         "ticket_id": ticket.ticket_id,
3854:         "ticket_sha256": ticket.content_sha256,
3855:         "decision": "approved",
3856:         "decided_by": current_user.username,
3857:         "decided_at": decided_at.isoformat(),
3858:         "notes": payload.notes,
3859:     }
3860:     signed_hash = _sha256_text(_canonical_json(signed_payload))
3861:     signature, signed_by = _sign_payload(_canonical_json(signed_payload))
3862:     db.add(ChangeApproval(
3863:         ticket_id=ticket.ticket_id,
3864:         decision="approved",
3865:         decided_by=current_user.username,
3866:         decided_at=decided_at,
3867:         approval_context=_canonical_json({
3868:             "role": current_user.role,
3869:             "customer_id": current_user.customer_id,
3870:             "signed_by": signed_by,
3871:         }),
3872:         signature=signature,
3873:         signed_payload_sha256=signed_hash,
3874:         notes=payload.notes,
3875:     ))
3876:     ticket.status = "approved"
3877:     ticket.updated_at = decided_at
3878:     if ticket.pending_update_id:
3879:         update = db.query(PendingUpdate).filter_by(id=ticket.pending_update_id).first()
3880:         if update and update.status in ("pending", "rejected"):
3881:             _assert_update_has_required_artifact(db, update)
3882:             update.status = "approved"
3883:             update.approved_at = decided_at
3884:             update.approved_by = current_user.username
3885:             _ensure_update_targets(db, update, ticket)
3886:     db.commit()
3887:     return {"ok": True, "ticket_id": ticket.ticket_id, "signed_payload_sha256": signed_hash}
3888:

3890: @app.post("/api/change-tickets/{ticket_id}/reject")
3891: def reject_change_ticket(
3892:     ticket_id: str,
3893:     payload: ChangeDecisionPayload = ChangeDecisionPayload(),
3894:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
3895:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
3896: ):
3897:     """Afvis et change ticket og bind beslutningen til en hash."""
3898:     ticket = db.query(ChangeTicket).filter_by(ticket_id=ticket_id).first()
3899:     if not ticket:
3900:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Change ticket ikke fundet")
3901:     decided_at = now_utc()
3902:     signed_payload = {
3903:         "ticket_id": ticket.ticket_id,
3904:         "ticket_sha256": ticket.content_sha256,
3905:         "decision": "rejected",
3906:         "decided_by": current_user.username,
3907:         "decided_at": decided_at.isoformat(),
3908:         "notes": payload.notes,
3909:     }
3910:     signed_hash = _sha256_text(_canonical_json(signed_payload))
3911:     signature, signed_by = _sign_payload(_canonical_json(signed_payload))
3912:     db.add(ChangeApproval(
3913:         ticket_id=ticket.ticket_id,
3914:         decision="rejected",
3915:         decided_by=current_user.username,
3916:         decided_at=decided_at,
3917:         approval_context=_canonical_json({
3918:             "role": current_user.role,
3919:             "customer_id": current_user.customer_id,
3920:             "signed_by": signed_by,
3921:         }),
3922:         signature=signature,
3923:         signed_payload_sha256=signed_hash,
3924:         notes=payload.notes,
3925:     ))
3926:     ticket.status = "rejected"
3927:     ticket.updated_at = decided_at
3928:     if ticket.pending_update_id:
3929:         update = db.query(PendingUpdate).filter_by(id=ticket.pending_update_id).first()
3930:         if update and update.status == "pending":
3931:             update.status = "rejected"
3932:             update.approved_at = decided_at
3933:             update.approved_by = current_user.username
3934:     db.commit()
3935:     return {"ok": True, "ticket_id": ticket.ticket_id, "signed_payload_sha256": signed_hash}

3972: def _control_summary_state(controls: list[dict]) -> dict:
3973:     counts = {"pass": 0, "warning": 0, "fail": 0, "unknown": 0}
3974:     for control in controls:
3975:         status = control.get("status", "unknown")
3976:         counts[status if status in counts else "unknown"] += 1
3977:     return counts
3978:

3980: def _approval_targets_for_update(db: Session, update: PendingUpdate) -> list[dict]:
3981:     targets = []
3982:     device_map = {d.device_id: d for d in _resolve_update_targets(db, update)}
3983:     if not device_map and update.scope == "device" and update.scope_id:
3984:         device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=update.scope_id).first()
3985:         if device:
3986:             device_map[device.device_id] = device
3987:     for device in device_map.values():
3988:         targets.append({
3989:             "device_id": device.device_id,
3990:             "customer_id": device.customer_id,
3991:             "customer_name": device.customer_name,
3992:             "site_id": device.site_id,
3993:             "site_name": device.site_name,
3994:             "camera_name": device.camera_name,
3995:         })
3996:     return targets
3997: 
3998: 
3999: def _user_can_approve_update(user: User, update: PendingUpdate, targets: list[dict]) -> bool:
4000:     if user.role in ("super_admin", "admin"):
4001:         return True
4002:     if user.role != "operator":
4003:         return False
4004:     if not user.customer_id:
4005:         return False
4006:     if update.scope == "customer" and update.scope_id == user.customer_id:
4007:         return True
4008:     return any(t.get("customer_id") == user.customer_id for t in targets)
4009:

4011: def _approval_queue(db: Session, user: User) -> list[dict]:
4012:     updates = (
4013:         db.query(PendingUpdate)
4014:         .filter(PendingUpdate.status.in_(["pending", "rejected"]))
4015:         .order_by(PendingUpdate.created_at.desc())
4016:         .all()
4017:     )
4018:     queue = []
4019:     for update in updates:
4020:         targets = _approval_targets_for_update(db, update)
4021:         if not _user_can_approve_update(user, update, targets):
4022:             continue
4023:         ticket = db.query(ChangeTicket).filter_by(pending_update_id=update.id).first()
4024:         artifact = _find_artifact_for_update(db, update)
4025:         risk = _risk_assessment(update.update_type, update.severity, None, None, update.status)
4026:         queue.append({
4027:             "id": update.id,
4028:             "update_type": update.update_type,
4029:             "version": update.version,
4030:             "description": update.description,
4031:             "severity": update.severity,
4032:             "status": update.status,
4033:             "environment": update.environment,
4034:             "scope": update.scope,
4035:             "scope_id": update.scope_id,
4036:             "created_at": update.created_at.isoformat() if update.created_at else None,
4037:             "risk": risk,
4038:             "targets": targets,
4039:             "change_ticket": _ticket_to_dict(ticket) if ticket else None,
4040:             "artifact": _artifact_to_dict(artifact) if artifact else None,
4041:             "approval_mode": "simple_acceptance",
4042:         })
4043:     return queue

4231: @app.get("/api/updates/policy/{device_id}")
4232: def get_update_policy(
4233:     device_id: str,
4234:     _auth: None = Depends(_verify_device_token),
4235:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
4236: ):
4237:     """Returnerer resolved update_policy for et device (bruges af edge)."""
4238:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
4239:     if not device:
4240:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
4241: 
4242:     # Default policy
4243:     policy = {
4244:         "app_security":  "auto",
4245:         "os_security":   "auto",
4246:         "app_updates":   "manual",
4247:         "os_updates":    "manual",
4248:         "maintenance_window": "02:00-04:00",
4249:     }
4250: 
4251:     # Merge hierarki (global → customer → site → device)
4252:     try:
4253:         site     = db.query(Site).filter_by(id=device.site_id).first() if device.site_id else None
4254:         customer = db.query(Customer).filter_by(id=site.customer_id).first() if site else None
4255:         defaults = db.query(ConfigDefaults).first()
4256: 
4257:         if defaults and getattr(defaults, "system", None):
4258:             sys_cfg = _json.loads(defaults.system)
4259:             if "update_policy" in sys_cfg:
4260:                 policy.update(sys_cfg["update_policy"])
4261: 
4262:         for obj in [customer, site, device]:
4263:             if not obj:
4264:                 continue
4265:             overrides_raw = getattr(obj, "config_overrides", None) or getattr(obj, "device_config", None)
4266:             if overrides_raw:
4267:                 try:
4268:                     overrides = _json.loads(overrides_raw) if isinstance(overrides_raw, str) else overrides_raw
4269:                     if "update_policy" in overrides:
4270:                         # Mest restriktive vinder: manual > auto
4271:                         for k, v in overrides["update_policy"].items():
4272:                             if k in policy:
4273:                                 if v == "manual" or policy[k] == "auto":
4274:                                     policy[k] = v
4275:                 except Exception:
4276:                     pass
4277:     except Exception as exc:
4278:         log.warning("Update policy resolution fejl: %s", exc)
4279: 
4280:     # Find godkendte opdateringer til denne enhed
4281:     from database import PendingUpdate as _PU
4282:     from sqlalchemy import or_
4283:     approved = db.query(_PU).filter(
4284:         _PU.status.in_(["approved", "rollback_requested"]),
4285:         or_(_PU.scope == "global", _PU.scope_id == device_id)
4286:     ).all()
4287: 
4288:     filtered = []
4289:     for u in approved:
4290:         if u.target_device_ids:
4291:             targets = json.loads(u.target_device_ids)
4292:             if device_id not in targets:
4293:                 continue
4294:         artifact = _find_artifact_for_update(db, u)
4295:         filtered.append({
4296:             "id":          u.id,
4297:             "update_type": u.update_type,
4298:             "version":     u.version,
4299:             "status":      u.status,
4300:             "environment": u.environment,
4301:             "severity":    u.severity,
4302:             "artifact":    _artifact_for_edge_policy(db, artifact),
4303:         })
4304: 
4305:     return {**policy, "pending_updates": filtered}
4306:

4333: @app.post("/api/updates/available")
4334: def report_available_updates(
4335:     payload: dict,
4336:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
4337: ):
4338:     """Edge rapporterer tilgængelige opdateringer — opretter PendingUpdate-poster."""
4339:     from database import PendingUpdate
4340: 
4341:     device_id          = payload.get("device_id", "unknown")
4342:     os_security_count  = int(payload.get("os_security_count", 0))
4343:     os_updates_count   = int(payload.get("os_updates_count", 0))
4344:     app_version        = payload.get("app_version", "")
4345:     app_behind_commits = int(payload.get("app_behind_commits", 0))
4346:     app_security       = bool(payload.get("app_security", False))
4347: 
4348:     created = []
4349: 
4350:     def _has_pending(update_type: str) -> bool:
4351:         from sqlalchemy import or_
4352:         return db.query(PendingUpdate).filter(
4353:             PendingUpdate.update_type == update_type,
4354:             PendingUpdate.scope == "device",
4355:             PendingUpdate.scope_id == device_id,
4356:             or_(PendingUpdate.status == "pending", PendingUpdate.status == "approved"),
4357:         ).first() is not None
4358: 
4359:     if os_security_count > 0 and not _has_pending("os_security"):
4360:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
4361:             update_type = "os_security",
4362:             version     = f"{os_security_count} pakker",
4363:             description = f"{os_security_count} sikkerhedsopdatering(er) klar til installation via apt",
4364:             severity    = "high" if os_security_count >= 10 else "medium",
4365:             scope       = "device",
4366:             scope_id    = device_id,
4367:             status      = "pending",
4368:         ))
4369:         created.append("os_security")
4370: 
4371:     if os_updates_count > 0 and not _has_pending("os_updates"):
4372:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
4373:             update_type = "os_updates",
4374:             version     = f"{os_updates_count} pakker",
4375:             description = f"{os_updates_count} funktionelle OS-opdatering(er) klar via apt",
4376:             severity    = "low",
4377:             scope       = "device",
4378:             scope_id    = device_id,
4379:             status      = "pending",
4380:         ))
4381:         created.append("os_updates")
4382: 
4383:     if app_security and not _has_pending("app_security"):
4384:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
4385:             update_type = "app_security",
4386:             version     = app_version or "ukendt",
4387:             description = "TimeLapse Pro sikkerhedsopdatering tilgængelig",
4388:             severity    = "critical",
4389:             scope       = "device",
4390:             scope_id    = device_id,
4391:             status      = "pending",
4392:         ))
4393:         created.append("app_security")
4394: 
4395:     if app_behind_commits > 0 and not _has_pending("app_updates"):
4396:         db.add(PendingUpdate(
4397:             update_type = "app_updates",
4398:             version     = app_version or "ukendt",
4399:             description = f"TimeLapse Pro er {app_behind_commits} commit(s) bagud",
4400:             severity    = "medium",
4401:             scope       = "device",
4402:             scope_id    = device_id,
4403:             status      = "pending",
4404:         ))
4405:         created.append("app_updates")
4406: 
4407:     db.commit()
4408:     log.info("Update rapport fra %s: %s", device_id, created or "ingen nye")
4409:     return {"ok": True, "created": created}

4411: # ── PROVISION PACKAGE (Sprint C) ─────────────────────────────────────
4412: # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
4413: 
4414: from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
4415: import io as _io
4416: import zipfile as _zipfile
4417: 
4418: def _generate_ed25519_keypair() -> tuple[str, str]:
4419:     """Generer Ed25519 nøglepar — returnerer (privat_pem, offentlig_openssh)."""
4420:     try:
4421:         from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey
4422:         from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.serialization import (
4423:             Encoding, PrivateFormat, PublicFormat, NoEncryption
4424:         )
4425:         private_key = Ed25519PrivateKey.generate()
4426:         private_pem = private_key.private_bytes(
4427:             encoding=Encoding.PEM,
4428:             format=PrivateFormat.OpenSSH,
4429:             encryption_algorithm=NoEncryption()
4430:         ).decode()
4431:         public_openssh = private_key.public_key().public_bytes(
4432:             encoding=Encoding.OpenSSH,
4433:             format=PublicFormat.OpenSSH
4434:         ).decode()
4435:         return private_pem, public_openssh
4436:     except ImportError:
4437:         # Fallback: brug subprocess + ssh-keygen
4438:         import subprocess, tempfile, os
4439:         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
4440:             key_path = os.path.join(tmp, "key")
4441:             subprocess.run(
4442:                 ["ssh-keygen", "-t", "ed25519", "-f", key_path, "-N", "", "-C", "timelapse-provision"],
4443:                 check=True, capture_output=True
4444:             )
4445:             priv = open(key_path).read()
4446:             pub  = open(key_path + ".pub").read().strip()
4447:         return priv, pub
4448: 
4449: 
4450: def _build_bootstrap_yaml(device_id_hint: str, headend_url: str, token: str,
4451:                            location_name: str) -> str:
4452:     return f"""# TimeLapse Pro — Bootstrap Configuration
4453: # Genereret: {now_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}
4454: # Kopiér til: /opt/timelapse/edge/bootstrap.yaml
4455: 
4456: device_id: {device_id_hint}
4457: headend_url: {headend_url}
4458: bootstrap_token: {token}
4459: location_name: {location_name}
4460: """
4461: 
4462: 
4463: def _build_install_md(site_name: str, camera_name: str, headend_url: str,
4464:                       tunnel_pub: str, sftp_pub: str, device_hint: str) -> str:
4465:     return f"""# TimeLapse Pro — Installationsguide
4466: ## {site_name} — {camera_name}
4467: Genereret: {now_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')}
4468: 
4469: ---
4470: 
4471: ## Forudsætninger
4472: 
4473: - Orange Pi 4 Pro med Ubuntu 22.04
4474: - TimeLapse Pro edge-kode deployed via GitHub Actions
4475: - Kamera tilsluttet via USB
4476: - Netværksforbindelse
4477: 
4478: ---
4479: 
4480: ## Trin 1 — Kopiér provisionerings-filer til Orange Pi
4481: 
4482: Fra Mac Mini (erstat `<orange-pi-ip>`):
4483: ```bash
4484: scp bootstrap.yaml pi@<orange-pi-ip>:/opt/timelapse/edge/
4485: scp tunnel_key pi@<orange-pi-ip>:/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/
4486: scp tunnel_key.pub pi@<orange-pi-ip>:/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/
4487: scp sftp_key pi@<orange-pi-ip>:/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/
4488: scp sftp_key.pub pi@<orange-pi-ip>:/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/
4489: ```
4490: 
4491: ---
4492: 
4493: ## Trin 2 — Sæt korrekte filrettigheder på Orange Pi
4494: 
4495: ```bash
4496: chmod 600 /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/tunnel_key
4497: chmod 644 /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/tunnel_key.pub
4498: chmod 600 /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/sftp_key
4499: chmod 644 /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/sftp_key.pub
4500: chmod 600 /opt/timelapse/edge/bootstrap.yaml
4501: chmod 644 /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/known_hosts
4502: ```
4503: 
4504: > **Bemærk:** `known_hosts` indeholder headendens SSH-fingerprint.
4505: > Orange Pi verificerer automatisk at den forbinder til den rigtige server.
4506: 
4507: ---
4508: 
4509: ## Trin 3 — Tilføj tunnel-nøgle til headend
4510: 
4511: På Mac Mini headend:
4512: ```bash
4513: echo "{tunnel_pub} {device_hint}" >> /home/tunnel/.ssh/authorized_keys
4514: ```
4515: 
4516: ---
4517: 
4518: ## Trin 4 — Tilføj SFTP-nøgle til headend
4519: 
4520: På Mac Mini headend (erstat `sftp_<site-kode>` med den rigtige bruger):
4521: ```bash
4522: echo "{sftp_pub} {site_name}" >> /Users/Shared/timelapse/sftp_keys/authorized_keys_<site-kode>
4523: ```
4524: 
4525: ---
4526: 
4527: ## Trin 5 — Start timelapse-edge service
4528: 
4529: ```bash
4530: sudo systemctl restart timelapse-edge
4531: sudo systemctl status timelapse-edge
4532: ```
4533: 
4534: Forventet output:
4535: ```
4536: ● timelapse-edge.service — TimeLapse Pro Edge Agent
4537:    Active: active (running)
4538:    ...
4539:    Config loaded — device_id=TL-... location={site_name} — {camera_name}
4540:    Bootstrapping device TL-... with headend…
4541:    Bootstrap OK
4542: ```
4543: 
4544: ---
4545: 
4546: ## Trin 6 — Verificer i UI
4547: 
4548: 1. Åbn TimeLapse Pro UI → Dashboard
4549: 2. Ny enhed vises som online
4550: 3. Tildel enheden til site: **{site_name}** → kamera: **{camera_name}**
4551: 4. Start LAB mode for at verificere kameraforbindelsen
4552: 
4553: ---
4554: 
4555: ## Fejlfinding
4556: 
4557: ```bash
4558: # Tjek logs
4559: journalctl -u timelapse-edge -f
4560: 
4561: # Tjek netværk
4562: curl {headend_url}/health
4563: 
4564: # Tjek SSH tunnel
4565: ssh -T -i /opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/tunnel_key tunnel@<headend-host>
4566: ```
4567: 
4568: ---
4569: 
4570: *TimeLapse Pro v3.0.0 — Headend: {headend_url}*
4571: """
4572: 
4573: 
4574:

4576: # ── Password politik ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

4578: def _get_password_policy(db: Session) -> dict:
4579:     """Hent password-politik fra settings."""
4580:     return {
4581:         "min_length":        int(_get_setting(db, "pw_min_length",        "8")),
4582:         "require_uppercase": _get_setting(db, "pw_require_uppercase", "false").lower() == "true",
4583:         "require_number":    _get_setting(db, "pw_require_number",    "false").lower() == "true",
4584:         "require_special":   _get_setting(db, "pw_require_special",   "false").lower() == "true",
4585:     }
4586: 
4587: 
4588: def _validate_password(pw: str, policy: dict) -> list[str]:
4589:     """Returnerer liste af fejl — tom liste = OK."""
4590:     errors = []
4591:     if len(pw) < policy["min_length"]:
4592:         errors.append(f"Mindst {policy['min_length']} tegn")
4593:     if policy["require_uppercase"] and not any(c.isupper() for c in pw):
4594:         errors.append("Mindst ét stort bogstav")
4595:     if policy["require_number"] and not any(c.isdigit() for c in pw):
4596:         errors.append("Mindst ét tal")
4597:     if policy["require_special"] and not any(c in "!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?" for c in pw):
4598:         errors.append("Mindst ét specialtegn")
4599:     return errors
4600:

4611: @app.put("/api/admin/password-policy")
4612: def update_password_policy(
4613:     payload: dict,
4614:     _user=require_role("super_admin"),
4615:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
4616: ):
4617:     """Opdater password-politik i settings."""
4618:     mapping = {
4619:         "min_length":        ("pw_min_length",        str),
4620:         "require_uppercase": ("pw_require_uppercase", lambda v: "true" if v else "false"),
4621:         "require_number":    ("pw_require_number",    lambda v: "true" if v else "false"),
4622:         "require_special":   ("pw_require_special",   lambda v: "true" if v else "false"),
4623:     }
4624:     for key, (setting_key, converter) in mapping.items():
4625:         if key in payload:
4626:             val = converter(payload[key])
4627:             existing = db.query(Settings).filter_by(key=setting_key).first()
4628:             if existing:
4629:                 existing.value = val
4630:             else:
4631:                 db.add(Settings(key=setting_key, value=val))
4632:     db.commit()
4633:     return _get_password_policy(db)

4713: # ── Provision Package ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
4714: 
4715: @app.post("/api/admin/provision-package")
4716: def create_provision_package(
4717:     payload: dict,
4718:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
4719:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
4720: ):
4721:     """
4722:     Generer komplet provisionerings-ZIP til ny Orange Pi edge-enhed.
4723: 
4724:     ZIP indeholder:
4725:       bootstrap.yaml       — device_id (foreløbig), headend_url, bootstrap_token
4726:       tunnel_key           — Ed25519 privat nøgle til reverse SSH tunnel
4727:       tunnel_key.pub       — Tilhørende public key (kopiér til headend authorized_keys)
4728:       sftp_key             — Ed25519 privat nøgle til SFTP upload
4729:       sftp_key.pub         — Tilhørende public key
4730:       INSTALL.md           — Trin-for-trin installationsguide
4731:     """
4732:     site_id     = payload.get("site_id")
4733:     camera_name = payload.get("camera_name", "Kamera 1")
4734:     device_id   = payload.get("device_id")  # valgfrit — hvis None genereres foreløbig ID
4735: 
4736:     if not site_id:
4737:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="site_id er påkrævet")
4738: 
4739:     # Hent site og kunde-info
4740:     site     = db.query(Site).filter_by(id=site_id).first()
4741:     if not site:
4742:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Site ikke fundet")
4743:     customer = db.query(Customer).filter_by(id=site.customer_id).first()
4744: 
4745:     site_name     = site.name
4746:     customer_name = customer.name if customer else "Ukendt kunde"
4747:     location_name = f"{customer_name} — {site_name} — {camera_name}"
4748: 
4749:     # Generer foreløbigt device_id hvis ikke angivet
4750:     device_id_hint = device_id or f"TL-PROV-{_uuid.uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}"
4751: 
4752:     # Headend URL fra settings
4753:     headend_url = _get_setting(db, "base_url", os.getenv("BASE_URL", "http://timelapse.froekjaer.dk:8000"))
4754: 
4755:     # Generer bootstrap token
4756:     import secrets
4757:     from datetime import timedelta
4758:     token_str = f"test-{secrets.token_hex(24)}"
4759:     token_rec = BootstrapToken(
4760:         token        = token_str,
4761:         device_label = location_name,
4762:         site_id      = site_id,
4763:         customer_id  = site.customer_id,
4764:         camera_name  = camera_name,
4765:         created_by   = current_user.username,
4766:         expires_at   = now_utc() + timedelta(hours=48),
4767:     )
4768:     db.add(token_rec)
4769:     db.commit()
4770: 
4771:     # Generer SSH-nøglepar
4772:     tunnel_priv, tunnel_pub = _generate_ed25519_keypair()
4773:     sftp_priv,   sftp_pub   = _generate_ed25519_keypair()
4774: 
4775:     # Tilføj kommentar til public keys
4776:     tunnel_pub = f"{tunnel_pub.strip()} {device_id_hint}"
4777:     sftp_pub   = f"{sftp_pub.strip()} sftp@{site_name.replace(' ', '_')}"
4778: 
4779:     # Byg filindhold
4780:     bootstrap_yaml = _build_bootstrap_yaml(device_id_hint, headend_url, token_str, location_name)
4781:     install_md     = _build_install_md(site_name, camera_name, headend_url, tunnel_pub, sftp_pub, device_id_hint)
4782: 
4783:     # Generer known_hosts med headendens SSH fingerprint
4784:     known_hosts_content = ""
4785:     try:
4786:         import subprocess as _sp
4787:         headend_host = headend_url.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "").split(":")[0]
4788:         result = _sp.run(
4789:             ["ssh-keyscan", "-H", headend_host],
4790:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
4791:         )
4792:         if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.strip():
4793:             known_hosts_content = result.stdout
4794:             log.info("known_hosts genereret for %s (%d linjer)",
4795:                      headend_host, len(result.stdout.splitlines()))
4796:         else:
4797:             log.warning("ssh-keyscan fejlede for %s — known_hosts udelades", headend_host)
4798:     except Exception as exc:
4799:         log.warning("known_hosts generering fejlede: %s", exc)
4800: 
4801:     # Byg ZIP i hukommelsen
4802:     zip_buffer = _io.BytesIO()
4803:     safe_site  = site_name.replace(" ", "_").replace("/", "-")[:20]
4804: 
4805:     with _zipfile.ZipFile(zip_buffer, "w", _zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
4806:         zf.writestr("bootstrap.yaml",   bootstrap_yaml)
4807:         zf.writestr("tunnel_key",       tunnel_priv)
4808:         zf.writestr("tunnel_key.pub",   tunnel_pub + "\n")
4809:         zf.writestr("sftp_key",         sftp_priv)
4810:         zf.writestr("sftp_key.pub",     sftp_pub + "\n")
4811:         if known_hosts_content:
4812:             zf.writestr("known_hosts", known_hosts_content)
4813:         zf.writestr("INSTALL.md",       install_md)
4814: 
4815:     zip_buffer.seek(0)
4816: 
4817:     # Log audit-event
4818:     db.add(Event(
4819:         device_id = device_id_hint,
4820:         level     = "INFO",
4821:         category  = "provision",
4822:         message   = f"Provisionerings-pakke genereret til {location_name}",
4823:         extra     = _json.dumps({
4824:             "site_id":    site_id,
4825:             "created_by": current_user.username,
4826:             "token":      token_str[:16] + "…",
4827:         }),
4828:     ))
4829:     db.commit()
4830:     log.info("Provisionerings-pakke genereret: %s af %s", location_name, current_user.username)
4831: 
4832:     filename = f"timelapse_provision_{safe_site}_{now_utc().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.zip"
4833:     return StreamingResponse(
4834:         _io.BytesIO(zip_buffer.read()),
4835:         media_type="application/zip",
4836:         headers={"Content-Disposition": f"attachment; filename={filename}"}
4837:     )
4838:

5022: 
5023: #Peter import subprocess as _subprocess
5024: #Peter import threading as _threading
5025: import uuid as _render_uuid
5026: from pathlib import Path as _RPath
5027: 
5028: RENDER_JOBS: dict = {}          # job_id → {status, progress, error, output_path}

5033: @app.get("/api/timelapse/frames")
5034: def get_timelapse_frames(
5035:     request: Request,
5036:     device_id: str,
5037:     start: str,
5038:     end: str,
5039:     min_blur: float = 0,
5040:     quality_only: bool = False,
5041:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
5042: ):
5043:     """Returner billeder i tidsinterval til timelapse preview."""
5044:     from datetime import datetime as _dt
5045:     try:
5046:         start_dt = _dt.fromisoformat(start.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
5047:         end_dt   = _dt.fromisoformat(end.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
5048:     except Exception:
5049:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ugyldigt datoformat")
5050: 
5051:     q = db.query(Capture).filter(
5052:         Capture.device_id == device_id,
5053:         Capture.captured_at >= start_dt,
5054:         Capture.captured_at <= end_dt,
5055:         Capture.captured_at.isnot(None),
5056:     ).order_by(Capture.captured_at.asc())
5057: 
5058:     if quality_only:
5059:         q = q.filter(Capture.quality_passed == True)
5060:     if min_blur > 0:
5061:         q = q.filter(Capture.blur_score >= min_blur)
5062:     # Lysstyrke filter
5063:     min_brightness = float(request.query_params.get("min_brightness", 0))
5064:     max_brightness = float(request.query_params.get("max_brightness", 255))
5065:     if min_brightness > 0:
5066:         q = q.filter(Capture.brightness_mean >= min_brightness)
5067:     if max_brightness < 255:
5068:         q = q.filter(Capture.brightness_mean <= max_brightness)
5069:     # Dag/nat filter via capture tidspunkt og GPS koordinater
5070:     day_night = request.query_params.get("day_night", "all")
5071:     if day_night in ("day", "night"):
5072:         try:
5073: #Peter            from datetime import timezone as _tz
5074:             import math as _math
5075:             lat = float(request.query_params.get("gps_lat", 0))
5076:             lon = float(request.query_params.get("gps_lon", 0))
5077:             if lat == 0 and lon == 0:
5078:                 lat, lon = 55.7, 12.6  # Default DK
5079:             def _is_daytime(dt):
5080:                 if not dt: return True
5081:                 if dt.tzinfo is None:
5082:                     dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=_tz.utc)
5083:                 doy = dt.timetuple().tm_yday
5084:                 hour = dt.hour + dt.minute/60 + dt.second/3600 + lon/15
5085:                 decl = 23.45 * _math.sin(_math.radians(360/365 * (doy - 81)))
5086:                 ha = (hour - 12) * 15
5087:                 elev = _math.degrees(_math.asin(
5088:                     _math.sin(_math.radians(lat))*_math.sin(_math.radians(decl)) +
5089:                     _math.cos(_math.radians(lat))*_math.cos(_math.radians(decl))*_math.cos(_math.radians(ha))
5090:                 ))
5091:                 return elev > -0.833
5092:             frames_all = q.all()
5093:             if day_night == "day":
5094:                 frames_all = [f for f in frames_all if _is_daytime(f.captured_at)]
5095:             else:
5096:                 frames_all = [f for f in frames_all if not _is_daytime(f.captured_at)]
5097:             frames = frames_all
5098:         except Exception as exc:
5099:             import traceback
5100:             log.warning("Dag/nat filter fejl: %s\n%s", exc, traceback.format_exc())
5101:     else:
5102:         frames = q.all()
5103:         frames = q.all()
5104:     return [
5105:         {
5106:             "id":            c.id,
5107:             "filename":      c.filename,
5108:             "device_id":     c.device_id,
5109:             "captured_at":   c.captured_at.isoformat() if c.captured_at else None,
5110:             "blur_score":    round(c.blur_score, 1) if c.blur_score else None,
5111:             "quality_passed":c.quality_passed,
5112:             "quality_flag":  c.quality_flag,
5113:             "filesize_mb":   round(c.filesize / 1e6, 1) if c.filesize else None,
5114:             "brightness":    round(c.brightness_mean, 1) if c.brightness_mean else None,
5115:         }
5116:         for c in frames
5117:     ]
5118:

5120: @app.post("/api/timelapse/create")
5121: def create_timelapse(payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
5122:     """Start timelapse video rendering job.
5123: 
5124:     payload: {
5125:         device_id: str,
5126:         frame_ids: [int],           # Valgte billeder (sorteret)
5127:         fps: int,                   # 12|24|25|30|60
5128:         resolution: str,            # "1080p"|"4k"|"original"
5129:         codec: str,                 # "h264"|"h265"
5130:         deflicker: bool,
5131:         fade_frames: int,           # 0 = ingen fade
5132:         timestamp_overlay: bool,
5133:         timestamp_position: str,    # "tl"|"tr"|"bl"|"br"
5134:         ken_burns: str,             # "none"|"zoom_in"|"zoom_out"
5135:         crop_ratio: str,            # "16:9"|"4:3"|"1:1"|"original"
5136:         title: str,                 # Til filnavn
5137:     }
5138:     """
5139:     device_id  = payload.get("device_id")
5140:     frame_ids  = payload.get("frame_ids", [])
5141:     fps        = int(payload.get("fps", 25))
5142:     resolution = payload.get("resolution", "1080p")
5143:     codec      = payload.get("codec", "h264")
5144:     deflicker  = bool(payload.get("deflicker", False))
5145:     fade_frames= int(payload.get("fade_frames", 0))
5146:     ts_overlay = bool(payload.get("timestamp_overlay", False))
5147:     ts_pos     = payload.get("timestamp_position", "br")
5148:     ken_burns  = payload.get("ken_burns", "none")
5149:     crop_ratio = payload.get("crop_ratio", "16:9")
5150:     title      = payload.get("title", "timelapse")
5151: 
5152:     if not frame_ids:
5153:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ingen billeder valgt")
5154: 
5155:     # Hent billeder fra DB
5156:     frames = db.query(Capture).filter(
5157:         Capture.id.in_(frame_ids)
5158:     ).order_by(Capture.captured_at.asc()).all()
5159: 
5160:     if not frames:
5161:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ingen billeder fundet")
5162: 
5163:     # Find billedstier
5164:     image_paths = []
5165:     for f in frames:
5166:         path = _find_image(f.device_id, f.filename)
5167:         if path:
5168:             image_paths.append((str(path), f.captured_at))
5169: 
5170:     if len(image_paths) < 2:
5171:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="For få billeder fundet på disk")
5172: 
5173:     job_id = str(_render_uuid.uuid4())[:8]
5174:     RENDER_JOBS[job_id] = {
5175:         "status":   "queued",
5176:         "progress": 0,
5177:         "error":    None,
5178:         "output_path": None,
5179:         "frame_count": len(image_paths),
5180:         "fps": fps,
5181:         "duration_s": round(len(image_paths) / fps, 1),
5182:         "title": title,
5183:     }
5184: 
5185:     # Start render i baggrunden
5186:     t = _threading.Thread(
5187:         target=_render_timelapse,
5188:         args=(job_id, image_paths, fps, resolution, codec,
5189:               deflicker, fade_frames, ts_overlay, ts_pos,
5190:               ken_burns, crop_ratio, title),
5191:         daemon=True
5192:     )
5193:     t.start()
5194:     log.info("Timelapse job %s startet: %d frames @ %d fps", job_id, len(image_paths), fps)
5195:     return {"job_id": job_id, "frame_count": len(image_paths), "duration_s": round(len(image_paths)/fps, 1)}
5196: 
5197: 
5198: def _render_timelapse(job_id, image_paths, fps, resolution, codec,
5199:                       deflicker, fade_frames, ts_overlay, ts_pos,
5200:                       ken_burns, crop_ratio, title):
5201:     """Kør FFmpeg rendering i baggrundstråd."""
5202: #Peter    import os, tempfile
5203: 
5204:     RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["status"] = "rendering"
5205:     output_file = RENDER_OUTPUT_DIR / f"{job_id}_{title.replace(' ','_')}.mp4"
5206: 
5207:     try:
5208:         # Skriv billedliste til temp fil (FFmpeg concat demuxer)
5209:         list_file = RENDER_OUTPUT_DIR / f"{job_id}_list.txt"
5210:         with open(list_file, "w") as lf:
5211:             for path, captured_at in image_paths:
5212:                 lf.write(f"file '{path}'\n")
5213:                 lf.write(f"duration {1/fps:.6f}\n")
5214:             # Gentag sidste billede (FFmpeg krav)
5215:             lf.write(f"file '{image_paths[-1][0]}'\n")
5216: 
5217:         # Byg FFmpeg video filter kæde
5218:         vf_parts = []
5219: 
5220:         # Beskæring — safe crop
5221:         if crop_ratio == "16:9":
5222:             vf_parts.append("crop='min(iw,ih*16/9)':'min(ih,iw*9/16)'")
5223:         elif crop_ratio == "4:3":
5224:             vf_parts.append("crop='min(iw,ih*4/3)':'min(ih,iw*3/4)'")
5225:         elif crop_ratio == "1:1":
5226:             vf_parts.append("crop='min(iw,ih)':'min(iw,ih)'")
5227: 
5228:         # Opløsning
5229:         if resolution == "1080p":
5230:             vf_parts.append("scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2")
5231:         elif resolution == "4k":
5232:             vf_parts.append("scale=3840:2160:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=3840:2160:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2")
5233: 
5234:         # Deflicker
5235:         if deflicker:
5236:             vf_parts.append("deflicker=size=10:mode=pm")
5237: 
5238:         # Ken Burns
5239:         if ken_burns == "zoom_in":
5240:             vf_parts.append("zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0015,1.3)':d=1:x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)'")
5241:         elif ken_burns == "zoom_out":
5242:             vf_parts.append("zoompan=z='if(lte(zoom,1.0),1.3,max(1.001,zoom-0.0015))':d=1:x='iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)':y='ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)'")
5243: 
5244:         # Fade in/ud
5245:         n = len(image_paths)
5246:         if fade_frames > 0:
5247:             vf_parts.append(f"fade=t=in:st=0:d={fade_frames/fps:.2f}")
5248:             vf_parts.append(f"fade=t=out:st={(n-fade_frames)/fps:.2f}:d={fade_frames/fps:.2f}")
5249: 
5250:         # Tidsstempel overlay
5251:         if ts_overlay:
5252:             positions = {
5253:                 "tl": "x=20:y=20",
5254:                 "tr": "x=w-tw-20:y=20",
5255:                 "bl": "x=20:y=h-th-20",
5256:                 "br": "x=w-tw-20:y=h-th-20",
5257:             }
5258:             pos = positions.get(ts_pos, positions["br"])
5259:             vf_parts.append(
5260:                 f"drawtext=fontsize=36:fontcolor=white:borderw=2:bordercolor=black:"
5261:                 f"text='%{{pts\\:hms}}':box=1:boxcolor=black@0.4:boxborderw=5:{pos}"
5262:             )
5263: 
5264:         vf = ",".join(vf_parts) if vf_parts else "null"
5265: 
5266:         # Codec indstillinger
5267:         codec_args = ["-c:v", "h264_videotoolbox", "-q:v", "50"]
5268:         if codec == "h265":
5269:             codec_args = ["-c:v", "hevc_videotoolbox", "-q:v", "50"]
5270: 
5271:         # FFmpeg kommando
5272:         cmd = [
5273:             os.getenv("FFMPEG_PATH", "ffmpeg"), "-y",
5274:             "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0",
5275:             "-i", str(list_file),
5276:             "-vf", vf,
5277:             "-r", str(fps),
5278:             *codec_args,
5279:             "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
5280:             "-movflags", "+faststart",
5281:             str(output_file)
5282:         ]
5283: 
5284:         log.info("FFmpeg: %s", " ".join(cmd))
5285: 
5286:         proc = _subprocess.Popen(
5287:             cmd,
5288:             stdout=_subprocess.PIPE,
5289:             stderr=_subprocess.PIPE,
5290:             text=True
5291:         )
5292: 
5293:         # Læs stderr for progress
5294:         total = len(image_paths)
5295:         for line in proc.stderr:
5296:             if "frame=" in line:
5297:                 try:
5298:                     frame_str = line.split("frame=")[1].split()[0]
5299:                     frame_num = int(frame_str)
5300:                     RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["progress"] = min(95, int(100 * frame_num / total))
5301:                 except Exception:
5302:                     pass
5303: 
5304:         proc.wait()
5305: 
5306:         if proc.returncode == 0 and output_file.exists():
5307:             RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["status"]      = "done"
5308:             RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["progress"]    = 100
5309:             RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["output_path"] = str(output_file)
5310:             RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["filesize_mb"] = round(output_file.stat().st_size / 1e6, 1)
5311:             log.info("Timelapse %s færdig: %s (%.1f MB)", job_id, output_file.name,
5312:                      RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["filesize_mb"])
5313:         else:
5314:             err = proc.stderr.read() if proc.stderr else "Ukendt fejl"
5315:             raise Exception(f"FFmpeg fejl: {err[:200]}")
5316: 
5317:     except Exception as exc:
5318:         log.error("Timelapse %s fejlede: %s", job_id, exc)
5319:         RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["status"] = "error"
5320:         RENDER_JOBS[job_id]["error"]  = str(exc)
5321:     finally:
5322:         # Ryd op
5323:         try: list_file.unlink()
5324:         except Exception: pass
5325: 
5326:

5375: def _init_sftp_base():
5376:     from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
5377:     db_gen = get_db()
5378:     db = next(db_gen)
5379:     try:
5380:         return _Path(_get_setting(db, "sftp_base", os.getenv("SFTP_BASE", "/Volumes/data")))

5384: SFTP_BASE = _init_sftp_base()

5388: def _find_image(device_id: str, filename: str) -> Optional[_Path]:
5389:     log.info("_find_image: device=%s filename=%r base=%s", device_id, filename, SFTP_BASE)
5390:     try:
5391:         top = list(SFTP_BASE.iterdir())
5392:         log.info("SFTP_BASE contents: %s", [x.name for x in top])
5393:     except Exception as e:
5394:         log.error("SFTP_BASE iterdir fejl: %s", e)
5395:     """
5396:     Find image — håndterer flere strukturer:
5397:       1. Canonical data root: SFTP_BASE/{customer}/{site}/{camera}/YYYY/MM/DD/filename
5398:       2. Legacy chroot:      SFTP_BASE/timelapse-incoming/{sftp_user}/data/{customer}/{site}/{camera}/YYYY/MM/DD/filename
5399:       3. Legacy site:        SFTP_BASE/{customer}/{site}/YYYY/MM/DD/filename
5400:       4. Flad/device:        SFTP_BASE/{device_id}/filename eller SFTP_BASE/{device_id}/YYYY/MM/DD/filename
5401:     """
5402:     m = _re.search(r"_(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})_\d{6}\.\w+$", filename)
5403:     if m:
5404:         yyyy, mm, dd = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
5405: 
5406:         # Struktur 1 — canonical: customer/site/camera/YYYY/MM/DD/
5407:         canonical_glob = f"*/*/*/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{filename}"
5408:         log.info("canonical_glob=%r", canonical_glob)
5409:         matches = list(SFTP_BASE.glob(canonical_glob))
5410:         log.info("canonical matches=%s", matches)
5411:         if matches:
5412:             return matches[0]
5413: 
5414:         # Struktur 2 — legacy chroot under timelapse-incoming/sftp_user/data/
5415:         legacy_chroot_glob = f"timelapse-incoming/*/data/*/*/*/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{filename}"
5416:         matches = list(SFTP_BASE.glob(legacy_chroot_glob))
5417:         if matches:
5418:             return matches[0]
5419: 
5420:         legacy_site_chroot_glob = f"timelapse-incoming/*/data/*/*/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{filename}"
5421:         matches = list(SFTP_BASE.glob(legacy_site_chroot_glob))
5422:         if matches:
5423:             return matches[0]
5424: 
5425:         # Struktur 3 — gammel hierarkisk: customer/site/YYYY/MM/DD/
5426:         old_glob = f"*/*/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/{filename}"
5427:         matches = list(SFTP_BASE.glob(old_glob))
5428:         if matches:
5429:             return matches[0]
5430: 
5431:         # Struktur 4 — device_id/YYYY/MM/DD/
5432:         p = SFTP_BASE / device_id / yyyy / mm / dd / filename
5433:         if p.exists():
5434:             return p
5435: 
5436:         # Struktur 5 — rekursiv fallback (langsommere men sikker)
5437:         matches = list(SFTP_BASE.rglob(filename))
5438:         if matches:
5439:             return matches[0]
5440: 
5441:     # Flad struktur SFTP_BASE/device_id/filename
5442:     flat = SFTP_BASE / device_id / filename
5443:     if flat.exists():
5444:         return flat
5445: 
5446:     return None
5447: 
5448: def _thumbs_dir_for(image_path: _Path) -> _Path:
5449:     """Return .thumbs directory next to the image."""
5450:     return image_path.parent / ".thumbs"
5451: 
5452: 
5453: def _generated_thumbs_dir_for(image_path: _Path) -> _Path:
5454:     """Return headend-owned fallback thumbnail directory."""
5455:     return image_path.parent / ".headend-thumbs"
5456: 
5457: 
5458: def _is_valid_jpeg(path: _Path) -> bool:
5459:     try:
5460:         if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size < 256:
5461:             return False
5462:         with Image.open(path) as existing:
5463:             existing.verify()
5464:         return True
5465:     except Exception:
5466:         return False
5467: 
5468: 
5469: def _thumbnail_candidates_for(image_path: _Path) -> list[_Path]:
5470:     stem = image_path.stem
5471:     suffix = image_path.suffix or ".jpg"
5472:     return [
5473:         image_path.parent / ".thumbs" / image_path.name,
5474:         image_path.parent / "thumbs" / image_path.name,
5475:         image_path.parent / "thumbnails" / image_path.name,
5476:         image_path.parent / f"thumb_{image_path.name}",
5477:         image_path.parent / f"thumbnail_{image_path.name}",
5478:         image_path.parent / f"{stem}_thumb{suffix}",
5479:         image_path.parent / f"{stem}.thumb{suffix}",
5480:     ]
5481: 
5482: 
5483: def _find_existing_thumbnail(image_path: _Path) -> _Path | None:
5484:     for candidate in _thumbnail_candidates_for(image_path):
5485:         if _is_valid_jpeg(candidate):
5486:             return candidate
5487:     return None
5488: 
5489: 
5490: def _unlink_thumbnail_variants(image_path: _Path, filename: str) -> bool:
5491:     deleted = False
5492:     for directory in (_thumbs_dir_for(image_path), _generated_thumbs_dir_for(image_path)):
5493:         try:
5494:             thumb = directory / filename
5495:             if thumb.exists():
5496:                 thumb.unlink(missing_ok=True)
5497:                 deleted = True
5498:         except Exception as exc:
5499:             log.warning("Kunne ikke slette thumbnail i %s: %s", directory, exc)
5500:     return deleted
5501: 
5502: 
5503: @app.get("/api/images/{device_id}/{filename}")
5504: def get_image(
5505:     device_id: str,
5506:     filename: str,
5507:     _user=require_role("viewer"),
5508:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
5509: ):
5510:     from urllib.parse import unquote as _unquote
5511:     _sanitize_device_id(device_id)
5512:     filename = _unquote(filename)
5513:     _ensure_capture_file_access(db, _user, device_id, filename)
5514:     path = _find_image(device_id, filename)
5515:     if not path:
5516:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Image not found")
5517:     return FileResponse(str(path), media_type="image/jpeg")

5519: @app.get("/api/thumbnails/{device_id}/{filename}")
5520: def get_thumbnail(
5521:     device_id: str,
5522:     filename: str,
5523:     _user=require_role("viewer"),
5524:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
5525: ):
5526:     from urllib.parse import unquote as _unquote
5527:     import uuid as _uuid
5528:     _sanitize_device_id(device_id)
5529:     filename = _unquote(filename)
5530:     _ensure_capture_file_access(db, _user, device_id, filename)
5531:     src = _find_image(device_id, filename)
5532:     if not src:
5533:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Image not found")
5534:     thumb = _find_existing_thumbnail(src)
5535:     if thumb:
5536:         return FileResponse(
5537:             str(thumb),
5538:             media_type="image/jpeg",
5539:             headers={"Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400"},
5540:         )
5541: 
5542:     thumbs_dir = _generated_thumbs_dir_for(src)
5543:     thumbs_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
5544:     thumb = thumbs_dir / filename
5545:     if not thumb.exists():
5546:         tmp_thumb = thumbs_dir / f".{filename}.{_uuid.uuid4().hex}.tmp"
5547:         try:
5548:             with Image.open(src) as original:
5549:                 img = original.convert("RGB")
5550:                 # Landscape 16:9 thumbnail (320x180)
5551:                 img.thumbnail((320, 180), Image.LANCZOS)
5552:                 canvas = Image.new("RGB", (320, 180), (15, 15, 15))
5553:                 offset = ((320 - img.width) // 2, (180 - img.height) // 2)
5554:                 canvas.paste(img, offset)
5555:                 canvas.save(str(tmp_thumb), "JPEG", quality=78)
5556:             tmp_thumb.replace(thumb)
5557:         except Exception as e:
5558:             tmp_thumb.unlink(missing_ok=True)
5559:             raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
5560:     if not _is_valid_jpeg(thumb):
5561:         thumb.unlink(missing_ok=True)
5562:         raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Thumbnail generation incomplete, retry")
5563:     return FileResponse(
5564:         str(thumb),
5565:         media_type="image/jpeg",
5566:         headers={"Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400"},
5567:     )

5685: def _run_backup():
5686:     """Kør backup i baggrunden."""
5687:     global _backup_status
5688:     _backup_status = {"running": True, "progress": [], "file": None, "error": None}
5689:     try:
5690:         import datetime, os, json
5691:         date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
5692:         nas_path = _get_nas_path()
5693:         base_dir = nas_path if (nas_path and os.path.isdir(nas_path)) else "/tmp"
5694:         backup_dir = f"{base_dir}/timelapse-backup-headend-{date}"
5695:         os.makedirs(f"{backup_dir}/database", exist_ok=True)
5696:         os.makedirs(f"{backup_dir}/configs", exist_ok=True)
5697: 
5698:         _backup_status["progress"].append("Database backup (pg_dump)...")
5699:         from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse
5700:         db_url = os.environ.get(
5701:             "BACKUP_DATABASE_URL",
5702:             os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "postgresql://timelapse@localhost/timelapse_db"),
5703:         )
5704:         parsed_db = urlparse(db_url)
5705:         db_name = (parsed_db.path or "/timelapse_db").lstrip("/") or "timelapse_db"
5706:         db_user = unquote(parsed_db.username or "timelapse")
5707:         db_host = parsed_db.hostname or "localhost"
5708:         db_port = str(parsed_db.port) if parsed_db.port else None
5709:         sql_path = f"{backup_dir}/database/timelapse_db_{date}.sql"
5710:         pg_dump_cmd = ["/opt/homebrew/bin/pg_dump", "-U", db_user, "-h", db_host, "--no-password", db_name]
5711:         if db_port:
5712:             pg_dump_cmd[5:5] = ["-p", db_port]
5713:         r = _subprocess.run(
5714:             pg_dump_cmd,
5715:             capture_output=True, text=True
5716:         )
5717:         if r.returncode == 0:
5718:             with open(sql_path, "w") as f:
5719:                 f.write(r.stdout)
5720:             _backup_status["progress"].append(f"Database OK ({len(r.stdout)//1024} KB SQL)")
5721:         else:
5722:             raise Exception(f"pg_dump fejlede: {r.stderr[:300]}")
5723:         _backup_status["progress"].append("Config backup...")
5724:         for f in ["timelapse-headend.service", "timelapse-deploy.service", "timelapse-deploy.timer"]:
5725:             src = f"/etc/systemd/system/{f}"
5726:             if os.path.exists(src):
5727:                 _shutil.copy2(src, f"{backup_dir}/configs/{f}")
5728:         for f in ["timelapse-deploy", "timelapse-headend"]:
5729:             src = f"/etc/sudoers.d/{f}"
5730:             if os.path.exists(src):
5731:                 _shutil.copy2(src, f"{backup_dir}/configs/sudoers-{f}")
5732:         poller = "/home/peter/timelapse-pro/deploy/headend_poller.sh"
5733:         if os.path.exists(poller):
5734:             _shutil.copy2(poller, f"{backup_dir}/configs/headend_poller.sh")
5735:         _backup_status["progress"].append("Config OK")
5736: 
5737:         _backup_status["progress"].append("System info...")
5738:         import platform
5739:         with open(f"{backup_dir}/SYSTEMINFO.txt", "w") as f:
5740:             f.write(f"TimeLapse Pro — Headend Backup\nDato: {date}\n")
5741:             f.write(f"OS: {platform.platform()}\n")
5742:         _backup_status["progress"].append("System info OK")
5743: 
5744:         _backup_status["progress"].append("Pakker backup...")
5745:         archive = f"{base_dir}/timelapse-backup-headend-{date}.tar.gz"
5746:         _subprocess.run(["tar", "czf", archive, "-C", base_dir, f"timelapse-backup-headend-{date}"],
5747:                        check=True, capture_output=True)
5748:         _shutil.rmtree(backup_dir, ignore_errors=True)
5749: 
5750:         _backup_status["file"] = archive
5751:         _backup_status["running"] = False
5752:         _backup_status["progress"].append(f"✅ Backup komplet: {os.path.getsize(archive)//1024} KB")
5753:         log.info("Backup komplet: %s", archive)
5754:     except Exception as e:
5755:         _backup_status["error"] = str(e)
5756:         _backup_status["running"] = False
5757:         _backup_status["progress"].append(f"❌ Fejl: {e}")
5758:         log.error("Backup fejl: %s", e)

5778: def _deep_merge(base: dict, override: dict) -> dict:
5779:     """Rekursiv merge — override vinder ved konflikt."""
5780:     result = dict(base)
5781:     for k, v in override.items():
5782:         if k in result and isinstance(result[k], dict) and isinstance(v, dict):
5783:             result[k] = _deep_merge(result[k], v)
5784:         else:
5785:             result[k] = v
5786:     return result

6093: @app.post("/api/node/{device_id}/bootstrap-camera")
6094: def bootstrap_camera(device_id: str, payload: dict, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
6095:     """Auto-bootstrap et sibling kamera på samme node.
6096:     
6097:     Opretter et nyt device med ID: {device_id}-{camera_index}
6098:     Kopierer site_id, customer_name, site_name fra primary device.
6099:     """
6100:     primary = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
6101:     if not primary:
6102:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Primary device not found")
6103: 
6104:     camera_index    = payload.get("camera_index", 1)
6105:     relay_gpio      = payload.get("relay_gpio_camera", 357)
6106:     camera_name     = payload.get("camera_name", f"Kamera {camera_index + 1}")
6107:     sibling_id      = f"{device_id}-{camera_index}"
6108: 
6109:     # Opret eller opdater sibling device
6110:     sibling = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=sibling_id).first()
6111:     if not sibling:
6112:         sibling = Device(device_id=sibling_id)
6113:         db.add(sibling)
6114:         log.info("Auto-bootstrap nyt kamera: %s", sibling_id)
6115:     else:
6116:         log.info("Opdaterer sibling kamera: %s", sibling_id)
6117: 
6118:     # Kopier site/kunde info fra primary
6119:     sibling.customer_name  = primary.customer_name
6120:     sibling.site_name      = primary.site_name
6121:     sibling.camera_name    = camera_name
6122:     sibling.location_name  = primary.location_name
6123:     sibling.last_seen      = now_utc()
6124:     sibling.ip_address     = primary.ip_address
6125: 
6126:     if hasattr(sibling, "site_id"):
6127:         sibling.site_id = primary.site_id if hasattr(primary, "site_id") else None
6128:     if hasattr(sibling, "camera_index"):
6129:         sibling.camera_index = camera_index
6130:     if hasattr(sibling, "relay_gpio_camera"):
6131:         sibling.relay_gpio_camera = relay_gpio
6132: 
6133:     # Sæt config_overrides med relay GPIO og ISO
6134:     primary_overrides = json.loads(primary.config_overrides or "{}") if hasattr(primary, "config_overrides") else {}
6135:     cam_overrides = dict(primary_overrides.get("camera", {}))
6136:     cam_overrides["relay_gpio_pin"] = relay_gpio
6137: 
6138:     sibling.config_overrides = json.dumps({
6139:         **primary_overrides,
6140:         "camera": cam_overrides,
6141:     })
6142: 
6143:     db.commit()
6144:     log.info("Kamera bootstrapped: %s (GPIO %d)", sibling_id, relay_gpio)
6145:     return {"status": "ok", "device_id": sibling_id, "camera_index": camera_index}
6146: 
6147: 
6148: @app.get("/api/node/{device_id}/cameras")
6149: def list_node_cameras(device_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
6150:     """Returner alle kameraer på samme fysiske node (primary + siblings)."""
6151:     primary = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
6152:     if not primary:
6153:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
6154: 
6155:     # Find alle siblings: device_id starter med primary device_id + "-"
6156:     all_devices = db.query(Device).all()
6157:     node_devices = [d for d in all_devices
6158:                     if d.device_id == device_id or d.device_id.startswith(device_id + "-")]
6159:     node_devices.sort(key=lambda d: d.device_id)
6160: 
6161:     return [
6162:         {
6163:             "device_id":    d.device_id,
6164:             "camera_index": d.camera_index if hasattr(d, "camera_index") else 0,
6165:             "camera_name":  d.camera_name,
6166:             "relay_gpio":   d.relay_gpio_camera if hasattr(d, "relay_gpio_camera") else 356,
6167:             "status":       "online" if d.last_seen and (now_utc() - (d.last_seen.replace(tzinfo=__import__("datetime").timezone.utc) if d.last_seen.tzinfo is None else d.last_seen)).total_seconds() < 300 else "offline",
6168:         }
6169:         for d in node_devices
6170:     ]

6275: def _latest_headend_backup_file(nas_path: str | None) -> str | None:
6276:     """Find latest persisted Headend backup archive, even after service restart."""
6277:     candidates: list[Path] = []
6278:     for base in [nas_path, "/tmp"]:
6279:         if not base:
6280:             continue
6281:         try:
6282:             root = Path(base)
6283:             if root.is_dir():
6284:                 candidates.extend(root.glob("timelapse-backup-headend-*.tar.gz"))
6285:         except Exception as exc:
6286:             log.warning("Kunne ikke scanne backup-sti %s: %s", base, exc)
6287:     existing = [p for p in candidates if p.is_file()]
6288:     if not existing:
6289:         return None
6290:     return str(max(existing, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime))
6291:

6293: @app.get("/api/admin/resilience/assessment")
6294: def resilience_assessment(_user=require_role("admin"), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
6295:     """Backup, restore, provisioning and compliance readiness snapshot."""
6296:     devices = db.query(Device).order_by(Device.device_id).all()
6297:     inventory = db.query(DeviceInventory).order_by(DeviceInventory.device_id).all()
6298:     device_ids = {d.device_id for d in devices}
6299:     tickets = db.query(ChangeTicket).count()
6300:     artifacts = db.query(UpdateArtifact).count()
6301:     active_tokens = db.query(BootstrapToken).filter_by(revoked=False).count()
6302: 
6303:     settings = {}
6304:     try:
6305:         rows = db.execute(text(
6306:             "SELECT key, value FROM settings WHERE key IN "
6307:             "('backup_nas_path','backup_auto_interval','backup_include_images')"
6308:         )).fetchall()
6309:         settings = {r[0]: r[1] for r in rows}
6310:     except Exception:
6311:         settings = {}
6312: 
6313:     device_by_id = {d.device_id: d for d in devices}
6314:     restore_inventory = []
6315:     for inv in inventory:
6316:         device = device_by_id.get(inv.device_id)
6317:         device_status = (getattr(device, "status", "") or "").lower() if device else ""
6318:         is_test = inv.device_id.lower().startswith("test") or inv.device_id.lower() == "test-device"
6319:         is_import = device_status == "import" or inv.device_id.startswith("TL-IMPORT-")
6320:         if is_test or is_import:
6321:             continue
6322:         if device or inv.hostname or inv.hardware_model:
6323:             restore_inventory.append(inv)
6324: 
6325:     cmdb_state_rows = [
6326:         inv for inv in restore_inventory
6327:         if getattr(inv, "os_packages", None) and inv.venv_packages and getattr(inv, "software_inventory", None)
6328:     ]
6329:     firmware_rows = [inv for inv in restore_inventory if getattr(inv, "firmware_version", None)]
6330:     backup_complete = []
6331:     backup_requested = []
6332:     for device in devices:
6333:         try:
6334:             cfg = json.loads(device.device_config or "{}")
6335:         except Exception:
6336:             cfg = {}
6337:         if cfg.get("backup_complete"):
6338:             backup_complete.append(device.device_id)
6339:         if cfg.get("backup_requested"):
6340:             backup_requested.append(device.device_id)
6341: 
6342:     nas_path = settings.get("backup_nas_path")
6343:     latest_backup_file = _backup_status.get("file") or _latest_headend_backup_file(nas_path)
6344:     latest_backup_exists = bool(latest_backup_file and os.path.exists(latest_backup_file))
6345:     nas_ready = bool(nas_path and os.path.isdir(nas_path))
6346: 
6347:     controls = [
6348:         _resilience_control(
6349:             "pass" if latest_backup_exists else "warning",
6350:             "Headend database/config backup",
6351:             f"latest_file={os.path.basename(latest_backup_file) if latest_backup_file else 'none'}",
6352:             ["ISO27000", "NIS2", "SABSA"],
6353:             "Run and verify headend backup before approval." if not latest_backup_exists else "",
6354:         ),
6355:         _resilience_control(
6356:             "pass" if nas_ready else "warning",
6357:             "Off-host backup target",
6358:             f"backup_nas_path={nas_path or 'not configured'}",
6359:             ["ISO27000", "NIS2"],
6360:             "Configure NAS/off-host target and restore test evidence." if not nas_ready else "",
6361:         ),
6362:         _resilience_control(
6363:             "pass" if len(cmdb_state_rows) == len(restore_inventory) and restore_inventory else "fail",
6364:             "Installed-state CMDB evidence",
6365:             f"{len(cmdb_state_rows)}/{len(restore_inventory)} restore node(s) include OS packages, venv and software state",
6366:             ["IEC62443", "CRA", "SABSA"],
6367:             "All restore-relevant nodes must report hardware, firmware, OS packages, venv and software inventory." if len(cmdb_state_rows) < len(restore_inventory) else "",
6368:         ),
6369:         _resilience_control(
6370:             "pass" if len(firmware_rows) == len(restore_inventory) and restore_inventory else "warning",
6371:             "Firmware inventory",
6372:             f"{len(firmware_rows)}/{len(restore_inventory)} restore node(s) include firmware state",
6373:             ["IEC62443", "CRA"],
6374:             "Firmware/bootloader state is needed for bare-metal restore and vulnerability governance." if len(firmware_rows) < len(restore_inventory) else "",
6375:         ),
6376:         _resilience_control(
6377:             "pass" if artifacts else "fail",
6378:             "Signed update/artifact catalog",
6379:             f"{artifacts} update artifact(s) registered",
6380:             ["CRA", "IEC62443", "ISO27000"],
6381:             "Create signed update/ISO artifact catalog for Headend-driven decisions." if not artifacts else "",
6382:         ),
6383:         _resilience_control(
6384:             "pass" if tickets else "warning",
6385:             "Signed change workflow",
6386:             f"{tickets} change ticket(s) registered",
6387:             ["ISO27000", "NIS2", "SABSA"],
6388:             "Bind backup, restore, update and ISO decisions to signed change tickets." if not tickets else "",
6389:         ),
6390:         _resilience_control(
6391:             "warning",
6392:             "Bare-metal edge ISO pipeline",
6393:             "blueprint defined; image build/sign/verify pipeline not implemented",
6394:             ["CRA", "IEC62443", "NIS2"],
6395:             "Build ISO/image generator with hardening profile, call-home bootstrap and signed manifest.",
6396:         ),
6397:         _resilience_control(
6398:             "warning",
6399:             "Automated restore and rollback tests",
6400:             f"edge_backup_complete={len(backup_complete)}, edge_backup_requested={len(backup_requested)}",
6401:             ["NIS2", "ISO27000", "IEC62443"],
6402:             "Add periodic restore test and rollback test evidence.",
6403:         ),
6404:     ]
6405: 
6406:     counts = {"pass": 0, "warning": 0, "fail": 0}
6407:     for control in controls:
6408:         counts[control["status"]] = counts.get(control["status"], 0) + 1
6409: 
6410:     return {
6411:         "generated_at": now_utc().isoformat(),
6412:         "summary": {
6413:             "devices": len(devices),
6414:             "inventory_rows": len(inventory),
6415:             "restore_inventory_rows": len(restore_inventory),
6416:             "headend_backup_ready": latest_backup_exists,
6417:             "nas_ready": nas_ready,
6418:             "active_bootstrap_tokens": active_tokens,
6419:             "update_artifacts": artifacts,
6420:             "change_tickets": tickets,
6421:             "counts": counts,
6422:         },
6423:         "headend_dr": {
6424:             "latest_backup_file": latest_backup_file,
6425:             "latest_backup_exists": latest_backup_exists,
6426:             "nas_path": nas_path,
6427:             "auto_interval": settings.get("backup_auto_interval", "manual"),
6428:             "warm_standby_status": "not_configured",
6429:         },
6430:         "edge_restore": [
6431:             {
6432:                 "device_id": inv.device_id,
6433:                 "hardware_model": inv.hardware_model,
6434:                 "firmware_version": getattr(inv, "firmware_version", None),
6435:                 "os_name": inv.os_name,
6436:                 "kernel_version": inv.kernel_version,
6437:                 "app_version": inv.app_version,
6438:                 "package_manager": getattr(inv, "package_manager", None),
6439:                 "has_os_packages": bool(getattr(inv, "os_packages", None)),
6440:                 "has_venv_packages": bool(inv.venv_packages),
6441:                 "has_software_inventory": bool(getattr(inv, "software_inventory", None)),
6442:                 "inventory_reported_at": inv.inventory_reported_at.isoformat() if inv.inventory_reported_at else None,
6443:                 "device_exists": inv.device_id in device_ids,
6444:             }
6445:             for inv in restore_inventory
6446:         ],
6447:         "iso_blueprint": {
6448:             "status": "planned",
6449:             "call_home": "/api/bootstrap with short-lived bootstrap token",
6450:             "hardening": [
6451:                 "disable password SSH for production profile",
6452:                 "only required users, services and packages",
6453:                 "firewall deny inbound except explicit debug profile",
6454:                 "signed agent, config and artifact verification",
6455:                 "audit logging to SIEM after first contact",

6457:             "required_outputs": [

6461:                 "SBOM/package inventory",
6462:                 "hardening evidence",
6463:                 "restore/update test evidence",
6464:             ],

6485: @app.post("/api/admin/backup/edge-complete/{device_id}")
6486: def edge_backup_complete(device_id: str, payload: dict, _user=require_role("operator"), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
6487:     """Edge rapporterer at backup er komplet — flyt til backup mappe lokalt på Pi 5."""
6488:     import os as _os
6489:     import shutil as _sh
6490:     device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=device_id).first()
6491:     if not device:
6492:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
6493: 
6494:     filename = payload.get("filename", "")
6495: 
6496:     # Filen er landet i SFTP incoming — flyt den lokalt til backup mappe
6497:     SFTP_INCOMING = "/data/sftp/incoming"
6498:     local_sftp_path = _os.path.join(SFTP_INCOMING, "_backups", _sanitize_device_id(device_id), filename)
6499: 
6500:     nas = _get_nas_path()
6501:     backup_dest = nas if (nas and _os.path.isdir(nas)) else "/home/peter/backup"
6502:     _os.makedirs(backup_dest, exist_ok=True)
6503: 
6504:     final_path = local_sftp_path
6505:     if _os.path.exists(local_sftp_path):
6506:         try:
6507:             dest = _os.path.join(backup_dest, filename)
6508:             _sh.move(local_sftp_path, dest)
6509:             final_path = dest
6510:             log.info("Edge backup flyttet til: %s", dest)
6511:         except Exception as e:
6512:             log.warning("Kunne ikke flytte edge backup: %s", e)
6513:     else:
6514:         log.warning("Edge backup fil ikke fundet: %s", local_sftp_path)
6515: 
6516:     existing = json.loads(device.device_config or "{}")
6517:     existing["backup_requested"] = False
6518:     existing["backup_complete"] = {
6519:         "filename": filename,
6520:         "size_kb":  payload.get("size_kb"),
6521:         "path":     final_path,
6522:         "sftp_path": sftp_path,
6523:         "at":       now_utc().isoformat(),
6524:     }
6525:     device.device_config = json.dumps(existing)
6526:     db.commit()
6527:     log.info("Edge backup komplet for %s: %s (%d KB)",
6528:              device_id, filename, payload.get("size_kb", 0))
6529:     return {"status": "ok", "path": final_path}
