6727: @app.get("/api/admin/captures/timeline")
6728: def captures_timeline(
6729:     device_id: str,
6730:     year:  Optional[int] = None,
6731:     month: Optional[int] = None,
6732:     day:   Optional[int] = None,
6733:     _user=require_role("viewer"),
6734:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
6735: ):
6736:     """
6737:     Hent captures til timeline navigation.
6738:     - Uden parametre: returner antal captures per dag (alle tider)
6739:     - Med year+month+day: returner alle captures den dag
6740:     """
6741:     _ensure_capture_device_access(db, _user, device_id)
6742:     q = db.query(Capture).filter(
6743:         Capture.device_id == device_id,
6744:         Capture.captured_at.isnot(None)
6745:     )
6746: 
6747:     if year and month and day:
6748:         # Hent alle captures på en specifik dag
6749:         from datetime import date
6750:         from sqlalchemy import func
6751:         tz = "Europe/Copenhagen"
6752:         local_ts = func.timezone(tz, Capture.captured_at)
6753:         captures = q.filter(
6754:             func.extract("year",  local_ts) == year,
6755:             func.extract("month", local_ts) == month,
6756:             func.extract("day",   local_ts) == day,
6757:         ).order_by(Capture.captured_at.asc()).all()
6758:         return [
6759:             {
6760:                 "id":           c.id,
6761:                 "device_id":    c.device_id,
6762:                 "filename":     c.filename,
6763:                 "captured_at":  c.captured_at.isoformat() if c.captured_at else None,
6764:                 "quality_flag": c.quality_flag,
6765:                 "quality_passed": c.quality_passed,
6766:                 "blur_score":   round(c.blur_score, 1) if c.blur_score else None,
6767:                 "brightness":   round(c.brightness_mean, 1) if c.brightness_mean else None,
6768:                 "filesize_mb":  round(c.filesize / 1e6, 1) if c.filesize else None,
6769:                 "uploaded":     c.uploaded,
6770:                 "ai_result":      c.ai_result if hasattr(c, 'ai_result') else None,
6771:                 "ai_analyzed_at": c.ai_analyzed_at.isoformat() if hasattr(c, 'ai_analyzed_at') and c.ai_analyzed_at else None,
6772:                 "ai_tags":        json.loads(c.ai_tags) if hasattr(c, 'ai_tags') and c.ai_tags else None,
6773:             }
6774:             for c in captures
6775:         ]
6776:     else:
6777:         # Returner daglig tæller for hele historikken
6778:         from sqlalchemy import func
6779:         from sqlalchemy import func as _func, text as _text
6780:         tz = "Europe/Copenhagen"
6781:         local_ts = func.timezone(tz, Capture.captured_at)
6782:         rows = db.query(
6783:             func.extract("year",  local_ts).label("year"),
6784:             func.extract("month", local_ts).label("month"),
6785:             func.extract("day",   local_ts).label("day"),
6786:             func.count(Capture.id).label("count")
6787:         ).filter(
6788:             Capture.device_id == device_id,
6789:             Capture.captured_at.isnot(None)
6790:         ).group_by("year", "month", "day").order_by("year", "month", "day").all()
6791:         return [
6792:             {"year": int(r.year), "month": int(r.month), "day": int(r.day), "count": r.count}
6793:             for r in rows
6794:         ]

6801: @app.post("/api/captures/bulk-tags")
6802: def bulk_update_tags(payload: dict, _user=require_role("operator"), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
6803:     """
6804:     Bulk opdater tags på en liste af captures.
6805:     Body: {"capture_ids": [1,2,3], "add_tags": ["tag1"], "remove_tags": ["tag2"]}
6806:     """
6807:     from database import Capture as _Cap
6808:     import json as _j
6809:     from ai.integration import update_sidecar_with_ai
6810:     capture_ids = payload.get("capture_ids", [])
6811:     add_tags    = [t.lower().strip() for t in payload.get("add_tags", [])]
6812:     remove_tags = [t.lower().strip() for t in payload.get("remove_tags", [])]
6813: 
6814:     updated = 0
6815:     for cid in capture_ids:
6816:         cap = db.query(_Cap).filter_by(id=cid).first()
6817:         if not cap:
6818:             continue
6819:         if not _capture_is_allowed(db, _user, cap):
6820:             raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til et eller flere billeder")
6821:         tags = _j.loads(cap.ai_tags) if cap.ai_tags else []
6822:         tags = [t for t in tags if t not in remove_tags]
6823:         tags = list(dict.fromkeys(tags + [t for t in add_tags if t not in tags]))
6824:         cap.ai_tags = _j.dumps(tags, ensure_ascii=False)
6825:         updated += 1
6826:     db.commit()
6827:     return {"updated": updated}

6844: @app.get("/api/ai/qa/search")
6845: def qa_search(
6846:     # QA_MULTI_FILTER_FIXED
6847:     causes:         Optional[str] = None,
6848:     cause:          Optional[str] = None,
6849:     is_anomaly:     Optional[str] = None,
6850:     alarm:          Optional[str] = None,
6851:     min_confidence: Optional[float] = None,
6852:     device_ids:     Optional[str] = None,
6853:     device_id:      Optional[str] = None,
6854:     date_from:      Optional[str] = None,
6855:     date_to:        Optional[str] = None,
6856:     limit:          int = 500,
6857:     _user=require_role("viewer"),
6858:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
6859: ):
6860:     """
6861:     Søg captures baseret på QA/AI-analyse resultater.
6862:     ?cause=condensation_on_lens&is_anomaly=true&min_confidence=0.5
6863:     """
6864:     from database import Capture as _Cap
6865:     import json as _j
6866: 
6867:     from datetime import datetime as _dt2, timedelta as _td2
6868:     q = db.query(_Cap).filter(_Cap.ai_result.isnot(None))
6869:     allowed_device_ids = _allowed_capture_device_ids(db, _user)
6870:     if allowed_device_ids is not None:
6871:         if not allowed_device_ids:
6872:             return {"total": 0, "results": []}
6873:         q = q.filter(_Cap.device_id.in_(allowed_device_ids))
6874: 
6875:     # Multi-device filter
6876:     all_dev = []
6877:     if device_ids:
6878:         all_dev = [d.strip() for d in device_ids.split(",") if d.strip()]
6879:     elif device_id:
6880:         all_dev = [device_id]
6881:     if all_dev:
6882:         if allowed_device_ids is not None:
6883:             forbidden = [d for d in all_dev if d not in allowed_device_ids]
6884:             if forbidden:
6885:                 raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til en eller flere enheder")
6886:         q = q.filter(_Cap.device_id.in_(all_dev))
6887: 
6888:     # Dato filter i SQL
6889:     if date_from:
6890:         try: q = q.filter(_Cap.captured_at >= _dt2.fromisoformat(date_from))
6891:         except Exception: pass
6892:     if date_to:
6893:         try: q = q.filter(_Cap.captured_at < _dt2.fromisoformat(date_to) + _td2(days=1))
6894:         except Exception: pass
6895: 
6896:     q = q.order_by(_Cap.captured_at.desc())
6897: 
6898:     # Multi-cause filter
6899:     all_causes = []
6900:     if causes:
6901:         all_causes = [c.strip() for c in causes.split(",") if c.strip()]
6902:     elif cause:
6903:         all_causes = [cause]
6904: 
6905:     results = []
6906:     for c in q.limit(limit * 3).all():
6907:         try:
6908:             ai = _j.loads(c.ai_result)
6909:             if all_causes and ai.get("probable_cause") not in all_causes:
6910:                 continue
6911:             if is_anomaly == "true" and not ai.get("is_anomaly"):
6912:                 continue
6913:             if is_anomaly == "false" and ai.get("is_anomaly"):
6914:                 continue
6915:             if alarm == "true" and not ai.get("alarm"):
6916:                 continue
6917:             if alarm == "false" and ai.get("alarm"):
6918:                 continue
6919:             if min_confidence is not None and float(ai.get("confidence", 0)) < min_confidence:
6920:                 continue
6921:             results.append({
6922:                 "id":             c.id,
6923:                 "device_id":      c.device_id,
6924:                 "filename":       c.filename,
6925:                 "captured_at":    c.captured_at.isoformat() if c.captured_at else None,
6926:                 "quality_passed": c.quality_passed,
6927:                 "blur_score":     c.blur_score,
6928:                 "brightness":     c.brightness_mean,
6929:                 "filesize_mb":    round(c.filesize / 1e6, 1) if c.filesize else None,
6930:                 "uploaded":       c.uploaded,
6931:                 "ai_result":      c.ai_result,
6932:                 "ai_tags":        _j.loads(c.ai_tags) if c.ai_tags else None,
6933:             })
6934:         except Exception:
6935:             pass
6936:         if len(results) >= limit:
6937:             break
6938: 
6939:     return {"total": len(results), "results": results}
6940:

7048: @app.delete("/api/admin/captures/{capture_id}")
7049: def delete_capture(capture_id: int, _user=require_role("admin"), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
7050:     """Slet et billede: fil, thumbnail, sidecar JSON og DB-record."""
7051:     capture = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.id == capture_id).first()
7052:     if not capture:
7053:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Capture ikke fundet")
7054:     if not _capture_is_allowed(db, _user, capture):
7055:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til dette billede")
7056: 
7057:     deleted = {"file": False, "thumbnail": False, "sidecar": False, "db": False}
7058: 
7059:     # Slet billedfil
7060:     path = _find_image(capture.device_id, capture.filename)
7061:     if path and path.exists():
7062:         try:
7063:             path.unlink()
7064:             deleted["file"] = True
7065:         except Exception as exc:
7066:             log.warning("Kunne ikke slette fil %s: %s", path, exc)
7067: 
7068:         # Slet thumbnail
7069:         deleted["thumbnail"] = _unlink_thumbnail_variants(path, capture.filename)
7070: 
7071:         # Slet sidecar JSON
7072:         sidecar = path.with_suffix(".json")
7073:         if sidecar.exists():
7074:             try:
7075:                 sidecar.unlink()
7076:                 deleted["sidecar"] = True
7077:             except Exception as exc:
7078:                 log.warning("Kunne ikke slette sidecar %s: %s", sidecar, exc)
7079: 
7080:     # Slet fra DB
7081:     db.delete(capture)
7082:     db.commit()
7083:     deleted["db"] = True
7084: 
7085:     log.info("Capture %d slettet: %s", capture_id, deleted)
7086:     return {"status": "ok", "capture_id": capture_id, "deleted": deleted}

7092:     ids = payload.get("ids", [])
7093:     if not ids:
7094:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Ingen ids angivet")
7095:     results = []
7096:     for cid in ids:
7097:         try:
7098:             capture = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.id == cid).first()
7099:             if not capture:
7100:                 results.append({"id": cid, "status": "not_found"})
7101:                 continue
7102:             if not _capture_is_allowed(db, _user, capture):
7103:                 results.append({"id": cid, "status": "forbidden"})
7104:                 continue
7105:             path = _find_image(capture.device_id, capture.filename)
7106:             if path and path.exists():
7107:                 path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
7108:                 _unlink_thumbnail_variants(path, capture.filename)
7109:                 path.with_suffix(".json").unlink(missing_ok=True)
7110:             db.delete(capture)
7111:             results.append({"id": cid, "status": "ok"})
7112:         except Exception as exc:
7113:             results.append({"id": cid, "status": "error", "error": str(exc)})
7114:     db.commit()
7115:     log.info("Bulk slettet %d captures", len([r for r in results if r["status"] == "ok"]))
7116:     return {"status": "ok", "results": results}

7128: ):
7129:     """Læs komplet EXIF metadata fra billedfil via exifread."""
7130:     from urllib.parse import unquote as _unquote
7131:     _sanitize_device_id(device_id)
7132:     filename = _unquote(filename)
7133:     _ensure_capture_file_access(db, _user, device_id, filename)

7137:     try:
7138:         import exifread
7139:         with open(str(src), "rb") as f:
7140:             tags = exifread.process_file(f, details=True)
7141:         if not tags:
7142:             return {"exif": {}, "note": "Ingen EXIF i fil"}
7143:         exif = {}
7144:         for key, value in tags.items():
7145:             try:
7146:                 exif[key] = str(value)
7147:             except Exception:
7148:                 exif[key] = "—"
7149:         return {"exif": exif, "count": len(exif)}
7150:     except Exception as exc:
7151:         log.warning("EXIF læsning fejl %s: %s", filename, exc)
7152:         return {"exif": {}, "error": str(exc)}

7206: @app.get("/api/admin/captures/stats/exif")
7207: def get_exif_stats(device_id: str, _user=require_role("viewer"), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
7208:     """EXIF-baseret statistik: ISO, lukkertid, blænde fordeling."""
7209:     _ensure_capture_device_access(db, _user, device_id)
7210:     rows = (
7211:         db.query(Capture.exif_data)
7212:         .filter(Capture.device_id == device_id, Capture.exif_data.isnot(None))
7213:         .order_by(Capture.captured_at.desc())
7214:         .limit(1000)
7215:         .all()
7216:     )
7217:     iso_dist, shutter_dist, aperture_dist, lens_dist = {}, {}, {}, {}
7218:     for (exif_json,) in rows:
7219:         try:
7220:             exif = _json.loads(exif_json)
7221:         except Exception:
7222:             continue
7223:         if iso := exif.get("EXIF ISOSpeedRatings"):
7224:             iso_dist[iso] = iso_dist.get(iso, 0) + 1
7225:         if sh := exif.get("EXIF ExposureTime"):
7226:             shutter_dist[sh] = shutter_dist.get(sh, 0) + 1
7227:         if ap := exif.get("EXIF FNumber"):
7228:             aperture_dist[ap] = aperture_dist.get(ap, 0) + 1
7229:         if ln := exif.get("EXIF LensModel"):
7230:             lens_dist[ln] = lens_dist.get(ln, 0) + 1
7231:     def top(d, n=15):
7232:         return sorted(d.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:n]
7233:     return {
7234:         "total_with_exif": len(rows),
7235:         "iso":      [{"value": k, "count": v} for k, v in top(iso_dist)],
7236:         "shutter":  [{"value": k, "count": v} for k, v in top(shutter_dist)],
7237:         "aperture": [{"value": k, "count": v} for k, v in top(aperture_dist)],
7238:         "lens":     [{"value": k, "count": v} for k, v in top(lens_dist)],
7239:     }

7250:     path = _find_image(capture.device_id, capture.filename)

7327: def _aiops_static_scan() -> dict:
7328:     """Lightweight read-only SAST snapshot for AI Ops.
7329: 
7330:     This is intentionally conservative and produces review signals, not proof of
7331:     vulnerability. It avoids reading generated exports and never returns secret
7332:     values.
7333:     """
7334:     root = _repo_root()
7335:     patterns = {
7336:         "hardcoded_secret_terms": ["password=", "api_key=", "secret=", "token="],
7337:         "shell_execution": ["subprocess.run", "subprocess.check_output", "os.system", "shell=True"],
7338:         "dangerous_file_ops": ["unlink(", "rmtree(", "chmod 777", "chown "],
7339:         "legacy_update_paths": ["git pull", "legacy_git_update", "TIMELAPSE_ENABLE_LEGACY_GIT_UPDATE"],
7340:     }
7341:     skip_parts = {"dist", "exports", "__pycache__", ".git", "venv", "node_modules"}
7342:     findings: list[dict] = []
7343:     scanned = 0
7344:     for path in root.rglob("*"):
7345:         if len(findings) >= 80:
7346:             break
7347:         if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".py", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".sh", ".sql", ".yaml", ".yml"}:
7348:             continue
7349:         if any(part in skip_parts for part in path.parts):
7350:             continue
7351:         try:
7352:             rel = str(path.relative_to(root))
7353:             text_value = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
7354:         except Exception:
7355:             continue
7356:         scanned += 1
7357:         for idx, line in enumerate(text_value.splitlines(), start=1):
7358:             lower = line.lower()
7359:             for category, needles in patterns.items():
7360:                 if any(n.lower() in lower for n in needles):
7361:                     snippet = line.strip()
7362:                     for sensitive in ("password", "api_key", "secret", "token"):
7363:                         snippet = _re.sub(rf"({sensitive}\s*[=:]\s*)['\"]?[^'\"\s,]+", rf"\1***", snippet, flags=_re.I)
7364:                     findings.append({
7365:                         "category": category,
7366:                         "file": rel,
7367:                         "line": idx,
7368:                         "snippet": snippet[:180],
7369:                     })
7370:                     break
7371:             if len(findings) >= 80:
7372:                 break
7373:     return {"files_scanned": scanned, "findings": findings, "finding_count": len(findings)}
7374: 
7375: 
7376: def _aiops_snapshot(db: Session) -> dict:
7377:     device_counts = db.execute(text("""
7378:         SELECT COALESCE(status, 'unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count
7379:         FROM devices GROUP BY COALESCE(status, 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC
7380:     """)).fetchall()
7381:     siem_counts = db.execute(text("""
7382:         SELECT COALESCE(severity, 'unknown') AS severity, COUNT(*) AS count
7383:         FROM security_events
7384:         WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
7385:         GROUP BY COALESCE(severity, 'unknown')
7386:         ORDER BY count DESC
7387:     """)).fetchall()
7388:     update_counts = db.execute(text("""
7389:         SELECT COALESCE(status, 'unknown') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count
7390:         FROM pending_updates GROUP BY COALESCE(status, 'unknown') ORDER BY count DESC
7391:     """)).fetchall()
7392:     latest_critical = db.execute(text("""
7393:         SELECT device_id, event_type, severity, occurred_at
7394:         FROM security_events
7395:         WHERE severity IN ('critical', 'CRITICAL', 'ERROR')
7396:         ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 5
7397:     """)).fetchall()
7398:     key_data = list_key_management(_user=object(), db=db)
7399:     resilience = resilience_assessment(_user=object(), db=db)
7400:     return {
7401:         "generated_at": now_utc().isoformat(),
7402:         "scope": "read_only_aiops_snapshot",
7403:         "guardrails": {
7404:             "model_may_write_database": False,
7405:             "model_may_execute_commands": False,
7406:             "human_acceptance_required": True,
7407:             "customer_data_minimized": True,
7408:         },
7409:         "cmdb": {
7410:             "device_count_by_status": {r[0]: r[1] for r in device_counts},
7411:             "inventory_rows": db.query(DeviceInventory).count(),
7412:         },
7413:         "siem": {
7414:             "last_24h_by_severity": {r[0]: r[1] for r in siem_counts},
7415:             "latest_critical": [
7416:                 {
7417:                     "device_id": r[0],
7418:                     "event_type": r[1],
7419:                     "severity": r[2],
7420:                     "occurred_at": r[3].isoformat() if r[3] else None,
7421:                 }
7422:                 for r in latest_critical
7423:             ],
7424:         },
7425:         "updates": {
7426:             "by_status": {r[0]: r[1] for r in update_counts},
7427:             "artifact_count": db.query(UpdateArtifact).count(),
7428:             "change_ticket_count": db.query(ChangeTicket).count(),
7429:         },
7430:         "keys": key_data["summary"],
7431:         "resilience": resilience["summary"],
7432:         "sast": _aiops_static_scan(),
7433:     }
7434: 
7435: 
7436: def _aiops_fallback(snapshot: dict) -> dict:
7437:     recommendations = []
7438:     if snapshot["keys"].get("missing_edge_api_key", 0):
7439:         recommendations.append({
7440:             "title": "Migrer Edge API credentials",
7441:             "severity": "high",
7442:             "domain": ["IEC62443", "ISO27000", "NIS2"],
7443:             "rationale": f"{snapshot['keys']['missing_edge_api_key']} enheder mangler aktiv key-registry API credential.",
7444:             "proposed_action": "Udsted og roter Edge API credentials via Nøglehåndtering. Fjern legacy tokens efter agent rollout.",
7445:             "requires_acceptance": True,
7446:         })
7447:     if snapshot["keys"].get("missing_signing_key", 0):
7448:         recommendations.append({
7449:             "title": "Udsted Edge signing identities",
7450:             "severity": "high",
7451:             "domain": ["CRA", "IEC62443", "ISO27000"],
7452:             "rationale": "Edge-signaler kan først attesteres stærkt når hver Edge har egen signing key.",
7453:             "proposed_action": "Registrer public signing key per Edge og aktiver krævet request-signering efter migration.",
7454:             "requires_acceptance": True,
7455:         })
7456:     if snapshot["sast"].get("finding_count", 0):
7457:         recommendations.append({
7458:             "title": "Review SAST findings",
7459:             "severity": "medium",
7460:             "domain": ["ISO27000", "CRA"],
7461:             "rationale": f"Den statiske scanner fandt {snapshot['sast']['finding_count']} review-signaler.",
7462:             "proposed_action": "Gennemgå findings og opret change tickets for reelle sårbarheder.",
7463:             "requires_acceptance": True,
7464:         })
7465:     if not recommendations:
7466:         recommendations.append({
7467:             "title": "Ingen kritiske AI Ops fund i baseline",
7468:             "severity": "low",
7469:             "domain": ["SABSA", "ISO27000"],
7470:             "rationale": "Read-only snapshot viser ingen umiddelbar højrisikoindikator.",
7471:             "proposed_action": "Fortsæt overvågning og kør assessment igen efter næste deployment.",
7472:             "requires_acceptance": False,
7473:         })
7474:     return {
7475:         "mode": "deterministic_fallback",
7476:         "summary": "Ollama var ikke tilgængelig eller returnerede ikke gyldigt JSON; anbefalinger er lavet deterministisk fra snapshot.",
7477:         "risk_level": "high" if any(r["severity"] == "high" for r in recommendations) else "medium",
7478:         "recommendations": recommendations,
7479:         "next_checks": ["SAST review", "DAST smoke tests", "Edge signing key rollout", "artifact rollback drill"],
7480:     }
7481:

7483: def _call_ollama_text(prompt: str, model: str = "llama3.2:latest") -> dict | None:
7484:     try:
7485:         import httpx
7486:         resp = httpx.post(
7487:             f"{os.getenv('OLLAMA_URL', 'http://127.0.0.1:11434').rstrip('/')}/api/generate",
7488:             json={
7489:                 "model": model,
7490:                 "prompt": prompt,
7491:                 "stream": False,
7492:                 "format": "json",
7493:                 "options": {"temperature": 0.1, "num_predict": 1800},
7494:             },
7495:             timeout=90,
7496:         )
7497:         resp.raise_for_status()
7498:         raw_text = resp.json().get("response", "")
7499:         match = _re.search(r"(\{.*\})", raw_text, _re.DOTALL)
7500:         return json.loads(match.group(1) if match else raw_text)
7501:     except Exception as exc:
7502:         log.warning("AI Ops Ollama analyse fejlede: %s", exc)
7503:         return None

7515: def aiops_analyze(
7516:     payload: dict | None = None,
7517:     _user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
7518:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
7519: ):
7520:     snapshot = _aiops_snapshot(db)
7521:     model = (payload or {}).get("model") or "llama3.2:latest"
7522:     prompt = f"""
7523: Du er TimeLapse Pro AI Ops co-pilot. Du må kun analysere read-only data.
7524: Du må ikke foreslå direkte ændringer uden accept, og du må ikke bede om hemmeligheder.
7525: Vurder CMDB, SIEM, updates, key management, resilience og SAST-signaler.
7526: 
7527: Returner KUN JSON:
7528: {{
7529:   "mode": "ollama",
7530:   "summary": "kort dansk status",
7531:   "risk_level": "low|medium|high|critical",
7532:   "recommendations": [
7533:     {{
7534:       "title": "kort titel",
7535:       "severity": "low|medium|high|critical",
7536:       "domain": ["SABSA", "IEC62443", "ISO27000", "NIS2", "CRA"],
7537:       "rationale": "hvorfor",
7538:       "proposed_action": "hvad bør vi gøre",
7539:       "requires_acceptance": true
7540:     }}
7541:   ],
7542:   "next_checks": ["SAST/DAST/pentest/check"]
7543: }}
7544: 
7545: SNAPSHOT:
7546: {json.dumps(snapshot, ensure_ascii=False)[:24000]}
7547: """
7548:     analysis = _call_ollama_text(prompt, model=model) or _aiops_fallback(snapshot)
7549:     if not isinstance(analysis, dict) or "recommendations" not in analysis:
7550:         analysis = _aiops_fallback(snapshot)
7551:     return {"snapshot": snapshot, "analysis": analysis}

7554: def _require_openwebui_loopback(request: Request) -> None:
7555:     """Open WebUI tool calls must stay local to Headend."""
7556:     client_host = request.client.host if request.client else ""
7557:     forwarded_for = (request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") or "").split(",")[0].strip()
7558:     allowed = {"127.0.0.1", "::1", "localhost"}
7559:     if client_host not in allowed or forwarded_for:
7560:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Open WebUI tool access is only allowed from Headend loopback")
7561: 
7562: 
7563: def _validate_openwebui_access(request: Request, db: Session) -> User:
7564:     token = request.cookies.get(OPENWEBUI_COOKIE_NAME)
7565:     payload = _decode_token(token) if token else None
7566:     if (
7567:         not payload
7568:         or payload.get("type") != "openwebui_access"
7569:         or payload.get("target") != "openwebui"
7570:         or not _session_is_mfa_verified(payload)
7571:     ):
7572:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Open WebUI requires MFA-authenticated TimeLapse access")
7573:     user = db.query(User).filter_by(username=payload.get("sub"), is_active=True).first()
7574:     if not user:
7575:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
7576:     if user.role not in ("super_admin", "admin"):
7577:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Open WebUI requires admin role")
7578:     return user
7579: 
7580: 
7581: def _openwebui_user_email(user: User) -> str:
7582:     if user.email:
7583:         return user.email.lower()
7584:     return f"{user.username}@timelapse.local".lower()
7585: 
7586: 
7587: def _openwebui_user_role(user: User) -> str:
7588:     return "admin" if user.role in ("super_admin", "admin") else "user"
7589:

7591: @app.get("/api/openwebui/access/status")

7593:     request: Request,
7594:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
7595: ):
7596:     payload = _session_payload(request)
7597:     mfa_verified = _session_is_mfa_verified(payload)
7598:     return {
7599:         "enabled": True,
7600:         "url": OPENWEBUI_PUBLIC_URL,
7601:         "allowed": bool(mfa_verified),
7602:         "mfa_verified": bool(mfa_verified),
7603:         "required_role": ["super_admin", "admin"],
7604:         "expires_minutes": 30,

7609: @app.post("/api/openwebui/access/issue")
7610: def issue_openwebui_access(
7611:     request: Request,
7612:     current_user=require_role("super_admin", "admin"),
7613: ):
7614:     payload = _session_payload(request)
7615:     if not _session_is_mfa_verified(payload):
7616:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Open WebUI kræver MFA-verificeret login")
7617:     max_age = 30 * 60
7618:     access_token = _create_token({
7619:         "type": "openwebui_access",
7620:         "target": "openwebui",
7621:         "sub": current_user.username,
7622:         "role": current_user.role,
7623:         "amr": payload.get("amr", ["mfa"]) if payload else ["mfa"],
7624:         "mfa_verified": True,
7625:     }, expire_hours=0.5)
7626:     resp = JSONResponse(content={
7627:         "ok": True,
7628:         "url": OPENWEBUI_PUBLIC_URL,
7629:         "expires_seconds": max_age,
7630:     })
7631:     resp.headers.append(
7632:         "Set-Cookie",
7633:         _cookie_header(OPENWEBUI_COOKIE_NAME, access_token, max_age, domain=OPENWEBUI_COOKIE_DOMAIN),
7634:     )
7635:     log.info("Open WebUI access issued to %s (%s) via MFA-authenticated TimeLapse session", current_user.username, current_user.role)
7636:     return resp

7748: def _openwebui_public_base_url() -> str:
7749:     return (
7750:         os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_PUBLIC_URL")
7751:         or os.getenv("BASE_URL")
7752:         or ALLOWED_ORIGIN
7753:         or "https://timelapse.froekjaer.dk"
7754:     ).rstrip("/")
7755: 
7756: 
7757: def _json_list(value: str | None) -> list:
7758:     if not value:
7759:         return []
7760:     try:
7761:         data = json.loads(value)
7762:         return data if isinstance(data, list) else []
7763:     except Exception:
7764:         return []
7765: 
7766: 
7767: def _json_dict(value: str | None) -> dict:
7768:     if not value:
7769:         return {}
7770:     try:
7771:         data = json.loads(value)
7772:         return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
7773:     except Exception:
7774:         return {}

7777: def _capture_openwebui_payload(capture: Capture) -> dict:
7778:     from urllib.parse import quote
7779: 
7780:     device = quote(capture.device_id or "", safe="")
7781:     filename = quote(capture.filename or "", safe="")
7782:     base = _openwebui_public_base_url()
7783:     ai = _json_dict(capture.ai_result)
7784:     tags = _json_list(capture.ai_tags)
7785:     image_url = f"{base}/api/images/{device}/{filename}"
7786:     thumb_url = f"{base}/api/thumbnails/{device}/{filename}"
7787:     return {
7788:         "id": capture.id,
7789:         "device_id": capture.device_id,
7790:         "filename": capture.filename,
7791:         "captured_at": capture.captured_at.isoformat() if capture.captured_at else None,
7792:         "quality": {
7793:             "passed": capture.quality_passed,
7794:             "flag": capture.quality_flag,
7795:             "blur_score": round(capture.blur_score, 1) if capture.blur_score is not None else None,
7796:             "brightness": round(capture.brightness_mean, 1) if capture.brightness_mean is not None else None,
7797:         },
7798:         "ai": {
7799:             "analyzed_at": capture.ai_analyzed_at.isoformat() if capture.ai_analyzed_at else None,
7800:             "tags": tags,
7801:             "scene_dk": ai.get("scene_dk") or ai.get("description"),
7802:             "quality_flag": ai.get("quality_flag"),
7803:             "probable_cause": ai.get("probable_cause"),
7804:             "confidence": ai.get("confidence"),
7805:         },
7806:         "image_url": image_url,
7807:         "thumbnail_url": thumb_url,
7808:         "markdown": f"![{capture.filename}]({image_url})",
7809:     }

7812: def _capture_date_window(date_value: str | None, tz: str = "Europe/Copenhagen") -> tuple[str, str]:
7813:     from datetime import timedelta as _td
7814:     import zoneinfo
7815: 
7816:     zone = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz)
7817:     raw = (date_value or "today").strip().lower()
7818:     today = datetime.now(zone).date()
7819:     if raw in {"today", "i dag", "idag"}:
7820:         day = today
7821:     elif raw in {"yesterday", "i gaar", "i går", "igaar"}:
7822:         day = today - _td(days=1)
7823:     else:
7824:         try:
7825:             day = datetime.fromisoformat(raw[:10]).date()
7826:         except Exception:
7827:             day = today
7828:     start = datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, tzinfo=zone).astimezone(timezone.utc)
7829:     end = start + _td(days=1)
7830:     return start.isoformat(), end.isoformat()
7831: 
7832: 
7833: def _query_captures_window(
7834:     db: Session,
7835:     date_value: str | None = "today",
7836:     device_id: str | None = None,
7837:     limit: int = 20,
7838:     newest_first: bool = True,
7839: ) -> list[Capture]:
7840:     start_iso, end_iso = _capture_date_window(date_value)
7841:     start = datetime.fromisoformat(start_iso)
7842:     end = datetime.fromisoformat(end_iso)
7843:     q = db.query(Capture).filter(
7844:         Capture.captured_at >= start,
7845:         Capture.captured_at < end,
7846:         Capture.captured_at.isnot(None),
7847:     )
7848:     if device_id:
7849:         q = q.filter(Capture.device_id == device_id)
7850:     order = Capture.captured_at.desc() if newest_first else Capture.captured_at.asc()
7851:     return q.order_by(order).limit(max(1, min(int(limit or 20), 200))).all()
7852:

7854: def _known_capture_tags(db: Session, max_rows: int = 1000) -> set[str]:
7855:     tags: set[str] = set()
7856:     rows = (
7857:         db.query(Capture.ai_tags)
7858:         .filter(Capture.ai_tags.isnot(None))
7859:         .order_by(Capture.captured_at.desc())
7860:         .limit(max_rows)
7861:         .all()
7862:     )
7863:     for (raw_tags,) in rows:
7864:         tags.update(str(t).lower() for t in _json_list(raw_tags))
7865:     return tags

7867: 
7868: def _parse_capture_natural_query(query: str, known_tags: set[str]) -> dict:
7869:     text_value = (query or "").strip()
7870:     lower = text_value.lower()
7871:     explicit_tags = set(_re.findall(r"#([\wæøåÆØÅ-]+)", lower))
7872:     explicit_tags.update(t.lower() for t in _re.findall(r'"([^"]+)"', lower))
7873:     mentioned_tags = {tag for tag in known_tags if tag and tag in lower}
7874:     include_tags = sorted(explicit_tags | mentioned_tags)
7875: 
7876:     exclude_tags: set[str] = set()
7877:     for marker in ("uden ", "ekskluder ", "undtagen ", "ikke "):
7878:         if marker in lower:
7879:             tail = lower.split(marker, 1)[1][:120]
7880:             exclude_tags.update(tag for tag in known_tags if tag and tag in tail)
7881:             exclude_tags.update(_re.findall(r"#([\wæøåÆØÅ-]+)", tail))
7882:     if any(term in lower for term in ("solen ikke skinner direkte", "ikke skinner direkte", "direkte ind i linsen", "sol i linsen", "modlys")):
7883:         exclude_tags.update({"sun_flare", "lens_flare", "glare", "overexposed", "direct_sun"})
7884: 
7885:     limit_match = _re.search(r"\b(\d{1,3})\b", lower)
7886:     limit = int(limit_match.group(1)) if limit_match else 20
7887:     if any(term in lower for term in ("jævnt", "jaevnt", "fordel", "spredt", "timelapse")):
7888:         sort = "timelapse_even_spacing"
7889:     elif any(term in lower for term in ("bedste", "skarpeste", "højeste kvalitet", "hoejeste kvalitet")):
7890:         sort = "quality"
7891:     elif "seneste" in lower or "nyeste" in lower:
7892:         sort = "newest"
7893:     elif "ældste" in lower or "aeldste" in lower:
7894:         sort = "oldest"
7895:     else:
7896:         sort = "newest"
7897: 
7898:     if "i går" in lower or "igår" in lower or "i gaar" in lower or "igaar" in lower:
7899:         date_value = "yesterday"
7900:     elif "i dag" in lower or "idag" in lower:
7901:         date_value = "today"
7902:     else:
7903:         iso_date = _re.search(r"\b(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\b", lower)
7904:         date_value = iso_date.group(1) if iso_date else None
7905: 
7906:     quality_only = any(term in lower for term in ("skarpe", "klare billeder", "klart billede", "ikke slør", "ikke sloer", "quality ok", "gode billeder"))
7907:     daily_sample = any(term in lower for term in ("billede om dagen", "et billede pr dag", "1 billede pr dag", "dagligt billede"))
7908:     purpose = "timelapse" if "timelapse" in lower or "video" in lower else "search"
7909:     return {
7910:         "query": text_value,
7911:         "date": date_value,
7912:         "limit": max(1, min(limit, 200)),
7913:         "sort": sort,
7914:         "include_tags": include_tags,
7915:         "exclude_tags": sorted(exclude_tags),
7916:         "quality_only": quality_only,
7917:         "daily_sample": daily_sample,
7918:         "purpose": purpose,
7919:     }
7920: 
7921: 
7922: def _filter_captures_by_ai(captures: list[Capture], spec: dict) -> list[Capture]:
7923:     include_tags = set(spec.get("include_tags") or [])
7924:     exclude_tags = set(spec.get("exclude_tags") or [])
7925:     filtered = []
7926:     for capture in captures:
7927:         tags = set(str(t).lower() for t in _json_list(capture.ai_tags))
7928:         ai = _json_dict(capture.ai_result)
7929:         haystack = " ".join([
7930:             " ".join(tags),
7931:             str(ai.get("scene_dk") or ""),
7932:             str(ai.get("description") or ""),
7933:             str(ai.get("probable_cause") or ""),
7934:             str(capture.quality_flag or ""),
7935:         ]).lower()
7936:         if spec.get("quality_only") and capture.quality_passed is False:
7937:             continue
7938:         if include_tags and not all(tag in tags or tag in haystack for tag in include_tags):
7939:             continue
7940:         if exclude_tags and any(tag in tags or tag in haystack for tag in exclude_tags):
7941:             continue
7942:         filtered.append(capture)
7943:     return filtered
7944: 
7945: 
7946: def _normalise_capture_search_spec(spec: dict, fallback: dict, known_tags: set[str]) -> dict:
7947:     safe = dict(fallback)
7948:     if isinstance(spec, dict):
7949:         safe.update({k: v for k, v in spec.items() if v is not None})
7950: 
7951:     def _tag_list(value) -> list[str]:
7952:         if not isinstance(value, list):
7953:             return []
7954:         stopwords = {
7955:             "billede", "billeder", "foto", "fotos", "seneste", "nyeste", "ældste", "aeldste",
7956:             "skarpe", "skarp", "bedste", "gode", "godkendte", "i dag", "idag", "today",
7957:             "timelapse", "video", "vælg", "vaelg", "find", "søg", "soeg",
7958:         }
7959:         cleaned = []
7960:         for item in value[:20]:
7961:             tag = str(item).strip().lower().replace("#", "")
7962:             generic = tag in stopwords or any(part in stopwords for part in _re.split(r"[_\s-]+", tag))
7963:             if tag and (tag in known_tags or not generic):
7964:                 cleaned.append(tag)
7965:         return sorted(dict.fromkeys(cleaned))
7966: 
7967:     safe["include_tags"] = _tag_list(safe.get("include_tags"))
7968:     safe["exclude_tags"] = _tag_list(safe.get("exclude_tags"))
7969:     query_lower = str(safe.get("query") or fallback.get("query") or "").lower()
7970:     fallback_include = set(fallback.get("include_tags") or [])
7971:     fallback_exclude = set(fallback.get("exclude_tags") or [])
7972: 
7973:     def _mentioned(tag: str, fallback_tags: set[str]) -> bool:
7974:         return tag in fallback_tags or tag in query_lower or tag.replace("_", " ") in query_lower
7975: 
7976:     safe["include_tags"] = [tag for tag in safe["include_tags"] if _mentioned(tag, fallback_include)]
7977:     safe["exclude_tags"] = [tag for tag in safe["exclude_tags"] if _mentioned(tag, fallback_exclude)]
7978:     safe["limit"] = max(1, min(int(safe.get("limit") or fallback.get("limit") or 20), 500))
7979:     safe["sort"] = str(safe.get("sort") or fallback.get("sort") or "newest")
7980:     if safe["sort"] not in {"newest", "oldest", "quality", "timelapse_even_spacing"}:
7981:         safe["sort"] = "newest"
7982:     safe["purpose"] = str(safe.get("purpose") or fallback.get("purpose") or "search")
7983:     if safe["purpose"] not in {"timeline", "tag_search", "timelapse", "openwebui", "search"}:
7984:         safe["purpose"] = "search"
7985:     quality_raw = safe.get("quality_only")
7986:     safe["quality_only"] = str(quality_raw).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "ja"} if isinstance(quality_raw, str) else bool(quality_raw)
7987:     if safe["quality_only"] and not fallback.get("quality_only"):
7988:         safe["quality_only"] = False
7989:     daily_raw = safe.get("daily_sample")
7990:     safe["daily_sample"] = str(daily_raw).strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "ja"} if isinstance(daily_raw, str) else bool(daily_raw)
7991:     if safe["daily_sample"] and not fallback.get("daily_sample"):
7992:         safe["daily_sample"] = False
7993:     if safe["include_tags"] or safe["exclude_tags"]:
7994:         safe["known_tag_matches"] = sorted(set(safe["include_tags"] + safe["exclude_tags"]) & known_tags)
7995:     return safe
7996: 
7997: 
7998: def _capture_spec_from_ollama(query: str, known_tags: set[str], purpose: str = "search") -> dict:
7999:     fallback = _parse_capture_natural_query(query, known_tags)
8000:     fallback["purpose"] = purpose or fallback.get("purpose") or "search"
8001:     prompt = f"""
8002: Du er TimeLapse Pro billedsøgnings-parser. Du må kun returnere JSON.
8003: Fortolk dansk/fritekst til sikre filtre. Brug kun tag-felter når brugeren faktisk efterspørger indhold.
8004: 
8005: Returner KUN JSON:
8006: {{
8007:   "date": "today|yesterday|YYYY-MM-DD|null",
8008:   "date_from": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
8009:   "date_to": "YYYY-MM-DD|null",
8010:   "include_tags": ["tag"],
8011:   "exclude_tags": ["tag"],
8012:   "quality_only": true,
8013:   "daily_sample": false,
8014:   "min_confidence": null,
8015:   "sort": "newest|oldest|quality|timelapse_even_spacing",
8016:   "limit": 20,
8017:   "purpose": "timeline|tag_search|timelapse|search",
8018:   "explanation": "kort dansk forklaring"
8019: }}
8020: 
8021: Kendte tags:
8022: {json.dumps(sorted(list(known_tags))[:250], ensure_ascii=False)}
8023: 
8024: Formål: {purpose}
8025: Brugerforespørgsel: {query[:1000]}
8026: """
8027:     parsed = _call_ollama_text(prompt, model=os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_QUERY_MODEL", "llama3.2:latest"))
8028:     return _normalise_capture_search_spec(parsed or {}, fallback, known_tags)
8029: 
8030: 
8031: def _parse_capture_range(payload: dict, spec: dict) -> tuple[datetime | None, datetime | None]:
8032:     from datetime import timedelta as _td
8033: 
8034:     date_value = payload.get("date") or spec.get("date")
8035:     if date_value and str(date_value).lower() not in {"null", "none"}:
8036:         start_iso, end_iso = _capture_date_window(str(date_value))
8037:         return datetime.fromisoformat(start_iso), datetime.fromisoformat(end_iso)
8038: 
8039:     start_raw = payload.get("date_from") or spec.get("date_from")
8040:     end_raw = payload.get("date_to") or spec.get("date_to")
8041:     start_dt = None
8042:     end_dt = None
8043:     if start_raw and str(start_raw).lower() not in {"null", "none"}:
8044:         try:
8045:             start_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(start_raw)[:10]).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
8046:         except Exception:
8047:             start_dt = None
8048:     if end_raw and str(end_raw).lower() not in {"null", "none"}:
8049:         try:
8050:             end_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(end_raw)[:10]).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) + _td(days=1)
8051:         except Exception:
8052:             end_dt = None
8053:     return start_dt, end_dt
8054: 
8055: 
8056: def _query_capture_candidates(db: Session, payload: dict, spec: dict) -> list[Capture]:
8057:     q = db.query(Capture).filter(Capture.captured_at.isnot(None))
8058:     candidate_ids = payload.get("candidate_ids")
8059:     if isinstance(candidate_ids, list) and candidate_ids:
8060:         ids = []
8061:         for raw_id in candidate_ids[:5000]:
8062:             try:
8063:                 ids.append(int(raw_id))
8064:             except Exception:
8065:                 pass
8066:         if ids:
8067:             q = q.filter(Capture.id.in_(ids))
8068:     else:
8069:         start_dt, end_dt = _parse_capture_range(payload, spec)
8070:         if start_dt:
8071:             q = q.filter(Capture.captured_at >= start_dt)
8072:         if end_dt:
8073:             q = q.filter(Capture.captured_at < end_dt)
8074: 
8075:     device_ids = payload.get("device_ids") or payload.get("device_id")
8076:     if isinstance(device_ids, str):
8077:         device_ids = [d.strip() for d in device_ids.split(",") if d.strip()]
8078:     if isinstance(device_ids, list) and device_ids:
8079:         q = q.filter(Capture.device_id.in_([str(d) for d in device_ids[:100]]))
8080: 
8081:     sort = spec.get("sort")
8082:     if sort == "oldest" or spec.get("purpose") == "timelapse":
8083:         q = q.order_by(Capture.captured_at.asc())
8084:     else:
8085:         q = q.order_by(Capture.captured_at.desc())
8086:     return q.limit(max(100, min(int(payload.get("candidate_limit") or 3000), 5000))).all()
8087: 
8088: 
8089: def _allowed_capture_device_ids(db: Session, user: User | None) -> set[str] | None:
8090:     if _is_platform_admin(user):
8091:         return None
8092:     if not user or not getattr(user, "customer_id", None):
8093:         return set()
8094:     site_ids = [row[0] for row in db.query(Site.id).filter(Site.customer_id == user.customer_id).all()]
8095:     devices = db.query(Device.device_id).filter(
8096:         (Device.customer_id == user.customer_id) | (Device.site_id.in_(site_ids))
8097:     ).all()
8098:     return {row[0] for row in devices}
8099: 
8100: 
8101: def _ensure_capture_device_access(db: Session, user: User | None, device_id: str) -> None:
8102:     allowed = _allowed_capture_device_ids(db, user)
8103:     if allowed is not None and device_id not in allowed:
8104:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til denne enhed")
8105: 
8106: 
8107: def _capture_is_allowed(db: Session, user: User | None, capture: Capture) -> bool:
8108:     allowed = _allowed_capture_device_ids(db, user)
8109:     return allowed is None or capture.device_id in allowed
8110: 
8111: 
8112: def _ensure_capture_file_access(db: Session, user: User | None, device_id: str, filename: str) -> Capture:
8113:     """Require a DB capture row and enforce tenant access before serving files."""
8114:     _ensure_capture_device_access(db, user, device_id)
8115:     capture = db.query(Capture).filter_by(device_id=device_id, filename=filename).first()
8116:     if not capture:
8117:         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Capture not found")
8118:     if not _capture_is_allowed(db, user, capture):
8119:         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Ingen adgang til dette billede")
8120:     return capture
8121: 
8122: 
8123: def _capture_quality_score(capture: Capture) -> float:
8124:     score = 0.0
8125:     if capture.quality_passed is True:
8126:         score += 40.0
8127:     if capture.blur_score is not None:
8128:         score += min(float(capture.blur_score), 100.0) * 0.35
8129:     if capture.brightness_mean is not None:
8130:         brightness = float(capture.brightness_mean)
8131:         score += max(0.0, 30.0 - abs(128.0 - brightness) / 4.5)
8132:     ai = _json_dict(capture.ai_result)
8133:     try:
8134:         score += float(ai.get("confidence") or 0) * 15.0
8135:     except Exception:
8136:         pass
8137:     return score
8138: 
8139: 
8140: def _select_evenly_spaced(captures: list[Capture], limit: int) -> list[Capture]:
8141:     if len(captures) <= limit:
8142:         return captures
8143:     selected = []
8144:     for idx in range(limit):
8145:         source_idx = round(idx * (len(captures) - 1) / max(limit - 1, 1))
8146:         selected.append(captures[source_idx])
8147:     return selected
8148: 
8149: 
8150: def _select_captures_for_spec(captures: list[Capture], spec: dict) -> list[Capture]:
8151:     filtered = _filter_captures_by_ai(captures, spec)
8152:     limit = max(1, min(int(spec.get("limit") or 20), 500))
8153:     sort = spec.get("sort")
8154:     if spec.get("daily_sample"):
8155:         by_day: dict[str, list[Capture]] = {}
8156:         for capture in sorted(filtered, key=lambda c: c.captured_at or datetime.min):
8157:             if not capture.captured_at:
8158:                 continue
8159:             by_day.setdefault(capture.captured_at.date().isoformat(), []).append(capture)
8160:         selected = []
8161:         for day in sorted(by_day):
8162:             day_captures = by_day[day]
8163:             selected.append(max(day_captures, key=_capture_quality_score))
8164:         return selected[:limit]
8165:     if sort == "quality":
8166:         filtered = sorted(filtered, key=_capture_quality_score, reverse=True)
8167:     elif sort == "timelapse_even_spacing":
8168:         filtered = _select_evenly_spaced(filtered, limit)
8169:     elif sort == "oldest" or spec.get("purpose") == "timelapse":
8170:         filtered = sorted(filtered, key=lambda c: c.captured_at or datetime.min)
8171:     else:
8172:         filtered = sorted(filtered, key=lambda c: c.captured_at or datetime.min, reverse=True)
8173:     return filtered[:limit]
8174: 
8175: 
8176: @app.post("/api/ai/captures/natural-search")
8177: def ai_capture_natural_search(
8178:     payload: dict,
8179:     _user=Depends(get_current_user),
8180:     db: Session = Depends(get_db),
8181: ):
8182:     if _user is None:
8183:         raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Not authenticated")
8184:     query = str(payload.get("query") or "").strip()
8185:     if not query:
8186:         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="query mangler")
8187:     purpose = str(payload.get("purpose") or "search")
8188:     known_tags = _known_capture_tags(db)
8189:     spec = _capture_spec_from_ollama(query, known_tags, purpose=purpose)
8190:     if payload.get("limit"):
8191:         try:
8192:             spec["limit"] = max(1, min(int(payload.get("limit")), 500))
8193:         except Exception:
8194:             pass
8195:     candidates = _query_capture_candidates(db, payload, spec)
8196:     allowed_device_ids = _allowed_capture_device_ids(db, _user)
8197:     if allowed_device_ids is not None:
8198:         candidates = [c for c in candidates if c.device_id in allowed_device_ids]
8199:     selected = _select_captures_for_spec(candidates, spec)
8200:     images = [_capture_openwebui_payload(c) for c in selected]
8201:     selected_ids = [c.id for c in selected]
8202:     candidate_ids = [c.id for c in candidates]
8203:     return {
8204:         "mode": "ollama" if spec.get("explanation") else "deterministic_fallback",
8205:         "query": query,
8206:         "selection": spec,
8207:         "total_candidates": len(candidates),
8208:         "total_matches": len(selected),
8209:         "results": images,
8210:         "capture_ids": selected_ids,
8211:         "selected_ids": selected_ids,

0098: def _dedup_hash(device_id: str, event_type: str,
0099:                 occurred_at: str, source_ip: str = "", raw_message: str = "") -> str:
0100:     """Hash til deduplicering uden at kollidere støj-events fra samme sekund."""
0101:     raw_short = hashlib.sha256((raw_message or "").encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
0102:     raw = f"{device_id}:{event_type}:{occurred_at[:19]}:{source_ip}:{raw_short}"
0103:     return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()[:64]

0106: def _parse_dt(s: str) -> datetime:
0107:     """Parser ISO8601 timestamp → aware datetime."""
0108:     try:
0109:         dt = datetime.fromisoformat(s)
0110:         if dt.tzinfo is None:
0111:             dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
0112:         return dt
0113:     except Exception:
0114:         return _now()

0117: def _redact_message(raw: str) -> str:
0118:     """Fjern oplagte hemmeligheder før loglinjer gemmes i SIEM."""
0119:     msg = raw or ""
0120:     patterns = [
0121:         (r"(?i)(authorization:\s*bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/\-]+=*", r"\1[REDACTED]"),
0122:         (r"(?i)(password\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1[REDACTED]"),
0123:         (r"(?i)(token\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1[REDACTED]"),
0124:         (r"(?i)(api[_-]?key\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1[REDACTED]"),
0125:         (r"(?i)(jwt_secret\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1[REDACTED]"),
0126:     ]
0127:     for pattern, repl in patterns:
0128:         msg = re.sub(pattern, repl, msg)
0129:     return msg
0130: 
0131: 
0132: def _normalize_event(ev: dict) -> dict:
0133:     raw = _redact_message(ev.get("raw_message") or ev.get("message") or "")[:2000]
0134:     severity = str(ev.get("severity", "info")).lower()
0135:     event_type = str(ev.get("event_type", "unknown")).lower()
0136:     logger_name = str(ev.get("logger") or "")
0137: 
0138:     if event_type == "log":
0139:         lowered = raw.lower()
0140:         if "camera not found" in lowered or "no camera found" in lowered:
0141:             event_type = "camera_detection_failed"
0142:             severity = max_severity(severity, "error")
0143:         elif "remote port forwarding failed" in lowered:
0144:             event_type = "ssh_tunnel_remote_port_busy"
0145:             severity = max_severity(severity, "error")
0146:         elif "connect fejlede" in lowered and "ssh tunnel" in lowered:
0147:             event_type = "ssh_tunnel_connect_failed"
0148:             severity = max_severity(severity, "warning")
0149:         elif "config drift" in lowered:
0150:             event_type = "camera_config_drift"
0151:             severity = max_severity(severity, "warning")
0152:         elif "traceback" in lowered or "exception" in lowered:
0153:             event_type = "application_exception"
0154:             severity = max_severity(severity, "error")
0155:         elif logger_name:
0156:             event_type = f"log_{logger_name.split('.')[0]}".lower()
0157: 
0158:     category = ev.get("category")
0159:     if event_type.startswith("ssh_tunnel"):
0160:         category = "connectivity"
0161:     elif event_type.startswith("camera"):
0162:         category = "camera"
0163:     elif event_type == "application_exception":
0164:         category = "application"
0165:     elif not category:
0166:         category = "application" if event_type.startswith("log_") else "security"
0167: 
0168:     return {
0169:         "event_type": event_type,
0170:         "severity": severity,
0171:         "category": category,
0172:         "raw_message": raw,
0173:         "normalized": {
0174:             "source": ev.get("source"),
0175:             "logger": logger_name or None,
0176:             "process": ev.get("process"),
0177:             "original_event_type": ev.get("event_type"),
0178:             "syslog": ev.get("syslog"),
0179:         },
0180:     }

0183: def max_severity(a: str, b: str) -> str:
0184:     order = {"debug": 0, "info": 1, "warning": 2, "error": 3, "critical": 4}
0185:     return a if order.get(a.lower(), 0) >= order.get(b.lower(), 0) else b

0190:     _ensure_schema(db)
0191:     inserted = 0

0244: def _check_api_rate_limit(device_id: str, event_count: int) -> None:
0245:     """Server-side SIEM API guard. Edge may buffer, Headend still enforces limits."""
0246:     max_batch = int(os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_SIEM_API_MAX_BATCH", "500"))
0247:     max_events_per_minute = int(os.getenv("TIMELAPSE_SIEM_API_MAX_EVENTS_PER_DEVICE_PER_MINUTE", "2000"))
0248:     if event_count > max_batch:
0249:         from fastapi import HTTPException
0250:         raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail=f"SIEM batch too large: {event_count}>{max_batch}")
0251: 
0252:     now = time.monotonic()
0253:     bucket = _API_RATE_BUCKETS[device_id]
0254:     while bucket and now - bucket[0] > 60:
0255:         bucket.popleft()
0256:     if len(bucket) + event_count > max_events_per_minute:
0257:         from fastapi import HTTPException
0258:         raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="SIEM rate limit exceeded")
0259:     bucket.extend([now] * event_count)

0262: def _line_to_headend_event(source: str, line: str, min_severity: str) -> Optional[dict]:
0263:     raw = line.strip()
0264:     if not raw or "SIEM:" in raw or "/api/siem/" in raw:
0265:         return None
0266: 
0267:     severity = "info"
0268:     logger_name = None
0269:     message = raw
0270:     occurred = _now()
0271: 
0272:     pylog = re.match(
0273:         r"^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+([A-Z]+)\s+([^\s]+)\s+(.*)$",
0274:         raw,
0275:     )
0276:     if pylog:
0277:         try:
0278:             local_tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
0279:             occurred = (
0280:                 datetime.strptime(pylog.group(1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
0281:                 .replace(tzinfo=local_tz)
0282:                 .astimezone(timezone.utc)
0283:             )
0284:         except Exception:
0285:             occurred = _now()
0286:         severity = pylog.group(2).lower()
0287:         if severity == "warn":
0288:             severity = "warning"
0289:         logger_name = pylog.group(3)
0290:         message = pylog.group(4)
0291:     elif "nginx" in source:
0292:         if re.search(r"\s5\d\d\s", raw):
0293:             severity = "error"
0294:         elif re.search(r"\s4\d\d\s", raw):
0295:             severity = "warning"
0296:         else:
0297:             severity = "info"
0298:         logger_name = "nginx"
0299: 
0300:     lowered = message.lower()
0301:     if "traceback" in lowered or "exception" in lowered:
0302:         severity = max_severity(severity, "error")
0303:     if "permission denied" in lowered or "unauthorized" in lowered:
0304:         severity = max_severity(severity, "warning")
0305: 
0306:     if _severity_rank(severity) < _severity_rank(min_severity):
0307:         return None
0308: 
0309:     return {
0310:         "event_type": "log",
0311:         "severity": severity,
0312:         "category": "headend_log",
0313:         "source": source,
0314:         "logger": logger_name,
0315:         "process": "headend",
0316:         "raw_message": message,
0317:         "occurred_at": occurred.isoformat(),
0318:     }

0338:     sources = [
0339:         Path(p) for p in os.getenv(
0340:             "TIMELAPSE_SIEM_HEADEND_LOGS",
0341:             "/var/log/timelapse-headend.log,/opt/homebrew/var/log/nginx-timelapse-error.log,/opt/homebrew/var/log/nginx-timelapse-access.log",

0346:     def load_state() -> dict:
0347:         try:
0348:             return json.loads(state_path.read_text())
0349:         except Exception:
0350:             return {}
0351: 
0352:     def save_state(state: dict) -> None:
0353:         try:
0354:             state_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0355:             state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state))
0356:         except Exception as exc:
0357:             log.debug("SIEM collector state write failed: %s", exc)

0359:     def read_new_lines(path: Path, state: dict) -> tuple[list[str], dict]:
0360:         key = str(path)
0361:         try:
0362:             stat = path.stat()
0363:         except FileNotFoundError:
0364:             return [], state
0365:         previous = state.get(key, {})
0366:         inode_changed = previous.get("inode") != stat.st_ino
0367:         offset = 0 if inode_changed else int(previous.get("offset", 0))
0368:         if offset > stat.st_size:
0369:             offset = 0
0370: 
0371:         with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
0372:             if offset == 0 and stat.st_size > 0:
0373:                 # Første kørsel tager kun halen, så vi ikke importerer hele historikken.
0374:                 fh.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
0375:                 end = fh.tell()
0376:                 fh.seek(max(0, end - 128_000))
0377:             else:
0378:                 fh.seek(offset)
0379:             lines = fh.readlines()[-max_lines:]
0380:             state[key] = {"inode": stat.st_ino, "offset": fh.tell()}
0381:         return lines, state
0382: 
0383:     def loop() -> None:
0384:         log.info("SIEM headend log collector started: min_severity=%s sources=%d", min_severity, len(sources))
0385:         while True:
0386:             try:
0387:                 state = load_state()
0388:                 batch: list[dict] = []
0389:                 for path in sources:
0390:                     lines, state = read_new_lines(path, state)
0391:                     for line in lines:
0392:                         ev = _line_to_headend_event(path.name, line, min_severity)
0393:                         if ev:
0394:                             batch.append(ev)
0395:                 if batch:
0396:                     from database import SessionLocal
0397:                     db = SessionLocal()
0398:                     try:
0399:                         record_events(db, "HEADEND-LOCAL", batch[-max_lines:])
0400:                     finally:
0401:                         db.close()
0402:                 save_state(state)
0403:             except Exception as exc:
0404:                 log.debug("SIEM headend log collector failed: %s", exc)
0405:             time.sleep(interval_s)
0406: 
0407:     threading.Thread(target=loop, name="siem-headend-log-collector", daemon=True).start()

0454: @router.get("/events")
0455: def get_events(
0456:     device_id:  Optional[str] = Query(None),
0457:     event_type: Optional[str] = Query(None),
0458:     severity:   Optional[str] = Query(None),
0459:     source_ip:  Optional[str] = Query(None),
0460:     hours:      int           = Query(24, ge=1, le=8760),
0461:     limit:      int           = Query(500, ge=1, le=2000),
0462:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
0463: ):
0464:     """Hent security events med filtrering."""
0465:     _ensure_schema(db)
0466:     since = _now() - timedelta(hours=hours)
0467:     q = db.query(SecurityEvent).filter(SecurityEvent.occurred_at >= since)
0468: 
0469:     if device_id:  q = q.filter(SecurityEvent.device_id  == device_id)
0470:     if event_type: q = q.filter(SecurityEvent.event_type == event_type)
0471:     if severity:   q = q.filter(SecurityEvent.severity   == severity)
0472:     if source_ip:  q = q.filter(SecurityEvent.source_ip  == source_ip)
0473: 
0474:     rows = q.order_by(SecurityEvent.occurred_at.desc()).limit(limit).all()
0475: 
0476:     return [_serialize(r) for r in rows]
0477:

0479: @router.get("/summary")
0480: def get_summary(
0481:     hours: int = Query(24, ge=1, le=8760),
0482:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
0483: ):
0484:     """Tæller pr. device / event_type / severity — til SIEM-dashboard."""
0485:     _ensure_schema(db)
0486:     since = _now() - timedelta(hours=hours)
0487: 
0488:     # Total pr. severity
0489:     severity_counts = db.execute(text("""
0490:         SELECT severity, COUNT(*) as count
0491:         FROM security_events
0492:         WHERE occurred_at >= :since
0493:         GROUP BY severity
0494:         ORDER BY count DESC
0495:     """), {"since": since}).fetchall()
0496: 
0497:     # Total pr. event_type
0498:     type_counts = db.execute(text("""
0499:         SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) as count
0500:         FROM security_events
0501:         WHERE occurred_at >= :since
0502:         GROUP BY event_type
0503:         ORDER BY count DESC
0504:     """), {"since": since}).fetchall()
0505: 
0506:     # Total pr. device
0507:     device_counts = db.execute(text("""
0508:         SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) as count
0509:         FROM security_events
0510:         WHERE occurred_at >= :since
0511:         GROUP BY device_id
0512:         ORDER BY count DESC
0513:     """), {"since": since}).fetchall()
0514: 
0515:     # Seneste kritiske event
0516:     latest_critical = db.query(SecurityEvent).filter(
0517:         SecurityEvent.occurred_at >= since,
0518:         SecurityEvent.severity == "critical"
0519:     ).order_by(SecurityEvent.occurred_at.desc()).first()
0520: 
0521:     return {
0522:         "period_hours":     hours,
0523:         "by_severity":      {r[0]: r[1] for r in severity_counts},
0524:         "by_event_type":    {r[0]: r[1] for r in type_counts},
0525:         "by_device":        {r[0]: r[1] for r in device_counts},
0526:         "total":            sum(r[1] for r in severity_counts),
0527:         "latest_critical":  _serialize(latest_critical) if latest_critical else None,
0528:     }

0531: @router.get("/threats")
0532: def get_threats(
0533:     hours:     int = Query(24, ge=1, le=168),
0534:     threshold: int = Query(5,  ge=1),
0535:     db: Session = Depends(get_db)
0536: ):

0538:     Brute force detektion — IPs med mere end `threshold` SSH-fejl.
0539:     Returnerer også geografisk info hvis tilgængeligt (fremtidigt).
0540:     """
0541:     _ensure_schema(db)
0542:     since = _now() - timedelta(hours=hours)
0543: 
0544:     rows = db.execute(text("""
0545:         SELECT source_ip, device_id, COUNT(*) as attempts,
0546:                MIN(occurred_at) as first_seen,
0547:                MAX(occurred_at) as last_seen
0548:         FROM security_events
0549:         WHERE event_type = 'ssh_failure'
0550:           AND source_ip IS NOT NULL
0551:           AND occurred_at >= :since
0552:         GROUP BY source_ip, device_id
0553:         HAVING COUNT(*) >= :threshold
0554:         ORDER BY attempts DESC
0555:         LIMIT 100
0556:     """), {"since": since, "threshold": threshold}).fetchall()
0557: 
0558:     return [
0559:         {
0560:             "source_ip":  r[0],
0561:             "device_id":  r[1],
0562:             "attempts":   r[2],
0563:             "first_seen": r[3].isoformat() if r[3] else None,
0564:             "last_seen":  r[4].isoformat() if r[4] else None,
0565:             "threat_level": (
0566:                 "critical" if r[2] >= 50 else
0567:                 "warning"  if r[2] >= 10 else
0568:                 "info"
0569:             ),
0570:         }
0571:         for r in rows
0572:     ]

0581:         "username":     r.username,
0582:         "source_ip":    r.source_ip,
0583:         "raw_message":  r.raw_message,
0584:         "source":       getattr(r, "source", None),
0585:         "category":     getattr(r, "category", None),
0586:         "logger":       getattr(r, "logger", None),
0587:         "process":      getattr(r, "process", None),
0588:         "normalized":   getattr(r, "normalized", None),
0589:         "occurred_at":  r.occurred_at.isoformat() if r.occurred_at else None,

0141:         text,

0154:         m3164 = re.match(

0156:             text,

0165:             if app_match:

0171:     event_type, category = _classify_message(message, app_name)

0196: class RateLimiter:
0197:     def __init__(self, per_minute: int):
0198:         self.per_minute = max(1, per_minute)
0199:         self._events: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)
0200: 
0201:     def allow(self, key: str) -> bool:
0202:         now = time.monotonic()
0203:         bucket = self._events[key]
0204:         while bucket and now - bucket[0] > 60:
0205:             bucket.popleft()
0206:         if len(bucket) >= self.per_minute:
0207:             return False
0208:         bucket.append(now)
0209:         return True
0210: 
0211: 
0212: class SyslogReceiver:
0213:     def __init__(self, host: str, port: int, protocols: set[str], allowlist: list[ipaddress._BaseNetwork],
0214:                  lab_accept_all: bool, rate_per_source_per_minute: int):

0217:         self.protocols = protocols
0218:         self.allowlist = allowlist
0219:         self.lab_accept_all = lab_accept_all
0220:         self.rate = RateLimiter(rate_per_source_per_minute)
0221:         self.selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
0222:         self.running = True
0223: 
0224:     def start(self) -> None:
0225:         if "udp" in self.protocols:
0226:             udp = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
0227:             udp.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
0228:             udp.bind((self.host, self.port))
0229:             udp.setblocking(False)
0230:             self.selector.register(udp, selectors.EVENT_READ, self._read_udp)
0231:         if "tcp" in self.protocols:
0232:             tcp = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
0233:             tcp.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
0234:             tcp.bind((self.host, self.port))
0235:             tcp.listen(100)
0236:             tcp.setblocking(False)
0237:             self.selector.register(tcp, selectors.EVENT_READ, self._accept_tcp)
0238:         LOG.info(
0239:             "Syslog receiver started host=%s port=%s protocols=%s lab_accept_all=%s allowlist=%s",
0240:             self.host, self.port, ",".join(sorted(self.protocols)), self.lab_accept_all, self.allowlist,
0241:         )
0242:         while self.running:
0243:             for key, _ in self.selector.select(timeout=1):
0244:                 key.data(key.fileobj)
0245: 
0246:     def stop(self, *_args) -> None:
0247:         self.running = False
0248: 
0249:     def _read_udp(self, sock: socket.socket) -> None:
0250:         data, addr = sock.recvfrom(65535)
0251:         self._handle(data, addr[0])
0252: 
0253:     def _accept_tcp(self, sock: socket.socket) -> None:
0254:         conn, addr = sock.accept()
0255:         conn.settimeout(3)
0256:         try:
0257:             chunks = []
0258:             while True:
0259:                 chunk = conn.recv(65535)
0260:                 if not chunk:
0261:                     break
0262:                 chunks.append(chunk)
0263:                 if b"\n" in chunk:
0264:                     break
0265:             for line in b"".join(chunks).splitlines():
0266:                 self._handle(line, addr[0])
0267:         finally:
0268:             conn.close()
0269: 
0270:     def _handle(self, data: bytes, source_ip: str) -> None:
0271:         if not _source_allowed(source_ip, self.allowlist, self.lab_accept_all):

### Raw source with line numbers

```python
0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """
0003: TimeLapse Pro - Headend update reconciliation.
0004: 
0005: Creates PendingUpdate records from CMDB installed-state and a Headend-owned
0006: update catalog. Edge reports what is installed; Headend decides what is missing.
0007: """
0008: from __future__ import annotations
0009: 
0010: import argparse
0011: import json
0012: import re
0013: import sys
0014: from collections import defaultdict
0015: from datetime import datetime, timezone
0016: from pathlib import Path
0017: from typing import Any
0018: 
0019: ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
0020: sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
0021: 
0022: from database import DeviceInventory, PendingUpdate, SessionLocal  # noqa: E402
0023: 
0024: 
0025: def main() -> int:
0026:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Reconcile CMDB installed-state with update catalog")
0027:     parser.add_argument("--device-id", required=True)
0028:     parser.add_argument("--catalog", help="JSON update catalog")
0029:     parser.add_argument("--from-apt-list", help="Parse apt list --upgradable output into a temporary catalog")
0030:     parser.add_argument("--environment", default="production", choices=["lab", "staging", "production"])
0031:     parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Show decisions without DB writes")
0032:     parser.add_argument("--create", action="store_true", help="Create pending update records")
0033:     args = parser.parse_args()
0034: 
0035:     if not args.catalog and not args.from_apt_list:
0036:         parser.error("use --catalog or --from-apt-list")
0037:     if args.dry_run and args.create:
0038:         parser.error("--dry-run and --create are mutually exclusive")
0039:     if not args.dry_run and not args.create:
0040:         parser.error("choose --dry-run or --create")
0041: 
0042:     catalog = (
0043:         catalog_from_apt_list(Path(args.from_apt_list), args.device_id)
0044:         if args.from_apt_list
0045:         else read_catalog(Path(args.catalog))
0046:     )
0047: 
0048:     db = SessionLocal()
0049:     try:
0050:         inv = db.query(DeviceInventory).filter_by(device_id=args.device_id).first()
0051:         if not inv:
0052:             raise SystemExit(f"CMDB inventory not found for {args.device_id}")
0053:         installed = json.loads(inv.os_packages or "{}")
0054:         decisions = reconcile(installed, catalog)
0055: 
0056:         print(json.dumps({
0057:             "device_id": args.device_id,
0058:             "environment": args.environment,
0059:             "catalog_source": catalog.get("source"),
0060:             "inventory_reported_at": inv.inventory_reported_at.isoformat() if inv.inventory_reported_at else None,
0061:             "decisions": decisions,
0062:         }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
0063: 
0064:         if args.create:
0065:             created = create_pending_updates(db, args.device_id, args.environment, decisions, catalog)
0066:             db.commit()
0067:             print(json.dumps({"created": created}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
0068:     finally:
0069:         db.close()
0070:     return 0
0071: 
0072: 
0073: def read_catalog(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
0074:     data = json.loads(path.read_text())
0075:     if not isinstance(data.get("packages"), list):
0076:         raise SystemExit("catalog must contain packages[]")
0077:     return data
0078: 
0079: 
0080: def catalog_from_apt_list(path: Path, device_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
0081:     packages = []
0082:     for line in path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
0083:         parsed = parse_apt_line(line)
0084:         if parsed:
0085:             packages.append(parsed)
0086:     return {
0087:         "schema": "dk.froekjaer.timelapse.update-catalog.v1",
0088:         "source": f"lab-import:apt-list:{device_id}",
0089:         "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
0090:         "packages": packages,
0091:     }
0092: 
0093: 
0094: def parse_apt_line(line: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
0095:     if not line or line.startswith("Listing"):
0096:         return None
0097:     # curl/noble-updates,noble-security 8.5.0-x arm64 [upgradable from: 8.5.0-y]
0098:     match = re.match(r"([^/]+)/(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+\S+\s+\[upgradable from:\s+([^\]]+)\]", line)
0099:     if not match:
0100:         return None
0101:     name, repos, available, installed = match.groups()
0102:     category = "os_security" if "security" in repos else "os_updates"
0103:     return {
0104:         "name": name,
0105:         "installed_version": installed,
0106:         "available_version": available,
0107:         "category": category,
0108:         "severity": "high" if category == "os_security" else "low",
0109:         "source_repo": repos,
0110:     }
0111: 
0112: 
0113: def reconcile(installed: dict[str, str], catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
0114:     grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
0115:     for package in catalog.get("packages", []):
0116:         name = package.get("name")
0117:         available = package.get("available_version")
0118:         category = package.get("category") or "os_updates"
0119:         if category not in {"os_security", "os_updates"}:
0120:             continue
0121:         installed_version = installed.get(name)
0122:         if not name or not available or not installed_version:
0123:             continue
0124:         if installed_version == available:
0125:             continue
0126:         grouped[category].append({
0127:             "name": name,
0128:             "installed_version": installed_version,
0129:             "available_version": available,
0130:             "severity": package.get("severity") or ("high" if category == "os_security" else "low"),
0131:             "source_repo": package.get("source_repo"),
0132:         })
0133: 
0134:     decisions = {}
0135:     for category, packages in grouped.items():
0136:         severities = {p["severity"] for p in packages}
0137:         severity = "high" if "high" in severities else "medium" if "medium" in severities else "low"
0138:         decisions[category] = {
0139:             "package_count": len(packages),
0140:             "severity": severity,
0141:             "packages": packages[:50],
0142:             "truncated": max(0, len(packages) - 50),
0143:         }
0144:     return decisions
0145: 
0146: 
0147: def create_pending_updates(
0148:     db,
0149:     device_id: str,
0150:     environment: str,
0151:     decisions: dict[str, Any],
0152:     catalog: dict[str, Any],
0153: ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
0154:     created = []
0155:     for update_type, decision in decisions.items():
0156:         existing = (
0157:             db.query(PendingUpdate)
0158:             .filter(
0159:                 PendingUpdate.update_type == update_type,
0160:                 PendingUpdate.scope == "device",
0161:                 PendingUpdate.scope_id == device_id,
0162:                 PendingUpdate.status.in_(["pending", "approved"]),
0163:             )
0164:             .first()
0165:         )
0166:         if existing:
0167:             created.append({"update_type": update_type, "status": "exists", "id": existing.id})
0168:             continue
0169: 
0170:         count = int(decision["package_count"])
0171:         label = "sikkerhedsopdatering(er)" if update_type == "os_security" else "funktionelle OS-opdatering(er)"
0172:         update = PendingUpdate(
0173:             update_type=update_type,
0174:             version=f"{count} pakker",
0175:             description=(
0176:                 f"{count} {label} klar via Headend update catalog "
0177:                 f"({catalog.get('source', 'unknown source')})"
0178:             ),
0179:             severity=decision["severity"],
0180:             scope="device",
0181:             scope_id=device_id,
0182:             status="pending",
0183:             environment=environment,
0184:         )
0185:         db.add(update)
0186:         db.flush()
0187:         created.append({"update_type": update_type, "status": "created", "id": update.id})
0188:     return created
0189: 
0190: 
0191: if __name__ == "__main__":
0192:     raise SystemExit(main())
```

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Audit and migrate TimeLapse Pro capture storage layout.
0003: 
0004: Canonical layout:
0005:   <storage_root>/<customer>/<site>/<camera>/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/<filename>
0006: 
0007: The tool is conservative:
0008:   - dry-run by default
0009:   - writes a JSONL manifest
0010:   - moves image, JSON sidecar, Edge thumbnail and Headend fallback thumbnail together
0011:   - never deletes empty legacy directories
0012: """

0014: from __future__ import annotations
0015:

0017: import json

0025:

0027:

0029: 
0030: 
0031: DATE_RE = re.compile(r"_(20\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})_\d{6}\.\w+$")
0032: 
0033: 
0034: def safe(value: str | None, fallback: str = "unknown") -> str:
0035:     text = str(value or "").strip() or fallback
0036:     text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9æøåÆØÅ_-]+", "_", text).strip("_")
0037:     return text or fallback

0040: def split_filename(filename: str) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, str | None]:
0041:     stem = Path(filename).stem
0042:     parts = stem.split("_")
0043:     date_idx = next((idx for idx, part in enumerate(parts) if re.fullmatch(r"20\d{6}", part)), -1)
0044:     if date_idx <= 0:
0045:         return None, None, None
0046:     prefix = parts[:date_idx]
0047:     if len(prefix) >= 3:
0048:         return prefix[0], "_".join(prefix[1:-2]) or None, "_".join(prefix[-2:]) or None
0049:     return None, None, None
0050: 
0051:

0053:     if capture.captured_at:
0054:         return capture.captured_at.strftime("%Y"), capture.captured_at.strftime("%m"), capture.captured_at.strftime("%d")
0055:     match = DATE_RE.search(capture.filename or "")
0056:     if match:
0057:         return match.group(1), match.group(2), match.group(3)
0058:     now = datetime.utcnow()
0059:     return now.strftime("%Y"), now.strftime("%m"), now.strftime("%d")
0060:
