0065: def build_file_index(root: Path) -> dict[str, list[Path]]:
0066:     index: dict[str, list[Path]] = defaultdict(list)
0067:     ignored_parts = {"_backups", ".thumbs", ".headend-thumbs"}
0068:     for path in root.rglob("*"):
0069:         if not path.is_file():
0070:             continue
0071:         if ignored_parts.intersection(path.parts):
0072:             continue
0073:         if path.suffix.lower() not in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
0074:             continue
0075:         index[path.name].append(path)

0078: 
0079: def find_image(root: Path, capture: Capture, file_index: dict[str, list[Path]]) -> Path | None:
0080:     filename = capture.filename or ""
0081:     yyyy, mm, dd = capture_date_parts(capture)
0082:     patterns = [
0083:         root / capture.device_id / yyyy / mm / dd / filename,
0084:         root / capture.device_id / filename,
0085:     ]
0086:     for path in patterns:
0087:         if path.exists():
0088:             return path
0089:     matches = file_index.get(filename, [])

0091:

0093: def target_for(root: Path, capture: Capture, device: Device | None, site: Site | None, customer: Customer | None) -> Path:
0094:     file_customer, file_site, file_camera = split_filename(capture.filename or "")
0095:     customer_name = customer.name if customer else (device.customer_name if device else None) or file_customer
0096:     site_name = site.name if site else (device.site_name if device else None) or file_site
0097:     camera_name = (device.camera_name if device else None) or file_camera or capture.device_id
0098:     yyyy, mm, dd = capture_date_parts(capture)
0099:     return (
0100:         root
0101:         / safe(customer_name)
0102:         / safe(site_name)
0103:         / safe(camera_name)
0104:         / yyyy
0105:         / mm
0106:         / dd
0107:         / (capture.filename or "")

0110: 
0111: def move_one(src: Path, dst: Path, apply: bool) -> dict:
0112:     result = {"src": str(src), "dst": str(dst), "status": "planned"}
0113:     if src == dst:
0114:         result["status"] = "already_canonical"
0115:         return result
0116:     if dst.exists():
0117:         result["status"] = "target_exists"
0118:         return result
0119:     if apply:
0120:         dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0121:         shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
0122:         result["status"] = "moved"
0123:     return result
0124: 
0125: 
0126: def companion_moves(src: Path, dst: Path, apply: bool) -> list[dict]:
0127:     moves = [move_one(src, dst, apply)]
0128:     sidecar = src.with_suffix(".json")
0129:     if sidecar.exists():
0130:         moves.append(move_one(sidecar, dst.with_suffix(".json"), apply))
0131:     for thumb_dir in (".thumbs", ".headend-thumbs"):
0132:         thumb = src.parent / thumb_dir / src.name
0133:         if thumb.exists():
0134:             moves.append(move_one(thumb, dst.parent / thumb_dir / dst.name, apply))
0135:     return moves

0138: def main() -> int:
0139:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
0140:     parser.add_argument("--root", default=os.getenv("SFTP_BASE", "/Volumes/data"))
0141:     parser.add_argument("--manifest", default="/private/tmp/timelapse-storage-migration.jsonl")
0142:     parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
0143:     parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0)
0144:     parser.add_argument("--device-id", help="Only migrate captures for this device id")
0145:     parser.add_argument("--filename-contains", help="Only migrate captures where filename contains this text")
0146:     args = parser.parse_args()
0147: 
0148:     root = Path(args.root)
0149:     if not root.exists():
0150:         raise SystemExit(f"SFTP root findes ikke: {root}")
0151:     file_index = build_file_index(root)
0152:     db = SessionLocal()
0153:     manifest = Path(args.manifest)
0154:     manifest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0155:     counts: dict[str, int] = {}
0156:     processed = 0
0157:     try:
0158:         query = db.query(Capture).order_by(Capture.captured_at.asc().nullslast(), Capture.id.asc())
0159:         if args.device_id:
0160:             query = query.filter(Capture.device_id == args.device_id)
0161:         if args.filename_contains:
0162:             query = query.filter(Capture.filename.contains(args.filename_contains))
0163:         if args.limit:
0164:             query = query.limit(args.limit)
0165:         with manifest.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
0166:             for capture in query:
0167:                 processed += 1
0168:                 device = db.query(Device).filter_by(device_id=capture.device_id).first()
0169:                 site = db.query(Site).filter_by(id=device.site_id).first() if device and device.site_id else None
0170:                 customer_id = site.customer_id if site else (device.customer_id if device else None)
0171:                 customer = db.query(Customer).filter_by(id=customer_id).first() if customer_id else None
0172:                 src = find_image(root, capture, file_index)
0173:                 if not src:
0174:                     record = {"capture_id": capture.id, "filename": capture.filename, "status": "missing_source"}
0175:                     counts["missing_source"] = counts.get("missing_source", 0) + 1
0176:                 else:
0177:                     dst = target_for(root, capture, device, site, customer)
0178:                     moves = companion_moves(src, dst, args.apply)
0179:                     status = moves[0]["status"]
0180:                     counts[status] = counts.get(status, 0) + 1
0181:                     record = {"capture_id": capture.id, "device_id": capture.device_id, "moves": moves, "status": status}
0182:                 fh.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0183:     finally:
0184:         db.close()
0185:     print(json.dumps({
0186:         "processed": processed,
0187:         "apply": args.apply,
0188:         "indexed_files": sum(len(v) for v in file_index.values()),
0189:         "counts": counts,
0190:         "manifest": str(manifest),
0191:     }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
0192:     return 0
0193: 
0194: 
0195: if __name__ == "__main__":
0196:     raise SystemExit(main())

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0003: # TimeLapse Pro — Node Agent
0004: # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0005: # Version  : 1.0.0
0006: # Dato     : 2026-05-11
0007: # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0008: # Universel agent der kører på ALLE noder (edge + headend).
0009: # Samler hardware-inventar og security events og poster til headend.
0010: #
0011: # Kørsel:
0012: #   python3 agent.py --config /etc/timelapse/node-agent.conf
0013: #
0014: # Installeres som:
0015: #   Linux  : systemd service (via install/linux.sh)
0016: #   macOS  : launchd plist   (via install/macos.sh)
0017: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0018: 
0019: from __future__ import annotations
0020: 
0021: import argparse
0022: import logging
0023: import signal
0024: import sys
0025: import time
0026: from pathlib import Path
0027: 
0028: from config import NodeAgentConfig
0029: from collectors.inventory import collect_inventory
0030: from collectors.security import collect_security_events
0031: from transport import post_inventory, post_security_events
0032: 
0033: # ── Logging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0034: logging.basicConfig(
0035:     level=logging.INFO,
0036:     format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)-8s %(name)-30s %(message)s",
0037:     datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
0038: )
0039: log = logging.getLogger("node-agent")
0040: 
0041: # ── Graceful shutdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0042: _running = True
0043: 
0044: def _handle_signal(sig, frame):
0045:     global _running
0046:     log.info("Signal %s modtaget — lukker ned", sig)
0047:     _running = False
0048: 
0049: signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _handle_signal)
0050: signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _handle_signal)
0051: 
0052: 
0053: # ── Hovedloop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0054: 
0055: def run(cfg: NodeAgentConfig) -> None:
0056:     log.info("Node Agent starter — device_id=%s headend=%s",
0057:              cfg.device_id, cfg.headend_url)
0058: 
0059:     # Første kørsel sker straks ved startup
0060:     last_inventory = 0.0
0061:     last_security  = 0.0
0062: 
0063:     while _running:
0064:         now = time.time()
0065: 
0066:         # ── Inventar (hvert inventory_interval sekunder) ──────────────────
0067:         if now - last_inventory >= cfg.inventory_interval:
0068:             try:
0069:                 log.info("Samler inventar...")
0070:                 inv = collect_inventory(cfg)
0071:                 ok, msg = post_inventory(cfg, inv)
0072:                 if ok:
0073:                     log.info("Inventar rapporteret OK")
0074:                 else:
0075:                     log.warning("Inventar-rapportering fejlede: %s", msg)
0076:             except Exception as e:
0077:                 log.warning("Inventar-fejl (uventet): %s", e)
0078:             last_inventory = now
0079: 
0080:         # ── Security events (hvert security_interval sekunder) ────────────
0081:         if now - last_security >= cfg.security_interval:
0082:             try:
0083:                 events = collect_security_events(cfg)
0084:                 if events:
0085:                     log.info("Poster %d security events", len(events))
0086:                     ok, msg = post_security_events(cfg, events)
0087:                     if not ok:
0088:                         log.warning("Security events fejlede: %s", msg)
0089:                 else:
0090:                     log.debug("Ingen nye security events")
0091:             except Exception as e:
0092:                 log.warning("Security-fejl (uventet): %s", e)
0093:             last_security = now
0094: 
0095:         # Sov 10 sekunder ad gangen (responsiv til shutdown)
0096:         for _ in range(10):
0097:             if not _running:
0098:                 break
0099:             time.sleep(1)
0100: 
0101:     log.info("Node Agent stoppet")
0102: 
0103: 
0104: # ── Entrypoint ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0105: 
0106: if __name__ == "__main__":
0107:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="TimeLapse Pro Node Agent")
0108:     parser.add_argument(
0109:         "--config", "-c",
0110:         default="/etc/timelapse/node-agent.conf",
0111:         help="Sti til konfigurationsfil"
0112:     )
0113:     args = parser.parse_args()
0114: 
0115:     config_path = Path(args.config)
0116:     if not config_path.exists():
0117:         log.error("Konfigurationsfil ikke fundet: %s", config_path)
0118:         log.error("Opret den med install/linux.sh eller install/macos.sh")
0119:         sys.exit(1)
0120: 
0121:     cfg = NodeAgentConfig.load(config_path)
0122:     run(cfg)
```

0001: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0002: # TimeLapse Pro — Security Events Collector
0003: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0004: """
0005: Samler security events fra systemlogs på Linux og macOS.
0006: 
0007: Events der samles:
0008:   ssh_failure     — Mislykket SSH login (brute force detektion)
0009:   ssh_success     — Vellykket SSH login
0010:   sudo_use        — sudo-kommando udført
0011:   sudo_failure    — sudo afvist (forkert password / ingen rettighed)
0012:   service_crash   — systemd/launchd service crashet
0013:   new_user        — ny bruger oprettet på systemet
0014:   passwd_change   — password ændret

0016: 
0017: from __future__ import annotations
0018: 
0019: import logging
0020: import platform
0021: import re
0022: import subprocess
0023: from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
0024: from typing import Optional
0025: 
0026: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0027: 
0028: # ── Event type konstanter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
0029: SSH_FAILURE    = "ssh_failure"
0030: SSH_SUCCESS    = "ssh_success"
0031: SUDO_USE       = "sudo_use"
0032: SUDO_FAILURE   = "sudo_failure"
0033: SERVICE_CRASH  = "service_crash"
0034: NEW_USER       = "new_user"
0035: PASSWD_CHANGE  = "passwd_change"
0036: HTTP_ERROR         = "http_error"
0037: SUSPICIOUS_REQUEST = "suspicious_request"
0038: 
0039: SEVERITY_INFO     = "info"
0040: SEVERITY_WARNING  = "warning"
0041: SEVERITY_CRITICAL = "critical"
0042: 
0043: EVENT_SEVERITY = {
0044:     SSH_FAILURE:   SEVERITY_WARNING,
0045:     SSH_SUCCESS:   SEVERITY_INFO,
0046:     SUDO_USE:      SEVERITY_INFO,
0047:     SUDO_FAILURE:  SEVERITY_WARNING,
0048:     SERVICE_CRASH: SEVERITY_CRITICAL,
0049:     NEW_USER:      SEVERITY_WARNING,
0050:     PASSWD_CHANGE: SEVERITY_WARNING,
0051: }
0052: 
0053: 
0054: def _now_utc() -> datetime:
0055:     return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
0056: 
0057: 
0058: def _since_iso(lookback_seconds: int) -> str:
0059:     """ISO8601 timestamp for X sekunder siden."""
0060:     return (_now_utc() - timedelta(seconds=lookback_seconds)).isoformat()
0061: 
0062: 
0063: # ── Linux collector (journalctl) ──────────────────────────────────────────

0065: # SSH patterns
0066: _SSH_FAIL_RE = re.compile(

0068: )
0069: _SSH_OK_RE = re.compile(
0070:     r"Accepted (?:password|publickey) for (\S+) from ([\d.]+)"
0071: )
0072: _SUDO_OK_RE = re.compile(
0073:     r"sudo:\s+(\S+)\s*:.*COMMAND=(.*)"
0074: )
0075: _SUDO_FAIL_RE = re.compile(
0076:     r"sudo:\s+(\S+)\s*:.*user NOT in sudoers|authentication failure"
0077: )
0078: _NEW_USER_RE = re.compile(
0079:     r"new user: name=(\S+)"
0080: )
0081: _PASSWD_RE = re.compile(
0082:     r"password changed for (\S+)"
0083: )
0084: 
0085: 
0086: def _collect_linux(lookback_seconds: int) -> list[dict]:
0087:     events = []
0088:     since = (_now_utc() - timedelta(seconds=lookback_seconds)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
0089: 
0090:     # ── SSH events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0091:     try:
0092:         out = subprocess.run(
0093:             ["journalctl", "-u", "ssh", "-u", "sshd",
0094:              "--since", since, "--no-pager", "-o", "short-iso"],
0095:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
0096:         ).stdout
0097: 
0098:         for line in out.splitlines():
0099:             ts = _parse_journalctl_ts(line)
0100: 
0101:             m = _SSH_FAIL_RE.search(line)
0102:             if m:
0103:                 events.append(_event(SSH_FAILURE, ts,
0104:                     username=m.group(1), source_ip=m.group(2),
0105:                     raw=line.strip()))
0106:                 continue
0107: 
0108:             m = _SSH_OK_RE.search(line)
0109:             if m:
0110:                 events.append(_event(SSH_SUCCESS, ts,
0111:                     username=m.group(1), source_ip=m.group(2),
0112:                     raw=line.strip()))
0113:     except Exception as e:
0114:         log.debug("SSH journal fejl: %s", e)
0115: 
0116:     # ── Sudo events ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0117:     try:
0118:         out = subprocess.run(
0119:             ["journalctl", "_COMM=sudo",
0120:              "--since", since, "--no-pager", "-o", "short-iso"],
0121:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
0122:         ).stdout
0123: 
0124:         for line in out.splitlines():
0125:             ts = _parse_journalctl_ts(line)
0126: 
0127:             m = _SUDO_OK_RE.search(line)
0128:             if m:
0129:                 events.append(_event(SUDO_USE, ts,
0130:                     username=m.group(1),
0131:                     raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0132:                 continue
0133: 
0134:             if _SUDO_FAIL_RE.search(line):
0135:                 events.append(_event(SUDO_FAILURE, ts, raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0136:     except Exception as e:

0138: 
0139:     # ── Service crashes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
0140:     try:
0141:         out = subprocess.run(
0142:             ["journalctl", "-p", "err",

0144:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
0145:         ).stdout
0146: 
0147:         for line in out.splitlines():
0148:             if "failed" in line.lower() and ("service" in line.lower() or "unit" in line.lower()):
0149:                 ts = _parse_journalctl_ts(line)

0151:     except Exception as e:
0152:         log.debug("Service crash journal fejl: %s", e)
0153: 
0154:     # ── Nye brugere / password-ændringer ─────────────────────────────────
0155:     try:
0156:         out = subprocess.run(
0157:             ["journalctl", "--since", since, "--no-pager",
0158:              "-o", "short-iso", "-g", "new user|password changed"],
0159:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
0160:         ).stdout
0161: 
0162:         for line in out.splitlines():
0163:             ts = _parse_journalctl_ts(line)
0164:             m = _NEW_USER_RE.search(line)
0165:             if m:
0166:                 events.append(_event(NEW_USER, ts,
0167:                     username=m.group(1), raw=line.strip()))
0168:                 continue
0169:             m = _PASSWD_RE.search(line)

0171:                 events.append(_event(PASSWD_CHANGE, ts,
0172:                     username=m.group(1), raw=line.strip()))
0173:     except Exception as e:

0175: 
0176:     return events

0179: def _parse_journalctl_ts(line: str) -> str:
0180:     """Forsøger at parse ISO timestamp fra journalctl short-iso output."""

0184:         if m:
0185:             return m.group(1)
0186:     except Exception:

0188:     return _now_utc().isoformat()

0195: )
0196: _MACOS_SSH_OK_RE = re.compile(
0197:     r"Accepted (?:password|publickey) for (\S+) from ([\d.]+)"
0198: )
0199: _MACOS_SUDO_RE = re.compile(
0200:     r"sudo\[.*\].*:\s+(\S+)\s*:.*COMMAND=(.*)"
0201: )

0204: def _collect_macos(lookback_seconds: int) -> list[dict]:
0205:     events = []

0213:             ["log", "show",

0215:              "--start", since_str,
0216:              "--style", "syslog"],
0217:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
0218:         ).stdout
0219: 
0220:         for line in out.splitlines():
0221:             ts = _parse_macos_ts(line)
0222:             m = _MACOS_SSH_FAIL_RE.search(line)
0223:             if m:
0224:                 events.append(_event(SSH_FAILURE, ts,
0225:                     username=m.group(1), source_ip=m.group(2),
0226:                     raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0227:                 continue
0228:             m = _MACOS_SSH_OK_RE.search(line)
0229:             if m:
0230:                 events.append(_event(SSH_SUCCESS, ts,
0231:                     username=m.group(1), source_ip=m.group(2),
0232:                     raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0233:     except Exception as e:
0234:         log.debug("macOS SSH log fejl: %s", e)
0235: 
0236:     # ── Sudo via log show ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
0237:     try:
0238:         out = subprocess.run(
0239:             ["log", "show",
0240:              "--predicate", 'process == "sudo"',
0241:              "--start", since_str,
0242:              "--style", "syslog"],
0243:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
0244:         ).stdout
0245: 
0246:         for line in out.splitlines():
0247:             ts = _parse_macos_ts(line)
0248:             m = _MACOS_SUDO_RE.search(line)
0249:             if m:
0250:                 events.append(_event(SUDO_USE, ts,
0251:                     username=m.group(1),
0252:                     raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0253:     except Exception as e:
0254:         log.debug("macOS sudo log fejl: %s", e)
0255: 
0256:     # ── Launchd crashes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
0257:     try:
0258:         out = subprocess.run(
0259:             ["log", "show",
0260:              "--predicate", 'process == "launchd" AND messageType == "error"',
0261:              "--start", since_str,
0262:              "--style", "syslog"],
0263:             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15
0264:         ).stdout
0265: 
0266:         for line in out.splitlines():
0267:             if "failed" in line.lower() or "crash" in line.lower():
0268:                 ts = _parse_macos_ts(line)
0269:                 events.append(_event(SERVICE_CRASH, ts, raw=line.strip()[:200]))
0270:     except Exception as e:

0272: 
0273:     return events
0274:

0276: def _parse_macos_ts(line: str) -> str:
0277:     try:
0278:         m = re.match(r"(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})", line)
0279:         if m:
0280:             dt = datetime.strptime(m.group(1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
0281:             return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()
0282:     except Exception:
0283:         pass
0284:     return _now_utc().isoformat()
0285: 
0286: 
0287: 
0288: 
0289: def _collect_nginx(log_path: str, lookback_seconds: int) -> list[dict]:
0290:     """Parser nginx access log for security events."""
0291:     events = []
0292:     since = _now_utc() - __import__('datetime').timedelta(seconds=lookback_seconds)
0293:     SUSPICIOUS = [".env", "wp-admin", "phpmyadmin", ".git", "xmlrpc",
0294:                   "shell", "passwd", "etc/shadow", "cmd=", "eval("]
0295:     try:
0296:         with open(log_path) as f:
0297:             for line in f:
0298:                 m = re.match(
0299:                     r"([\d.]+) .+ \[(.+?)\] \"(\S+) (\S+) \S+\" (\d+)",
0300:                     line
0301:                 )
0302:                 if not m:
0303:                     continue
0304:                 ip, ts_str, method, path_req, status = m.groups()
0305:                 status = int(status)
0306:                 try:
0307:                     from datetime import datetime
0308:                     ts = datetime.strptime(ts_str, "%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z")
0309:                 except Exception:
0310:                     continue
0311:                 if ts < since:
0312:                     continue
0313:                 ts_iso = ts.isoformat()
0314:                 if status >= 400:
0315:                     events.append(_event(
0316:                         "http_error", ts_iso,
0317:                         source_ip=ip,
0318:                         raw=f"{method} {path_req} -> {status}"
0319:                     ))
0320:                 if any(s in path_req.lower() for s in SUSPICIOUS):
0321:                     events.append(_event(
0322:                         "suspicious_request", ts_iso,
0323:                         source_ip=ip,
0324:                         raw=f"{method} {path_req} -> {status}"
0325:                     ))
0326:     except Exception as e:
0327:         log.debug("Nginx log fejl: %s", e)
0328:     return events
0329: 
0330: # ── Fælles event-builder ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
0331: 
0332: def _event(event_type: str, occurred_at: str,
0333:            username: Optional[str] = None,
0334:            source_ip: Optional[str] = None,
0335:            raw: str = "") -> dict:
0336:     return {
0337:         "event_type":  event_type,
0338:         "severity":    EVENT_SEVERITY.get(event_type, SEVERITY_INFO),
0339:         "username":    username,
0340:         "source_ip":   source_ip,
0341:         "raw_message": raw,
0342:         "occurred_at": occurred_at,
0343:     }
0344: 
0345: 
0346: # ── Offentlig API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0347: 
0348: def collect_security_events(cfg) -> list[dict]:
0349:     """
0350:     Samler security events for lookback_seconds siden.
0351:     Returnerer liste af event-dicts klar til POST.
0352:     """
0353:     is_macos = platform.system() == "Darwin"
0354:     try:
0355:         if is_macos:
0356:             events = _collect_macos(cfg.security_lookback)
0357:         else:
0358:             events = _collect_linux(cfg.security_lookback)
0359:         log.debug("Security collector: %d events fundet (%s)",
0360:                   len(events), "macOS" if is_macos else "Linux")
0361:         # Nginx access log
0362:         nginx_log = getattr(cfg, 'nginx_access_log', '')
0363:         if nginx_log:
0364:             from pathlib import Path
0365:             if Path(nginx_log).exists():
0366:                 events.extend(_collect_nginx(nginx_log, cfg.security_lookback))
0367: 
0368:         return events
0369:     except Exception as e:
0370:         log.warning("Security collector fejlede: %s", e)
0371:         return []

0001: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

0004: from __future__ import annotations
0005:

0007: import platform
0008: from dataclasses import dataclass, field

0010: 
0011: 
0012: @dataclass
0013: class NodeAgentConfig:
0014:     # Identitet
0015:     device_id:          str
0016:     headend_url:        str         # https://timelapse.froekjaer.dk
0017: 
0018:     # Intervaller (sekunder)
0019:     inventory_interval: int = 300   # 5 min
0020:     security_interval:  int = 60    # 1 min
0021: 
0022:     # Platform (auto-detekteret)
0023:     platform:           str = field(default_factory=lambda: (
0024:         "macos" if platform.system() == "Darwin" else "linux"
0025:     ))
0026: 
0027:     # Security collector config
0028:     security_lookback:  int = 120   # Kig X sekunder tilbage ved hvert poll
0029:     ssh_log_path:       str = ""    # Auto-detekteret hvis tom
0030: 
0031:     # Auth
0032:     api_token:          str = ""
0033:     nginx_access_log:   str = ""    # Til fremtidig JWT-auth
0034: 
0035:     @classmethod
0036:     def load(cls, path: Path) -> "NodeAgentConfig":
0037:         cp = configparser.ConfigParser()
0038:         cp.read(path)
0039:         s = cp["agent"]
0040: 
0041:         cfg = cls(
0042:             device_id          = s["device_id"],
0043:             headend_url        = s["headend_url"].rstrip("/"),
0044:             inventory_interval = int(s.get("inventory_interval", "300")),
0045:             security_interval  = int(s.get("security_interval",  "60")),
0046:             security_lookback  = int(s.get("security_lookback",  "120")),

### Raw source with line numbers

```python
0001: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0002: # TimeLapse Pro — Node Agent Transport
0003: # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0004: from __future__ import annotations
0005: 
0006: import json
0007: import logging
0008: import urllib.error
0009: import urllib.request
0010: from typing import Any
0011: 
0012: log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0013: 
0014: TIMEOUT = 15
0015: 
0016: 
0017: def _post(url: str, payload: Any, token: str = "") -> tuple[bool, str]:
0018:     data = json.dumps(payload).encode()
0019:     headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
0020:     if token:
0021:         headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
0022:     try:
0023:         req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST")
0024:         with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT) as resp:
0025:             body = resp.read().decode()
0026:             return True, body
0027:     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
0028:         return False, f"HTTP {e.code}: {e.reason}"
0029:     except Exception as e:
0030:         return False, str(e)
0031: 
0032: 
0033: def post_inventory(cfg, payload: dict) -> tuple[bool, str]:
0034:     url = f"{cfg.headend_url}/api/inventory/{cfg.device_id}"
0035:     return _post(url, payload, cfg.api_token)
0036: 
0037: 
0038: def post_security_events(cfg, events: list[dict]) -> tuple[bool, str]:
0039:     url = f"{cfg.headend_url}/api/siem/events/{cfg.device_id}"
0040:     return _post(url, {"events": events}, cfg.api_token)
```

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """
0003: generate_source_inventory.py
0004: 
0005: Genererer en Markdown-fil med alle .py og .tsx filer i projektet.
0006: Brug:
0007:     python3 generate_source_inventory.py /sti/til/projekt TimeLapse_SourceCode_Inventory.md
0008: """
0009: 
0010: from pathlib import Path
0011: import sys
0012: from datetime import datetime
0013: 
0014: EXCLUDE_DIRS = {
0015:     ".git",
0016:     "__pycache__",
0017:     "node_modules",
0018:     "dist",
0019:     "build",
0020:     ".venv",
0021:     "venv",
0022:     ".next",
0023:     ".turbo",
0024:     ".pytest_cache",
0025:     ".mypy_cache",
0026: }
0027: 
0028: INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS = {".py", ".tsx"}
0029: 
0030: 
0031: def should_skip(path: Path) -> bool:
0032:     return any(part in EXCLUDE_DIRS for part in path.parts)
0033: 
0034: 
0035: def language_for_suffix(suffix: str) -> str:
0036:     if suffix == ".py":
0037:         return "python"
0038:     if suffix == ".tsx":
0039:         return "tsx"
0040:     return ""
0041: 
0042: 
0043: def collect_files(root: Path):
0044:     files = []
0045:     for path in root.rglob("*"):
0046:         if path.is_file() and path.suffix in INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS and not should_skip(path):
0047:             files.append(path)
0048:     return sorted(files)
0049: 
0050: 
0051: def main():
0052:     if len(sys.argv) < 2:
0053:         print("Brug: python3 generate_source_inventory.py /sti/til/projekt [output.md]")
0054:         sys.exit(1)
0055: 
0056:     root = Path(sys.argv[1]).expanduser().resolve()
0057:     output = Path(sys.argv[2]).expanduser().resolve() if len(sys.argv) > 2 else Path("TimeLapse_SourceCode_Inventory.md").resolve()
0058: 
0059:     if not root.exists():
0060:         print(f"Projektmappe findes ikke: {root}")
0061:         sys.exit(1)
0062: 
0063:     files = collect_files(root)
0064: 
0065:     with output.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
0066:         f.write("# TimeLapse Pro — Source Code Inventory\n\n")
0067:         f.write(f"Generated: {datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}\n\n")
0068:         f.write(f"Project root: `{root}`\n\n")
0069:         f.write(f"Included file types: `{', '.join(sorted(INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS))}`\n\n")
0070:         f.write(f"Files found: **{len(files)}**\n\n")
0071: 
0072:         f.write("## File Index\n\n")
0073:         for path in files:
0074:             rel = path.relative_to(root)
0075:             f.write(f"- `{rel}`\n")
0076:         f.write("\n---\n\n")
0077: 
0078:         for path in files:
0079:             rel = path.relative_to(root)
0080:             lang = language_for_suffix(path.suffix)
0081: 
0082:             f.write(f"## `{rel}`\n\n")
0083:             f.write("### Raw source with line numbers\n\n")
0084:             f.write(f"```{lang}\n")
0085: 
0086:             try:
0087:                 lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
0088:             except Exception as e:
0089:                 f.write(f"# ERROR reading file: {e}\n")
0090:                 f.write("```\n\n")
0091:                 continue
0092: 
0093:             for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
0094:                 f.write(f"{i:04d}: {line}\n")
0095: 
0096:             f.write("```\n\n")
0097:             f.write("### Description placeholder\n\n")
0098:             f.write("_To be filled by ChatGPT: purpose, imports, constants, functions, classes, data flow, side effects, security considerations, and improvement suggestions._\n\n")
0099:             f.write("---\n\n")
0100: 
0101:     print(f"Generated: {output}")
0102:     print(f"Files included: {len(files)}")
0103: 
0104: 
0105: if __name__ == "__main__":
0106:     main()
```

0036: function RequireAuth({ children }: { children: ReactElement }) {

0038:   const location = useLocation()

0054:         <RequireAuth>
0055:           <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
0056:             <Navbar />
0057:             <main>
0058:               <Routes>
0059:                 <Route path="/" element={<Dashboard />} />
0060:                 <Route path="/devices/:id" element={<DevicePage />} />
0061:                 <Route path="/settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />

0063:                 <Route path="/sites/:siteId" element={<SitePage />} />
0064:                 <Route path="/customers/new" element={<NewCustomerPage />} />
0065:                 <Route path="/customers/:customerId" element={<CustomerPage />} />
0066:                 <Route path="/cameras/:deviceId" element={<CameraPage />} />
0067:                 <Route path="/global-config" element={<GlobalConfigPage />} />
0068:                 <Route path="/lab/:deviceId" element={<LabPage />} />
0069:                 <Route path="/devices/:deviceId/lab" element={<LabPage />} />
0070:                 <Route path="/system-admin" element={<SystemAdminPage />} />
0071:             <Route path="/tags" element={<TagSearchPage />} />
0072:             <Route path="/notifications" element={<NotificationsPage />} />
0073:                 <Route path="/devices/:id/timelapse" element={<TimelapseVideoPage />} />
0074:                 <Route path="/users" element={<UsersPage />} />
0075:                 <Route path="/key-management" element={<KeyManagementPage />} />
0076:                 <Route path="/ssh-tunnel" element={<SshTunnelPage />} />
0077:                 <Route path="/updates" element={<UpdatesPage />} />
0078:                 <Route path="/change-tickets" element={<ChangeTicketsPage />} />
0079:                 <Route path="/compliance" element={<CompliancePage />} />
0080:         <Route path="/cmdb" element={<CMDBPage />} />
0081:         <Route path="/siem" element={<SIEMPage />} />
0082:         <Route path="/import" element={<ImportPage />} />
0083:         <Route path="/cmdb/:deviceId" element={<CMDBDetailPage />} />
0084:         <Route path="/ai" element={<AIPage />} />
0085:         <Route path="/openwebui" element={<OpenWebUIPage />} />
0086:               </Routes>
0087:             </main>
0088:           </div>
0089:         </RequireAuth>
0090:       } />
0091:     </Routes>
0092:   )
0093: }
0094: 
0095: export default function App() {
0096:   return (
0097:     <BrowserRouter>

0099:         <AppRoutes />
0100:       </AuthProvider>
0101:     </BrowserRouter>
0102:   )
0103: }

0001: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
0002: import { Image } from 'lucide-react'
0003: import { getThumbnailUrl } from '../api/client'
0004: import type { Capture } from '../types'
0005: 
0006: const getTz = () => localStorage.getItem('timelapse_timezone') ?? 'Europe/Copenhagen'
0007: 
0008: export function parseCaptureAI(capture: any, sidecar?: any): Record<string, any> | null {
0009:   if (sidecar?.ai_analysis) return sidecar.ai_analysis
0010:   if (!capture.ai_result) return null
0011:   try { return JSON.parse(capture.ai_result) } catch { return null }
0012: }
0013: 
0014: function filenameParts(filename: string) {
0015:   const fn = filename.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '')
0016:   const parts = fn.split('_')
0017:   const dateIdx = parts.findIndex((p: string) => /^\d{8}$/.test(p))
0018:   const nameParts = dateIdx > 0 ? parts.slice(0, dateIdx) : parts
0019:   return {
0020:     customer: nameParts[0] ?? '',
0021:     site: nameParts.slice(1, -2).join(' '),
0022:     camera: nameParts.slice(-2).join(' '),
0023:   }
0024: }
0025: 
0026: function qaBadge(ai: Record<string, any> | null) {
0027:   if (!ai) return null
0028:   if (ai.alarm) {
0029:     return <span title={ai.description ?? 'QA alarm'} className="text-xs flex-shrink-0 cursor-help">🚨</span>
0030:   }
0031:   if (ai.is_anomaly) {
0032:     return <span title={ai.description ?? 'QA afvigelse'} className="text-xs flex-shrink-0 cursor-help">⚠️</span>
0033:   }
0034:   if (ai.probable_cause === 'ok' || ai.scene_dk || ai.quality_flag) {
0035:     return (
0036:       <span
0037:         title={ai.scene_dk ? `AI: ${ai.scene_dk}` : 'QA: OK'}
0038:         className="text-[9px] flex-shrink-0 text-emerald-600 font-bold cursor-help"
0039:       >
0040:         QA✓
0041:       </span>
0042:     )
0043:   }
0044:   return null
0045: }
0046: 
0047: export function CaptureThumbnailCard({
0048:   capture,
0049:   onClick,
0050:   selected = false,
0051:   overlay,
0052:   compact = false,
0053: }: {
0054:   capture: Capture
0055:   onClick: () => void
0056:   selected?: boolean
0057:   overlay?: React.ReactNode
0058:   compact?: boolean
0059: }) {
0060:   const time = capture.captured_at
0061:     ? new Date(capture.captured_at).toLocaleString('da-DK', { timeZone: getTz(), day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
0062:     : '-'
0063:   const passed = capture.quality_passed !== false
0064:   const thumbUrl = getThumbnailUrl(capture.device_id, capture.filename)
0065:   const [imgOk, setImgOk] = useState(true)
0066:   const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0)
0067:   const ai = parseCaptureAI(capture)
0068:   const parts = filenameParts(capture.filename)
0069:   const imgSrc = retry > 0 ? `${thumbUrl}?retry=${retry}` : thumbUrl
0070: 
0071:   useEffect(() => {
0072:     setImgOk(true)
0073:     setRetry(0)
0074:   }, [thumbUrl])
0075: 
0076:   return (
0077:     <div
0078:       onClick={onClick}
0079:       className={`rounded-xl border overflow-hidden bg-white cursor-pointer hover:ring-2 hover:ring-sky-300 transition-all ${
0080:         selected ? 'ring-2 ring-red-400 border-red-300' : passed ? 'border-gray-200' : 'border-red-200'
0081:       }`}
0082:     >
0083:       <div className="aspect-video bg-slate-100 relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
0084:         {imgOk ? (
0085:           <img
0086:             src={imgSrc}
0087:             alt={capture.filename}
0088:             className="w-full h-full object-cover"
0089:             loading="lazy"
0090:             onError={() => {
0091:               if (retry < 2) {
0092:                 window.setTimeout(() => setRetry(r => r + 1), 250 * (retry + 1))
0093:               } else {
0094:                 setImgOk(false)
0095:               }
0096:             }}
0097:           />
0098:         ) : (
0099:           <Image className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300" />
0100:         )}
0101:         <span className="absolute bottom-1.5 right-1.5 text-xs bg-black/50 text-white px-1 py-0.5 rounded">
0102:           {capture.filesize_mb ? `${capture.filesize_mb} MB` : '-'}
0103:         </span>
0104:         {!passed && <span className="absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 text-xs bg-red-500 text-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">Fejlet</span>}
0105:         {overlay}
0106:       </div>
0107:       <div className="px-2 py-1.5">
0108:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
0109:           <p className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-700">{time}</p>
0110:           {capture.blur_score != null && (
0111:             <p className={`text-xs font-medium flex-shrink-0 ${capture.blur_score < 80 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
0112:               ⬡ {Math.round(capture.blur_score)}
0113:             </p>
0114:           )}
0115:           {qaBadge(ai)}
0116:         </div>
0117: 
0118:         {!compact && (
0119:           <>
0120:             <div className="border-t border-gray-100 pt-1 mt-1">
0121:               <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight truncate">{parts.customer}</p>
0122:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-800 leading-tight mt-0.5 truncate">{parts.site}</p>
0123:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-700 leading-tight mt-0.5 truncate">{parts.camera}</p>
0124:             </div>
0125:             {capture.ai_tags && capture.ai_tags.length > 0 && (
0126:               <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-0.5 mt-1">
0127:                 {capture.ai_tags.slice(0, 3).map((t: string) => (
0128:                   <span key={t} className="text-[9px] bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 px-1 py-0.5 rounded-full">#{t}</span>
0129:                 ))}
0130:                 {capture.ai_tags.length > 3 && (
0131:                   <span className="text-[9px] text-gray-400">+{capture.ai_tags.length - 3}</span>
0132:                 )}
0133:               </div>
0134:             )}
0135:           </>
0136:         )}
0137:       </div>
0138:     </div>
0139:   )
0140: }

0003: import {

0285:             <div key={d} className="text-center text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 py-1">{d}</div>
0286:           ))}
0287:           {(() => {
0288:             const firstDay  = new Date(selected.year!, selected.month!-1, 1).getDay()
0289:             const offset    = firstDay === 0 ? 6 : firstDay-1
0290:             const daysInMo  = new Date(selected.year!, selected.month!, 0).getDate()
0291:             const cells = []
0292:             for (let i=0; i<offset; i++) cells.push(<div key={`e${i}`} />)
0293:             for (let d=1; d<=daysInMo; d++) {
0294:               const dc    = days.find(x => x.day===d)
0295:               const count = dc?.count ?? 0
0296:               const isSel = selected.day === d
0297:               cells.push(
0298:                 <button key={d} onClick={() => { if (count > 0) { setNaturalNote(''); setSelected(s=>({...s,day:d})) } }}
0299:                   disabled={count===0}
0300:                   className={`rounded text-xs font-semibold transition-all flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 py-1.5 ${isSel ? 'ring-2 ring-sky-500 ring-offset-1' : ''} ${count>0 ? densityColor(count)+' hover:scale-105 cursor-pointer' : 'bg-transparent text-gray-300 cursor-default'}`}>
0301:                   <span className={count > 0 ? '' : 'text-gray-300'}>{d}</span>
0302:                   {count>0 && <span style={{fontSize:8}} className="opacity-80">{count}</span>}
0303:                 </button>
0304:               )
0305:             }
0306:             return cells
0307:           })()}
0308:         </div>
0309:         </div>
0310:       )}
0311: 
0312:       {/* Dagens billeder */}
0313:       {selected.day && (
0314:         <div className="mt-4">
0315:           {loading ? (
0316:             <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">Indlæser billeder…</div>
0317:           ) : dayCaptures.length === 0 ? (
0318:             <div className="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">Ingen billeder</div>
0319:           ) : (
0320:             <>
0321:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3">{dayCaptures.length} billeder</p>
0322:               <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
0323:                 {dayCaptures.map(c => {
0324:                   return (
0325:                     <CaptureThumbnailCard
0326:                       key={c.id}
0327:                       capture={c}
0328:                       compact
0329:                       selected={deleteMode && selectedIds.has(c.id)}
0330:                       onClick={() => deleteMode ? toggleSelect(c.id) : openCapture(c)}
0331:                       overlay={deleteMode && selectedIds.has(c.id) ? <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-red-400/20" /> : null}
0332:                     />
0333:                   )
0334:                 })}
0335:               </div>
0336:             </>
0337:           )}
0338:         </div>
0339:       )}
0340:     </div>
0341:   )
0342: }

0001: // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0002: // AuthContext.tsx — JWT auth state for TimeLapse Pro
0003: // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0004: import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react'
0005: import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
0006: import { getApiUrl } from '../api/client'
0007: import { startAuthentication } from '@simplewebauthn/browser'
0008: 
0009: export interface User {
0010:   username:    string
0011:   role:        'super_admin' | 'admin' | 'operator' | 'viewer'
0012:   customer_id: string | null
0013: }
0014: 
0015: interface MfaResult { mfa_required?: boolean; mfa_token?: string }
0016: 
0017: interface AuthCtx {
0018:   user: User | null
0019:   token: string | null
0020:   login:     (username: string, password: string) => Promise<MfaResult | void>
0021:   logout:    () => void
0022:   verifyMfa: (mfa_token: string, code: string) => Promise<void>
0023:   isAuthenticated: boolean
0024:   loading: boolean
0025:   hasRole: (...roles: User['role'][]) => boolean
0026: }
0027: 
0028: const Ctx = createContext<AuthCtx | null>(null)
0029: 
0030: export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
0031:   const [user,  setUser]  = useState<User | null>(null)
0032:   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null)
0033:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0034: 
0035:   // Restore user fra /api/auth/me ved mount (cookie valideres af backend)
0036:   useEffect(() => {
0037:     const u = localStorage.getItem('tl_user')
0038:     if (u) {
0039:       try { setUser(JSON.parse(u)) } catch { /* ignore */ }
0040:     }
0041:     // Verificér cookie stadig er gyldig
0042:     fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/me`, { credentials: 'include' })
0043:       .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
0044:       .then(async d => {
0045:         if (d) {
0046:           setUser({ username: d.username, role: d.role, customer_id: d.customer_id })
0047:           localStorage.setItem('tl_user', JSON.stringify(d))
0048:         } else {
0049:           // Cookie mangler — forsøg WebAuthn auto-login hvis bruger er gemt
0050:           const saved = localStorage.getItem('tl_user')
0051:           if (saved) {
0052:             try {
0053:               const savedUser = JSON.parse(saved)
0054:               const opts = await fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/webauthn/login-begin`, {
0055:                 method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
0056:                 headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0057:                 body: JSON.stringify({ username: savedUser.username })
0058:               })
0059:               if (opts.ok) {
0060:                 const optsJson = await opts.json()
0061:                 const result = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON: optsJson })
0062:                 const loginRes = await fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/webauthn/login-complete`, {
0063:                   method: 'POST', credentials: 'include',
0064:                   headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0065:                   body: JSON.stringify({ ...result, username: savedUser.username })
0066:                 })
0067:                 if (loginRes.ok) {
0068:                   const data = await loginRes.json()
0069:                   const u = { username: data.username, role: data.role, customer_id: data.customer_id ?? null }
0070:                   localStorage.setItem('tl_user', JSON.stringify(u))
0071:                   setUser(u)
0072:                   return
0073:                 }
0074:               }
0075:             } catch { /* WebAuthn ikke tilgængeligt eller afvist */ }
0076:           }
0077:           if (!localStorage.getItem('tl_user')) setUser(null)
0078:         }
0079:       })
0080:       .catch(() => {})
0081:       .finally(() => setLoading(false))
0082:   }, [])
0083: 
0084:   async function login(username: string, password: string) {
0085:     const res = await fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/login`, {
0086:       method:      'POST',
0087:       credentials: 'include',
0088:       headers:     { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0089:       body:        JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
0090:     })
0091:     if (!res.ok) {
0092:       const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
0093:       throw new Error(err.detail ?? 'Login fejlede')
0094:     }
0095:     const data = await res.json()
0096:     if (data.mfa_required) {
0097:       return { mfa_required: true, mfa_token: data.mfa_token }
0098:     }
0099:     const u: User = { username: data.username ?? username, role: data.role ?? 'viewer', customer_id: data.customer_id ?? null }
0100:     localStorage.setItem('tl_user', JSON.stringify(u))
0101:     setUser(u)
0102:     return {}
0103:   }
0104: 
0105:   async function verifyMfa(mfa_token: string, code: string) {
0106:     const res = await fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/verify-mfa`, {
0107:       method:      'POST',
0108:       credentials: 'include',
0109:       headers:     { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0110:       body:        JSON.stringify({ mfa_token, code }),
0111:     })
0112:     if (!res.ok) {
0113:       const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
0114:       throw new Error(err.detail ?? 'Forkert kode')
0115:     }
0116:     const data = await res.json()
0117:     const u: User = { username: data.username, role: data.role, customer_id: data.customer_id ?? null }
0118:     localStorage.setItem('tl_user', JSON.stringify(u))
0119:     setUser(u)
0120:   }
0121: 
0122:   function logout() {
0123:     fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include' }).catch(() => {})
0124:     localStorage.removeItem('tl_user')
0125:     setToken(null)
0126:     setUser(null)
0127:   }
0128: 
0129:   const hasRole = (...roles: User['role'][]) => !!user && roles.includes(user.role)
0130: 
0131:   return (
0132:     <Ctx.Provider value={{ user, token, login, logout, verifyMfa, isAuthenticated: !!user, hasRole, loading }}>
0133:       {children}
0134:     </Ctx.Provider>
0135:   )
0136: }
0137: 
0138: export function useAuth() {
0139:   const ctx = useContext(Ctx)
0140:   if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth must be inside AuthProvider')
0141:   return ctx
0142: }
```

0309:       <div className="bg-violet-950/40 border border-violet-800/30 rounded-xl p-4 flex gap-3">
0310:         <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
0311:         <div className="text-sm text-slate-300 space-y-1">
0312:           <p>AI Ops bruger Ollama som read-only co-pilot på CMDB, SIEM, updates, key management, resilience og SAST-signaler.</p>
0313:           <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs">Modellen må ikke ændre database, køre kommandoer eller remediate uden menneskelig accept. Forslag skal videre som change tickets eller manuelle beslutninger.</p>
0314:         </div>
0315:       </div>
0316: 
0317:       {error && (
0318:         <div className="bg-red-950/40 border border-red-800/40 text-red-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm">
0319:           {error}
0320:         </div>
0321:       )}
0322: 
0323:       <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
0324:         <button onClick={runAnalysis} disabled={loading}
0325:           className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-sm font-medium">
0326:           <Brain className="w-4 h-4" />
0327:           Kør Ollama AI Ops analyse
0328:         </button>
0329:         <button onClick={loadSnapshot} disabled={loading}
0330:           className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-900 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5 disabled:opacity-50 text-sm text-slate-300">
0331:           <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
0332:           Opdater snapshot
0333:         </button>
0334:         {snapshot && <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Snapshot: {new Date(snapshot.generated_at).toLocaleString('da-DK')}</span>}
0335:       </div>
0336: 
0337:       {snapshot && (
0338:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
0339:           <MiniMetric label="CMDB enheder" value={Object.values(snapshot.cmdb.device_count_by_status || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} icon={Server} />
0340:           <MiniMetric label="SIEM 24h events" value={Object.values(snapshot.siem.last_24h_by_severity || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} icon={AlertTriangle} />
0341:           <MiniMetric label="Updates" value={Object.values(snapshot.updates.by_status || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)} icon={RefreshCw} />
0342:           <MiniMetric label="SAST findings" value={snapshot.sast.finding_count} icon={Database} />
0343:         </div>
0344:       )}
0345: 
0346:       {analysis && (
0347:         <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
0348:           <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/8 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
0349:             <div>
0350:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0351:                 <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">AI Ops vurdering</h2>
0352:                 <span className={`text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${severityClass(analysis.risk_level)}`}>{analysis.risk_level}</span>
0353:                 <span className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/10 text-slate-400">{analysis.mode}</span>
0354:               </div>
0355:               <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 mt-2">{analysis.summary}</p>
0356:             </div>
0357:           </div>
0358: 
0359:           <div className="divide-y divide-white/6">
0360:             {analysis.recommendations.map((rec, idx) => (
0361:               <div key={`${rec.title}-${idx}`} className="p-5">
0362:                 <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
0363:                   <div className="min-w-0">
0364:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
0365:                       <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{rec.title}</h3>
0366:                       <span className={`text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${severityClass(rec.severity)}`}>{rec.severity}</span>
0367:                       {rec.requires_acceptance && (
0368:                         <span className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-700 bg-amber-950 text-amber-200">kræver accept</span>
0369:                       )}
0370:                     </div>
0371:                     <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mt-2">{rec.rationale}</p>
0372:                     <p className="text-sm text-slate-200 mt-2">{rec.proposed_action}</p>
0373:                     <div className="mt-3 flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
0374:                       {rec.domain.map(d => (
0375:                         <span key={d} className="text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/10 bg-black/20 text-slate-400">{d}</span>
0376:                       ))}
0377:                     </div>
0378:                   </div>
0379:                 </div>
0380:               </div>
0381:             ))}
0382:           </div>
0383:         </div>
0384:       )}
0385: 
0386:       {snapshot?.sast.findings.length ? (
0387:         <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
0388:           <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-white/8">
0389:             <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">SAST review-signaler</h2>
0390:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Read-only heuristik. Fund skal vurderes før change ticket.</p>
0391:           </div>
0392:           <div className="divide-y divide-white/6 max-h-96 overflow-auto">
0393:             {snapshot.sast.findings.slice(0, 25).map((f, idx) => (
0394:               <div key={`${f.file}-${f.line}-${idx}`} className="px-5 py-3 text-xs">
0395:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0396:                   <span className="text-violet-300">{f.category}</span>
0397:                   <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono">{f.file}:{f.line}</span>
0398:                 </div>
0399:                 <code className="block mt-1 text-slate-400 whitespace-pre-wrap">{f.snippet}</code>
0400:               </div>
0401:             ))}
0402:           </div>
0403:         </div>
0404:       ) : null}
0405:     </div>
0406:   )
0407: }
0408: 
0409: // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0410: // STRATEGI TAB
0411: // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0412: 
0413: function StrategyTab() {
0414:   const [configs, setConfigs] = useState<AIConfig[]>([])
0415:   const [editing, setEditing] = useState<AIConfig | null>(null)
0416:   const [priority, setPriority] = useState<OllamaPriority | null>(null)
0417:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0418:   const [saving,  setSaving]  = useState(false)
0419:   const [prioritySaving, setPrioritySaving] = useState(false)
0420: 
0421:   const load = useCallback(() => {
0422:     setLoading(true)
0423:     api('/api/settings/config').then(d => { setConfigs(Array.isArray(d) ? d : []); setLoading(false) }).catch(() => setLoading(false))
0424:   }, [])
0425: 
0426:   const loadPriority = useCallback(() => {
0427:     api('/api/ai/ollama-priority').then(d => setPriority(d)).catch(() => setPriority(null))
0428:   }, [])
0429: 
0430:   useEffect(() => { load(); loadPriority() }, [load, loadPriority])
0431: 
0432:   const save = async () => {
0433:     if (!editing) return
0434:     setSaving(true)
0435:     try {
0436:       await api('/api/settings/config', {
0437:         method: 'POST',
0438:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0439:         body: JSON.stringify(editing),
0440:       })
0441:       setEditing(null)
0442:       load()
0443:     } finally {
0444:       setSaving(false)
0445:     }
0446:   }
0447: 
0448:   const togglePriority = async () => {
0449:     if (!priority || prioritySaving) return
0450:     const next = !priority.open_webui_priority
0451:     setPrioritySaving(true)
0452:     const updated = await api('/api/ai/ollama-priority', {
0453:       method: 'PUT',
0454:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0455:       body: JSON.stringify({ open_webui_priority: next }),
0456:     })
0457:     setPriority(updated)
0458:     setPrioritySaving(false)
0459:   }
0460: 
0461:   return (
0462:     <div className="space-y-4">
0463:       {/* Forklaring */}
0464:       <div className="bg-violet-950/40 border border-violet-800/30 rounded-xl p-4 flex gap-3">
0465:         <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
0466:         <div className="text-sm text-slate-300 space-y-1">
0467:           <p>Strategi bestemmer hvilken AI der bruges pr. kunde. Fallback-hierarki: <strong>Site → Kunde → Global</strong></p>
0468:           <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs">Ændringer træder i kraft ved næste analyse. Eksisterende analyser påvirkes ikke.</p>
0469:         </div>
0470:       </div>
0471: 
0472:       {/* Ollama prioritet */}
0473:       {priority && (
0474:         <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
0475:           <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center ${priority.open_webui_priority ? 'bg-amber-950 text-amber-300' : 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300'}`}>
0476:             <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" />
0477:           </div>
0478:           <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
0479:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0480:               <h2 className="font-semibold text-sm text-white">Peter vil gerne lege med Ollama</h2>
0481:               <code className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 bg-black/30 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5">{priority.key}</code>
0482:             </div>
0483:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
0484:               {priority.open_webui_priority
0485:                 ? `Open WebUI har prioritet. Timelapse AI holder pause, og ${priority.queue_size} billeder venter i analyse-køen.`
0486:                 : `Normal drift. Timelapse AI prioriterer Ollama, og ${priority.queue_size} billeder venter i analyse-køen.`}
0487:             </p>
0488:           </div>
0489:           <button
0490:             onClick={togglePriority}
0491:             disabled={prioritySaving}
0492:             className={`relative w-12 h-7 rounded-full transition-colors shrink-0 disabled:opacity-50 ${priority.open_webui_priority ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-gray-700'}`}
0493:             aria-pressed={priority.open_webui_priority}
0494:             aria-label="Skift Ollama prioritet"
0495:           >
0496:             <span className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${priority.open_webui_priority ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0'}`} />
0497:           </button>
0498:         </div>
0499:       )}
0500: 
0501:       {/* Strategi-forklaring */}
0502:       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
0503:         {(Object.entries(STRATEGY_META) as [Strategy, typeof STRATEGY_META[Strategy]][]).map(([key, m]) => (
0504:           <div key={key} className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-3 space-y-1">
0505:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0506:               <StrategyBadge strategy={key} />
0507:             </div>
0508:             <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{m.desc}</p>
0509:           </div>
0510:         ))}
0511:       </div>
0512: 
0513:       {/* Tabel */}
0514:       {loading ? (
0515:         <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-500">Henter konfiguration...</div>
0516:       ) : (
0517:         <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
0518:           <table className="w-full text-sm">
0519:             <thead>
0520:               <tr className="border-b border-white/8 text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
0521:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Scope</th>
0522:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Strategi</th>
0523:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Lokal model</th>
0524:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Threshold</th>
0525:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Vocab limit</th>
0526:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left">Status</th>
0527:                 <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right"></th>
0528:               </tr>
0529:             </thead>
0530:             <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
0531:               {configs.map(cfg => (
0532:                 <tr key={cfg.id} className="hover:bg-white/3 transition-colors">
0533:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0534:                     <div className="font-medium text-white">{cfg.display_name}</div>
0535:                     {cfg.notes && <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{cfg.notes}</div>}
0536:                   </td>
0537:                   <td className="px-4 py-3"><StrategyBadge strategy={cfg.strategy} /></td>
0538:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 font-mono text-xs">{cfg.local_model}</td>
0539:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400">{cfg.escalation_threshold}</td>
0540:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400">{cfg.tag_vocabulary_limit}</td>
0541:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0542:                     <span className={`text-xs ${cfg.enabled ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
0543:                       {cfg.enabled ? '● Aktiv' : '○ Deaktiveret'}
0544:                     </span>
0545:                   </td>
0546:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
0547:                     <button
0548:                       onClick={() => setEditing({ ...cfg })}
0549:                       className="text-xs text-violet-400 hover:text-violet-300 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-violet-900/30 transition-colors"
0550:                     >
0551:                       Rediger
0552:                     </button>
0553:                   </td>
0554:                 </tr>
0555:               ))}
0556:             </tbody>
0557:           </table>
0558:         </div>
0559:       )}
0560: 
0561:       {/* Edit modal */}
0562:       {editing && (
0563:         <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
0564:           <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-5">
0565:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
0566:               <h2 className="font-semibold text-white">{editing.display_name}</h2>
0567:               <button onClick={() => setEditing(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white">✕</button>
0568:             </div>
0569: 
0570:             {/* Strategi */}
0571:             <div className="space-y-2">
0572:               <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Strategi</label>
0573:               <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
0574:                 {(Object.keys(STRATEGY_META) as Strategy[]).map(s => (
0575:                   <button
0576:                     key={s}
0577:                     onClick={() => setEditing({ ...editing, strategy: s })}
0578:                     className={`flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
0579:                       editing.strategy === s
0580:                         ? 'border-violet-500 bg-violet-950/50'
0581:                         : 'border-white/8 bg-gray-800 hover:border-white/20'
0582:                     }`}
0583:                   >
0584:                     <div className="mt-0.5"><StrategyBadge strategy={s} /></div>
0585:                     <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{STRATEGY_META[s].desc}</p>
0586:                   </button>
0587:                 ))}
0588:               </div>
0589:             </div>
0590: 
0591:             {/* Lokal model */}
0592:             {(editing.strategy === 'local_only' || editing.strategy === 'local_then_cloud') && (
0593:               <div className="space-y-1.5">
0594:                 <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">Lokal model</label>
0595:                 <select
0596:                   value={editing.local_model}
0597:                   onChange={e => setEditing({ ...editing, local_model: e.target.value })}
0598:                   className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
0599:                 >
0600:                   <option value="qwen2.5vl:7b">qwen2.5vl:7b (anbefalet)</option>
0601:                   <option value="llama3.2-vision:11b">llama3.2-vision:11b (tung)</option>
0602:                   <option value="llava-phi3:latest">llava-phi3:latest (hurtig/svag)</option>
0603:                 </select>
0604:               </div>
0605:             )}
0606: 
0607:             {/* Thresholds */}
0608:             {editing.strategy === 'local_then_cloud' && (
0609:               <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
0610:                 <div className="space-y-1.5">
0611:                   <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
0612:                     Eskalér hvis confidence &lt;
0613:                   </label>
0614:                   <input
0615:                     type="number" min="0.5" max="1" step="0.05"
0616:                     value={editing.escalation_threshold}
0617:                     onChange={e => setEditing({ ...editing, escalation_threshold: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
0618:                     className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
0619:                   />
0620:                 </div>
0621:                 <div className="space-y-1.5">
0622:                   <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
0623:                     Eskalér hvis &gt; N nye tags
0624:                   </label>
0625:                   <input
0626:                     type="number" min="1" max="20"
0627:                     value={editing.escalation_new_tags}
0628:                     onChange={e => setEditing({ ...editing, escalation_new_tags: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
0629:                     className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
0630:                   />
0631:                 </div>
0632:               </div>
0633:             )}
0634: 
0635:             {/* Vocab limit */}
0636:             <div className="space-y-1.5">
0637:               <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
0638:                 Max tags i prompt (performance)
0639:               </label>
0640:               <input
0641:                 type="number" min="20" max="372" step="10"
0642:                 value={editing.tag_vocabulary_limit}
0643:                 onChange={e => setEditing({ ...editing, tag_vocabulary_limit: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
0644:                 className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
0645:               />
0646:               <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Færre = hurtigere. 372 = alle tags</p>
0647:             </div>
0648: 
0649:             {/* Enabled */}
0650:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
0651:               <span className="text-sm text-slate-300">AI aktiveret for denne kunde</span>
0652:               <button
0653:                 onClick={() => setEditing({ ...editing, enabled: !editing.enabled })}
0654:                 className={`w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${editing.enabled ? 'bg-violet-600' : 'bg-gray-700'}`}
0655:               >
0656:                 <div className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white mx-auto transition-transform ${editing.enabled ? 'translate-x-2.5' : '-translate-x-2.5'}`} />
0657:               </button>
0658:             </div>
0659: 
0660:             <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2">
0661:               <button
0662:                 onClick={() => setEditing(null)}
0663:                 className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
0664:               >
0665:                 Annuller
0666:               </button>
0667:               <button
0668:                 onClick={save}
0669:                 disabled={saving}
0670:                 className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-sm font-medium transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
0671:               >
0672:                 {saving ? 'Gemmer...' : 'Gem'}
0673:               </button>
0674:             </div>
0675:           </div>
0676:         </div>
0677:       )}
0678:     </div>
0679:   )
0680: }
0681: 
0682: // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0683: // TAG REVIEW TAB
0684: // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
0685: 
0686: function TagReviewTab() {
0687:   const [tags,    setTags]    = useState<PendingTag[]>([])
0688:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0689:   const [busy,    setBusy]    = useState<Set<number>>(new Set())
0690: 
0691:   const load = () => {
0692:     setLoading(true)
0693:     api('/api/ai/vocabulary/pending').then(d => { setTags(Array.isArray(d) ? d : []); setLoading(false) })
0694:   }
0695: 
0696:   useEffect(() => { load() }, [])
0697: 
0698:   const approve = async (id: number, category?: string) => {
0699:     setBusy(b => new Set(b).add(id))
0700:     await api(`/api/ai/vocabulary/${id}/approve${category ? `?category=${category}` : ''}`, { method: 'POST' })
0701:     setTags(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id))
0702:     setBusy(b => { const s = new Set(b); s.delete(id); return s })
0703:   }
0704: 
0705:   const reject = async (id: number) => {
0706:     setBusy(b => new Set(b).add(id))
0707:     await api(`/api/ai/vocabulary/${id}/reject`, { method: 'POST' })
0708:     setTags(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id))
0709:     setBusy(b => { const s = new Set(b); s.delete(id); return s })
0710:   }
0711: 
0712:   return (
0713:     <div className="space-y-4">
0714:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
0715:         <div>
0716:           <h2 className="font-semibold text-white">Model-opfundne tags</h2>
0717:           <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Tags AI-modellen har fundet selv — godkend eller afvis</p>
0718:         </div>
0719:         <button onClick={load} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-400 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
0720:           <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Opdater
0721:         </button>
0722:       </div>
0723: 
0724:       {loading ? (
0725:         <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-500">Henter tags...</div>
0726:       ) : tags.length === 0 ? (
0727:         <div className="text-center py-16">
0728:           <CheckCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-3" />
0729:           <p className="text-slate-400">Ingen tags afventer godkendelse</p>
0730:         </div>
0731:       ) : (
0732:         <div className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
0733:           <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-white/5 text-xs text-slate-500 flex gap-4">

0751:                 </span>

0757:                   >

0759:                   </button>
0760:                   <button
0761:                     onClick={() => reject(tag.id)}

0763:                     className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-red-900/30 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-800/30 text-xs transition-colors disabled:opacity-40"
0764:                   >
0765:                     <ThumbsDown className="w-3 h-3" /> Afvis
0766:                   </button>
0767:                 </div>
0768:               </div>
0769:             ))}
0770:           </div>
0771:         </div>
0772:       )}
0773:     </div>
0774:   )
0775: }

0780: 
0781: function EscalationTab() {

0785:   const [sending,  setSending]  = useState(false)

0791:       api('/api/review/escalation/pending?limit=100'),

0809:       method: 'POST',

0814:     setSelected(new Set())
0815:     load()
0816:   }
0817: 
0818:   const rejectSelected = async () => {

0821:       method: 'POST',
0822:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0823:       body: JSON.stringify({ analysis_ids: [...selected], admin_id: 'admin' }),
0824:     })

0842:               <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">{s.label}</div>
0843:             </div>
0844:           ))}
0845:         </div>
0846:       )}
0847: 
0848:       {/* Actions */}
0849:       {selected.size > 0 && (

0852:           <div className="flex gap-2 ml-auto">

0856:             >
0857:               <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Afvis
0858:             </button>
0859:             <button
0860:               onClick={approveSelected}
0861:               disabled={sending}

0863:             >
0864:               <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
0865:               {sending ? 'Sender til Gemini...' : 'Send til Gemini'}
0866:             </button>
0867:           </div>
0868:         </div>
0869:       )}
0870: 
0871:       {loading ? (

0873:       ) : items.length === 0 ? (

0875:           <CheckCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-3" />
0876:           <p className="text-slate-400">Ingen billeder afventer Gemini-analyse</p>

0881:             <button

0883:               className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
0884:             >
0885:               {selected.size === items.length ? 'Fravælg alle' : 'Vælg alle'}
0886:             </button>

0888:           </div>
0889:           <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">

0895:               >

0908:                       ai_tags: item.current_tags,
0909:                     })}
0910:                     compact
0911:                     onClick={() => {}}

0913:                 </div>

0920:                   </div>

0926:               </div>

0939: function DailyReviewTab() {
0940:   const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
0941:   const [date,     setDate]     = useState(today)
0942:   const [captures, setCaptures] = useState<DayCapture[]>([])

0945:   const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null)

0948: 
0949:   const load = () => {
0950:     setLoading(true)
0951:     api(`/api/review/day/${date}?limit=200`).then(d => {
0952:       setCaptures(Array.isArray(d.captures) ? d.captures : [])
0953:       setLoading(false)
0954:     }).catch(() => setLoading(false))
0955:   }
0956: 
0957:   const startSession = async () => {
0958:     const d = await api('/api/review/session/start', {
0959:       method: 'POST',

0964:     load()
0965:   }
0966: 
0967:   const saveCorrection = async (cap: DayCapture) => {
0968:     let sid = sessionId
0969:     if (!sid) {
0970:       const d = await api('/api/review/session/start', {
0971:         method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'},
0972:         body: JSON.stringify({session_date: date, admin_id: 'admin'})
0973:       })
0974:       sid = d.session_id
0975:       setSessionId(sid)
0976:     }
0977:     if (!sid) return
0978:     setSaving(true)
0979:     const tags = editTags.split(',').map(t => t.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)
0980:     await api('/api/review/correction', {
0981:       method: 'POST',
0982:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0983:       body: JSON.stringify({
0984:         capture_id: cap.capture_id,
0985:         session_id: sid,
0986:         admin_id: 'admin',
0987:         corrected_tags: tags,
0988:         corrected_quality_flag: cap.quality_flag,
0989:         corrected_quality_ok: cap.quality_ok,
0990:       }),
0991:     })
0992:     setSaving(false)
0993:     setEditingId(null)
0994:     load()
0995:   }
0996: 
0997:   const completeSession = async () => {
0998:     if (!sessionId) return
0999:     const result = await api(`/api/review/session/${sessionId}/complete`, { method: 'POST' })
1000:     alert(`Session afsluttet! ${result.examples_generated} nye prompt-eksempler genereret.`)
1001:     setSessionId(null)
1002:   }
1003: 
1004:   return (
1005:     <div className="space-y-4">
1006:       {/* Datovælger + session */}
1007:       <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
1008:         <input
1009:           type="date" value={date}
1010:           onChange={e => setDate(e.target.value)}
1011:           className="bg-gray-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white"
1012:         />
1013:         <button onClick={load} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-sm transition-colors">
1014:           <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Hent billeder
1015:         </button>
1016:         {!sessionId ? (
1017:           <button onClick={startSession} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-sm font-medium transition-colors">
1018:             Start korrektions-session
1019:           </button>
1020:         ) : (
1021:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
1022:             <span className="text-sm text-emerald-400">Session #{sessionId} aktiv</span>
1023:             <button onClick={completeSession} className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-sm font-medium transition-colors">
1024:               <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Afslut session
1025:             </button>
1026:           </div>
1027:         )}
1028:       </div>
1029: 
1030:       {loading ? (
1031:         <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-500">Henter billeder...</div>
1032:       ) : captures.length === 0 ? (
