1034:       ) : (
1035:         <div className="space-y-2">
1036:           <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 px-1">{captures.length} billeder · {captures.filter(c => c.is_corrected).length} korrigerede</div>
1037:           {captures.map(cap => (
1038:             <div
1039:               key={cap.capture_id}
1040:               className={`bg-gray-900 border rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all ${
1041:                 cap.is_corrected ? 'border-emerald-800/40' : 'border-white/8'
1042:               }`}
1043:             >
1044:               <div className="flex gap-4 p-4">
1045:                 <div className="w-32 shrink-0">
1046:                   <CaptureThumbnailCard
1047:                     capture={captureFromPath(cap.filename, {
1048:                       id: cap.capture_id,
1049:                       captured_at: cap.captured_at,
1050:                       quality_flag: cap.quality_flag,
1051:                       ai_tags: cap.current_tags,
1052:                     })}
1053:                     compact
1054:                     onClick={() => {}}
1055:                   />
1056:                 </div>
1057:                 <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2">
1058:                   {/* Scene */}
1059:                   <p className="text-sm text-slate-300">{cap.scene_dk || 'Ingen beskrivelse'}</p>
1060:                   {/* Tags */}
1061:                   <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
1062:                     {(cap.corrected_tags || cap.current_tags || []).slice(0, 20).map(tag => (
1063:                       <span key={tag} className={`text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono ${
1064:                         cap.is_corrected ? 'bg-emerald-950/50 text-emerald-300' : 'bg-gray-800 text-slate-400'
1065:                       }`}>#{tag}</span>
1066:                     ))}
1067:                   </div>
1068:                   {/* Meta */}
1069:                   <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
1070:                     <span>{new Date(cap.captured_at).toLocaleTimeString('da-DK', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span>
1071:                     <span>{cap.quality_flag}</span>
1072:                     {cap.should_escalate && <span className="text-amber-400">🔺 eskaleret</span>}
1073:                     {cap.gemini_tags && <span className="text-sky-400">☁️ Gemini</span>}
1074:                     {cap.is_corrected && <span className="text-emerald-400">✓ korrigeret</span>}
1075:                   </div>
1076:                 </div>
1077:                 {/* Rediger knap */}
1078:                 {sessionId && (
1079:                   <button
1080:                     onClick={() => {
1081:                       setEditingId(cap.capture_id)
1082:                       setEditTags((cap.corrected_tags || cap.current_tags || []).join(', '))

1084:                     className="shrink-0 text-xs text-violet-400 hover:text-violet-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-violet-900/30 transition-colors self-start"
1085:                   >
1086:                     Ret
1087:                   </button>
1088:                 )}
1089:               </div>
1090: 
1091:               {/* Edit panel */}
1092:               {editingId === cap.capture_id && (
1093:                 <div className="border-t border-white/8 p-4 bg-gray-900/80 space-y-3">
1094:                   <label className="text-xs text-slate-400">Tags (kommasepareret)</label>
1095:                   <textarea
1096:                     value={editTags}
1097:                     onChange={e => setEditTags(e.target.value)}
1098:                     rows={3}
1099:                     className="w-full bg-gray-800 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white font-mono resize-none focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500/50"
1100:                     placeholder="tag1, tag2, tag3..."
1101:                   />
1102:                   <div className="flex gap-3">
1103:                     <button onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm text-slate-400 border border-white/10 hover:text-white transition-colors">
1104:                       Annuller
1105:                     </button>
1106:                     <button
1107:                       onClick={() => saveCorrection(cap)}
1108:                       disabled={saving}
1109:                       className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
1110:                     >
1111:                       {saving ? 'Gemmer...' : 'Gem korrektion'}
1112:                     </button>
1113:                   </div>
1114:                 </div>
1115:               )}
1116:             </div>
1117:           ))}
1118:         </div>
1119:       )}
1120:     </div>
1121:   )
1122: }

0044: interface CMDBDetail extends CMDBEntry {
0045:   cpu_cores: number | null
0046:   ram_mb: number | null
0047:   mac_address: string | null
0048:   serial_number: string | null
0049:   kernel_version: string | null
0050:   python_version: string | null
0051:   boot_storage_type: string | null
0052:   boot_storage_total_gb: number | null
0053:   boot_storage_used_pct: number | null
0054:   data_partition_path: string | null
0055:   data_partition_total_gb: number | null
0056:   data_partition_used_pct: number | null
0057:   primary_interface: string | null
0058:   wifi_capable: boolean
0059:   wifi_ssid: string | null
0060:   venv_packages: Record<string, string>
0061: }
0062: 
0063: interface BreakGlassAccount {
0064:   id: number
0065:   admin_username: string
0066:   ssh_username: string
0067:   has_public_key: boolean
0068:   checkout_count: number
0069:   last_used_at: string | null
0070:   last_used_by: string | null
0071:   rotated_at: string | null
0072:   expires_at: string | null
0073:   created_at: string | null
0074: }
0075: 
0076: // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0077: 
0078: function api(path: string) {
0079:   return fetch(`${getApiUrl()}${path}`, { credentials: 'include' })
0080: }
0081: 
0082: function apiPost(path: string, body: unknown) {
0083:   return fetch(`${getApiUrl()}${path}`, {
0084:     method: 'POST',
0085:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0086:     body: JSON.stringify(body),
0087:     credentials: 'include',
0088:   })
0089: }
0090: 
0091: function apiPut(path: string, body: unknown) {
0092:   return fetch(`${getApiUrl()}${path}`, {
0093:     method: 'PUT',
0094:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0095:     body: JSON.stringify(body),
0096:     credentials: 'include',
0097:   })
0098: }
0099: 
0100: function apiDelete(path: string) {
0101:   return fetch(`${getApiUrl()}${path}`, { method: 'DELETE', credentials: 'include' })
0102: }
0103: 
0104: function fmtDate(iso: string | null) {
0105:   if (!iso) return '—'
0106:   return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('da-DK', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' })
0107: }
0108: 
0109: function EnvBadge({ env }: { env: string }) {
0110:   const cls = {
0111:     lab:        'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-200',
0112:     staging:    'bg-amber-100  text-amber-700  border-amber-200',
0113:     production: 'bg-green-100  text-green-700  border-green-200',
0114:   }[env] ?? 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border-gray-200'
0115:   return (
0116:     <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium border ${cls}`}>
0117:       {env}
0118:     </span>
0119:   )
0120: }
0121: 
0122: function StatusDot({ status }: { status: string }) {
0123:   return (
0124:     <span className={`inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full mr-1.5 ${
0125:       status === 'online' ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-gray-300'
0126:     }`} />
0127:   )
0128: }
0129: 
0130: function StorageBar({ pct }: { pct: number | null }) {
0131:   if (pct == null) return <span className="text-gray-400 text-xs">—</span>
0132:   const color = pct > 85 ? 'bg-red-500' : pct > 65 ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-sky-500'
0133:   return (
0134:     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0135:       <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-gray-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
0136:         <div className={`h-full ${color} rounded-full`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(pct, 100)}%` }} />
0137:       </div>
0138:       <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 w-10 text-right">{pct.toFixed(0)}%</span>
0139:     </div>
0140:   )
0141: }
0142: 
0143: // ── CMDB List (oversigt) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
0144: 
0145: export function CMDBPage() {
0146:   const [entries, setEntries] = useState<CMDBEntry[]>([])
0147:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0148:   const [aiQuestion, setAiQuestion] = useState('Hvilke enheder har størst drifts- eller compliance-risiko lige nu?')
0149:   const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false)
0150:   const [aiAnswer, setAiAnswer] = useState<any | null>(null)
0151:   const navigate = useNavigate()
0152: 
0153:   async function load() {
0154:     setLoading(true)
0155:     try {
0156:       const r = await api('/api/cmdb/')
0157:       setEntries(await r.json())
0158:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
0159:     setLoading(false)
0160:   }
0161: 
0162:   useEffect(() => { load() }, [])
0163: 
0164:   async function askAi() {
0165:     if (!aiQuestion.trim()) return
0166:     setAiLoading(true)
0167:     try {
0168:       const r = await apiPost('/api/ai/ops/query', { area: 'cmdb', question: aiQuestion })
0169:       const data = await r.json()
0170:       setAiAnswer(data.analysis)
0171:     } catch {
0172:       setAiAnswer({ answer: 'AI-analyse fejlede. Tjek Ollama/headend-log og prøv igen.', risk_level: 'unknown', recommendations: [] })
0173:     } finally {
0174:       setAiLoading(false)
0175:     }
0176:   }
0177: 
0178:   return (
0179:     <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-8">
0180:       {/* Header */}
0181:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
0182:         <div>
0183:           <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
0184:             <Server className="w-6 h-6 text-sky-600" />
0185:             CMDB — Enhedsinventar
0186:           </h1>
0187:           <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
0188:             Hardwareinventar og nødadgang for alle edge-enheder
0189:           </p>
0190:         </div>
0191:         <button onClick={load} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700">
0192:           <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
0193:           Opdater
0194:         </button>
0195:       </div>
0196: 
0197:       {/* Stats bar */}
0198:       {!loading && entries.length > 0 && (
0199:         <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
0200:           {(['lab', 'staging', 'production'] as const).map(env => {
0201:             const count = entries.filter(e => e.environment === env).length
0202:             return (
0203:               <div key={env} className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3">
0204:                 <EnvBadge env={env} />
0205:                 <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{count}</span>
0206:                 <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">enhed{count !== 1 ? 'er' : ''}</span>
0207:               </div>
0208:             )
0209:           })}
0210:         </div>
0211:       )}
0212: 
0213:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-sky-100 p-4 mb-6">
0214:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
0215:           <Brain className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
0216:           <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800">AI CMDB-analyse</h2>
0217:           {aiAnswer?.risk_level && (
0218:             <span className="ml-auto text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-100 text-gray-600">
0219:               Risk: {aiAnswer.risk_level}
0220:             </span>
0221:           )}
0222:         </div>
0223:         <div className="flex gap-2">
0224:           <input
0225:             className="flex-1 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0226:             value={aiQuestion}
0227:             onChange={e => setAiQuestion(e.target.value)}
0228:             onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') askAi() }}
0229:           />
0230:           <button
0231:             onClick={askAi}
0232:             disabled={aiLoading || !aiQuestion.trim()}
0233:             className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-sky-600 text-white text-sm rounded-lg disabled:opacity-40"
0234:           >
0235:             {aiLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Brain className="w-4 h-4" />}
0236:             Spørg
0237:           </button>
0238:         </div>
0239:         {aiAnswer && (
0240:           <div className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-700 space-y-2">
0241:             <p>{aiAnswer.answer}</p>
0242:             {(aiAnswer.recommendations ?? []).length > 0 && (
0243:               <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
0244:                 {aiAnswer.recommendations.slice(0, 4).map((rec: any, idx: number) => (
0245:                   <div key={idx} className="border border-gray-100 rounded-lg p-3 bg-gray-50">
0246:                     <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0247:                       <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{rec.title}</span>
0248:                       <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{rec.severity}</span>
0249:                     </div>
0250:                     <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{rec.proposed_action || rec.rationale}</p>
0251:                   </div>
0252:                 ))}
0253:               </div>
0254:             )}
0255:           </div>
0256:         )}
0257:       </div>
0258: 
0259:       {/* Table */}
0260:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
0261:         {loading ? (
0262:           <div className="py-16 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">Indlæser…</div>
0263:         ) : entries.length === 0 ? (
0264:           <div className="py-16 text-center">
0265:             <Server className="w-10 h-10 text-gray-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
0266:             <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm">Ingen CMDB-poster endnu.</p>
0267:             <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1">
0268:               Edge-enheder rapporterer automatisk inventar ved startup.
0269:             </p>
0270:           </div>
0271:         ) : (
0272:           <table className="w-full text-sm">
0273:             <thead>
0274:               <tr className="border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
0275:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">Enhed</th>
0276:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">Hardware</th>
0277:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">Miljø</th>
0278:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">OS / App</th>
0279:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">Sidst set</th>
0280:                 <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">Break-glass</th>
0281:                 <th className="px-4 py-3" />
0282:               </tr>
0283:             </thead>
0284:             <tbody>
0285:               {entries.map(e => (
0286:                 <tr
0287:                   key={e.device_id}
0288:                   className="border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-sky-50 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
0289:                   onClick={() => navigate(`/cmdb/${pathSegment(e.device_id)}`)}
0290:                 >
0291:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0292:                     <div className="font-mono font-medium text-gray-900 flex items-center">
0293:                       <StatusDot status={e.status} />
0294:                       {e.device_id}
0295:                     </div>
0296:                     {(e.customer_name || e.site_name) && (
0297:                       <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
0298:                         {[e.customer_name, e.site_name].filter(Boolean).join(' › ')}
0299:                       </div>
0300:                     )}
0301:                     {e.hostname && (
0302:                       <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">{e.hostname}</div>
0303:                     )}
0304:                   </td>
0305:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0306:                     <div className="text-gray-900">{e.hardware_model ?? '—'}</div>
0307:                     <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">{e.soc_model ?? ''}</div>
0308:                   </td>
0309:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0310:                     <EnvBadge env={e.environment} />
0311:                   </td>
0312:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0313:                     <div className="text-gray-700 text-xs">{e.os_name ?? '—'}</div>
0314:                     <div className="text-gray-400 text-xs font-mono">{e.app_version ?? ''}</div>
0315:                   </td>
0316:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-500">
0317:                     {fmtDate(e.last_seen)}
0318:                     {e.inventory_reported_at && (
0319:                       <div className="text-gray-400">
0320:                         Inv: {fmtDate(e.inventory_reported_at)}
0321:                       </div>
0322:                     )}
0323:                   </td>
0324:                   <td className="px-4 py-3">
0325:                     <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
0326:                       e.break_glass_count > 0
0327:                         ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700'
0328:                         : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'
0329:                     }`}>
0330:                       <Key className="w-3 h-3" />
0331:                       {e.break_glass_count}
0332:                     </span>
0333:                   </td>
0334:                   <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-400">
0335:                     <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
0336:                   </td>
0337:                 </tr>
0338:               ))}
0339:             </tbody>
0340:           </table>
0341:         )}
0342:       </div>
0343:     </div>
0344:   )
0345: }
0346: 
0347: // ── CMDB Detail ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0348: 
0349: export function CMDBDetailPage() {
0350:   const { deviceId } = useParams<{ deviceId: string }>()
0351:   const [detail, setDetail] = useState<CMDBDetail | null>(null)
0352:   const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<BreakGlassAccount[]>([])
0353:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0354:   const [editField, setEditField] = useState<string | null>(null)
0355:   const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState('')
0356:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
0357: 
0358:   // Break-glass state
0359:   const [bgModal, setBgModal] = useState(false)
0360:   const [bgAdminUser, setBgAdminUser] = useState('')
0361:   const [bgExpiresDays, setBgExpiresDays] = useState(0)
0362:   const [bgCreating, setBgCreating] = useState(false)
0363:   const [checkoutModal, setCheckoutModal] = useState<number | null>(null)
0364:   const [checkoutReason, setCheckoutReason] = useState('')
0365:   const [checkoutResult, setCheckoutResult] = useState<null | { password: string; ssh_username: string }>(null)
0366:   const [checkingOut, setCheckingOut] = useState(false)
0367: 
0368:   async function load() {
0369:     if (!deviceId) return
0370:     setLoading(true)
0371:     try {
0372:       const [detailR, bgR] = await Promise.all([
0373:         api(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}`),
0374:         api(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/break-glass`),
0375:       ])
0376:       setDetail(await detailR.json())
0377:       setAccounts(await bgR.json())
0378:     } catch { /* ignore */ }
0379:     setLoading(false)
0380:   }
0381: 
0382:   useEffect(() => { load() }, [deviceId])
0383: 
0384:   async function saveField(field: string, value: string) {
0385:     if (!deviceId) return
0386:     setSaving(true)
0387:     await apiPut(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}`, { [field]: value })
0388:     setSaving(false)
0389:     setEditField(null)
0390:     load()
0391:   }
0392: 
0393:   async function createBreakGlass() {
0394:     if (!deviceId || !bgAdminUser) return
0395:     setBgCreating(true)
0396:     await apiPost(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/break-glass`, {
0397:       admin_username: bgAdminUser,
0398:       expires_days: bgExpiresDays,
0399:     })
0400:     setBgCreating(false)
0401:     setBgModal(false)
0402:     setBgAdminUser('')
0403:     load()
0404:   }
0405: 
0406:   async function doCheckout(accountId: number) {
0407:     if (!deviceId) return
0408:     setCheckingOut(true)
0409:     const r = await apiPost(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/break-glass/checkout`, {
0410:       admin_username: accounts.find(a => a.id === accountId)?.admin_username,
0411:       reason: checkoutReason || 'Ikke angivet',
0412:     })
0413:     const data = await r.json()
0414:     setCheckoutResult({ password: data.password, ssh_username: data.ssh_username })
0415:     setCheckingOut(false)
0416:     load()
0417:   }
0418: 
0419:   async function deleteAccount(accountId: number) {
0420:     if (!deviceId || !confirm('Slet break-glass konto?')) return
0421:     await apiDelete(`/api/cmdb/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/break-glass/${accountId}`)
0422:     load()
0423:   }
0424: 
0425:   if (loading) return (
0426:     <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-400">Indlæser…</div>
0427:   )
0428: 
0429:   if (!detail) return (
0430:     <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-500">
0431:       Ingen CMDB-post fundet for {deviceId}
0432:     </div>
0433:   )
0434: 
0435:   function EditableField({ label, field, value }: { label: string; field: string; value: string | null }) {
0436:     const isEditing = editField === field
0437:     return (
0438:       <div className="flex items-start gap-2 py-1.5">
0439:         <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 w-36 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">{label}</span>
0440:         {isEditing ? (
0441:           <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-1">
0442:             <input
0443:               className="flex-1 text-sm border border-sky-300 rounded px-2 py-0.5 outline-none"
0444:               value={editValue}
0445:               onChange={e => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
0446:               autoFocus
0447:             />
0448:             <button onClick={() => saveField(field, editValue)} disabled={saving}
0449:               className="text-green-600 hover:text-green-700">
0450:               <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
0451:             </button>
0452:             <button onClick={() => setEditField(null)} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
0453:               <X className="w-4 h-4" />
0454:             </button>
0455:           </div>
0456:         ) : (
0457:           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1 group">
0458:             <span className={`text-sm ${value ? 'text-gray-900' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
0459:               {value ?? '—'}
0460:             </span>
0461:             <button
0462:               onClick={() => { setEditField(field); setEditValue(value ?? '') }}
0463:               className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-gray-400 hover:text-sky-500 transition-opacity"
0464:             >
0465:               <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
0466:             </button>
0467:           </div>
0468:         )}
0469:       </div>
0470:     )
0471:   }
0472: 
0473:   const envOptions: Array<'lab' | 'staging' | 'production'> = ['lab', 'staging', 'production']
0474: 
0475:   return (
0476:     <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 py-8">
0477:       {/* Header */}
0478:       <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
0479:         <Link to="/cmdb" className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
0480:           <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
0481:         </Link>
0482:         <div>
0483:           <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 font-mono">{detail.device_id}</h1>
0484:           <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
0485:             {[detail.customer_name, detail.site_name].filter(Boolean).join(' › ') || 'Ikke tildelt'}
0486:           </p>
0487:         </div>
0488:         <div className="ml-4">
0489:           <EnvBadge env={detail.environment} />
0490:         </div>
0491:         <div className="ml-2">
0492:           <StatusDot status={detail.status} />
0493:           <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">{detail.status}</span>
0494:         </div>
0495:         <button onClick={load} className="ml-auto text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
0496:           <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
0497:         </button>
0498:       </div>
0499: 
0500:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
0501: 
0502:         {/* Hardware */}
0503:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0504:           <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
0505:             <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" /> Hardware
0506:           </h2>
0507:           <div className="space-y-0.5">
0508:             <Row label="Model" value={detail.hardware_model} />
0509:             <Row label="SoC" value={detail.soc_model} />
0510:             <Row label="CPU-kerner" value={detail.cpu_cores?.toString()} />
0511:             <Row label="RAM" value={detail.ram_mb ? `${detail.ram_mb} MB` : null} />
0512:             <Row label="MAC-adresse" value={detail.mac_address} mono />
0513:             <Row label="Serienummer" value={detail.serial_number} mono />
0514:             <Row label="Hostname" value={detail.hostname} />
0515:             <Row label="IP-adresse" value={detail.ip_address} mono />
0516:           </div>
0517:         </div>
0518: 
0519:         {/* OS / Software */}
0520:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0521:           <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
0522:             <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" /> OS / Software
0523:           </h2>
0524:           <div className="space-y-0.5">
0525:             <Row label="OS" value={detail.os_name} />
0526:             <Row label="Kernel" value={detail.kernel_version} mono />
0527:             <Row label="Python" value={detail.python_version} />
0528:             <Row label="App-version" value={detail.app_version} mono />
0529:             <Row label="Sidst set" value={fmtDate(detail.last_seen)} />
0530:             <Row label="Inv. rapporteret" value={fmtDate(detail.inventory_reported_at)} />
0531:           </div>
0532:           {Object.keys(detail.venv_packages ?? {}).length > 0 && (
0533:             <details className="mt-3">
0534:               <summary className="text-xs text-sky-600 cursor-pointer hover:text-sky-700">
0535:                 {Object.keys(detail.venv_packages).length} venv-pakker
0536:               </summary>

0078: function getNestedValue(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string): string {
0079:   const parts = path.split('.')
0080:   let val: unknown = obj
0081:   for (const p of parts) {
0082:     if (val && typeof val === 'object') val = (val as Record<string, unknown>)[p]
0083:     else return ''
0084:   }
0085:   return val != null ? String(val) : ''
0086: }
0087: 
0088: function setNestedValue(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string, value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
0089:   const result = { ...obj }
0090:   const parts = path.split('.')
0091:   if (parts.length === 1) {
0092:     result[parts[0]] = value
0093:   } else {
0094:     const section = parts[0]
0095:     const rest = parts.slice(1).join('.')
0096:     result[section] = setNestedValue((result[section] as Record<string, unknown>) || {}, rest, value)
0097:   }
0098:   return result
0099: }

0331:                 <MR l="Optaget UTC" v={sidecar.integrity?.captured_at_utc?.replace('T',' ').slice(0,19)} />
0332:                 <MR l="Lokal tid" v={sidecar.integrity?.captured_at_local?.replace('T',' ').slice(0,19)} />
0333:                 <MR l="Tidszone" v={sidecar.integrity?.timezone} />
0334:                 <MR l="Original uberørt" v={<span className={sidecar.integrity?.original_unmodified ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'}>{sidecar.integrity?.original_unmodified ? '✅ Ja' : '⚠️ Nej'}</span>} />
0335:                 <MR l="XMP skrevet" v={<span className={sidecar.integrity?.xmp_written ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-white/40'}>{sidecar.integrity?.xmp_written ? '✅ Ja' : 'Nej'}</span>} />
0336:                 {sidecar.added_metadata?.fields_added?.length > 0 && (
0337:                   <MR l="Tilføjede felter" v={<span className="text-amber-300/80">{sidecar.added_metadata.fields_added.join(', ')}</span>} />
0338:                 )}
0339:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mt-2 mb-1.5">📊 Kvalitet</p>
0340:                 <MR l="Blur score" v={c.blur_score != null ? `${Math.round(c.blur_score)} ${c.blur_score > 100 ? '✅' : '⚠️ lav'}` : '—'} />
0341:                 <MR l="Lysstyrke" v={c.brightness != null ? `${Math.round(c.brightness)}/255` : '—'} />
0342:                 <MR l="Kvalitetsflag" v={<span className={c.quality_passed ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-400'}>{c.quality_flag ?? '—'}</span>} />
0343:                 <MR l="Størrelse" v={c.filesize_mb != null ? `${c.filesize_mb.toFixed(1)} MB` : '—'} />
0344: 
0345:                 {/* QA ANALYSE */}
0346:                 {(() => {
0347:                   const ai = parseCaptureAI(c, sidecar)
0348:                   const causeLabels: Record<string, string> = {
0349:                     ok: 'OK', condensation_on_lens: 'Kondens på linse',
0350:                     dirty_lens: 'Snavset linse', focus_drift: 'Fokusdrift',
0351:                     camera_moved: 'Kamera flyttet', obstruction: 'Afskærmning',
0352:                     rain_on_lens: 'Regn på linse', sun_flare: 'Solreflektion',
0353:                     night_capture: 'Natkamera', hardware_failure: 'Hardwarefejl',
0354:                     unknown: 'Ukendt',
0355:                   }
0356:                   const actionLabels: Record<string, string> = {
0357:                     none: '—', inspect_camera_housing: 'Tjek kamerahus',
0358:                     clean_lens: 'Rengør linse', check_focus: 'Tjek fokus',
0359:                     reposition_camera: 'Juster kamera',
0360:                     wait_for_conditions: 'Afvent vejr', replace_camera: 'Udskift kamera',
0361:                   }
0362:                   return (
0363:                     <div className="mt-2">
0364:                       <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-1.5">🔬 QA</p>
0365:                       {!ai ? (
0366:                         <p className="text-white/30 text-xs italic">Ikke analyseret endnu</p>
0367:                       ) : ai.scene_dk ? (
0368:                         <>
0369:                           <MR l="Scene" v={<span className="text-white/60 text-[10px] leading-tight">{ai.scene_dk}</span>} />
0370:                           <MR l="Kvalitet" v={<span className={ai.quality_ok === false ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}>{ai.quality_flag ?? '—'}</span>} />
0371:                           <MR l="Ændring" v={ai.change_detected ? (ai.change_summary ?? 'Ja') : 'Nej'} />
0372:                           <MR l="Model" v={<span className="text-white/40 text-[10px]">{ai.model}{ai.used_thumbnail ? ' · thumbnail' : ''}</span>} />
0373:                           {((ai.tags?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (ai.new_tags?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (c.ai_tags?.length ?? 0) > 0) && (
0374:                             <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1.5">
0375:                               {[...(ai.tags ?? []), ...(ai.new_tags ?? []), ...(c.ai_tags ?? [])].filter((tag, idx, arr) => arr.indexOf(tag) === idx).slice(0, 24).map((tag: string) => (
0376:                                 <span key={tag} className="text-[10px] bg-white/10 text-white/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/20" title={`Søg på #${tag}`}>
0377:                                   #{tag}
0378:                                 </span>
0379:                               ))}
0380:                             </div>
0381:                           )}
0382:                           {(c.ai_analyzed_at || ai.analyzed_at) && (
0383:                             <MR l="Analyseret" v={
0384:                               <span className="text-white/30 text-[10px]">
0385:                                 {new Date(c.ai_analyzed_at ?? ai.analyzed_at).toLocaleString('da-DK', {timeZone: getTz(), day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}
0386:                               </span>
0387:                             } />
0388:                           )}
0389:                         </>
0390:                       ) : (
0391:                         <>
0392:                           <MR l="Status" v={
0393:                             <span className={`font-medium ${ai.alarm ? 'text-red-400' : ai.is_anomaly ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'}`}>
0394:                               {ai.alarm ? '🚨 ' : ai.is_anomaly ? '⚠️ ' : '✓ '}
0395:                               {causeLabels[ai.probable_cause] ?? ai.probable_cause}
0396:                             </span>
0397:                           } />
0398:                           <MR l="Konfidence" v={`${Math.round((ai.confidence ?? 0) * 100)}%`} />
0399:                           <MR l="Beskrivelse" v={<span className="text-white/60 text-[10px] leading-tight">{ai.description}</span>} />
0400:                           {ai.action && ai.action !== 'none' && (
0401:                             <MR l="Handling" v={<span className="text-amber-300">{actionLabels[ai.action] ?? ai.action}</span>} />
0402:                           )}
0403:                           <MR l="Model" v={<span className="text-white/40 text-[10px]">{ai.model}{ai.used_thumbnail ? ' · thumbnail' : ''}</span>} />
0404:                           {c.ai_tags && c.ai_tags.length > 0 && (
0405:                             <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1.5">
0406:                               {c.ai_tags.map((tag: string) => (
0407:                                 <span key={tag} className="text-[10px] bg-white/10 text-white/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/20" title={`Søg på #${tag}`}>
0408:                                   #{tag}
0409:                                 </span>
0410:                               ))}
0411:                             </div>
0412:                           )}
0413:                           {c.ai_analyzed_at && (
0414:                             <MR l="Analyseret" v={
0415:                               <span className="text-white/30 text-[10px]">
0416:                                 {new Date(c.ai_analyzed_at).toLocaleString('da-DK', {timeZone: getTz(), day:'2-digit', month:'2-digit', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}
0417:                               </span>
0418:                             } />
0419:                           )}
0420:                         </>
0421:                       )}
0422:                     </div>
0423:                   )
0424:                 })()}
0425: 
0426:               </div>
0427: 
0428:               {/* Kolonne 2: Kamera EXIF */}
0429:               <div className="space-y-0.5">
0430:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-1.5">📷 Kamera EXIF</p>
0431:                 <MR l="Model" v={sidecar.camera?.model} />
0432:                 <MR l="ISO" v={sidecar.camera?.iso} />
0433:                 <MR l="Lukker" v={sidecar.camera?.shutter_speed} />
0434:                 <MR l="Blænde" v={sidecar.camera?.aperture} />
0435:                 <MR l="Fokustilstand" v={sidecar.camera?.focus_mode} />
0436:                 <MR l="USB port" v={sidecar.camera?.gphoto2_port} />
0437:                 <MR l="Relay GPIO" v={sidecar.camera?.relay_gpio_pin} />
0438:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mt-2 mb-1.5">🏗️ Projekt</p>
0439:                 <MR l="Kunde" v={sidecar.project?.customer || '—'} />
0440:                 <MR l="Site" v={sidecar.project?.site || '—'} />
0441:                 <MR l="Kamera" v={sidecar.project?.camera_name || '—'} />
0442:                 <MR l="Device ID" v={<span className="font-mono text-[10px]">{sidecar.project?.device_id}</span>} />
0443:                 <MR l="Kamera index" v={sidecar.project?.camera_index ?? '—'} />
0444:                 <MR l="TLP version" v={sidecar.timelapse_pro?.version} />
0445:               </div>
0446: 
0447:               {/* Kolonne 3: Lokation + Orientering */}
0448:               <div className="space-y-0.5">
0449:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-1.5">📍 Lokation</p>
0450:                 <MR l="GPS" v={sidecar.location?.gps_lat != null ? `${sidecar.location.gps_lat.toFixed(6)}°, ${sidecar.location.gps_lon?.toFixed(6)}°` : '—'} />
0451:                 <MR l="Højde" v={sidecar.location?.gps_alt_m != null ? `${sidecar.location.gps_alt_m} m` : '—'} />
0452:                 <MR l="GPS kilde" v={sidecar.location?.gps_source || '—'} />
0453:                 <MR l="Adresse" v={sidecar.location?.address || '—'} />
0454:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mt-2 mb-1.5">🧭 Orientering</p>
0455:                 <MR l="Azimut" v={sidecar.location?.azimuth_deg != null ? `${sidecar.location.azimuth_deg}°` : '—'} />
0456:                 <MR l="Tilt" v={sidecar.location?.tilt_deg != null ? `${sidecar.location.tilt_deg}°` : '—'} />
0457:                 <MR l="Montagehøjde" v={sidecar.location?.mount_height_m != null ? `${sidecar.location.mount_height_m} m` : '—'} />
0458:                 <MR l="Horis. FOV" v={sidecar.location?.fov_horizontal_deg != null ? `${sidecar.location.fov_horizontal_deg}°` : '—'} />
0459:                 <MR l="Vert. FOV" v={sidecar.location?.fov_vertical_deg != null ? `${sidecar.location.fov_vertical_deg}°` : '—'} />
0460:                 <MR l="Perspektiv" v={sidecar.location?.perspective || '—'} />
0461:               </div>
0462: 
0463:               {/* Raw EXIF */}
0464:               {exif && Object.keys(exif).length > 0 && (
0465:               <div className="col-span-3 mt-3 border-t border-white/10 pt-3">
0466:                 <p className="text-white/30 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-2">📷 Raw EXIF fra JPG ({Object.keys(exif).length} felter)</p>
0467:                 <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-8 gap-y-0.5 text-xs">
0468:                   {Object.entries(exif)
0469:                     .filter(([k]) => !['MakerNote','UserComment','PrintImageMatching','FlashPixVersion','ExifVersion','ComponentsConfiguration','SceneType','FileSource','GPSInfo'].includes(k))
0470:                     .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
0471:                     .map(([k, v]) => (
0472:                     <div key={k} className="flex gap-2 min-w-0">
0473:                       <span className="text-white/35 shrink-0 text-[10px]" style={{width:'160px'}}>{k}</span>
0474:                       <span className="text-white/75 min-w-0 truncate text-[10px]" title={v}>{v}</span>
0475:                     </div>
0476:                   ))}
0477:                 </div>
0478:               </div>
0479:               )}
0480: 
0481:             </div>
0482:           )}
0483:         </div>
0484:       )}
0485:       {/* Filmstrip
0486: 
0487: 
0488:       {/* Filmstrip */}
0489:       <div className="flex-shrink-0 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-4 py-2 justify-center bg-black/50" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
0490:         {captures.map((cap, i) => {
0491:           const nearby = Math.abs(i - cur) <= 8
0492:           return (
0493:             <div key={cap.id} className={`flex-shrink-0 w-24 transition-all ${i === cur ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-45 hover:opacity-80'}`}>
0494:               {nearby
0495:                 ? (
0496:                   <CaptureThumbnailCard
0497:                     capture={cap}
0498:                     compact
0499:                     selected={i === cur}
0500:                     onClick={() => { setCur(i); setZoom(1); setPan({ x: 0, y: 0 }) }}
0501:                   />
0502:                 )
0503:                 : <div className="w-full h-full bg-white/5" />
0504:               }
0505:             </div>
0506:           )
0507:         })}
0508:       </div>
0509:     </div>
0510:   )
0511: }

0515: // ── Camera param row (bruges i ConfigTab) ────────────────────────────────────
0516: function CameraParamRow({ param, deviceId }: {
0517:   param: any; deviceId: string
0518: }) {
0519:   const [editing, setEditing]         = useState(false)
0520:   const [value, setValue]             = useState(param.current)
0521:   const [displayValue, setDisplayValue] = useState(param.current)
0522:   const [saving, setSaving]           = useState(false)
0523:   const [saved, setSaved]             = useState(false)
0524: 
0525:   async function save() {
0526:     setSaving(true)
0527:     try {
0528:       const key = param.path.replace('/main/', '')
0529:       await setParam(deviceId, key, value)
0530:       // Opdater camera_params i headend så refresh ikke nulstiller værdien
0531:       const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0532:       const encodedDeviceId = pathSegment(deviceId)
0533:       const cfg = await (await authFetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${encodedDeviceId}`)).json()
0534:       const updatedParams = (cfg?.device?.device_config ? 
0535:         JSON.parse(typeof cfg.device.device_config === 'string' ? cfg.device.device_config : JSON.stringify(cfg.device.device_config)) : {}
0536:       )
0537:       if (updatedParams.camera_params) {
0538:         updatedParams.camera_params = updatedParams.camera_params.map((cp: any) =>
0539:           cp.path.endsWith(key) ? { ...cp, current: value } : cp
0540:         )
0541:         await authFetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${encodedDeviceId}/config`, {
0542:           method: 'PUT',
0543:           headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0544:           body: JSON.stringify({ camera_params: updatedParams.camera_params })
0545:         })
0546:       }
0547:       setSaved(true)
0548:       setDisplayValue(value)
0549:       setTimeout(() => { setSaved(false); setEditing(false) }, 800)
0550:     } catch (err) { 
0551:       console.error('save error:', err)
0552:     }
0553:     setSaving(false)
0554:   }
0555: 
0556:   return (
0557:     <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2 px-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50">
0558:       <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
0559:         <div className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 truncate">{param.label}</div>
0560:         <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 truncate">{param.path}</div>
0561:       </div>
0562:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
0563:         {!editing ? (
0564:           <>
0565:             <span className="text-sm px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-sky-700 bg-sky-50">{displayValue || '–'}</span>
0566:             <button onClick={() => { setValue(displayValue); setEditing(true) }}
0567:               className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-sky-600 rounded">
0568:               <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
0569:             </button>
0570:           </>
0571:         ) : (
0572:           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
0573:             {param.choices?.length > 0 ? (
0574:               <select value={value} onChange={e => setValue(e.target.value)}
0575:                 className="text-sm border border-sky-300 rounded px-2 py-0.5 bg-white focus:outline-none">
0576:                 {param.choices.map((c: any) => (
0577:                   <option key={c.index} value={c.label}>{c.label}</option>
0578:                 ))}
0579:               </select>
0580:             ) : (
0581:               <input value={value} onChange={e => setValue(e.target.value)}
0582:                 className="text-sm border border-sky-300 rounded px-2 py-0.5 w-28 focus:outline-none"
0583:                 onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') save(); if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditing(false) }}
0584:               />
0585:             )}
0586:             <button onClick={save} disabled={saving}
0587:               className="p-1 text-green-600 hover:text-green-700 rounded">
0588:               <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
0589:             </button>
0590:             <button onClick={() => setEditing(false)} className="p-1 text-gray-400 rounded">
0591:               <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
0592:             </button>
0593:           </div>
0594:         )}
0595:       </div>
0596:     </div>
0597:   )
0598: }
0599: 
0600: function ConfigTab({ deviceId }: { deviceId: string }) {
0601:   const [cfg, setCfg]       = useState<any>(null)
0602:   const [info, setInfo]     = useState<any>(null)
0603:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
0604:   const [msg, setMsg]       = useState<string | null>(null)
0605: 
0606:   useEffect(() => {
0607:     getConfig(deviceId).then(d => { setCfg(d); setInfo(d?.device ?? {}) })
0608:   }, [deviceId])
0609: 
0610:   async function saveConfig() {
0611:     setSaving(true); setMsg(null)
0612:     try {
0613:       await updateConfig(deviceId, cfg)
0614:       setMsg('Konfiguration gemt ✓')
0615:     } catch { setMsg('Fejl ved gemning') }
0616:     setSaving(false)
0617:   }
0618: 
0619:   async function saveInfo() {
0620:     setSaving(true); setMsg(null)
0621:     try {
0622:       await updateDeviceInfo(deviceId, info)
0623:       setMsg('Enhedsinfo gemt ✓')
0624:     } catch { setMsg('Fejl ved gemning') }
0625:     setSaving(false)
0626:   }
0627: 
0628:   if (!cfg) return <div className="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">Indlæser konfiguration…</div>
0629: 
0630:   const schedule = cfg.schedule ?? {}
0631:   const camera   = cfg.camera   ?? {}
0632:   const sftp     = cfg.sftp     ?? {}
0633: 
0634:   return (
0635:     <div className="space-y-5 max-w-2xl">
0636:       {msg && (
0637:         <div className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium ${msg.includes('✓') ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-red-50 text-red-700'}`}>
0638:           {msg}
0639:         </div>
0640:       )}
0641: 
0642:       {/* Enhedsidentitet */}
0643:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0644:         <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Enhedsidentitet</h3>
0645:         <div className="space-y-3">
0646:           {[
0647:             { label: 'Kundenavn', key: 'customer_name' },
0648:             { label: 'Sitenavn', key: 'site_name' },
0649:             { label: 'Kameranavn', key: 'camera_name' },
0650:           ].map(({ label, key }) => (
0651:             <div key={key}>
0652:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">{label}</label>
0653:               <input className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0654:                 value={info?.[key] ?? ''} onChange={e => setInfo({ ...info, [key]: e.target.value })} />
0655:             </div>
0656:           ))}
0657:           <button onClick={saveInfo} disabled={saving}
0658:             className="mt-2 px-4 py-2 bg-sky-500 text-white text-sm rounded-lg hover:bg-sky-600 disabled:opacity-50">
0659:             Gem enhedsinfo
0660:           </button>
0661:         </div>
0662:       </div>
0663: 
0664:       {/* Kamera-parametre */}
0665:       {cfg?.camera_params && cfg.camera_params.length > 0 && (
0666:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0667:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
0668:             <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">Kamera-parametre</h3>
0669:             <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{cfg.camera_params.length} parametre · fra seneste lab-session</span>
0670:           </div>
0671:           <div className="space-y-1">
0672:             {cfg.camera_params
0673:               .filter((p: any) => !p.readonly && p.current)
0674:               .map((p: any) => (
0675:               <CameraParamRow key={p.path} param={p} deviceId={deviceId} />
0676:             ))}
0677:           </div>
0678:           <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-3">Readonly-parametre vises ikke. Gå til Kamera-lab for fuld liste.</p>
0679:         </div>
0680:       )}
0681: 
0682:       {/* GPS / Lokation */}
0683:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0684:         <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">GPS og Lokation</h3>
0685:         <div className="space-y-3">
0686:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
0687:             <div>
0688:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Breddegrad (lat)</label>
0689:               <input type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="55.676098"
0690:                 className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono"
0691:                 value={cfg?.location?.gps_lat ?? ''}
0692:                 onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, location: { ...(cfg.location ?? {}), gps_lat: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) : null } })} />
0693:             </div>
0694:             <div>
0695:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Længdegrad (lon)</label>
0696:               <input type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="12.568337"
0697:                 className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono"
0698:                 value={cfg?.location?.gps_lon ?? ''}
0699:                 onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, location: { ...(cfg.location ?? {}), gps_lon: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) : null } })} />
0700:             </div>
0701:           </div>
0702:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
0703:             <div>
0704:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Højde (meter over hav)</label>
0705:               <input type="number" step="1" placeholder="0"
0706:                 className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono"
0707:                 value={cfg?.location?.gps_alt ?? ''}
0708:                 onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, location: { ...(cfg.location ?? {}), gps_alt: e.target.value ? parseFloat(e.target.value) : null } })} />
0709:             </div>
0710:             <div>
0711:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">GPS kilde</label>
0712:               <select className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0713:                 value={cfg?.location?.gps_source ?? 'manual'}
0714:                 onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, location: { ...(cfg.location ?? {}), gps_source: e.target.value } })}>
0715:                 <option value="manual">Manuelt indsat</option>
0716:                 <option value="gpsd">gpsd (Orange Pi GPS modul)</option>
0717:               </select>
0718:             </div>
0719:           </div>
0720:           <div>
0721:             <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Adresse (valgfri)</label>
0722:             <input type="text" placeholder="Nordre Villavej 17c, 7100 Vejle"
0723:               className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0724:               value={cfg?.location?.address ?? ''}
0725:               onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, location: { ...(cfg.location ?? {}), address: e.target.value } })} />
0726:           </div>
0727:           {cfg?.location?.gps_lat && cfg?.location?.gps_lon && (
0728:             <a href={`https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${cfg.location.gps_lat}&mlon=${cfg.location.gps_lon}&zoom=17`}
0729:               target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
0730:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-sky-500 hover:text-sky-700">
0731:               🗺️ Vis på kort (OpenStreetMap)
0732:             </a>
0733:           )}
0734:         </div>
0735:       </div>
0736: 
0737:       {/* Schedule */}
0738:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0739:         <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Optagelsesplan</h3>
0740: 
0741:         {/* Mode selector */}
0742:         <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">
0743:           {(['interval', 'fixed'] as const).map(m => (
0744:             <button key={m} onClick={() => setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, capture_mode: m } })}
0745:               className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border transition-colors ${
0746:                 (schedule.capture_mode ?? 'interval') === m
0747:                   ? 'bg-sky-500 text-white border-sky-500'
0748:                   : 'bg-white text-gray-500 border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300'
0749:               }`}>
0750:               {m === 'interval' ? 'Interval' : 'Faste tidspunkter'}
0751:             </button>
0752:           ))}
0753:         </div>
0754: 
0755:         {(schedule.capture_mode ?? 'interval') === 'interval' ? (
0756:           <div className="space-y-3">
0757:             <div>
0758:               <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Interval (minutter)</label>
0759:               <input type="number" min={1} max={720} className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0760:                 value={schedule.interval_minutes ?? 10}
0761:                 onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, interval_minutes: parseInt(e.target.value) } })} />
0762:             </div>
0763:             <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
0764:               <div>
0765:                 <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Aktiv fra</label>
0766:                 <input type="time" className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0767:                   value={schedule.active_hours?.[0] ?? '06:00'}
0768:                   onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, active_hours: [e.target.value, schedule.active_hours?.[1] ?? '21:00'] } })} />
0769:               </div>
0770:               <div>
0771:                 <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Aktiv til</label>
0772:                 <input type="time" className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0773:                   value={schedule.active_hours?.[1] ?? '21:00'}
0774:                   onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, active_hours: [schedule.active_hours?.[0] ?? '06:00', e.target.value] } })} />
0775:               </div>
0776:             </div>
0777:           </div>
0778:         ) : (
0779:           <div className="space-y-3">
0780:             <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block">Tidspunkter for optagelse</label>
0781:             <div className="space-y-2">
0782:               {(schedule.capture_times ?? ['08:00']).map((t: string, i: number) => (
0783:                 <div key={i} className="flex gap-2 items-center">
0784:                   <input type="time" className="flex-1 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0785:                     value={t}
0786:                     onChange={e => {
0787:                       const times = [...(schedule.capture_times ?? [])]
0788:                       times[i] = e.target.value
0789:                       times.sort()
0790:                       setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, capture_times: times } })
0791:                     }} />
0792:                   <button onClick={() => {
0793:                     const times = (schedule.capture_times ?? []).filter((_: string, j: number) => j !== i)
0794:                     setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, capture_times: times } })
0795:                   }} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 px-2 py-1 text-lg leading-none">×</button>
0796:                 </div>
0797:               ))}
0798:             </div>
0799:             <button onClick={() => {
0800:               const times = [...(schedule.capture_times ?? []), '12:00']
0801:               times.sort()
0802:               setCfg({ ...cfg, schedule: { ...schedule, capture_times: times } })
0803:             }} className="text-sky-500 hover:text-sky-700 text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
0804:               + Tilføj tidspunkt
0805:             </button>
0806:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">Tidspunkterne koordineres automatisk på tværs af kameraer på samme site.</p>
0807:           </div>
0808:         )}
0809:       </div>
0810: 
0811:       {/* Kamera */}
0812:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0813:         <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Kamera</h3>
0814:         <div className="space-y-3">
0815:           <div>
0816:             <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Strømstyring</label>
0817:             <select className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0818:               value={camera.power_mode ?? 'relay'}
0819:               onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, camera: { ...camera, power_mode: e.target.value } })}>
0820:               <option value="relay">relay</option>
0821:               <option value="usb_powered">usb_powered</option>
0822:             </select>
0823:           </div>
0824:           <div>
0825:             <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Opvarmningstid (sekunder)</label>
0826:             <input type="number" min={1} max={60} className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0827:               value={camera.relay_on_seconds_before ?? 10}
0828:               onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, camera: { ...camera, relay_on_seconds_before: parseInt(e.target.value) } })} />
0829:           </div>
0830:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
0831:             <input type="checkbox" id="delete_after"
0832:               checked={camera.delete_after_download ?? true}
0833:               onChange={e => setCfg({ ...cfg, camera: { ...camera, delete_after_download: e.target.checked } })} />
0834:             <label htmlFor="delete_after" className="text-sm text-gray-700">Slet billede fra kamera efter download</label>
0835:           </div>
0836:         </div>
0837:       </div>
0838: 
0839:       <button onClick={saveConfig} disabled={saving}
0840:         className="w-full py-2.5 bg-sky-500 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-sky-600 disabled:opacity-50">
0841:         {saving ? 'Gemmer…' : 'Gem konfiguration'}
0842:       </button>
0843:     </div>
0844:   )
0845: }

0847: function ProgressBar({ pct, color }: { pct: number; color: string }) {
0848:   return (
0849:     <div className="h-1.5 bg-gray-100 rounded-full mt-1.5 overflow-hidden">
0850:       <div className={`h-full rounded-full ${color}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(pct, 100)}%` }} />
0851:     </div>
0852:   )
0853: }
0854: 
0855: function DriftBadge({ param, expected, actual }: { param: string; expected: string; actual: string }) {
0856:   const labels: Record<string, string> = {
0857:     focus_mode: 'Fokus', image_format: 'Format', iso: 'ISO',
0858:     white_balance: 'Hvidbalance', color_space: 'Farverum',
0859:     exposure_comp: 'Eksponering', ae_mode: 'AE-tilstand',
0860:     picture_style: 'Billedstil', metering_mode: 'Måling',
0861:   }
0862:   return (
0863:     <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0 text-xs">
0864:       <span className="text-gray-500">{labels[param] ?? param}</span>
0865:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0866:         <span className="text-gray-300 line-through">{expected}</span>
0867:         <span className="text-red-600 font-medium">{actual}</span>
0868:       </div>
0869:     </div>
0870:   )
0871: }

0873: function StatsTab({ captures, diagnostics, deviceId }: { captures: Capture[]; diagnostics: any; deviceId: string }) {
0874:   const [diagHistory, setDiagHistory] = useState<any[]>([])
0875:   useEffect(() => {
0876:     const apiUrl = (window as any).__TIMELAPSE_API__ || localStorage.getItem('timelapse_api_url') || ''
0877:     authFetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/diagnostics/history?days=7&limit=500`)
0878:       .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : [])
0879:       .then(d => setDiagHistory(d))
0880:       .catch(() => {})
0881:   }, [deviceId])
0882:   const sorted = [...captures].sort((a, b) =>
0883:     new Date(a.captured_at ?? 0).getTime() - new Date(b.captured_at ?? 0).getTime()
0884:   )
0885: 
0886:   const qualityData = sorted
0887:     .filter(c => c.captured_at)
0888:     .map(c => ({
0889:       time: new Date(c.captured_at!).toLocaleTimeString('da-DK', { timeZone: getTz(), hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
0890:       blur:       c.blur_score != null ? Math.round(c.blur_score) : null,
0891:       brightness: c.brightness != null ? Math.round(c.brightness) : null,
0892:       size:       c.filesize_mb ?? null,
0893:       passed:     c.quality_passed,
0894:     }))
0895: 
0896:   const passRate   = captures.length > 0 ? Math.round(100 * captures.filter(c => c.quality_passed).length / captures.length) : 0
0897:   const uploadRate = captures.length > 0 ? Math.round(100 * captures.filter(c => c.uploaded).length / captures.length) : 0
0898:   const avgBlur    = captures.filter(c => c.blur_score != null).length > 0
0899:     ? Math.round(captures.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.blur_score ?? 0), 0) / captures.filter(c => c.blur_score != null).length) : 0
0900: 
0901:   // Parse camera diagnostics from diagnostics object
0902:   const camDrift: any[] = (() => {
0903:     try { return diagnostics?.cam_drift_json ? JSON.parse(diagnostics.cam_drift_json) : [] }
0904:     catch { return [] }
0905:   })()
0906:   const camConfig: any = (() => {
0907:     try { return diagnostics?.cam_config_json ? JSON.parse(diagnostics.cam_config_json) : null }
0908:     catch { return null }
0909:   })()
0910: 
0911:   const shutterPct   = diagnostics?.cam_shutter_pct
0912:   const shutterAlarm = diagnostics?.cam_shutter_alarm
0913:   const ssdUsedPct   = diagnostics?.ssd_used_pct
0914:   const ntpOffset    = diagnostics?.ntp_offset_s
0915: 
0916:   return (
0917:     <div className="space-y-5">
0918: 
0919:       {/* Capture statistik */}
0920:       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
0921:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 text-center">
0922:           <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Captures</p>
0923:           <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-gray-800">{captures.length}</p>
0924:         </div>
0925:         <div className={`bg-white rounded-xl border p-4 text-center ${passRate >= 95 ? 'border-emerald-200' : 'border-amber-200'}`}>
0926:           <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Kvalitet OK</p>
0927:           <p className={`text-2xl font-semibold ${passRate >= 95 ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`}>{passRate}%</p>
0928:         </div>
0929:         <div className={`bg-white rounded-xl border p-4 text-center ${uploadRate >= 95 ? 'border-emerald-200' : 'border-amber-200'}`}>
0930:           <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Uploadet</p>
0931:           <p className={`text-2xl font-semibold ${uploadRate >= 95 ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-amber-600'}`}>{uploadRate}%</p>
0932:         </div>
0933:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 text-center">
0934:           <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Gns. blur</p>
0935:           <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-gray-800">{avgBlur}</p>
0936:         </div>
0937:       </div>
0938: 
0939:       {/* Hardware diagnostik */}
0940:       {diagnostics && (
0941:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0942:           <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-1.5">
0943:             <Heart className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />Heartbeat — Orange Pi
0944:           </h3>
0945:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
0946:             {/* CPU */}
0947:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
0948:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">CPU temperatur</p>
0949:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${(diagnostics.cpu_temp_c ?? 0) > 75 ? 'text-red-600' : (diagnostics.cpu_temp_c ?? 0) > 65 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
0950:                 {diagnostics.cpu_temp_c != null ? `${diagnostics.cpu_temp_c.toFixed(1)}°C` : '–'}
0951:               </p>
0952:               {diagnostics.cpu_temp_c != null && <ProgressBar pct={diagnostics.cpu_temp_c / 85 * 100} color={(diagnostics.cpu_temp_c > 75) ? 'bg-red-400' : (diagnostics.cpu_temp_c > 65) ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'} />}
0953:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1">Alarm ved &gt;75°C</p>
0954:             </div>
0955:             {/* CPU load */}
0956:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
0957:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">CPU load</p>
0958:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${(diagnostics.cpu_load_pct ?? 0) > 80 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
0959:                 {diagnostics.cpu_load_pct != null ? `${diagnostics.cpu_load_pct.toFixed(1)}%` : '–'}
0960:               </p>
0961:               {diagnostics.cpu_load_pct != null && <ProgressBar pct={diagnostics.cpu_load_pct} color={(diagnostics.cpu_load_pct > 80) ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'} />}
0962:             </div>
0963:             {/* SSD */}
0964:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
0965:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">SSD lager</p>
0966:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${(ssdUsedPct ?? 0) > 85 ? 'text-red-600' : (ssdUsedPct ?? 0) > 70 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
0967:                 {ssdUsedPct != null ? `${ssdUsedPct.toFixed(1)}% brugt` : diagnostics.disk_used_gb != null ? `${diagnostics.disk_used_gb.toFixed(1)} GB` : '–'}
0968:               </p>
0969:               {ssdUsedPct != null && <ProgressBar pct={ssdUsedPct} color={(ssdUsedPct > 85) ? 'bg-red-400' : (ssdUsedPct > 70) ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'} />}
0970:               <div className="flex justify-between mt-1">
0971:                 {ssdUsedPct != null && <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">{ssdUsedPct.toFixed(0)}% brugt</p>}
0972:                 {diagnostics.ssd_free_gb != null && <p className="text-xs text-gray-300">{diagnostics.ssd_free_gb.toFixed(1)} GB ledig</p>}
0973:               </div>
0974:             </div>
0975:             {/* NTP */}
0976:             <div className={`rounded-lg p-3 ${ntpOffset != null && Math.abs(ntpOffset) > 2 ? 'bg-red-50' : 'bg-gray-50'}`}>
0977:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">NTP offset</p>
0978:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${ntpOffset != null && Math.abs(ntpOffset) > 2 ? 'text-red-600' : ntpOffset != null && Math.abs(ntpOffset) > 0.5 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
0979:                 {ntpOffset != null ? `${ntpOffset > 0 ? '+' : ''}${ntpOffset.toFixed(3)}s` : '–'}
0980:               </p>
0981:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1">Alarm ved &gt;2s</p>
0982:             </div>
0983:             {/* Netværk */}
0984:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
0985:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Netværk</p>
0986:               <p className="font-semibold mt-0.5 text-gray-700">{diagnostics.connectivity ?? '–'}</p>
0987:               {diagnostics.connectivity === 'wifi' && (diagnostics as any).wifi_ssid && (
0988:                 <p className="text-xs text-sky-500 mt-0.5 truncate" title="WiFi SSID">📶 {(diagnostics as any).wifi_ssid}</p>
0989:               )}
0990:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1">{diagnostics.upload_queue != null ? `${diagnostics.upload_queue} i kø` : ''}</p>
0991:             </div>
0992:             {/* Oppetid */}
0993:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
0994:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Oppetid</p>
0995:               <p className="font-semibold mt-0.5 text-gray-700">{diagnostics.uptime_s != null ? formatUptime(diagnostics.uptime_s) : '–'}</p>
0996:               {diagnostics.service_restarts != null && diagnostics.service_restarts > 0 && (
0997:                 <p className="text-xs text-amber-500 mt-1">{diagnostics.service_restarts} genstarter</p>
0998:               )}
0999:             </div>
1000:           </div>
1001:           <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-3">
1002:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-center">
1003:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Total captures</p>
1004:               <p className="font-semibold text-gray-700">{diagnostics.capture_total ?? '–'}</p>
1005:             </div>
1006:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-center">
1007:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Kvalitet OK</p>
1008:               <p className="font-semibold text-emerald-600">{diagnostics.capture_passed ?? '–'}</p>
1009:             </div>
1010:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-center">
1011:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Uploadet</p>
1012:               <p className="font-semibold text-sky-600">{diagnostics.capture_uploaded ?? '–'}</p>
1013:             </div>
1014:           </div>
1015:         </div>
1016:       )}
1017: 
1018:       {/* Kamera diagnostik */}
1019:       {diagnostics && (
1020:         <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
1021:           <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-4">Kamera — Canon EOS 1300D</h3>
1022:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-4">
1023:             {/* Batteri */}
1024:             <div className={`rounded-lg p-3 ${(diagnostics.cam_battery_pct ?? 100) < 20 ? 'bg-red-50' : 'bg-gray-50'}`}>
1025:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Batteri</p>
1026:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${(diagnostics.cam_battery_pct ?? 100) < 20 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
1027:                 {diagnostics.cam_battery_pct != null ? `${diagnostics.cam_battery_pct}%` : '–'}
1028:               </p>
1029:               {diagnostics.cam_battery_pct != null && <ProgressBar pct={diagnostics.cam_battery_pct} color={(diagnostics.cam_battery_pct < 20) ? 'bg-red-400' : (diagnostics.cam_battery_pct < 50) ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'} />}
1030:             </div>
1031:             {/* Shutter */}
1032:             <div className={`rounded-lg p-3 ${shutterAlarm ? 'bg-red-50' : (shutterPct ?? 0) > 60 ? 'bg-amber-50' : 'bg-gray-50'}`}>
1033:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Lukker-tæller</p>
1034:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${shutterAlarm ? 'text-red-600' : (shutterPct ?? 0) > 60 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
1035:                 {diagnostics.cam_shutter_cnt != null ? diagnostics.cam_shutter_cnt.toLocaleString('da-DK') : '–'}
1036:               </p>
1037:               {shutterPct != null && <ProgressBar pct={shutterPct} color={shutterAlarm ? 'bg-red-400' : (shutterPct > 60) ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-400'} />}
1038:               {shutterPct != null && <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1">{shutterPct.toFixed(1)}% af levetid</p>}
1039:             </div>
1040:             {/* Ledige billeder */}
1041:             <div className={`rounded-lg p-3 ${(diagnostics.cam_available_shots ?? 999) < 50 ? 'bg-amber-50' : 'bg-gray-50'}`}>
1042:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Ledige billeder</p>
1043:               <p className={`font-semibold mt-0.5 ${(diagnostics.cam_available_shots ?? 999) < 50 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-gray-700'}`}>
1044:                 {diagnostics.cam_available_shots ?? '–'}
1045:               </p>
1046:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 mt-1">Alarm ved &lt;50</p>
1047:             </div>
1048:             {/* Linse */}
1049:             <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-3">
1050:               <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Linse</p>
1051:               <p className="font-semibold mt-0.5 text-gray-700 text-xs leading-tight">{diagnostics.cam_lens_name ?? '–'}</p>
1052:             </div>
1053:           </div>
1054: 
1055:           {/* Config drift */}
1056:           {camDrift.length > 0 ? (
1057:             <div className="border border-red-200 rounded-lg p-3 bg-red-50">
1058:               <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-700 mb-2">Kamera-konfiguration afviger fra forventet ({camDrift.length})</p>
1059:               {camDrift.map((d: any) => <DriftBadge key={d.param} {...d} />)}
1060:             </div>
1061:           ) : camConfig ? (
1062:             <div className="border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg p-3 bg-emerald-50">
