1301: }
1302: // ── Main page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1303: type Tab = 'captures' | 'timeline' | 'stats' | 'config'
1304: 
1305: export function DevicePage() {
1306:   const navigate = useNavigate()
1307:   const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>()
1308:   const [detail, setDetail]   = useState<DeviceDetail | null>(null)
1309:   const [captures, setCaptures] = useState<Capture[]>([])
1310:   const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(true)
1311:   const [tab, setTab]           = useState<Tab>('captures')
1312:   const [lightbox, setLightbox] = useState<number | null>(null)
1313: 
1314:   const load = async () => {
1315:     if (!id) return
1316:     setLoading(true)
1317:     try {
1318:       const [d, c] = await Promise.all([getDevice(id), getCaptures(id, 200)])
1319:       setDetail(d)
1320:       setCaptures(c)
1321:     } finally {
1322:       setLoading(false)
1323:     }
1324:   }
1325: 
1326:   useEffect(() => { load() }, [id])
1327: 
1328:   if (loading) return <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-400">Indlæser…</div>
1329:   if (!detail) return <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-16 text-center text-gray-400">Enhed ikke fundet</div>
1330: 
1331:   const { device, diagnostics } = detail
1332:   const routeDeviceId = pathSegment(device.device_id)
1333: 
1334:   const tabs: { key: Tab; label: string; icon: any }[] = [
1335:     { key: 'captures',  label: `Billeder (${captures.length})`, icon: Camera },
1336:     { key: 'timeline',  label: 'Tidslinje', icon: CalendarDays },
1337:     { key: 'stats',     label: 'Statistik', icon: BarChart2 },
1338:     { key: 'config',    label: 'Konfiguration', icon: Settings },
1339:   ]
1340: 
1341:   return (
1342:     <>
1343:       {lightbox !== null && (
1344:         <Lightbox captures={captures} index={lightbox} onClose={() => setLightbox(null)} />
1345:       )}
1346: 
1347:       <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8">
1348:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
1349:           <Link to="/" className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"><ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" /></Link>
1350:           <div className="flex-1">
1351:             <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
1352:               <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{device.camera_name || device.location_name || device.device_id}</h1>
1353:             {(device.customer_name || device.site_name) && (
1354:               <span className="text-sm text-gray-400">{[device.customer_name, device.site_name].filter(Boolean).join(' — ')}</span>
1355:             )}
1356:               <StatusBadge status={device.status} />
1357:             </div>
1358:             <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{device.device_id}</p>
1359:           </div>
1360:           <button onClick={load} disabled={loading} className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50">
1361:             <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 text-gray-500 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
1362:           </button>
1363:         </div>
1364: 
1365:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-6">
1366:           {diagnostics?.cpu_temp_c != null && (
1367:             <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
1368:               <Thermometer className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1369:               <div><p className="text-xs text-gray-400">CPU temp</p><p className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">{diagnostics.cpu_temp_c.toFixed(1)}°C</p></div>
1370:             </div>
1371:           )}
1372:           {diagnostics?.disk_used_gb != null && (
1373:             <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
1374:               <HardDrive className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1375:               <div><p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Disk brugt</p><p className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">{diagnostics.disk_used_gb.toFixed(1)} GB</p></div>
1376:             </div>
1377:           )}
1378:           {diagnostics?.connectivity && (
1379:             <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
1380:               <Wifi className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1381:               <div><p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Netværk</p><p className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">{diagnostics.connectivity}</p></div>
1382:             </div>
1383:           )}
1384:           {diagnostics?.uptime_s != null && (
1385:             <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
1386:               <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400 flex-shrink-0" />
1387:               <div><p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Oppetid</p><p className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">{formatUptime(diagnostics.uptime_s)}</p></div>
1388:             </div>
1389:           )}
1390:         </div>
1391: 
1392:         <div className="flex gap-1 mb-6 border-b border-gray-200">
1393:           <button onClick={() => navigate(`/devices/${routeDeviceId}/timelapse`)}
1394:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-sky-600 hover:text-sky-700 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:border-sky-400 -mb-px transition-colors mr-2">
1395:             <Film className="w-4 h-4" />Timelapse Video
1396:           </button>
1397:           <button onClick={() => navigate(`/devices/${routeDeviceId}/lab`)}
1398:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-purple-600 hover:text-purple-700 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:border-purple-400 -mb-px transition-colors mr-2">
1399:             <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4" />Lab
1400:           </button>
1401:           {tabs.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
1402:             <button key={key} onClick={() => setTab(key)}
1403:               className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${
1404:                 tab === key ? 'border-sky-500 text-sky-600' : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700'
1405:               }`}
1406:             >
1407:               <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />{label}
1408:             </button>
1409:           ))}
1410:         </div>
1411: 
1412:         {tab === 'captures' && (
1413:           <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
1414:             {captures.map((c, i) => (
1415:               <CaptureThumbnailCard key={c.id} capture={c} onClick={() => setLightbox(i)} />
1416:             ))}
1417:             {captures.length === 0 && (
1418:               <div className="col-span-full py-12 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">Ingen captures endnu</div>
1419:             )}
1420:           </div>
1421:         )}
1422: 
1423:         {tab === 'timeline' && id && <TimelineNavigator deviceId={id} captures={captures} onSelect={i => { setLightbox(i) }} />}
1424:         {tab === 'stats' && id && <StatsTab captures={captures} diagnostics={diagnostics} deviceId={id} />}
1425:         {tab === 'config' && id && <ConfigTab deviceId={id} />}
1426:       </div>
1427:     </>

0041: // ── Histogram hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0042: function useHistogram(imgRef: React.RefObject<HTMLImageElement | null>) {
0043:   const [hist, setHist] = useState<{ r: number[]; g: number[]; b: number[]; lum: number[] } | null>(null)
0044:   const compute = useCallback(() => {
0045:     const img = imgRef.current
0046:     if (!img || !img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return
0047:     const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
0048:     const scale  = Math.min(1, 400 / Math.max(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight))
0049:     canvas.width  = Math.round(img.naturalWidth * scale)
0050:     canvas.height = Math.round(img.naturalHeight * scale)
0051:     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!
0052:     ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
0053:     const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data
0054:     const r = new Array(256).fill(0), g = new Array(256).fill(0)
0055:     const b = new Array(256).fill(0), lum = new Array(256).fill(0)
0056:     for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
0057:       r[data[i]]++; g[data[i+1]]++; b[data[i+2]]++
0058:       lum[Math.round(0.299*data[i] + 0.587*data[i+1] + 0.114*data[i+2])]++
0059:     }
0060:     setHist({ r, g, b, lum })
0061:   }, [imgRef])
0062:   return { hist, compute, clear: () => setHist(null) }
0063: }
0064: 
0065: // ── Mini histogram display ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0066: function MiniHistogram({ hist }: { hist: { r: number[]; g: number[]; b: number[]; lum: number[] } }) {
0067:   return (
0068:     <div className="flex gap-4 items-end p-3 bg-black/60 rounded-xl w-full">
0069:       {(['lum', 'r', 'g', 'b'] as const).map(ch => {
0070:         const colors: Record<string, string> = { lum: '#d1d5db', r: '#f87171', g: '#4ade80', b: '#60a5fa' }
0071:         const labels: Record<string, string> = { lum: 'L', r: 'R', g: 'G', b: 'B' }
0072:         const data = hist[ch]
0073:         const max  = Math.max(...data.slice(1, 255)) || 1
0074:         const H = 56
0075:         // Alarm grænse: bucket 60/64 ≈ pixel value 240 (overbelyst varsel)
0076:         return (
0077:           <div key={ch} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 flex-1">
0078:             <div className="relative w-full" style={{ height: H + 12 }}>
0079:               {/* Y-akse linje */}
0080:               <div style={{
0081:                 position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: 0, width: 1,
0082:                 height: H, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'
0083:               }} />
0084:               {/* X-akse linje */}
0085:               <div style={{
0086:                 position: 'absolute', left: 0, top: H - 1, right: 0,
0087:                 height: 1, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)'
0088:               }} />
0089:               {/* Vandret clip-alarm linje øverst */}
0090:               <div style={{
0091:                 position: 'absolute', left: 0, right: 0,
0092:                 top: 0, height: 2,
0093:                 background: '#fbbf24', opacity: 0.85,
0094:               }} />
0095:               {/* Bars */}
0096:               <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-end gap-px" style={{ height: H }}>
0097:                 {Array.from({ length: 64 }, (_, i) => {
0098:                   const val = data.slice(i*4, i*4+4).reduce((a: number, b: number) => a + b, 0)
0099:                   const h = Math.max(1, Math.round((val / max / 4) * H))
0100:                   return <div key={i} style={{ flex: 1, height: h, background: colors[ch], opacity: 0.85 }} />
0101:                 })}
0102:               </div>
0103:               
0104:             </div>
0105:             <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: colors[ch] }}>{labels[ch]}</span>
0106:           </div>
0107:         )
0108:       })}
0109:     </div>
0110:   )
0111: }

0185:         )}
0186:       </div>
0187:     </div>
0188:   )
0189: }
0190: 
0191: function CameraProfilePanel({ profile }: { profile: CameraProfile | null }) {
0192:   if (!profile) {

0194:       <div className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 p-4 text-sm text-gray-400">
0195:         Hent kamera-parametre for at se den aktive kamera-profil.
0196:       </div>
0197:     )
0198:   }
0199: 
0200:   const featureLabels: Record<string, string> = {
0201:     autofocus: 'Autofokus',
0202:     remote_focus: 'Remote focus',
0203:     liveview: 'Liveview',
0204:     movie: 'Video',
0205:   }
0206:   const settingLabels: Record<string, string> = {
0207:     exposure_time: 'Lukker',
0208:     aperture: 'Blænde',
0209:     iso: 'ISO',
0210:     focus_mode: 'Fokus',
0211:   }
0212: 
0213:   return (
0214:     <div className="mx-4 mt-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-100 bg-purple-50/50 p-4">
0215:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
0216:         <div>
0217:           <div className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-purple-500">Aktiv kamera-profil</div>
0218:           <div className="mt-1 text-base font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.profile_name}</div>
0219:           <div className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">
0220:             {profile.detected_model} · {profile.driver} · {profile.gphoto2_port}
0221:           </div>
0222:         </div>
0223:         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
0224:           {Object.entries(featureLabels).map(([key, label]) => {
0225:             const enabled = profile.features?.[key] === true
0226:             return (
0227:               <span key={key} className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${
0228:                 enabled ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-400'

0230:                 {label}
0231:               </span>
0232:             )
0233:           })}
0234:         </div>
0235:       </div>
0236: 
0237:       <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
0238:         <div>
0239:           <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Metadata-stier</div>
0240:           <div className="space-y-1.5">
0241:             {Object.entries(settingLabels).map(([key, label]) => (
0242:               <div key={key} className="grid grid-cols-[5rem,1fr] gap-2 text-xs">
0243:                 <span className="text-gray-500">{label}</span>
0244:                 <span className="break-all font-mono text-gray-700">
0245:                   {(profile.capture_settings?.[key] ?? []).join(', ') || '–'}
0246:                 </span>
0247:               </div>
0248:             ))}
0249:           </div>
0250:         </div>
0251:         <div>
0252:           <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Kontrol-actions</div>
0253:           <div className="space-y-1.5">
0254:             {Object.entries(profile.actions ?? {}).length === 0 ? (
0255:               <div className="text-xs text-gray-400">Ingen profil-actions defineret</div>
0256:             ) : Object.entries(profile.actions).map(([key, path]) => (
0257:               <div key={key} className="grid grid-cols-[6rem,1fr] gap-2 text-xs">
0258:                 <span className="text-gray-500">{key}</span>
0259:                 <span className="break-all font-mono text-gray-700">{path}</span>
0260:               </div>
0261:             ))}
0262:           </div>
0263:         </div>
0264:       </div>
0265:     </div>
0266:   )

0269: // ── Main LabPage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0270: export default function LabPage() {
0271:   const { deviceId: id } = useParams<{ deviceId: string }>()
0272:   const navigate = useNavigate()
0273:   const deviceId = id!
0274: 
0275:   const [deviceName, setDeviceName]   = useState('')
0276:   const [debugMode, setDebugModeState] = useState<DebugMode | null>(null)
0277:   const [labActive, setLabActive]     = useState(false)
0278:   const [previews, setPreviews]       = useState<LabPreview[]>([])
0279:   const [params, setParams]           = useState<CameraParam[]>([])
0280:   const [cameraProfile, setCameraProfile] = useState<CameraProfile | null>(null)
0281:   const [selectedPreview, setSelectedPreview] = useState<LabPreview | null>(null)
0282:   const userSelectedRef = useRef(false)
0283:   const selectedPreviewRef = useRef<LabPreview | null>(null)
0284:   const [loadingPreview, setLoadingPreview]   = useState(false)
0285:   const [loadingCapture, setLoadingCapture]   = useState(false)
0286:   const [loadingParams, setLoadingParams]     = useState(false)
0287:   const [activeGroup, setActiveGroup] = useState<string>('Eksponering')
0288:   const [wifiData, setWifiData]       = useState<any>(null)
0289:   const [wifiLoading, setWifiLoading] = useState(false)
0290:   const [wifiPasswords, setWifiPasswords] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
0291:   const [wifiConnecting, setWifiConnecting] = useState('')
0292:   const [zoom, setZoom]               = useState(1)
0293:   const [showHistogram, setShowHistogram] = useState(true)
0294:   const [pollInterval, setPollInterval]   = useState<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)
0295:   const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg]     = useState('')
0296:   const [labConnecting, setLabConnecting] = useState(false)
0297:   const [labConnectSecs, setLabConnectSecs] = useState(0)
0298:   const [labReady, setLabReady]           = useState(false)
0299:   const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null)
0300:   const { hist, compute, clear } = useHistogram(imgRef)
0301: 
0302:   // Hold ref synkroniseret med state for brug i polling closure
0303:   useEffect(() => { selectedPreviewRef.current = selectedPreview }, [selectedPreview])
0304: 
0305:   // Genberegn histogram når selectedPreview ændres (håndterer cached billeder)
0306:   useEffect(() => {
0307:     if (selectedPreview && showHistogram) {
0308:       // Vent til img er klar i DOM — brug lille delay for cached billeder
0309:       const t = setTimeout(() => {
0310:         if (imgRef.current?.complete) compute()
0311:       }, 150)
0312:       return () => clearTimeout(t)
0313:     }
0314:   }, [selectedPreview?.filename, showHistogram])
0315: 
0316:   // Load device info
0317:   useEffect(() => {
0318:     getDevice(deviceId).then(d => {
0319:       const dev = d.device
0320:       setDeviceName(dev.camera_name || dev.location_name || deviceId)
0321:     }).catch(() => {})
0322:     loadConfig()
0323:   }, [deviceId])
0324: 
0325:   // ── Genopret LAB-state ved side-refresh ──────────────────────────────────
0326:   // Hvis headend viser debug_mode.enabled=true og lab_camera_ready=true,
0327:   // spring "Venter"-fasen over og vis LAB direkte som aktiv og klar.
0328:   useEffect(() => {
0329:     if (!deviceId) return
0330:     let cancelled = false
0331: 
0332:     async function checkExistingLab() {
0333:       try {
0334:         const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0335:         const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(deviceId)}`)
0336:         if (!res.ok) return
0337:         const data = await res.json()
0338:         if (cancelled) return
0339: 
0340:         const raw = data.device?.device_config
0341:         let cfg: Record<string, any> = {}
0342:         if (raw) {
0343:           try {
0344:             cfg = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw
0345:           } catch { /* ignorer parse-fejl */ }
0346:         }
0347: 
0348:         const debugEnabled = cfg?.debug_mode?.enabled === true
0349:         const cameraReady  = cfg?.lab_camera_ready === true
0350: 
0351:         if (debugEnabled && cameraReady) {
0352:           // LAB er aktiv og kamera er klar — vis direkte uden "Venter"
0353:           setLabActive(true)
0354:           setLabConnecting(false)
0355:           setLabConnectSecs(0)
0356:           setLabReady(true)
0357:           listPreviews(deviceId).then(setPreviews).catch(() => {})
0358:         } else if (debugEnabled && !cameraReady) {
0359:           // LAB er startet men kamera ikke klar endnu — vis "Venter"
0360:           setLabActive(true)
0361:           setLabConnecting(true)
0362:         }
0363:         // Hvis debug_mode ikke er enabled: gør ingenting
0364:       } catch {
0365:         // Netværksfejl ved mount — ignorer
0366:       }
0367:     }
0368: 
0369:     checkExistingLab()
0370:     return () => { cancelled = true }
0371:   }, [deviceId])
0372: 
0373:   // ── Genopret LAB-state ved side-refresh ──────────────────────────────────
0374:   // Hvis headend viser debug_mode.enabled=true og lab_camera_ready=true,
0375:   // spring "Venter"-fasen over og vis LAB direkte som aktiv og klar.
0376:   useEffect(() => {
0377:     if (!deviceId) return
0378:     let cancelled = false
0379: 
0380:     async function checkExistingLab() {
0381:       try {
0382:         const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0383:         const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(deviceId)}`)
0384:         if (!res.ok) return
0385:         const data = await res.json()
0386:         if (cancelled) return
0387: 
0388:         const raw = data.device?.device_config
0389:         let cfg: Record<string, any> = {}
0390:         if (raw) {
0391:           try {
0392:             cfg = typeof raw === 'string' ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw
0393:           } catch { /* ignorer parse-fejl */ }
0394:         }
0395: 
0396:         const debugEnabled = cfg?.debug_mode?.enabled === true
0397:         const cameraReady  = cfg?.lab_camera_ready === true
0398: 
0399:         if (debugEnabled && cameraReady) {
0400:           // LAB er aktiv og kamera er klar — vis direkte uden "Venter"
0401:           setLabActive(true)
0402:           setLabConnecting(false)
0403:           setLabConnectSecs(0)
0404:           setLabReady(true)
0405:           listPreviews(deviceId).then(setPreviews).catch(() => {})
0406:         } else if (debugEnabled && !cameraReady) {
0407:           // LAB er startet men kamera ikke klar endnu — vis "Venter"
0408:           setLabActive(true)
0409:           setLabConnecting(true)
0410:         }
0411:         // Hvis debug_mode ikke er enabled: gør ingenting
0412:       } catch {
0413:         // Netværksfejl ved mount — ignorer
0414:       }
0415:     }
0416: 
0417:     checkExistingLab()
0418:     return () => { cancelled = true }
0419:   }, [deviceId])
0420: 
0421:   async function loadConfig() {
0422:     try {
0423:       const cfg = await getDeviceRawConfig(deviceId)
0424:       const dm  = cfg?.debug_mode
0425:       if (dm) {
0426:         setDebugModeState(dm)
0427:         setLabActive(dm.enabled)
0428:       }
0429:       if (cfg?.camera_profile) {
0430:         setCameraProfile(cfg.camera_profile)
0431:       }
0432:     } catch {}
0433:   }
0434: 
0435:   // Poll for new previews when lab is active
0436:   useEffect(() => {
0437:     if (labActive) {
0438:       const iv = setInterval(() => {
0439:         listPreviews(deviceId).then(p => {
0440:           setPreviews(p)
0441:           // Auto-select kun nyeste hvis bruger ikke har valgt manuelt
0442:           if (p.length > 0 && !userSelectedRef.current && p[0].filename !== selectedPreviewRef.current?.filename) {
0443:             setSelectedPreview(p[0])
0444:           }
0445:         }).catch(() => {})
0446:       }, 3000)
0447:       setPollInterval(iv)
0448:       return () => clearInterval(iv)
0449:     } else {
0450:       if (pollInterval) clearInterval(pollInterval)
0451:     }
0452:   }, [labActive, deviceId])
0453: 
0454:   async function toggleLab() {
0455:     const next = !labActive
0456:     setLabActive(next)
0457:     if (next) {
0458:       setLabConnecting(true)
0459:       const warmupS     = 30   // relay 10s + connect + commands
0460:       const configPullS = 60   // edge waker hvert 60s
0461: 
0462:       // Beregn sekunder til næste 60s wake (synkroniseret)
0463:       const nowS        = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
0464:       const secsToPull  = configPullS - (nowS % configPullS)
0465:       const totalWait   = secsToPull + warmupS
0466:       setLabConnectSecs(totalWait)
0467: 
0468:       // Nedtælling — viser realistisk ventetid
0469:       let remaining = totalWait
0470:       const countdown = setInterval(() => {
0471:         remaining -= 1
0472:         setLabConnectSecs(Math.max(0, remaining))
0473:       }, 1000)
0474: 
0475:       try {
0476:         // Sæt debug mode — edge vil opdage det ved næste config pull (~60s)
0477:         await setDebugMode(deviceId, true, 5)
0478: 
0479:         // Poll headend for faktisk LAB CAMERA READY signal
0480:         // Edge sender /lab/{id}/camera-ready når kameraet er forbundet
0481:         // Det er det præcise signal vi venter på
0482:         const check = setInterval(async () => {
0483:           try {
0484:             const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0485:             const r = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(deviceId)}`)
0486:             const data = await r.json()
0487:             const cfg = data?.device?.device_config ? JSON.parse(data.device.device_config) : {}
0488:             if (cfg?.lab_camera_ready === true) {
0489:               clearInterval(check)
0490:               clearInterval(countdown)
0491:               setLabConnecting(false)
0492:               setLabConnectSecs(0)
0493:               listPreviews(deviceId).then(setPreviews).catch(() => {})
0494:               setLabReady(true)
0495:             }
0496:           } catch { /* ignore */ }
0497:         }, 3000)
0498: 
0499:       } catch {
0500:         setLabActive(false)
0501:         setLabConnecting(false)
0502:         setLabConnectSecs(0)
0503:         clearInterval(countdown)
0504:         setStatusMsg('Fejl ved aktivering af lab mode')
0505:       }
0506:     } else {
0507:       setLabConnecting(false)
0508:       setLabConnectSecs(0)
0509:       setLabReady(false)
0510:       // Nulstil camera-ready signal på headend
0511:       try {
0512:         const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0513:         await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/lab/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/camera-ready`, {
0514:           method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
0515:           body: JSON.stringify({ready: false})
0516:         }).catch(() => {})
0517:       } catch { /* ignore */ }
0518:       try {
0519:         await setDebugMode(deviceId, false)
0520:         setStatusMsg('Lab mode deaktiveret')
0521:         setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 2000)
0522:       } catch {
0523:         setLabActive(true)
0524:         setStatusMsg('Fejl ved deaktivering')
0525:       }
0526:     }
0527:   }
0528: 
0529:   async function takePreview() {
0530:     setLoadingPreview(true)
0531:     setStatusMsg('Anmoder om preview…')
0532:     try {
0533:       await requestPreview(deviceId)
0534:       setStatusMsg('Preview anmodet — venter på billede…')
0535:       // Poll for new preview
0536:       userSelectedRef.current = false
0537:       const prevFilename = selectedPreview?.filename ?? ''
0538:       let attempts = 0
0539:       const check = setInterval(async () => {
0540:         attempts++
0541:         try {
0542:           const p = await listPreviews(deviceId)
0543:           setPreviews(p)
0544:           if (p.length > 0 && p[0].filename !== prevFilename) {
0545:             setSelectedPreview(p[0])
0546:             clear()
0547:             clearInterval(check)
0548:             setStatusMsg('Preview modtaget! ✓')
0549:             setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 2000)
0550:             return
0551:           }
0552:         } catch { /* ignore */ }
0553:         if (attempts > 20) {
0554:           clearInterval(check)
0555:           setStatusMsg('Ingen respons — er lab mode aktiv?')
0556:         }
0557:       }, 1500)
0558:     } catch {
0559:       setStatusMsg('Fejl ved preview')
0560:     } finally {
0561:       setLoadingPreview(false)
0562:     }
0563:   }
0564: 
0565:   async function takeCapture() {
0566:     setLoadingCapture(true)
0567:     setStatusMsg('Anmoder om fuld capture (tæller lukker)…')
0568:     try {
0569:       await requestCapture(deviceId)
0570:       setStatusMsg('Capture anmodet!')
0571:       setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 3000)
0572:     } catch {
0573:       setStatusMsg('Fejl ved capture')
0574:     } finally {
0575:       setLoadingCapture(false)
0576:     }
0577:   }
0578: 
0579:   async function loadParams() {
0580:     setLoadingParams(true)
0581:     setStatusMsg('Anmoder om kamera-parametre…')
0582:     try {
0583:       // Trin 1: anmod om get_params kommando
0584:       const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0585:       await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/lab/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/get-params`, { method: 'POST' })
0586:       setStatusMsg('Venter på kamera-parametre…')
0587: 
0588:       // Trin 2: poll config indtil camera_params er klar
0589:       let attempts = 0
0590:       const poll = setInterval(async () => {
0591:         attempts++
0592:         try {
0593:           const cfg = await getDeviceRawConfig(deviceId)
0594:           const camParams = cfg?.camera_params || []
0595:           if (camParams.length > 0) {
0596:             clearInterval(poll)
0597:             setParams(camParams)
0598:             setCameraProfile(cfg?.camera_profile ?? null)
0599:             setStatusMsg(`✓ ${camParams.length} parametre hentet`)
0600:             setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 3000)
0601:             setLoadingParams(false)
0602:           }
0603:         } catch { /* ignore */ }
0604:         if (attempts > 20) {
0605:           clearInterval(poll)
0606:           setStatusMsg('Timeout — er lab mode aktiv og kamera tilsluttet?')
0607:           setLoadingParams(false)
0608:         }
0609:       }, 1500)
0610:     } catch {
0611:       setStatusMsg('Fejl ved hentning af parametre')
0612:       setLoadingParams(false)
0613:     }
0614:   }
0615: 
0616:   async function wifiScan() {
0617:     setWifiLoading(true)
0618:     setStatusMsg('Scanner WiFi netværk…')
0619:     try {
0620:       const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0621:       await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/lab/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/wifi/scan`, { method: 'POST' })
0622:       // Poll for result
0623:       let attempts = 0
0624:       const poll = setInterval(async () => {
0625:         attempts++
0626:         const cfg = await getDeviceRawConfig(deviceId)
0627:         const wd  = cfg?.wifi_data
0628:         if (wd?.type === 'scan') {
0629:           setWifiData(wd)
0630:           setWifiLoading(false)
0631:           setStatusMsg(`${wd.networks?.length ?? 0} netværk fundet`)
0632:           setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 3000)
0633:           clearInterval(poll)
0634:         }
0635:         if (attempts > 15) { clearInterval(poll); setWifiLoading(false); setStatusMsg('Timeout') }
0636:       }, 1500)
0637:     } catch { setWifiLoading(false) }
0638:   }
0639: 
0640:   async function wifiConnect(ssid: string, password: string) {
0641:     setWifiConnecting(ssid)
0642:     setStatusMsg(`Tilslutter til ${ssid}…`)
0643:     try {
0644:       const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0645:       const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/lab/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/wifi/connect`, {
0646:         method: 'POST',
0647:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0648:         body: JSON.stringify({ ssid, password })
0649:       })
0650:       if (!res.ok) {
0651:         const data = await res.json().catch(() => null)
0652:         throw new Error(data?.detail ?? 'WiFi connect blev afvist')
0653:       }
0654:       let attempts = 0
0655:       const poll = setInterval(async () => {
0656:         attempts++
0657:         const cfg = await getDeviceRawConfig(deviceId)
0658:         const wd  = cfg?.wifi_data
0659:         if (wd?.type === 'connect') {
0660:           setWifiData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, current: wd.current }))
0661:           setWifiConnecting('')
0662:           setStatusMsg(wd.result?.success ? `✓ Tilsluttet ${ssid}` : `Fejl ved tilslutning til ${ssid}`)
0663:           setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 4000)
0664:           clearInterval(poll)
0665:         }
0666:         if (attempts > 20) { clearInterval(poll); setWifiConnecting('') }
0667:       }, 1500)
0668:     } catch (err) {
0669:       setWifiConnecting('')
0670:       setStatusMsg(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'WiFi connect fejlede')
0671:       setTimeout(() => setStatusMsg(''), 5000)
0672:     }
0673:   }
0674: 
0675:   function lockParams() {
0676:     // Build initial_commands from current known params
0677:     const LOCKABLE = ['capturetarget', 'iso', 'colorspace', 'meteringmode',
0678:                       'whitebalance', 'exposurecompensation', 'picturestyle', 'imageformat']
0679:     const commands = params
0680:       .filter(p => !p.readonly && LOCKABLE.some(k => p.path.includes(k)))
0681:       .map(p => {
0682:         const key = p.path.split('/').pop()!
0683:         return `${key}=${p.current}`
0684:       })
0685:     if (commands.length === 0) { setStatusMsg('Ingen parametre at låse'); return }
0686:     // Update config via API
0687:     import('../api/client').then(({ getApiUrl }) => {
0688:       fetch(`${getApiUrl()}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/config`, {
0689:         method: 'PUT',
0690:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0691:         body: JSON.stringify({ camera: { initial_commands: commands } })
0692:       }).then(() => setStatusMsg(`✓ ${commands.length} parametre låst som initial_commands`))
0693:         .catch(() => setStatusMsg('Fejl ved låsning'))
0694:     })
0695:   }
0696: 
0697:   // Group params
0698:   const groupedParams = Object.entries(PARAM_GROUPS).reduce((acc, [group, paths]) => {
0699:     const matched = params.filter(p => paths.includes(p.path))
0700:     const rest = params.filter(p =>
0701:       !Object.values(PARAM_GROUPS).flat().includes(p.path) && group === 'Status'
0702:     )
0703:     acc[group] = group === 'Status' ? [...matched, ...rest] : matched
0704:     return acc
0705:   }, {} as Record<string, CameraParam[]>)
0706: 
0707:   // All ungrouped params shown under active group if "Alle" selected
0708:   const displayParams = activeGroup === 'Alle'
0709:     ? params
0710:     : (groupedParams[activeGroup] || [])
0711: 
0712:   return (
0713:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50">
0714:       {/* Header */}
0715:       <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 px-6 py-4">
0716:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
0717:           <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

0163: 
0164:           {/* Husk denne enhed */}
0165:           {!mfaRequired && (

0168:                 className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-sky-500 focus:ring-sky-400" />
0169:               <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Husk denne enhed i 30 dage</span>
0170:             </label>
0171:           )}
0172: 
0173:           {/* WebAuthn / biometrisk login */}
0174:           <button type="button" onClick={handleWebAuthn} disabled={loading}
0175:             className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 border border-gray-200 text-gray-600 text-sm font-medium rounded-xl hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50">
0176:             <Fingerprint className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
0177:             Log ind med Windows Hello / Touch ID
0178:           </button>
0179: 
0180:           {/* Submit */}
0181:           <button type="submit" disabled={loading || !username || !password}
0182:             className="w-full py-2.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-600 disabled:bg-sky-300
0183:                        text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors">
0184:             {loading ? 'Logger ind…' : 'Log ind'}
0185:           </button>
0186:         </form>
0187:       </div>
0188:     </div>
0189:   )
0190: }

0001: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

0003: import { getApiUrl } from '../api/client'
0004: 
0005: interface OpenWebUIStatus {

0008:   allowed: boolean
0009:   mfa_verified: boolean

0011:   expires_minutes: number
0012:   message: string
0013: }
0014: 
0015: async function api(path: string, options?: RequestInit) {
0016:   const res = await fetch(`${getApiUrl()}${path}`, {
0017:     credentials: 'include',
0018:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(options?.headers ?? {}) },
0019:     ...options,
0020:   })
0021:   if (!res.ok) {
0022:     const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
0023:     throw new Error(err.detail ?? 'Request fejlede')
0024:   }
0025:   return res.json()
0026: }
0027: 
0028: export default function OpenWebUIPage() {
0029:   const [status, setStatus] = useState<OpenWebUIStatus | null>(null)
0030:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
0031:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
0032:   const [launching, setLaunching] = useState(false)
0033: 
0034:   useEffect(() => {
0035:     api('/api/openwebui/access/status')
0036:       .then(setStatus)
0037:       .catch(e => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Kunne ikke hente Open WebUI status'))
0038:       .finally(() => setLoading(false))
0039:   }, [])
0040: 
0041:   async function launch() {
0042:     setLaunching(true)
0043:     setError(null)
0044:     try {
0045:       const data = await api('/api/openwebui/access/issue', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({}) })
0046:       window.open(data.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')
0047:     } catch (e) {
0048:       setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Kunne ikke åbne Open WebUI')
0049:     } finally {
0050:       setLaunching(false)
0051:     }
0052:   }
0053: 
0054:   if (loading) return <div className="p-6 text-sm text-slate-500">Henter Open WebUI adgang...</div>
0055: 
0056:   return (
0057:     <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-5">
0058:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
0059:         <div>
0060:           <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
0061:             <Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-600" />
0062:             Open WebUI
0063:           </h1>
0064:           <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Kontrolleret adgang til TimeLapse Pro co-pilot via MFA-verificeret session.</p>
0065:         </div>

0067:           onClick={launch}
0068:           disabled={!status?.allowed || launching}
0069:           className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-md bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-medium disabled:bg-slate-300 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-slate-800"
0070:         >
0071:           <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
0072:           {launching ? 'Åbner...' : 'Åbn Open WebUI'}
0073:         </button>
0074:       </div>
0075: 
0076:       {error && (
0077:         <div className="border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-sm">
0078:           {error}
0079:         </div>
0080:       )}
0081: 
0082:       <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
0083:         <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-lg p-4">
0084:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
0085:             <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
0086:             Session
0087:           </div>
0088:           <p className={`mt-3 text-sm ${status?.mfa_verified ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-amber-700'}`}>
0089:             {status?.mfa_verified ? 'MFA verificeret' : 'MFA kræves før adgang'}
0090:           </p>
0091:         </div>
0092: 
0093:         <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-lg p-4">
0094:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
0095:             <LockKeyhole className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
0096:             Adgang
0097:           </div>
0098:           <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
0099:             {status?.required_role.join(' eller ')} med kortlivet adgangscookie på {status?.expires_minutes} min.
0100:           </p>
0101:         </div>
0102: 
0103:         <div className="border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-lg p-4">
0104:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
0105:             <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-600" />
0106:             Scope
0107:           </div>
0108:           <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
0109:             Direkte Open WebUI adgang er låst af nginx og skal udstedes herfra.
0110:           </p>
0111:         </div>
0112:       </div>
0113: 
0114:       {!status?.allowed && (

0121: }

0069: function fmtRelative(iso: string) {

0072:   if (min < 1)  return 'lige nu'

0074:   const hr = Math.floor(min / 60)

0682: // ── Summary card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0683: 
0684: function SummaryCard({ label, value, icon: Icon, color, bg, alert = false }: {
0685:   label: string; value: number; icon: any
0686:   color: string; bg: string; alert?: boolean
0687: }) {
0688:   return (
0689:     <div className={`rounded-xl border p-4 ${bg} ${alert && value > 0 ? 'border-red-300 ring-1 ring-red-200' : 'border-gray-200'}`}>
0690:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
0691:         <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{label}</span>
0692:         <Icon className={`w-4 h-4 ${color}`} />
0693:       </div>
0694:       <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${alert && value > 0 ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>
0695:         {value}
0696:       </div>
0697:     </div>
0698:   )
0699: }
0700: 
0701: function RiskLine({ label, value, tone }: { label: string; value: number; tone: 'red' | 'rose' | 'amber' | 'purple' }) {
0702:   const cls = {
0703:     red: 'text-red-700 bg-red-50 border-red-100',
0704:     rose: 'text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border-rose-100',
0705:     amber: 'text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-amber-100',
0706:     purple: 'text-purple-700 bg-purple-50 border-purple-100',
0707:   }[tone]
0708:   return (
0709:     <div className={`flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${cls}`}>
0710:       <span>{label}</span>
0711:       <span className="font-bold">{value}</span>
0712:     </div>
0713:   )
0714: }
0715: 
0716: function PolicyLine({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
0717:   return (
0718:     <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-gray-100 pb-2 last:border-0">
0719:       <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{label}</span>
0720:       <span className="text-right text-gray-600">{value}</span>
0721:     </div>
0722:   )
0723: }
0724: 
0725: function SiemSourceCard({ icon: Icon, title, status, description, items }: {
0726:   icon: any
0727:   title: string
0728:   status: string
0729:   description: string
0730:   items: string[]
0731: }) {
0732:   return (
0733:     <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-5">
0734:       <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
0735:         <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-600" />
0736:         <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{title}</h2>
0737:         <span className="ml-auto text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-gray-100 text-gray-600">{status}</span>
0738:       </div>
0739:       <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">{description}</p>
0740:       <div className="space-y-1.5">
0741:         {items.map(item => (
0742:           <div key={item} className="text-xs font-mono text-gray-600 bg-gray-50 rounded px-2 py-1">
0743:             {item}
0744:           </div>
0745:         ))}
0746:       </div>
0747:     </div>
0748:   )
0749: }
0750: 
0751: function parseNormalized(value?: string | null) {
0752:   if (!value) return null
0753:   try { return JSON.parse(value) } catch { return value }
0754: }
0755: 
0756: function DetailRow({ label, value, mono = false }: { label: string; value: any; mono?: boolean }) {
0757:   if (value == null || value === '') return null
0758:   return (
0759:     <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 py-2 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0">
0760:       <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">{label}</dt>
0761:       <dd className={`col-span-2 text-sm text-gray-900 break-words ${mono ? 'font-mono text-xs' : ''}`}>{String(value)}</dd>
0762:     </div>
0763:   )
0764: }
0765: 
0766: function EventDetailDrawer({ event, onClose, onFilter }: {
0767:   event: SecurityEvent

0782:               <SeverityBadge severity={event.severity} />
0783:             </div>
0784:           </div>
0785:           <button onClick={onClose} className="ml-auto text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700">
0786:             <X className="w-5 h-5" />
0787:           </button>

0789: 
0790:         <div className="p-5 space-y-5">
0791:           <section>
0792:             <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400 mb-2">Kernefelter</h3>
0793:             <dl className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 px-3">
0794:               <DetailRow label="Device" value={event.device_id} mono />
0795:               <DetailRow label="Type" value={event.event_type} mono />
0796:               <DetailRow label="Severity" value={event.severity} />

0077: }
0078: 
0079: // Relay tester komponent
0080: function RelayTester({ deviceId, labActive }: { deviceId: string; labActive: boolean }) {
0081:   const [camOn, setCamOn] = useState(false)
0082:   const [modOn, setModOn] = useState(false)
0083:   const [busy, setBusy]   = useState(false)
0084:   const [msg, setMsg]     = useState('')
0085: 
0086:   async function sendRelayCmd(relay: 'camera' | 'modem', state: boolean) {
0087:     await api(`/api/lab/${pathSegment(deviceId)}/relay`, {
0088:       method: 'POST',
0089:       body: JSON.stringify({ relay, state })
0090:     })
0091:     // Vent på edge processer kommandoen (~2 sek)
0092:     await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000))
0093:   }
0094: 
0095:   async function toggleRelay(relay: 'camera' | 'modem', on: boolean) {
0096:     setBusy(true)
0097:     setMsg(`${relay === 'camera' ? 'Kamera' : 'Modem'} relay ${on ? 'tændes' : 'slukkes'}…`)
0098:     try {
0099:       await sendRelayCmd(relay, on)
0100:       if (relay === 'camera') setCamOn(on)
0101:       else setModOn(on)
0102:       setMsg(`${relay === 'camera' ? 'Kamera' : 'Modem'} relay ${on ? 'TIL ✓' : 'FRA ✓'}`)
0103:       setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 2000)
0104:     } catch {
0105:       setMsg('Fejl — er LAB mode aktiv?')
0106:     } finally {
0107:       setBusy(false)
0108:     }
0109:   }
0110: 
0111:   async function pulse(relay: 'camera' | 'modem') {
0112:     setBusy(true)
0113:     try {
0114:       // Tænd relay
0115:       setMsg(`${relay === 'camera' ? 'Kamera' : 'Modem'} relay tændes…`)
0116:       await sendRelayCmd(relay, true)
0117:       if (relay === 'camera') setCamOn(true)
0118:       else setModOn(true)
0119:       // Hold tændt i 3 sek
0120:       setMsg(`Relay TIL — venter 3 sek…`)
0121:       await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000))
0122:       // Sluk relay
0123:       setMsg(`Relay slukkes…`)
0124:       await sendRelayCmd(relay, false)
0125:       if (relay === 'camera') setCamOn(false)
0126:       else setModOn(false)
0127:       setMsg('Puls komplet ✓')
0128:       setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 2000)
0129:     } catch {
0130:       setMsg('Fejl')
0131:     } finally {
0132:       setBusy(false)
0133:     }
0134:   }
0135: 
0136:   return (
0137:     <div className="space-y-4">
0138:       {msg && (
0139:         <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-sky-50 border border-sky-100 rounded-lg text-xs text-sky-700 font-medium">{msg}</div>
0140:       )}
0141:       {!labActive && (
0142:         <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
0143:           ⚠️ LAB mode er ikke aktiv — aktiver LAB mode på enheden først
0144:         </p>
0145:       )}
0146:       {labActive && (
0147:         <p className="text-xs text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
0148:           ✅ LAB mode aktiv — relay kan styres
0149:         </p>
0150:       )}
0151:       {/* Kamera relay */}
0152:       <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
0153:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
0154:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0155:             <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
0156:             <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Kamera relay</span>
0157:             <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${camOn ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'}`}>
0158:               {camOn ? 'TIL' : 'FRA'}
0159:             </span>
0160:           </div>
0161:         </div>
0162:         <div className="flex gap-2">
0163:           <button disabled={busy || camOn} onClick={() => toggleRelay('camera', true)}
0164:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-600 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0165:             <Power className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> TIL
0166:           </button>
0167:           <button disabled={busy || !camOn} onClick={() => toggleRelay('camera', false)}
0168:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0169:             <PowerOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> FRA
0170:           </button>
0171:           <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => pulse('camera')}
0172:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0173:             <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Puls 3s
0174:           </button>
0175:         </div>
0176:       </div>
0177:       {/* Modem relay */}
0178:       <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-4">
0179:         <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
0180:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0181:             <Wifi className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
0182:             <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Modem relay</span>
0183:             <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${modOn ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-400'}`}>
0184:               {modOn ? 'TIL' : 'FRA'}
0185:             </span>
0186:           </div>
0187:         </div>
0188:         <div className="flex gap-2">
0189:           <button disabled={busy || modOn} onClick={() => toggleRelay('modem', true)}
0190:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-600 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0191:             <Power className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> TIL
0192:           </button>
0193:           <button disabled={busy || !modOn} onClick={() => toggleRelay('modem', false)}
0194:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0195:             <PowerOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> FRA
0196:           </button>
0197:           <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => pulse('modem')}
0198:             className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-300 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed cursor-pointer">
0199:             <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Puls 3s
0200:           </button>
0201:         </div>
0202:       </div>
0203:     </div>
0204:   )
0205: }

0207: export function SystemAdminPage() {
0208:   const [devices, setDevices]   = useState<Device[]>([])
0209:   const [selectedDevice, setSelectedDevice] = useState('')
0210:   const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Record<string,string>>({})
0211:   const [savingSettings, setSavingSettings] = useState(false)
0212:   const [savedSettings, setSavedSettings] = useState(false)
0213:   const [saving, setSaving]     = useState(false)
0214:   const [saved, setSaved]       = useState(false)
0215:   const [cfg, setCfg]           = useState<any>(null)
0216:   const [labActive, setLabActive] = useState(false)
0217:   const [tunnelEnabled, setTunnelEnabled] = useState(false)
0218:   const [tunnelPrimary, setTunnelPrimary] = useState('peter@timelapse.froekjaer.dk:22')
0219:   const [tunnelRemotePort, setTunnelRemotePort] = useState('2201')
0220:   const [tunnelKeyFile, setTunnelKeyFile] = useState('/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/tunnel_key')
0221:   const [tunnelAutoOnApiLoss, setTunnelAutoOnApiLoss] = useState(true)
0222:   const [tunnelDeny, setTunnelDeny] = useState(false)
0223:   const [tunnelSaved, setTunnelSaved] = useState(false)
0224:   const [multiCameraMode, setMultiCameraMode] = useState('single')
0225:   const [nodeCameras, setNodeCameras] = useState<{camera_index:number, relay_gpio_camera:number, camera_name:string, serial_number:string}[]>([])
0226:   const [savingMultiCam, setSavingMultiCam] = useState(false)
0227: 
0228:   // Config state
0229:   const [relayGpioCamera, setRelayGpioCamera] = useState('356')
0230:   const [relayGpioModem, setRelayGpioModem]   = useState('361')
0231:   const [relaySimulate, setRelaySimulate]     = useState(false)
0232:   const [cameraPowerMode, setCameraPowerMode] = useState('relay')
0233:   const [relayOnBefore, setRelayOnBefore]     = useState('10')
0234:   const [relayOffAfter, setRelayOffAfter]     = useState('5')
0235:   const [captureTimeout, setCaptureTimeout]   = useState('60')
0236:   const [downloadTimeout, setDownloadTimeout] = useState('30')
0237:   const [modemGpio, setModemGpio]             = useState('361')
0238:   const [modemCycleFailures, setModemCycleFailures] = useState('3')
0239:   const [modemMinInterval, setModemMinInterval]     = useState('600')
0240:   const [modemOffSeconds, setModemOffSeconds]       = useState('5')
0241:   const [modemRecoverSeconds, setModemRecoverSeconds] = useState('15')
0242:   const [uploadAttempts, setUploadAttempts]   = useState('5')
0243:   const [configPollS, setConfigPollS]         = useState('300')
0244:   const [heartbeatMin, setHeartbeatMin]       = useState('60')
0245:   const [errorSleepS, setErrorSleepS]         = useState('30')
0246:   const [minSleepS, setMinSleepS]             = useState('60')
0247:   const [apiTimeoutS, setApiTimeoutS]         = useState('15')
0248: 
0249:   useEffect(() => {
0250:     api('/api/admin/settings').then((s: any) => setSettings(s)).catch(() => {})
0251:   }, [])
0252: 
0253:   async function saveSettings() {
0254:     setSavingSettings(true)
0255:     try {
0256:       await api('/api/admin/settings', { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(settings) })
0257:       setSavedSettings(true)
0258:       setTimeout(() => setSavedSettings(false), 2000)
0259:     } catch { } finally { setSavingSettings(false) }
0260:   }
0261: 
0262:   useEffect(() => {
0263:     api('/api/admin/devices').then((d: any) => {
0264:       const devs = d.devices ?? d
0265:       setDevices(devs)
0266:       if (devs.length > 0) setSelectedDevice(devs[0].device_id)
0267:     }).catch(() => {})
0268:   }, [])
0269: 
0270:   useEffect(() => {
0271:     if (!selectedDevice) return
0272:     api(`/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}`).then((d: any) => {
0273:       const dc = d.device_config ?? {}
0274:       setLabActive(!!(dc.debug_mode?.enabled))
0275:       setMultiCameraMode(dc.multi_camera_mode ?? 'single')
0276:       const tun = dc.ssh_tunnel ?? {}

0278:       setTunnelPrimary(tun.primary ?? 'peter@timelapse.froekjaer.dk:22')
0279:       setTunnelRemotePort(String(tun.remote_port ?? '2201'))
0280:       setTunnelKeyFile(tun.key_file ?? '/opt/timelapse/edge/ssh/tunnel_key')
0281:       setTunnelAutoOnApiLoss(tun.auto_on_api_loss !== false)
0282:       setTunnelDeny(!!tun.deny)
0283:       setNodeCameras(dc.node_cameras ?? [])
0284:     }).catch(() => {})
0285:     api(`/api/config/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}`).then((c: any) => {
0286:       setCfg(c)
0287:       const cam  = c.camera  ?? {}
0288:       const mod  = c.modem   ?? {}
0289:       const diag = c.diagnostics ?? {}
0290:       const sys  = c.system  ?? {}
0291:       const sftp = c.sftp    ?? {}
0292:       setRelayGpioCamera(String(cam.relay_gpio_pin ?? 356))
0293:       setRelayGpioModem(String(mod.modem_relay_gpio_pin ?? 361))
0294:       setRelaySimulate(!!cam.relay_simulate)
0295:       setCameraPowerMode(String(cam.power_mode ?? 'relay'))
0296:       setRelayOnBefore(String(cam.relay_on_seconds_before ?? 10))
0297:       setRelayOffAfter(String(cam.relay_off_seconds_after ?? 5))
0298:       setCaptureTimeout(String(cam.capture_timeout ?? 60))
0299:       setDownloadTimeout(String(cam.download_timeout ?? 30))
0300:       setModemGpio(String(mod.modem_relay_gpio_pin ?? 361))
0301:       setModemCycleFailures(String(mod.modem_cycle_after_failures ?? 3))
0302:       setModemMinInterval(String(mod.modem_min_cycle_interval_s ?? 600))
0303:       setModemOffSeconds(String(mod.modem_power_cycle_off_s ?? 5))
0304:       setModemRecoverSeconds(String(mod.modem_power_cycle_recover_s ?? 15))
0305:       setUploadAttempts(String(sftp.upload_attempts ?? 5))
0306:       setConfigPollS(String(diag.config_poll_interval_minutes ? diag.config_poll_interval_minutes * 60 : 300))
0307:       setHeartbeatMin(String(diag.heartbeat_interval_minutes ?? 60))
0308:       setErrorSleepS(String(sys.error_recovery_sleep_s ?? 30))
0309:       setMinSleepS(String(sys.min_sleep_s ?? 60))
0310:       setApiTimeoutS(String(sys.api_timeout_s ?? 15))
0311:     }).catch(() => {})
0312:   }, [selectedDevice])
0313: 
0314:   async function saveMultiCamera() {
0315:     setSavingMultiCam(true)
0316:     try {
0317:       await api(`/api/node/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}/multi-camera-config`, {
0318:         method: 'PUT',
0319:         body: JSON.stringify({
0320:           multi_camera_mode: multiCameraMode,
0321:           node_cameras: nodeCameras,
0322:         })
0323:       })
0324:       // Auto-bootstrap sibling devices
0325:       if (multiCameraMode === 'auto_bootstrap') {
0326:         for (const cam of nodeCameras) {
0327:           await api(`/api/node/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}/bootstrap-camera`, {
0328:             method: 'POST',
0329:             body: JSON.stringify(cam)
0330:           })
0331:         }
0332:       }
0333:       alert('Multi-kamera config gemt og devices bootstrapped ✓')
0334:     } catch {
0335:       alert('Fejl ved gemning')
0336:     } finally {
0337:       setSavingMultiCam(false)
0338:     }
0339:   }
0340: 
0341:   function addNodeCamera() {
0342:     setNodeCameras(prev => [...prev, {
0343:       camera_index: prev.length + 1,
0344:       relay_gpio_camera: 357,
0345:       camera_name: `Kamera ${prev.length + 2}`,
0346:       serial_number: ''
0347:     }])
0348:   }
0349: 
0350:   function updateNodeCamera(idx: number, field: string, value: string | number) {
0351:     setNodeCameras(prev => prev.map((c, i) => i === idx ? {...c, [field]: value} : c))
0352:   }
0353: 
0354:   function removeNodeCamera(idx: number) {
0355:     setNodeCameras(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx))
0356:   }
0357: 
0358:   async function saveTunnel() {
0359:     if (!selectedDevice) return
0360:     const apiUrl = (await import('../api/client')).getApiUrl()
0361:     const res = await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}`)
0362:     const data = await res.json()
0363:     const existing = data.device?.device_config ?? {}
0364:     const cfg = typeof existing === 'string' ? JSON.parse(existing) : existing
0365:     cfg.ssh_tunnel = {
0366:       enabled: tunnelEnabled,
0367:       primary: tunnelPrimary,
0368:       remote_port: parseInt(tunnelRemotePort),
0369:       local_port: 22,
0370:       key_file: tunnelKeyFile,
0371:       auto_on_api_loss: tunnelAutoOnApiLoss,
0372:       auto_on_api_loss_threshold_s: 300,
0373:       deny: tunnelDeny,
0374:     }
0375:     await fetch(`${apiUrl}/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}/config`, {
0376:       method: 'PUT',
0377:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
0378:       body: JSON.stringify({ ssh_tunnel: cfg.ssh_tunnel }),
0379:     })
0380:     setTunnelSaved(true)
0381:     setTimeout(() => setTunnelSaved(false), 2000)
0382:   }
0383: 
0384:   async function save() {
0385:     setSaving(true)
0386:     try {
0387:       await api(`/api/admin/devices/${pathSegment(selectedDevice)}/overrides`, {
0388:         method: 'PUT',
0389:         body: JSON.stringify({
0390:           config_overrides: {
0391:             camera: {
0392:               power_mode:            cameraPowerMode,
0393:               relay_gpio_pin:        parseInt(relayGpioCamera),
0394:               relay_simulate:        relaySimulate,
0395:               relay_on_seconds_before: parseInt(relayOnBefore),
0396:               relay_off_seconds_after: parseInt(relayOffAfter),
0397:               capture_timeout:       parseInt(captureTimeout),
0398:               download_timeout:      parseInt(downloadTimeout),
0399:             },
0400:             modem: {
0401:               modem_relay_gpio_pin:        parseInt(modemGpio),
0402:               modem_cycle_after_failures:  parseInt(modemCycleFailures),
0403:               modem_min_cycle_interval_s:  parseInt(modemMinInterval),
0404:               modem_power_cycle_off_s:     parseInt(modemOffSeconds),
0405:               modem_power_cycle_recover_s: parseInt(modemRecoverSeconds),
0406:             },
0407:             sftp: { upload_attempts: parseInt(uploadAttempts) },
0408:             diagnostics: {
0409:               heartbeat_interval_minutes:   parseInt(heartbeatMin),
0410:               config_poll_interval_minutes: Math.round(parseInt(configPollS) / 60),
0411:             },
0412:             system: {
0413:               error_recovery_sleep_s: parseInt(errorSleepS),
0414:               min_sleep_s:            parseInt(minSleepS),
0415:               api_timeout_s:          parseInt(apiTimeoutS),
0416:             },
0417:           }
0418:         })
0419:       })
0420:       setSaved(true)
0421:       setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000)
0422:     } catch { } finally {
0423:       setSaving(false)
0424:     }
0425:   }
0426: 
0427:   return (
0428:     <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 py-8">
0429:       {/* Header */}
0430:       <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
0431:         <Link to="/settings" className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-400">
0432:           <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
0433:         </Link>
0434:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
0435:           <Terminal className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
0436:           <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900">System Administration</h1>
0437:         </div>
0438:       </div>
0439: 
0440:       {/* Enhedsvalg */}
0441:       <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-4 mb-6">
0442:         <label className="text-xs text-gray-400 block mb-1">Konfigurer enhed</label>
0443:         <select className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm"
0444:           value={selectedDevice} onChange={e => setSelectedDevice(e.target.value)}>
0445:           {devices.map(d => (
0446:             <option key={d.device_id} value={d.device_id}>
0447:               {d.camera_name || d.location_name || d.device_id} ({d.device_id})
0448:             </option>
0449:           ))}
0450:         </select>
0451:       </div>
0452: 
0453:       {/* Relay GPIO */}
0454:       <Section title="Relay & GPIO" icon={<Radio className="w-4 h-4" />}
0455:         description="Hardware GPIO pins til relæstyring og simuleringstilstand"
0456:         defaultOpen={true}>
0457:         <Field label="Kamera strømstyring"
0458:           description="relay = GPIO styrer kameraforsyning; usb_powered = kameraet har konstant USB/batteri og går selv i standby">
0459:           <select className="w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm"
0460:             value={cameraPowerMode} onChange={e => setCameraPowerMode(e.target.value)}>
0461:             <option value="relay">relay</option>
0462:             <option value="usb_powered">usb_powered</option>
0463:           </select>
0464:         </Field>
0465:         <Field label="Kamera relay GPIO pin" unit="sysfs"
0466:           description="GPIO nummer i sysfs (fx 356 = physical pin 7 på Orange Pi 4 Pro)">
0467:           <Num value={relayGpioCamera} onChange={setRelayGpioCamera} placeholder="356" />
0468:         </Field>
0469:         <Field label="Modem relay GPIO pin" unit="sysfs"
0470:           description="GPIO nummer til modem/4G relay (fx 361 = physical pin 11)">
0471:           <Num value={relayGpioModem} onChange={setRelayGpioModem} placeholder="361" />
0472:         </Field>
0473:         <Field label="Relay varmetid" unit="sekunder"
0474:           description="Sekunder relay er tændt inden kamera-connect forsøges">
0475:           <Num value={relayOnBefore} onChange={setRelayOnBefore} placeholder="10" />
0476:         </Field>
0477:         <Field label="Relay nedkølingstid" unit="sekunder"
0478:           description="Sekunder relay forbliver tændt efter capture er downloadet">
0479:           <Num value={relayOffAfter} onChange={setRelayOffAfter} placeholder="5" />
0480:         </Field>
0481:         <Field label="Relay simulering"
0482:           description="Aktivér for at køre uden fysisk relay (test/development)">
0483:           <Toggle value={relaySimulate} onChange={setRelaySimulate} />
0484:         </Field>
0485:       </Section>
0486: 
0487:       {/* Relay tester */}
0488:       <Section title="Relay test" icon={<Zap className="w-4 h-4" />}
0489:         description="Test og toggle relay udgange manuelt — kræver LAB mode">
0490:         {selectedDevice && <RelayTester deviceId={selectedDevice} labActive={labActive} />}
0491:       </Section>
0492: 
0493:       {/* Kamera timeouts */}
0494:       <Section title="Kamera timeouts" icon={<Camera className="w-4 h-4" />}
0495:         description="Timeout parametre for gphoto2 capture og download">
0496:         <Field label="Capture timeout" unit="sekunder"
0497:           description="Maksimal ventetid på at gphoto2 trigger og downloader billede">
0498:           <Num value={captureTimeout} onChange={setCaptureTimeout} placeholder="60" />
0499:         </Field>
0500:         <Field label="Download timeout" unit="sekunder"
0501:           description="Maksimal ventetid på filoverførsel fra kamera til edge SSD">
0502:           <Num value={downloadTimeout} onChange={setDownloadTimeout} placeholder="30" />
0503:         </Field>
0504:       </Section>
0505: 
0506:       {/* Modem */}
0507:       <Section title="Modem & 4G" icon={<Wifi className="w-4 h-4" />}
0508:         description="Automatisk power cycling af 4G modem ved forbindelsesfejl">
0509:         <Field label="Power cycle efter N fejl"
0510:           description="Antal på hinanden følgende upload-fejl inden modem power cycles">
0511:           <Num value={modemCycleFailures} onChange={setModemCycleFailures} placeholder="3" />
0512:         </Field>
0513:         <Field label="Minimum interval mellem cycles" unit="sekunder"
0514:           description="Minimumstid mellem to modem power cycles (undgår rapid cycling)">

0231:       if (selected.size === 0) {
0232:         setAiNote('AI fandt ingen billeder i det aktuelle udvalg. Prøv at gøre søgningen bredere.')
0233:       } else {
0234:         setExcluded(new Set(frames.filter(f => !selected.has(f.id)).map(f => f.id)))
0235:         setAiNote(data.selection?.explanation || `AI valgte ${selected.size} af ${frames.length} billeder`)
0236:       }
0237:     } catch (e: any) {
0238:       setAiNote(`AI-udvalg fejlede: ${e.message ?? 'ukendt fejl'}`)
0239:     } finally {
0240:       setAiSelecting(false)
0241:     }
0242:   }
0243: 
0244:   // ── Beregn statistik ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0245: 
0246:   const selectedFrames = frames.filter(f => !excluded.has(f.id))
0247:   const duration_s     = selectedFrames.length / settings.fps
0248:   const failedCount    = frames.filter(f => !f.quality_passed).length
0249: 
0250:   // ── Start render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0251:

0255:     setJob(null)

0258:         method: 'POST',

0260:           device_id:          deviceId,
0261:           frame_ids:          selectedFrames.map(f => f.id),
0262:           fps:                settings.fps,
0263:           resolution:         settings.resolution,
0264:           codec:              settings.codec,
0265:           deflicker:          settings.deflicker,
0266:           fade_frames:        settings.fade_frames,
0267:           timestamp_overlay:  settings.timestamp_overlay,
0268:           timestamp_position: settings.timestamp_position,
0269:           timestamp_format:   settings.timestamp_format,
0270:           ken_burns:          settings.ken_burns,
0271:           crop_ratio:         settings.crop_ratio,
0272:           title:              settings.title || 'timelapse',
0273:         })
0274:       })
0275:       setJob({ ...result, status: 'queued', progress: 0, error: null, title: settings.title })
0276:       // Poll status
0277:       pollRef.current = setInterval(async () => {
0278:         try {
0279:           const status = await apiCall(`/api/timelapse/status/${result.job_id}`)
0280:           setJob(s => ({ ...s, ...status }))
0281:           if (status.status === 'done' || status.status === 'error') {
0282:             clearInterval(pollRef.current!)
0283:             setRendering(false)
0284:           }
0285:         } catch {
0286:           clearInterval(pollRef.current!)
0287:           setRendering(false)
0288:         }
0289:       }, 1000)
0290:     } catch (e: any) {
0291:       setRendering(false)
0292:       alert('Render fejlede: ' + (e.message ?? 'Ukendt fejl'))
0293:     }
0294:   }
0295: 
0296:   useEffect(() => () => { if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current) }, [])
0297: 
0298:   const apiUrl = getApiUrl()
0299:

0315:       </div>

0317:       <div className="max-w-screen-2xl mx-auto px-4 py-6 grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-[380px_1fr] gap-6">

0708:

0074: // ── Password styrke ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
0075: function PwStrength({ pw, policy }: { pw: string; policy: Policy | null }) {
0076:   if (!policy || !pw) return null
0077:   const checks = [
0078:     { ok: pw.length >= policy.min_length,        label: `Mindst ${policy.min_length} tegn` },
0079:     { ok: !policy.require_uppercase || /[A-Z]/.test(pw), label: 'Stort bogstav', hide: !policy.require_uppercase },
0080:     { ok: !policy.require_number    || /[0-9]/.test(pw), label: 'Tal',           hide: !policy.require_number },
0081:     { ok: !policy.require_special   || /[!@#$%^&*]/.test(pw), label: 'Specialtegn', hide: !policy.require_special },
0082:   ].filter(c => !c.hide)
0083: 
0084:   const score = checks.filter(c => c.ok).length
0085:   const pct   = Math.round((score / checks.length) * 100)
0086:   const color = pct < 50 ? 'bg-red-400' : pct < 100 ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-emerald-500'
0087: 
0088:   return (
0089:     <div className="mt-1.5 space-y-1.5">
0090:       <div className="h-1.5 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
0091:         <div className={`h-full transition-all ${color}`} style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
0092:       </div>
0093:       <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5">
0094:         {checks.map(c => (
0095:           <span key={c.label} className={`text-xs flex items-center gap-1 ${c.ok ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
0096:             {c.ok ? <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> : <X className="w-3 h-3" />}
0097:             {c.label}
0098:           </span>
0099:         ))}
0100:       </div>
0101:     </div>
0102:   )
0103: }

0183:   const [newRole,   setNewRole]   = useState<Role>('viewer')
0184:   const [newCust,   setNewCust]   = useState('')

0186:   const [createErr, setCreateErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
0187: 
0188:   // Skift password

0190:   const [newPwFor,   setNewPwFor]   = useState('')
0191:   const [changePwErr,setChangePwErr]= useState<string | null>(null)
0192:   const [editId,     setEditId]     = useState<number | null>(null)
0193:   const [editRole,   setEditRole]   = useState<Role>('viewer')
0194:   const [editEmail,  setEditEmail]  = useState('')
0195:   const [editCust,   setEditCust]   = useState('')
0196:   const [editActive, setEditActive] = useState(true)
0197:   const [editErr,    setEditErr]    = useState<string | null>(null)
0198:   const [editSaving,    setEditSaving]    = useState(false)
0199:   const [mfaId,         setMfaId]         = useState<number | null>(null)
0200:   const [mfaQr,         setMfaQr]         = useState('')
0201:   const [mfaSecret,     setMfaSecret]     = useState('')
0202:   const [mfaCode,       setMfaCode]       = useState('')
0203:   const [mfaErr,        setMfaErr]        = useState<string | null>(null)
0204:   const [mfaSaving,     setMfaSaving]     = useState(false)
0205:   const [waId,          setWaId]          = useState<number | null>(null)
0206:   const [waDeviceName,  setWaDeviceName]  = useState('')
0207:   const [waCredentials, setWaCredentials] = useState<any[]>([])

0209:   const [waErr,         setWaErr]         = useState<string | null>(null)

0211:   const load = () => {
0212:     setLoading(true)
0213:     Promise.all([
0214:       api('/api/admin/users'),
0215:       api('/api/admin/customers').catch(() => []),
0216:       api('/api/admin/password-policy').catch(() => ({ min_length: 8, require_uppercase: false, require_number: false, require_special: false })),
0217:     ]).then(([u, c, p]) => {
0218:       setUsers(Array.isArray(u) ? u : (u.users ?? []))
0219:       setCustomers(Array.isArray(c) ? c : (c.customers ?? []))
0220:       setPolicy(p)
0221:     }).catch(e => setError(e.message))
0222:       .finally(() => setLoading(false))
0223:   }
0224: 
0225:   useEffect(load, [])
0226: 
0227:   async function createUser() {
0228:     if (!newUser || !newPw) return
0229:     setCreating(true)
0230:     setCreateErr(null)
0231:     try {
0232:       await api('/api/admin/users', {
0233:         method: 'POST',
0234:         body: JSON.stringify({
0235:           username:    newUser,
0236:           password:    newPw,
0237:           role:        newRole,
0238:           email:       newEmail || `${newUser}@timelapse.local`,
0239:           customer_id: newCust || null,
0240:         }),
0241:       })
0242:       setShowNew(false)
0243:       setNewUser(''); setNewPw(''); setNewEmail(''); setNewRole('viewer'); setNewCust('')
0244:       load()
0245:     } catch (e: any) { setCreateErr(e.message) }
0246:     finally { setCreating(false) }
0247:   }

0249:   async function deleteUser(id: number) {
0250:     if (!confirm('Slet bruger?')) return
0251:     await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(e => alert(e.message))
0252:     load()
0253:   }

0255:   function startEdit(u: UserRec) {
0256:     setEditId(u.id)
0257:     setEditRole(u.role)
0258:     setEditEmail(u.email ?? '')
0259:     setEditCust(u.customer_id ?? '')
0260:     setEditActive(u.is_active)
0261:     setEditErr(null)
0262:   }
0263: 
0264:   async function saveEdit(id: number) {

0267:       await api(`/api/admin/users/${id}`, {
0268:         method: 'PUT',
0269:         body: JSON.stringify({ role: editRole, email: editEmail || null, customer_id: editCust || null, is_active: editActive })
0270:       })
0271:       setEditId(null)
0272:       load()
0273:     } catch (e: any) { setEditErr(e.message) }
0274:     finally { setEditSaving(false) }
0275:   }
0276: 
0277:   async function startMfaSetup(id: number) {

0281:       setMfaQr(d.qr_code); setMfaSecret(d.secret)
0282:     } catch (e: any) { setMfaErr(e.message) }
0283:   }
0284: 
0285:   async function confirmMfaSetup(id: number) {
0286:     setMfaSaving(true); setMfaErr(null)
0287:     try {
0288:       await api('/api/auth/confirm-mfa', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: mfaCode }) })
0289:       setMfaId(null); load()
0290:     } catch (e: any) { setMfaErr(e.message) }
0291:     finally { setMfaSaving(false) }
0292:   }
0293: 
0294:   async function disableMfa(id: number) {
0295:     setMfaSaving(true); setMfaErr(null)
0296:     try {
0297:       await api('/api/auth/disable-mfa', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: id }) })
0298:       setMfaId(null); load()
0299:     } catch (e: any) { setMfaErr(e.message) }
0300:     finally { setMfaSaving(false) }
0301:   }
0302: 
0303:   async function openWebAuthn(u: UserRec) {
0304:     setWaId(u.id); setWaErr(null); setWaDeviceName(''); setWaLoading(true)
0305:     try {
0306:       if (u.username === me?.username) {
0307:         const creds = await api(`/api/auth/webauthn/credentials`)
0308:         setWaCredentials(creds)
0309:       } else {
0310:         setWaCredentials([])
0311:       }
0312:     } catch { setWaCredentials([]) }
0313:     finally { setWaLoading(false) }
0314:   }
0315: 
0316:   async function registerWebAuthn() {
0317:     setWaErr(null); setWaLoading(true)
0318:     try {
0319:       const opts = await api('/api/auth/webauthn/register-begin', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({}) })
0320:       const result = await startRegistration({ optionsJSON: opts })
0321:       await api('/api/auth/webauthn/register-complete', {
0322:         method: 'POST',
0323:         body: JSON.stringify({ ...result, deviceName: waDeviceName || 'Denne enhed' })
0324:       })
0325:       const creds = await api('/api/auth/webauthn/credentials')
0326:       setWaCredentials(creds)
0327:       setWaDeviceName('')
0328:     } catch (e: any) {
0329:       setWaErr(e.message ?? 'Registrering fejlede')
0330:     } finally { setWaLoading(false) }
0331:   }
0332: 
0333:   async function deleteWebAuthnCred(credId: number) {
0334:     try {
0335:       await api(`/api/auth/webauthn/credentials/${credId}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
0336:       setWaCredentials(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== credId))
0337:     } catch (e: any) { setWaErr(e.message) }
0338:   }
0339: 
0340:   async function changePassword(id: number) {
0341:     if (!newPwFor) return
0342:     setChangePwErr(null)
0343:     try {

0345:         method: 'PUT',
0346:         body: JSON.stringify({ password: newPwFor }),
0347:       })
0348:       setChangePwId(null); setNewPwFor('')

0350:   }
